attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 country/region code representing the household's primary geographic location. Used for regional assortment personalization, geo-targeted marketing campaigns, and compliance with jurisdiction-specific data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA).

attributes.name: household_name
attributes.description: The display name assigned to the household unit, typically derived from the primary member's surname (e.g., 'The Johnson Household'). Used for personalized communications, loyalty program correspondence, and CRM segmentation in Salesforce and Adobe Experience Platform.

attributes.name: household_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the household record. 'active' indicates an operational household with at least one active member; 'merged' indicates the household was consolidated into another; 'dissolved' indicates all members have been disassociated; 'pending' indicates formation in progress.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Customer Data Platform

attributes.name: household_type
attributes.description: Classification of the household composition for segmentation and personalization strategies. 'family' denotes multi-generational or parent-child units; 'couple' denotes two-adult units; 'individual' denotes a single-person household; 'shared_residence' denotes non-family cohabitants; 'corporate' denotes a business account grouped as a household.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Customer Data Platform; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: identity_resolution_code
attributes.description: The unique identity graph node identifier assigned by Adobe Experience Platform's identity resolution service, linking the household to its constituent individual identity fragments across devices, channels, and touchpoints. Used for cross-channel attribution and personalization.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Customer Data Platform; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: last_purchase_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent purchase transaction made by any member of the household across all channels (DTC, retail store, e-commerce). Used for recency scoring in RFM (Recency, Frequency, Monetary) analysis, lapse detection, and win-back campaign targeting.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository; Salesforce Commerce Cloud

attributes.name: loyalty_points_balance
attributes.description: Current accumulated loyalty points balance at the household level, reflecting the combined earning activity of all associated members. Used for redemption eligibility, tier qualification, and household-level reward management.

attributes.name: loyalty_tier
attributes.description: Current loyalty tier assigned to the household based on combined member spend and engagement. Determines household-level benefits, early access to collections, and exclusive event invitations across DTC, retail, and e-commerce channels.

attributes.name: marketing_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household has consented to receive marketing communications at the household level. True = opted in; False = opted out. Governs household-level campaign eligibility in compliance with GDPR and CCPA consent requirements.

attributes.name: member_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual customer profiles currently associated with this household unit. Used for household-size-based segmentation, family apparel category targeting, and loyalty tier qualification. Reflects active members only.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Customer Data Platform

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Most recent Net Promoter Score recorded at the household level, ranging from 0 to 10. NPS = Net Promoter Score. Captures household-level brand advocacy and satisfaction. Used for retention strategy, service recovery prioritization, and brand health reporting.

attributes.name: nps_survey_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent NPS survey response was recorded for this household. Used to assess recency of satisfaction data and to schedule follow-up surveys in compliance with survey frequency guidelines.

attributes.name: preferred_apparel_category
attributes.description: The primary apparel category (e.g., athletic, lifestyle, luxury, footwear, accessories) most frequently purchased by household members. Derived from purchase history and used to drive personalized product recommendations, collection previews, and targeted marketing campaigns.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Customer Data Platform

attributes.name: preferred_channel
attributes.description: The primary shopping channel through which the household most frequently transacts, as identified from purchase history analysis. DTC = Direct-to-Consumer. Used for channel-specific personalization, targeted promotions, and omnichannel engagement strategies.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Customer Data Platform; Salesforce Commerce Cloud

attributes.name: purchase_frequency
attributes.description: Total number of distinct purchase transactions made by all household members within the current fiscal year across all channels. Used as the frequency dimension in RFM (Recency, Frequency, Monetary) analysis and for loyalty tier qualification.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository; Salesforce Commerce Cloud

attributes.name: return_rate
attributes.description: Ratio of returned items to total purchased items across all household members within the current fiscal year, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.1500 = 15%). Used for returns risk scoring, fraud detection, and after-sales service prioritization.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Salesforce Commerce Cloud

attributes.name: rfid_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household has opted into RFID-based in-store personalization services, enabling smart fitting room experiences and automated loyalty point capture at RFID-equipped retail locations. RFID = Radio Frequency Identification.
attributes.references: FTC - Consumer Privacy Guidelines; GDPR Article 6

attributes.name: sms_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household has provided explicit consent to receive SMS/text marketing communications. True = consented; False = not consented or withdrawn. Managed in compliance with TCPA, GDPR Article 6, and CCPA.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this household record was originally created or last authoritatively updated. Used for data lineage tracking, conflict resolution during identity stitching, and audit compliance. AEP = Adobe Experience Platform; SFCC = Salesforce Commerce Cloud; SAP CAR = SAP Customer Activity Repository.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform; Salesforce CRM; SAP Customer Activity Repository

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The UTC timestamp when the household record was most recently modified in the Databricks Silver Layer. Used for change data capture (CDC), incremental ETL processing, and audit trail compliance.

attributes.name: vip_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household has been designated as a VIP account, qualifying for exclusive services such as personal styling appointments, early collection access, private sale invitations, and dedicated client advisor support.

products.name: loyalty_program
products.description: Master definition of loyalty program tiers, rules, and configurations offered by Apparel Fashion. Captures program name, tier structure (e.g., Silver, Gold, Platinum), points earning rules, redemption thresholds, expiry policies, eligible channel flags (DTC, retail, e-commerce), program launch date, and program status. Serves as the reference template against which individual enrollments are tracked.

attributes.name: loyalty_program_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the loyalty program record. Serves as the primary key for all downstream enrollment, tier, and points tracking references.

attributes.name: circular_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.circular_program. Business justification: Loyalty programs integrate circular economy incentives (points for garment returns, trade-in bonuses). Links loyalty mechanics to sustainability initiatives for program design, points calculation rule

attributes.name: customer_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.segment. Business justification: loyalty_program has eligible_customer_segment (STRING) defining which segment can enroll. Normalizing to FK enables referential integrity for program eligibility rules. Note: This is a simplified 1:N

attributes.name: annual_fee
attributes.description: Recurring annual fee charged to maintain active membership in the loyalty program. A value of 0.00 indicates no annual fee. Used for subscription-based program revenue recognition.

attributes.name: birthday_bonus_points
attributes.description: Number of bonus loyalty points awarded to a member during their birthday month or on their birthday date as a program benefit. A value of 0 indicates no birthday bonus.

attributes.name: ccpa_opt_out_supported
attributes.business_glossary_term: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Opt-Out Supported
attributes.description: Indicates whether this loyalty program supports the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) right to opt out of the sale of personal information, applicable to members in California.
attributes.references: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA); Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: cltv_segment_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether members enrolled in this program are included in Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV) segmentation models run through Adobe Experience Platform for personalization and targeted marketing.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this loyalty program record was first created in the data platform. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; GDPR Article 5; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which monetary thresholds, rewards values, and redemption amounts for this program are denominated (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP').

attributes.name: eligible_country_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes identifying the geographic markets where this loyalty program is available for enrollment (e.g., 'USA,CAN,GBR'). Null indicates global availability.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the loyalty program is scheduled to close or was retired. Null for open-ended programs. Used to manage program sunset communications and enrollment cutoffs.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: enrollment_fee
attributes.description: One-time fee charged to a customer upon joining the loyalty program. A value of 0.00 indicates the program is free to join. Applicable primarily to subscription-type programs.

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether explicit GDPR consent must be captured from members at enrollment for this program, applicable to programs operating in EU jurisdictions. Drives consent management workflows.

attributes.name: is_dtc_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether members can earn and redeem points through the Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) channel, including brand-owned retail stores and owned digital storefronts.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud; Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: is_ecommerce_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether members can earn and redeem points through the e-commerce channel, including the brand's online store and digital marketplace integrations.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud; Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: is_partner_earn_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether members can earn loyalty points through purchases or activities with third-party partner brands or co-branded programs affiliated with Apparel Fashion.

attributes.name: is_retail_store_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether members can earn and redeem points at physical retail store locations via POS transactions tracked through SAP Customer Activity Repository.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository; Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: is_wholesale_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether B2B wholesale account holders are eligible to participate in this loyalty program and earn rewards on wholesale purchase volumes.

attributes.name: launch_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the loyalty program became publicly available and open for customer enrollment. Used for program age calculations and anniversary promotions.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud; Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: max_points_balance
attributes.description: Maximum cumulative points balance a member may hold at any time. Enforces program liability ceiling and prevents excessive point accumulation. Null indicates no cap.

attributes.name: max_points_per_transaction
attributes.description: Cap on the number of loyalty points that can be earned in a single transaction. Prevents abuse of promotional multipliers and controls program liability exposure per event.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; FTC Consumer Protection Guidelines

attributes.name: nps_tracking_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether Net Promoter Score (NPS) surveys are triggered for members of this loyalty program to measure customer satisfaction and advocacy. Supports CRM and brand management analytics.

attributes.name: personalization_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether Adobe Experience Platform personalization and AI-driven offer targeting is activated for members of this loyalty program, enabling tailored product recommendations and promotions.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform; GDPR Article 22; CCPA

attributes.name: points_earning_rate
attributes.description: Base number of loyalty points awarded per unit of currency spent (e.g., 1.0000 point per USD spent). Tier-specific multipliers may override this base rate at the enrollment level.

attributes.name: points_expiry_months
attributes.description: Number of months after which unspent loyalty points expire from a member's account if no qualifying activity occurs. A value of 0 or null indicates points do not expire.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; FTC Consumer Protection Guidelines

attributes.name: points_expiry_policy
attributes.description: Rule governing when points expire: rolling resets the expiry window on each qualifying activity; fixed_anniversary expires points on the member's enrollment anniversary; no_expiry means points never expire; calendar_year expires all points at year-end.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; FTC Consumer Protection Guidelines

attributes.name: points_monetary_value
attributes.description: Monetary value assigned to a single loyalty point at redemption (e.g., 0.010000 USD per point). Used to calculate reward discount amounts and program liability on the balance sheet.

attributes.name: points_redemption_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum accumulated points balance a member must hold before they are eligible to redeem points for rewards or discounts. Enforces program economics and prevents micro-redemptions.

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the loyalty program across all channels and systems (e.g., 'AF_REWARDS_2024'). Used in EDI, CRM, and POS integrations as the canonical business identifier.

attributes.name: program_description
attributes.description: Full marketing and operational description of the loyalty program, including its value proposition, key benefits, and eligibility criteria as communicated to customers and internal stakeholders.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud; Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: program_name
attributes.description: Human-readable marketing name of the loyalty program as presented to customers across DTC, retail, and e-commerce channels (e.g., 'Apparel Fashion Rewards').
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud; Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: program_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the loyalty program. Active programs accept new enrollments and transactions; draft programs are in configuration; suspended programs are temporarily halted; retired programs are closed to new activity.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: program_type
attributes.description: Classification of the loyalty program structure. Points-based programs award redeemable points per transaction; tiered programs unlock benefits at spend thresholds; cashback returns a percentage of spend; subscription requires a membership fee; hybrid combines multiple mechanics.

attributes.name: redemption_increment
attributes.description: Minimum unit of points that can be redeemed in a single transaction (e.g., points must be redeemed in multiples of 100). Ensures redemption amounts align with reward value denominations.

attributes.name: referral_bonus_points
attributes.description: Number of loyalty points awarded to an existing member when they successfully refer a new customer who enrolls in the program. Supports member acquisition through word-of-mouth incentives.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this loyalty program configuration was originated or is mastered (e.g., SFCC for Salesforce Commerce Cloud, AEP for Adobe Experience Platform).
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud; Adobe Experience Platform; SAP S/4HANA

attributes.name: terms_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current version of the loyalty program terms and conditions became legally effective. Members enrolled before this date may require re-consent notification.
attributes.references: FTC Consumer Protection Guidelines; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: terms_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the loyalty program's terms and conditions document currently in effect (e.g., 'v2.1'). Used to track member consent to specific T&C versions and manage regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: FTC Consumer Protection Guidelines; GDPR Article 7; CCPA

attributes.name: tier_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct membership tiers defined within this loyalty program (e.g., 3 for Silver, Gold, Platinum). Drives tier configuration and progression rule setup.

attributes.name: tier_qualification_metric
attributes.description: The primary metric used to determine a member's tier eligibility and progression (e.g., cumulative spend amount, total points earned, number of transactions, or units purchased within the qualification period).

attributes.name: tier_qualification_period_months
attributes.description: Rolling or fixed window in months over which a member's qualifying activity is measured for tier assignment or maintenance (e.g., 12 months for annual tier review).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this loyalty program record in the data platform. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change detection and incremental processing.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; GDPR Article 5; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: welcome_bonus_points
attributes.description: Number of bonus loyalty points awarded to a new member upon successful enrollment in the program. A value of 0 indicates no welcome bonus is offered.

products.name: loyalty_enrollment
products.description: Tracks each customer's active enrollment in a loyalty program including current tier status, points balance, and full transaction history of points movements. Captures enrollment date, current tier, tier qualification/expiry dates, lifetime points earned, redeemable balance, enrollment channel, and a ledger of all earn/redeem/adjust/expire/bonus events with timestamps, triggering references, and running balances. Provides complete loyalty lifecycle per customer.

attributes.name: loyalty_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate key identifying each loyalty program enrollment record. One record per customer-program combination.

attributes.name: acquisition_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Loyalty enrollments are frequently driven by specific acquisition campaigns (sign-up bonuses, enrollment promotions). Essential for calculating campaign-specific CAC, measuring enrollment campaign eff

attributes.name: current_tier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loyalty tier definition the customer currently holds (e.g., Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum). Drives benefit entitlements and earn rate multipliers.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform CDP; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: loyalty_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loyalty program definition this enrollment belongs to (e.g., Rewards Club, VIP Program, Wholesale Partner Program).
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform CDP; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: primary_loyalty_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer who is enrolled in the loyalty program. Links to the customer master record in the CRM/CDP.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform CDP; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: retail_store_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retail store location where the customer enrolled, if the enrollment channel was in-store. Null for digital enrollments.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (POS); Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: ccpa_opt_out_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Opt-Out Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has exercised their California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) right to opt out of the sale or sharing of their personal information. Applicable to California-resident members.
attributes.references: CCPA Section 1798.120; California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this loyalty enrollment record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and GDPR accountability requirements.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the monetary values recorded in this enrollment (e.g., tier qualification spend, reward monetary equivalents). Supports multi-currency loyalty programs.

attributes.name: data_retention_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this enrollment record is subject to a legal hold or data retention requirement that prevents deletion even after termination. Set by legal or compliance teams.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17; CCPA Section 1798.105; IFRS/GAAP Record Retention Requirements

attributes.name: enrollment_channel
attributes.description: The Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) or wholesale channel through which the customer enrolled in the loyalty program. Supports channel attribution and omnichannel analytics.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform CDP; SAP Customer Activity Repository (POS)

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the customer formally enrolled in the loyalty program. Used for anniversary calculations, tenure segmentation, and cohort analysis.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform CDP; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: enrollment_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable enrollment reference number used in customer communications, receipts, and CRM lookups. Follows the format LYL-XXXXXXXXXX.
attributes.references: Internal CRM Naming Convention; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the loyalty enrollment. Active = earning and redeeming; Suspended = temporarily blocked; Terminated = permanently closed; Pending = awaiting verification; Frozen = points locked pending investigation.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform CDP; Salesforce CRM; GDPR Article 17

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_date
attributes.description: Date on which the member provided GDPR consent for loyalty data processing. Required for audit trail and regulatory compliance demonstration under GDPR Article 7(1).
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; GDPR Article 5(2) Accountability Principle

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has provided explicit consent for personal data processing under GDPR Article 6 for loyalty program purposes. Mandatory for EU-resident members.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; GDPR Article 7; European Data Protection Board Guidelines

attributes.name: last_activity_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent qualifying loyalty activity (earn, redeem, or bonus event) by this member. Used to identify inactive members, trigger re-engagement campaigns, and enforce inactivity-based points expiry policies.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform CDP; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: last_transaction_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent purchase transaction that generated a loyalty points earn event. Distinct from last_activity_date which may include non-purchase activities such as profile updates or bonus events.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (POS); Salesforce Commerce Cloud

attributes.name: lifetime_points_earned
attributes.description: Total cumulative points earned by the customer since enrollment inception, including all earn, bonus, and adjustment credits. Used for Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV) analysis and VIP qualification.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform CDP; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: lifetime_points_expired
attributes.description: Total cumulative points that have expired due to inactivity or program policy since enrollment inception. Used for program liability management and customer re-engagement targeting.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform CDP; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: lifetime_points_redeemed
attributes.description: Total cumulative points redeemed by the customer since enrollment inception. Used to measure program engagement and redemption rate analytics.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform CDP; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: member_card_number
attributes.description: Physical or virtual loyalty card number issued to the member. Used for in-store Point of Sale (POS) identification, RFID scanning, and customer service lookups. Classified as confidential PII identifier.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; SAP Customer Activity Repository (POS)

attributes.name: member_card_type
attributes.description: Format of the loyalty card issued to the member. Physical = plastic card; Virtual = app-based barcode; RFID = contactless chip card; Digital Wallet = Apple/Google Wallet pass.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (POS); Adobe Experience Platform CDP

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Most recent Net Promoter Score (NPS) survey response from this loyalty member, on a scale of 0-10. Used to segment promoters, passives, and detractors for loyalty program satisfaction analysis.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform CDP; Salesforce CRM; NPS Methodology (Bain & Company)

attributes.name: nps_survey_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent NPS survey response was captured for this loyalty member. Used to determine survey recency and schedule follow-up surveys.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform CDP; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: opt_in_email
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has opted in to receive loyalty-related email communications including points statements, tier upgrade notifications, and exclusive member offers.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; CCPA Section 1798.120; CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: opt_in_push
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has opted in to receive mobile push notifications for loyalty events such as points earned, tier changes, and reward availability.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; CCPA Section 1798.120; Adobe Experience Platform CDP

attributes.name: opt_in_sms
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has opted in to receive loyalty-related SMS/text message communications including points alerts and promotional offers.

attributes.name: pending_points
attributes.description: Points earned from recent transactions that are not yet confirmed as redeemable, typically held during a return window or fraud review period before being credited to the redeemable balance.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform CDP; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: points_balance
attributes.description: Current redeemable points balance available to the customer for redemption against purchases, rewards, or experiences. Reflects all earned, redeemed, adjusted, and expired points.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform CDP; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: points_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current redeemable points balance (or the oldest tranche of points) will expire if no qualifying activity occurs. Drives expiry notification campaigns.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform CDP; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: referral_source_code
attributes.description: Campaign or referral code used at enrollment to attribute the sign-up to a specific marketing campaign, influencer, or existing member referral. Supports Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) and campaign ROI analysis.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform CDP; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this enrollment was originated or last updated. AEP = Adobe Experience Platform; SFCC = Salesforce Commerce Cloud; SAP_CAR = SAP Customer Activity Repository; CRM = Salesforce CRM; MANUAL = manual entry.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform CDP; Salesforce Commerce Cloud; SAP Customer Activity Repository

attributes.name: source_system_member_code
attributes.description: The member or enrollment identifier as recorded in the originating source system (e.g., AEP profile ID, Salesforce Contact ID). Used for cross-system reconciliation and data lineage tracing.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform CDP; Salesforce CRM; GDPR Article 5(2)

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the loyalty enrollment was terminated or closed, either by customer request, program policy, or fraud investigation outcome. Null for active enrollments.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure); CCPA Section 1798.105; Adobe Experience Platform CDP

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the loyalty enrollment was terminated. Used for compliance reporting, program analytics, and customer win-back strategy.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17; CCPA Section 1798.105; FTC Textile and Apparel Regulations

attributes.name: tier_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the customer's current tier status became effective. Used to calculate tier tenure and determine when the next tier review is due.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform CDP; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: tier_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the customer's current tier qualification expires and is subject to re-evaluation based on qualifying spend or activity. Null for lifetime tiers.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform CDP; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: tier_qualification_spend
attributes.description: Cumulative qualifying spend amount (in program currency) accumulated by the customer within the current tier qualification period. Compared against tier thresholds to determine tier status.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform CDP; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this loyalty enrollment record was most recently modified in the data platform. Used for incremental data processing, change detection, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(2) Accountability Principle; ISO 8601; Databricks Delta Lake

products.name: segment
products.description: Defines named market segments used to classify B2C and B2B customers for personalization, merchandising, and marketing targeting. Captures segment name, segment type (behavioral, demographic, psychographic, RFM, channel-based), definition criteria, segment owner (marketing vs. merchandising), creation date, and active status. Segments are managed in Adobe Experience Platform and synced to CRM for campaign activation.

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Primary key for segment

attributes.name: parent_segment_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to a parent segment when this segment is a sub-segment or refinement of a broader segment hierarchy (e.g., 'High-Value Female Loyalists' as a child of 'High-Value Loyalists'). Supports hierarchical segment structures for nested targeting.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - Segment Hierarchy; Internal Segmentation Taxonomy

attributes.name: age_band_max
attributes.description: Maximum age (in years) of the target demographic for this segment. Used in demographic segmentation to define the upper bound of the age range for personalization and marketing targeting.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 8 - Child Consent; CCPA - Age-Based Data Handling

attributes.name: age_band_min
attributes.description: Minimum age (in years) of the target demographic for this segment. Used in demographic segmentation to define the lower bound of the age range for personalization and marketing targeting.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 8 - Child Consent; CCPA - Age-Based Data Handling

attributes.name: campaign_budget_usd
attributes.description: Planned marketing spend budget allocated to campaigns targeting this segment, expressed in USD. Used for marketing financial planning in Anaplan and ROI measurement. Classified as confidential as it reflects internal budget allocation strategy.
attributes.references: Anaplan - Marketing Financial Planning; Internal Budget Governance Policy

attributes.name: channel_scope
attributes.description: The commerce channel(s) this segment is scoped to. DTC (Direct-to-Consumer) covers owned e-commerce and retail stores; wholesale covers B2B accounts; omnichannel covers all channels. Drives channel-specific activation in Salesforce Commerce Cloud and SAP Customer Activity Repository.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud - Channel Configuration; SAP Customer Activity Repository

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this segment record was first created in the Apparel Fashion data platform. Provides audit trail for data lineage and governance compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 - Accountability; ISO/IEC 27001 - Audit Logging

attributes.name: crm_sync_status
attributes.description: Current synchronization status of this segment to Salesforce CRM for campaign activation. Synced indicates the segment definition and membership are current in CRM; pending indicates a sync is queued; failed indicates a sync error requiring investigation.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Data Sync Framework; Adobe Experience Platform - Destination Activation

attributes.name: crm_sync_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent successful synchronization of this segment to Salesforce CRM. Used to monitor data freshness and SLA compliance for campaign activation pipelines.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Data Sync Audit; Adobe Experience Platform - Activation Monitoring

attributes.name: customer_class
attributes.description: Indicates whether the segment targets B2C (individual consumers), B2B (wholesale accounts), household-level groupings, or enterprise partnerships. Drives different activation logic and CRM workflows in Salesforce and Adobe Experience Platform.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Account Type Classification; Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: data_consent_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether activation of this segment requires verified customer consent under GDPR or CCPA regulations. When true, only profiles with explicit consent records in Adobe Experience Platform may be included in segment activations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 - Lawfulness of Processing; CCPA Section 1798.100; Adobe Experience Platform - Consent Management

attributes.name: data_sensitivity_level
attributes.description: Data classification level assigned to this segment definition based on the sensitivity of its qualifying criteria and the customer data it processes. Restricted segments may involve sensitive demographic or behavioral data requiring heightened access controls per GDPR and CCPA.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 9 - Special Categories of Data; CCPA; Internal Data Classification Policy

attributes.name: definition_criteria
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the business rules and logic used to qualify customers into this segment (e.g., 'Customers with 3+ purchases in last 90 days, AOV > $150, active loyalty member'). Serves as the business specification for technical implementation in Adobe Experience Platform.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - Segment Builder; Salesforce CRM Segment Rules

attributes.name: definition_expression
attributes.description: Structured query expression or rule set (e.g., PQL — Profile Query Language from Adobe Experience Platform) that technically defines segment membership criteria. Enables automated re-evaluation and sync to CRM activation systems.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - Profile Query Language (PQL); Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this segment definition expires and is no longer used for active targeting. Nullable for evergreen segments with no planned expiry. Supports time-bound campaign segments tied to seasonal promotions or collection launches.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - Segment Lifecycle; Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Season Calendar

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this segment definition becomes active and eligible for campaign targeting and personalization activation. Supports seasonal and campaign-specific segment scheduling aligned with collection launches and promotional calendars.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - Segment Scheduling; Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Season Planning

attributes.name: estimated_size
attributes.description: Estimated count of customer profiles qualifying for this segment at the last evaluation run. Used for campaign reach planning, budget allocation, and marketing ROI forecasting. Sourced from Adobe Experience Platform segment evaluation output.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - Segment Evaluation; Anaplan - Marketing Planning

attributes.name: evaluation_frequency
attributes.description: How frequently the segment membership is re-evaluated and refreshed. Real-time segments update continuously via streaming; daily/weekly/monthly segments are refreshed on a scheduled batch cadence. Impacts campaign activation timeliness and system resource planning.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - Segment Scheduling; Salesforce CRM Sync

attributes.name: evaluation_method
attributes.description: Method by which Adobe Experience Platform evaluates segment membership. Batch evaluation runs on a scheduled cadence; streaming evaluation updates membership in near-real-time as profile events occur; edge evaluation enables on-device personalization at the point of interaction.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - Segment Evaluation Types

attributes.name: gender_affinity
attributes.description: Gender affinity profile of the segment used for product assortment targeting, personalization, and marketing creative selection. Informs merchandising allocation and collection planning for gender-specific product lines.
attributes.references: Internal Merchandising Standards; Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Assortment Planning

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Geographic market scope for this segment expressed as ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes or region identifiers (e.g., 'USA', 'GBR', 'DEU'). Supports geo-targeted campaign activation and regional merchandising decisions. Multiple values stored as comma-separated codes.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3 Country Codes; GDPR - Data Residency Requirements

attributes.name: lifecycle_stage
attributes.description: The customer lifecycle stage this segment targets. Acquisition segments target new prospects; activation targets first-time buyers; retention targets active loyal customers; reactivation targets declining customers; winback targets lapsed customers. Aligns with CRM and CLTV (Customer Lifetime Value) strategy.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Customer Lifecycle Framework; Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: loyalty_program_linked
attributes.description: Indicates whether this segment is linked to a loyalty program tier or reward structure. Loyalty-linked segments receive differentiated offers, early access to collections, and exclusive promotions managed through Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Loyalty Management; Internal Loyalty Program Policy

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for business analysts and segment owners to capture contextual notes, assumptions, known limitations, or activation guidance for this segment. Supports knowledge transfer and operational documentation.

attributes.name: nps_target_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this segment is designated as a target population for NPS (Net Promoter Score) survey distribution. NPS-targeted segments are used to measure customer satisfaction and brand loyalty across DTC and wholesale channels.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - NPS Survey Management; Internal Customer Experience KPI Framework

attributes.name: owner_function
attributes.description: The business function responsible for defining, maintaining, and activating this segment. Marketing-owned segments drive campaign targeting; merchandising-owned segments inform assortment and OTB planning; CRM-owned segments support loyalty and NPS programs.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Policy; Adobe Experience Platform - Segment Governance

attributes.name: owner_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual business owner or manager accountable for this segment's definition, quality, and activation. Supports data stewardship and governance workflows.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Policy; GDPR Article 5 - Accountability

attributes.name: personalization_use_case
attributes.description: Primary personalization or activation use case this segment supports (e.g., 'Email re-engagement campaign', 'Homepage product recommendation', 'Loyalty tier upgrade offer', 'Wholesale reorder reminder'). Guides campaign brief creation and Adobe Experience Platform activation configuration.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - Personalization Strategy; Salesforce Marketing Cloud

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking of this segment relative to other segments within the same owner function or campaign cycle. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used to resolve conflicts when a customer qualifies for multiple segments and to sequence campaign activation.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - Segment Priority; Salesforce Marketing Cloud - Audience Priority

attributes.name: rfm_tier
attributes.description: RFM (Recency, Frequency, Monetary) classification tier assigned to this segment when segment_type is 'rfm'. Champions are highest-value active buyers; loyal are consistent purchasers; at_risk are declining in engagement; lapsed have not purchased recently; prospects are new or low-activity customers.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - RFM Scoring Model; CRM Analytics Best Practices

attributes.name: season_code
attributes.description: Apparel season code associated with this segment when the segment is scoped to a specific merchandise season (e.g., 'SS2025' for Spring/Summer 2025, 'FW2024' for Fall/Winter 2024). Links segment activation to collection planning and merchandising calendars in Oracle Retail Merchandising System.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Season Management; Centric PLM - Collection Calendar

attributes.name: segment_code
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for the segment (e.g., 'LOYAL_VIP_B2C', 'WHOLESALE_TIER1'). Used as the stable reference key across Adobe Experience Platform, Salesforce CRM, and campaign activation systems.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - Segment Definition API; Salesforce CRM Segment Object

attributes.name: segment_name
attributes.description: Human-readable display name of the customer segment (e.g., 'High-Value Loyalists', 'Lapsed Wholesale Accounts', 'Gen-Z Streetwear Enthusiasts'). Used in campaign briefs, merchandising plans, and personalization dashboards.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - Audience Manager; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: segment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the segment. Active segments are available for campaign targeting and personalization. Draft segments are under construction. Inactive segments are paused. Archived segments are retained for historical analysis but not used in live activations.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - Segment Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: segment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the methodology used to define the segment. Behavioral segments are based on purchase/browse actions; demographic on age/gender/location; psychographic on lifestyle/values; RFM (Recency, Frequency, Monetary) on transactional scoring; channel_based on preferred shopping channel (DTC, wholesale, retail).
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - Segment Classification; CRM Best Practices

attributes.name: size_last_evaluated_date
attributes.description: Date on which the segment membership count (estimated_size) was last computed by Adobe Experience Platform. Indicates data freshness for campaign planning and audience activation decisions.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - Segment Evaluation Schedule

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record where this segment was originally created and is mastered. Adobe Experience Platform is the primary CDP for B2C segments; Salesforce CRM manages B2B wholesale account segments; Anaplan supports planning-driven segments; manual indicates analyst-defined segments.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - Segment API; Salesforce CRM - Segment Object

attributes.name: source_system_segment_code
attributes.description: The native identifier of this segment in the originating source system (e.g., Adobe Experience Platform Segment GUID, Salesforce CRM Segment Record ID). Enables bidirectional traceability and sync reconciliation between the lakehouse and operational systems.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - Segment Definition API; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: suppression_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this segment is a suppression list used to exclude customers from specific campaigns or communications (e.g., recent purchasers suppressed from acquisition campaigns, opted-out customers). Critical for compliance with GDPR and CCPA opt-out requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 21 - Right to Object; CCPA Section 1798.120 - Opt-Out Rights

attributes.name: tags_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of free-form business tags applied to this segment for discoverability, governance, and cross-functional search (e.g., 'loyalty,high-value,email-only,seasonal'). Supports segment catalog management in Adobe Experience Platform and internal data governance portals.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - Segment Tagging; Internal Data Catalog Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this segment record, including definition changes, status updates, or ownership reassignments. Supports change tracking and data freshness monitoring.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 - Accountability; ISO/IEC 27001 - Audit Logging

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Monotonically incrementing version number tracking revisions to the segment definition criteria. Enables audit trail of definition changes and supports rollback to prior versions when segment performance degrades.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - Segment Versioning; Internal Data Governance Policy

products.name: preference
products.description: SSOT for all explicit and inferred customer preferences, body measurements, and size profiles across apparel categories. Captures style affinities, fit preferences, color palettes, brand preferences, communication channel preferences, and detailed size/measurement data per category (tops, bottoms, outerwear, footwear, accessories). For each preference or measurement: records type, source (self-declared, behavioral inference, stylist-assigned, in-store body scan, virtual try-on), value with units, preferred brand size per category, confidence level, and last updated timestamp. Consolidates all personalization and fit inputs to feed recommendation engines, enable size/fit personalization, and reduce return rates in Adobe Experience Platform.

attributes.name: preference_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each customer preference or measurement record. Serves as the primary key for the preference data product.

attributes.name: customer_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.segment. Business justification: preference table has personalization_segment (STRING) for tagging preferences with segment context. Normalizing to FK enables linking preference patterns to segment definitions and supports segment-ba

attributes.name: ecolabel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.ecolabel. Business justification: Customers prefer certified products (GOTS, Fair Trade, OEKO-TEX). Enables filtering and personalized merchandising based on certification preferences. Supports targeted marketing campaigns for sustain

attributes.name: merchandise_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.merchandise_hierarchy. Business justification: Customer preferences map to specific product categories in the merchandise hierarchy. Powers recommendation engines, personalized emails, and size/style suggestions. Replaces denormalized apparel_cate

attributes.name: previous_preference_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the prior version of this preference record when it was superseded or updated. Enables preference history chaining and change tracking without a separate history table. Null for the initial version of a preference.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer whose preference or measurement this record describes. Links to the customer master profile in the CRM and Adobe Experience Platform.

attributes.name: sustainable_material_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.sustainable_material. Business justification: Customers express material preferences (organic cotton, recycled polyester, Tencel). Drives personalized product recommendations, sustainability-focused marketing segmentation, and preference-based fi

attributes.name: brand_name
attributes.description: The brand to which the preferred_brand_size or brand preference applies. Enables brand-specific size mapping and brand affinity tracking for personalization and assortment planning.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - Brand Affinity Schema

attributes.name: channel_of_capture
attributes.description: The business channel through which this preference was captured or inferred. Supports omnichannel preference reconciliation and channel-specific personalization strategies. Distinct from source_system (technical system) — this represents the customer-facing channel. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ecommerce|retail_store|mobile_app|style_quiz|loyalty_portal|wholesale|call_center|social_commerce|pop_up_event — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: color_palette
attributes.description: Customer's preferred color palette or specific color preferences (e.g., 'neutrals', 'earth tones', 'navy,white,grey', 'bold primaries'). Used to filter product recommendations and personalize marketing communications. May store comma-separated color values.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - Color Preference Schema

attributes.name: communication_channel
attributes.description: Customer's preferred channel for receiving marketing communications, personalized recommendations, and promotional offers. Drives omnichannel campaign orchestration in Adobe Experience Platform and Salesforce CRM. Null indicates no stated preference.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7 - Conditions for Consent; CCPA Section 1798.120

attributes.name: communication_frequency
attributes.description: Customer's preferred frequency for receiving marketing and personalization communications. Used to govern outreach cadence in campaign management and suppress over-communication. Supports GDPR and CCPA consent management.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7 - Conditions for Consent; CCPA Section 1798.120

attributes.name: confidence_score
attributes.description: Confidence level (0.00–100.00) indicating the reliability of this preference or measurement. Self-declared and body scan data typically score highest; behavioral inference scores reflect signal strength from purchase/browse history. Used by recommendation engines to weight preference inputs.

attributes.name: consent_date
attributes.description: Date on which the customer provided consent for this preference data to be collected and used. Required for GDPR and CCPA audit trails. Null for preferences captured prior to consent framework implementation.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7 - Conditions for Consent; CCPA Section 1798.120

attributes.name: consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has provided explicit consent for this preference data to be collected, stored, and used for personalization purposes. Mandatory for GDPR and CCPA compliance. False values trigger suppression from personalization pipelines.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 - Lawfulness of Processing; CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this preference record was first created in the system. Used for audit trails, GDPR data retention calculations, and preference lifecycle analytics.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 - Storage Limitation; ISO/IEC 27001 - Audit Logging

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Composite data quality score (0.00–100.00) for this preference record, reflecting completeness, recency, and source reliability. Used by recommendation engines to weight preference inputs and by data stewards to prioritize enrichment efforts.
attributes.references: ISO 8000 - Data Quality; Adobe Experience Platform - Profile Quality

attributes.name: fit_preference
attributes.description: Customer's preferred garment fit silhouette for the associated apparel category. Drives fit-based filtering in recommendation engines and reduces return rates by surfacing appropriately fitted products. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: slim|regular|relaxed|oversized|athletic|tailored|skinny|straight|wide_leg — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - Fit Preference Schema

attributes.name: inference_model_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the AI/ML model used to infer this preference from behavioral data (e.g., 'style_affinity_v2.3', 'fit_inference_v1.1'). Null for self-declared or manually assigned preferences. Supports model governance, A/B testing, and reproducibility audits.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - AI/ML Model Governance

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this preference record is currently active and should be used by recommendation engines and personalization systems. Inactive records are retained for audit and historical analysis but excluded from real-time personalization.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this preference record, whether from customer self-service, behavioral re-inference, stylist update, or system refresh. Critical for staleness detection and preference freshness scoring in recommendation engines.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - Profile Update Tracking

attributes.name: locale
attributes.description: IETF BCP 47 locale code representing the language and regional context in which this preference was captured (e.g., 'en-US', 'fr-FR', 'de-DE'). Ensures size system and communication preferences are interpreted in the correct regional context.

attributes.name: material_preference
attributes.description: Customer's preferred fabric or material types (e.g., 'organic cotton', 'merino wool', 'recycled polyester', 'linen'). Supports sustainability-aligned personalization and allergy/sensitivity filtering. May store comma-separated material values.
attributes.references: Global Organic Textile Standard (GOTS); OEKO-TEX Standard 100

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes added by a stylist, customer service agent, or automated system providing additional context about this preference (e.g., 'customer mentioned sensitivity to wool', 'measured during in-store fitting event'). Supports qualitative enrichment of structured preference data.

attributes.name: numeric_value
attributes.description: Parsed numeric representation of the preference value for body measurements and quantitative preferences (e.g., chest circumference 92.50, inseam 76.00, shoe size 10.5). Null for non-numeric preferences. Used by recommendation engines for size matching algorithms.
attributes.references: ISO 8559-1 - Garment Construction and Anthropometric Surveys

attributes.name: occasion_preference
attributes.description: Customer's preferred occasions or use cases for apparel (e.g., 'workwear', 'casual', 'formal', 'activewear', 'evening'). Supports occasion-based product filtering and targeted collection recommendations. May store comma-separated occasion values.

attributes.name: override_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this preference record was manually overridden by a stylist, customer service agent, or the customer themselves, superseding a previously inferred value. When true, the record takes precedence over behavioral inference for the same preference type.

attributes.name: preference_category
attributes.description: High-level category classifying the type of preference or measurement captured. Drives segmentation and personalization routing in Adobe Experience Platform. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: style|fit|color|size|brand|communication|sustainability|material|fragrance|occasion|price_range — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: preference_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of this preference record. Active records are used in personalization; superseded records have been replaced by a newer version; expired records have passed their validity window; withdrawn records reflect customer opt-out; pending_verification awaits confirmation.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - Profile Lifecycle; GDPR Article 17 - Right to Erasure

attributes.name: preference_type
attributes.description: Specific type of preference or measurement within the category (e.g., 'neckline_style', 'waist_fit', 'chest_circumference_cm', 'preferred_color_palette', 'inseam_length_cm'). Provides granular classification for recommendation engine targeting.

attributes.name: preference_value
attributes.description: The actual value of the preference or measurement (e.g., 'slim fit', 'navy blue', '92.5', 'XL', 'Nike'). For numeric measurements, this stores the string representation; numeric_value stores the parsed decimal. Supports both categorical and quantitative preference data.

attributes.name: preferred_brand_size
attributes.description: Customer's preferred size label as used by a specific brand for the associated apparel category (e.g., 'M', 'L', '32x30', '10.5'). Captures brand-specific sizing conventions which differ from standardized measurements, enabling brand-aware size recommendations.
attributes.references: ISO 8559-1 - Garment Construction and Anthropometric Surveys

attributes.name: price_range_preference
attributes.description: Customer's preferred price tier for apparel purchases, aligned to the brand's pricing architecture. Informs personalized product recommendations and promotional targeting. Derived from purchase history behavioral inference or self-declared via style profile.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this preference was captured or inferred. Supports data lineage tracking and conflict resolution when the same preference type is captured from multiple systems. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: adobe_experience_platform|salesforce_crm|salesforce_commerce_cloud|sap_car|in_store_scan|virtual_try_on_app|stylist_portal|mobile_app|web_portal — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: source_type
attributes.description: Method by which this preference or measurement was captured. Drives confidence scoring and consent management. Self-declared data from customer profiles, behavioral inference from purchase/browse history, stylist-assigned from in-store consultations, in-store body scan from 3D measurement technology, virtual try-on from digital fitting tools.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - Data Ingestion; GDPR Article 5 - Data Minimisation

attributes.name: style_affinity
attributes.description: Customer's preferred aesthetic style or fashion archetype (e.g., 'minimalist', 'streetwear', 'classic', 'bohemian', 'athleisure'). Captured via style quiz, behavioral inference from browse/purchase patterns, or stylist assessment. Feeds personalization and collection recommendation engines.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - Style Affinity Schema

attributes.name: sustainability_preference
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has expressed a preference for sustainably sourced, ethically produced, or eco-certified products. When true, recommendation engines prioritize GOTS-certified, BCI cotton, and OEKO-TEX certified products.
attributes.references: Global Organic Textile Standard (GOTS); Better Cotton Initiative (BCI); OEKO-TEX Standard 100

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit associated with the numeric preference value (e.g., 'cm' for body measurements, 'in' for imperial measurements, 'EU'/'UK'/'US' for shoe sizing systems). Null for non-numeric or unitless preferences. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cm|in|mm|kg|lbs|EU|UK|US|JP — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 8559-1 - Garment Construction and Anthropometric Surveys

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date after which this preference record expires and should no longer be applied in personalization. Null indicates an open-ended preference with no expiry. Supports seasonal preference windows and time-limited style profiles.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which this preference record is considered valid and applicable for personalization. Supports temporal preference management, enabling seasonal or time-bounded preferences (e.g., summer color preferences).

products.name: consent
products.description: Tracks customer consent and privacy preferences in compliance with GDPR and CCPA regulations. Captures consent type (marketing email, SMS, push notification, data sharing, profiling, cookies), consent status (granted, withdrawn, pending), consent timestamp, consent version, collection channel, IP address at time of consent, and regulatory jurisdiction. Mandatory for FTC and GDPR compliance across all customer touchpoints.

attributes.name: consent_id
attributes.description: Primary key for consent

attributes.name: customer_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.segment. Business justification: consent table has customer_segment_code (STRING) for compliance reporting and segmentation. Normalizing to FK enables tracking which segments have specific consent patterns and supports segment-level

attributes.name: loyalty_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loyalty program associated with this consent record, where consent was captured as part of a loyalty enrollment or re-enrollment process. Links to the loyalty program master in the customer domain.

attributes.name: parent_consent_record_consent_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier linking this consent record to a prior version or parent consent record. Enables full consent history lineage tracking when a customer updates or re-grants consent under a new policy version.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer whose consent is being recorded. Links to the master customer profile managed in Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) and Salesforce CRM.

attributes.name: sales_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the order transaction during which this consent was captured (e.g., checkout opt-in for marketing emails). Links to the order transaction in the order domain. Null if consent was not captured in the context of a purchase.

attributes.name: collection_channel
attributes.description: The touchpoint or channel through which the customer's consent was collected. Supports omnichannel compliance tracking across DTC e-commerce (Salesforce Commerce Cloud), POS (SAP CAR), in-store, and wholesale portals. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: web|mobile_app|pos|email|sms|call_center|in_store_kiosk|wholesale_portal — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; CCPA Section 1798.100; FTC Act Section 5

attributes.name: consent_method
attributes.description: The mechanism by which consent was obtained. Explicit = active affirmative action by the customer; Implicit = inferred from behavior; Pre-ticked = checkbox pre-selected (non-compliant under GDPR); Opt-out = consent assumed unless declined.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; GDPR Recital 32; CCPA Section 1798.120

attributes.name: consent_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the consent record indicating whether the customer has actively granted, withdrawn, or has a pending or expired consent for the specified consent type.

attributes.name: consent_type
attributes.description: The category of consent being captured, indicating the specific processing activity or communication channel for which the customer is granting or withdrawing permission. Covers marketing email, SMS, push notification, data sharing, profiling, and cookies.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; CCPA Section 1798.120; FTC Textile and Apparel Labeling Requirements

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the country of the customer at the time of consent. Determines the applicable regulatory jurisdiction and consent requirements (e.g., GDPR for EU countries, CCPA for USA-California).
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; GDPR Article 3; CCPA Section 1798.140

attributes.name: data_subject_age_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer's age was verified prior to consent capture to ensure compliance with child data protection requirements (e.g., GDPR Article 8 requires parental consent for children under 16). True = age verified; False = not verified.

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: The category of device used by the customer when providing consent. Supports channel analytics and helps identify consent collection patterns across DTC digital touchpoints and in-store POS terminals.

attributes.name: double_opt_in_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer completed a double opt-in verification process (e.g., email confirmation link clicked) to confirm their consent. True = double opt-in confirmed; False = single opt-in only. Relevant for marketing email compliance.

attributes.name: double_opt_in_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the customer completed the double opt-in verification step. Null if double opt-in was not required or not completed. Supports email marketing compliance audit trails.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this consent record is considered active and enforceable. May differ from the granted timestamp if consent is scheduled to take effect at a future date (e.g., post-enrollment cooling-off period).

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the consent record expires and must be re-obtained from the customer. Used to enforce time-limited consent policies and trigger re-consent workflows in Adobe Experience Platform.

attributes.name: granted_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time (with timezone offset) when the customer actively granted consent. This is the principal business event timestamp for the consent record and is mandatory for GDPR and CCPA audit trails.

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: The IP address of the device from which the customer submitted their consent. Captured at the moment of consent for regulatory audit purposes. May be considered PII under GDPR in certain jurisdictions.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4(1); GDPR Recital 30; CCPA Section 1798.140(o)

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consent record is the current active version for the customer and consent type combination. True = this is the authoritative current record; False = superseded by a newer consent record. Supports efficient querying of current consent state without full history traversal.

attributes.name: legal_basis
attributes.description: The lawful basis under which customer data is being processed, as required by GDPR Article 6. Consent is one of six possible legal bases. Mandatory for GDPR compliance documentation and DPA audit responses.

attributes.name: locale_code
attributes.description: The IETF BCP 47 locale code (e.g., en-US, fr-FR, de-DE) representing the language and region in which the consent notice was presented to the customer. Ensures the customer received consent information in their preferred language.

attributes.name: notice_url
attributes.description: The URL of the privacy notice, cookie policy, or consent form that was presented to the customer at the time of consent capture. Provides an auditable link to the exact disclosure document shown.

attributes.name: nps_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Promoter Score (NPS) Survey Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has consented to receiving Net Promoter Score (NPS) survey invitations. Derived from the consent record for survey/feedback consent type. Used by the CRM and customer experience teams to build eligible NPS survey audiences.

attributes.name: parental_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether parental or guardian consent was obtained on behalf of a minor customer. Required under GDPR Article 8 for data subjects under the age of digital consent in the applicable jurisdiction.

attributes.name: personalization_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has consented to data-driven personalization of their shopping experience, including product recommendations and targeted content. Consumed by Adobe Experience Platform personalization workflows.

attributes.name: preference_center_code
attributes.description: Reference to the preference center session or interaction through which the customer managed their consent preferences. Links to the preference management module in Adobe Experience Platform or Salesforce Marketing Cloud.

attributes.name: proof_of_consent_reference
attributes.description: A reference identifier (e.g., document ID, audit log reference, or digital signature hash) pointing to the stored proof of consent artifact. Supports regulatory audit responses and dispute resolution under GDPR Article 7(1) burden-of-proof requirements.

attributes.name: re_consent_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consent record requires re-confirmation from the customer due to a policy change, expiry, or regulatory update. True = re-consent workflow must be triggered; False = consent is current and valid.

attributes.name: re_consent_sent_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when a re-consent request was dispatched to the customer via the applicable communication channel. Supports SLA tracking for re-consent campaigns and regulatory response timelines.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this consent record was first created in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Serves as the audit creation timestamp for data lineage and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this consent record was last modified in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Tracks updates such as status changes, re-consent confirmations, or suppression flag updates.

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: The applicable data privacy regulatory framework under which this consent record was captured. Determines the legal basis, retention rules, and customer rights applicable to this record. Supports multi-jurisdiction compliance for global apparel operations.

attributes.name: source_record_reference
attributes.description: The native identifier of this consent record in the originating source system (e.g., AEP consent event ID, Salesforce consent object ID). Enables traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver Layer and upstream operational systems.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this consent record originated. Supports data lineage tracking across Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC), SAP Customer Activity Repository (SAP CAR), and Salesforce CRM.

attributes.name: suppression_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this customer is suppressed from the specific communication type associated with this consent record. True = customer must not receive communications of this type; False = communications are permitted. Enforced in Salesforce Marketing Cloud and Adobe Experience Platform.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 21; CCPA Section 1798.120; CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: suppression_reason
attributes.description: The reason why a customer has been suppressed from communications of this consent type. Supports compliance reporting and operational triage for marketing and CRM teams. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: customer_request|regulatory_requirement|bounce|complaint|deceased|fraud|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GDPR Article 21; CCPA Section 1798.120; CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: text_snapshot
attributes.description: A verbatim snapshot or hash reference of the consent language presented to the customer at the time of consent. Preserves the exact wording for regulatory audit and dispute resolution purposes.

attributes.name: third_party_sharing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has consented to their data being shared with third-party partners (e.g., wholesale partners, affiliate marketers, analytics vendors). Critical for CCPA 'Do Not Sell' compliance and GDPR data sharing agreements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; CCPA Section 1798.120 (Do Not Sell); ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: user_agent
attributes.description: The browser or application user agent string captured at the time of consent submission for digital channels. Used for technical audit trails and device fingerprinting in compliance investigations.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the consent notice, privacy policy, or terms and conditions document that was presented to the customer at the time of consent capture. Enables tracking of consent obtained under different policy versions.

attributes.name: withdrawn_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time (with timezone offset) when the customer withdrew or revoked a previously granted consent. Null if consent has not been withdrawn. Required for GDPR right-to-withdraw audit compliance.

products.name: identity_link
products.description: Manages cross-channel identity resolution by linking multiple identifiers (email, phone, cookie ID, device ID, loyalty card number, POS customer ID, Salesforce contact ID, Adobe ECID) to a single resolved profile. Captures identifier type, identifier value, source system, link confidence score, resolution method (deterministic, probabilistic), link creation date, and active flag. Core to the CDP identity graph managed in Adobe Experience Platform.

attributes.name: identity_link_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the identity link record. Primary key for cross-channel identity resolution.

attributes.name: household_id
attributes.description: Reference to the household entity that this identity belongs to. Supports household-level identity resolution and marketing for shared addresses and family relationships.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the resolved master customer profile that this identity link belongs to. Links to the unified customer identity in the Customer Data Platform (CDP).

attributes.name: active_flag
