attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this identity link is currently active and should be used in identity resolution. True indicates active link, false indicates inactive or deprecated link.

attributes.name: channel_source
attributes.description: The customer interaction channel where this identifier was captured. Indicates the touchpoint origin (web, mobile app, POS, call center, email, social media, wholesale portal, partner system). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: web|mobile_app|pos|call_center|email|social|wholesale|partner — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: consent_status
attributes.description: Customer consent status for using this identifier in identity resolution and marketing. Granted indicates explicit consent, denied indicates opt-out, pending awaits customer response, withdrawn indicates revoked consent, not required for non-regulated identifiers.

attributes.name: consent_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when consent status was last updated. Required for GDPR and CCPA compliance to demonstrate when customer consent was obtained or withdrawn.

attributes.name: cross_device_cluster_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the cross-device cluster or household that this identity belongs to. Used to link multiple devices and identifiers to the same person or household for unified customer view.

attributes.name: data_retention_days
attributes.description: Number of days this identity link should be retained based on regulatory requirements and business policies. Used to enforce GDPR right to erasure and data minimization principles.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 - Data Minimization, CCPA Section 1798.105

attributes.name: deletion_requested_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the customer has requested deletion of this identifier under GDPR right to erasure or CCPA right to deletion. True indicates pending deletion, false indicates normal retention.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17 - Right to Erasure, CCPA Section 1798.105

attributes.name: deletion_scheduled_date
attributes.description: Date when this identity link is scheduled for deletion. Null if no deletion is scheduled. Used to manage GDPR and CCPA deletion requests and automated data retention policies.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17 - Right to Erasure, CCPA Section 1798.105

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: Type of device associated with this identifier. Relevant for device-based identifiers (cookie ID, device ID, IDFA, GAID). Helps understand customer device preferences and cross-device behavior. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: desktop|mobile|tablet|pos_terminal|kiosk|iot|unknown — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: first_seen_date
attributes.description: The date when this identifier was first observed in any system. Helps establish customer relationship timeline and identifier age.

attributes.name: geographic_region_code
attributes.description: Geographic region code where this identifier was first captured or is primarily used. Supports regional identity resolution rules and compliance requirements (e.g., GDPR for EU, CCPA for California).

attributes.name: identifier_namespace
attributes.description: The namespace or domain context for the identifier. Used to disambiguate identifiers that may have the same value across different systems (e.g., Email, Phone_SHA256, ECID, IDFA, GAID).
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - Identity Namespace Registry

attributes.name: identifier_type
attributes.description: The type of identifier being linked. Indicates the category of identity data (email, phone, cookie ID, device ID, loyalty card number, POS customer ID, Salesforce contact ID, Adobe ECID).

attributes.name: identifier_value
attributes.description: The actual value of the identifier (e.g., email address, phone number, cookie string, device UUID, loyalty card number). This is the raw identity data point being resolved.

attributes.name: is_pii_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this identifier contains personally identifiable information (PII) subject to GDPR, CCPA, or other privacy regulations. True for email, phone, name; false for anonymous cookies or device IDs.

attributes.name: is_primary_identifier
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is the primary identifier of its type for the customer. True indicates this is the preferred identifier for communication and identification, false indicates secondary or alternate identifier.

attributes.name: last_seen_date
attributes.description: The most recent date when this identifier was observed in any system activity. Used to identify stale or inactive identifiers.

attributes.name: link_confidence_score
attributes.description: Confidence score (0.0000 to 1.0000) indicating the certainty of the identity link. Deterministic links typically score 1.0, while probabilistic links have lower scores based on matching algorithm confidence.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - Identity Graph Algorithm

attributes.name: link_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this identity link was first established in the identity graph. Represents when the resolution process connected this identifier to the customer profile.

attributes.name: link_expiry_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this identity link expires or should be re-verified. Null for permanent links. Used for time-bound identifiers like session cookies or temporary device IDs.

attributes.name: link_priority
attributes.description: Priority ranking of this identity link when multiple identifiers of the same type exist for a customer. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used to determine the primary identifier for each type.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - Identity Stitching Rules

attributes.name: link_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the identity link. Active links are used in identity resolution, inactive links are historical, pending links await verification, disputed links require review, merged links have been consolidated, split links have been separated.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - Identity Graph Management

attributes.name: link_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this identity link record. Tracks when link attributes (status, confidence, priority) were last modified.

attributes.name: link_verified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this identity link was last verified or validated. Used for links that require periodic confirmation (e.g., email verification, phone validation).

attributes.name: match_attributes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of attributes used to establish this identity link (e.g., email+last_name, phone+postal_code). Documents the matching logic for audit and troubleshooting.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - Identity Matching Rules

attributes.name: match_weight
attributes.description: Numeric weight assigned to this identity link based on the strength of matching attributes. Higher weights indicate stronger matches. Used in probabilistic identity resolution scoring.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - Identity Scoring Model

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about this identity link. Used to document manual overrides, dispute resolutions, data quality issues, or special handling instructions.

attributes.name: resolution_algorithm_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the identity resolution algorithm or model used to create this link. Enables tracking of resolution logic changes over time and supports reprocessing when algorithms are updated.

attributes.name: resolution_method
attributes.description: The method used to establish this identity link. Deterministic uses exact matches (e.g., same email across systems), probabilistic uses statistical matching, manual indicates human review, third-party uses external identity resolution services, machine learning uses AI/ML models.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - Identity Resolution Framework

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the system of record that provided this identity link (e.g., SAP_CAR for POS, SFCC for e-commerce, AEP for CDP, SFDC for CRM, LOYALTY for loyalty platform).

attributes.name: third_party_reference
attributes.description: Identifier assigned by the third-party identity resolution provider. Used for reconciliation and audit with external identity graphs.

attributes.name: third_party_source
attributes.description: Name of the third-party identity resolution provider or data enrichment service that contributed to this identity link (e.g., LiveRamp, Neustar, Experian). Null for first-party links.

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify the authenticity of this identity link. Email click indicates email verification, SMS code indicates phone verification, login indicates authenticated session, purchase indicates transaction confirmation, customer service indicates agent verification.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Current verification status of this identity link. Verified links have been confirmed, unverified links are assumed but not confirmed, failed links did not pass verification, expired links need re-verification, pending links await verification.

products.name: cltv_record
products.description: Stores calculated Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV) metrics per customer, updated on a scheduled basis. Captures historical gross revenue, total orders, AOV (Average Order Value), purchase frequency, average inter-purchase interval, predicted future value, CLTV model version, calculation date, and CLTV tier classification (high, mid, low). Used for retention prioritization, personalization investment decisions, and CRM segmentation in Salesforce.

attributes.name: cltv_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the CLTV record. Primary key.

attributes.name: customer_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.segment. Business justification: cltv_record has segment_code (STRING) which is a business key reference to segment table. Normalizing to FK enables referential integrity and allows JOINing to segment definition, criteria, and metada

attributes.name: merchandise_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.merchandise_hierarchy. Business justification: CLTV models segment customers by preferred product category to predict future value. Category affinity (footwear vs apparel vs accessories) significantly impacts lifetime value calculations and retent

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer for whom this CLTV record is calculated. Links to the customer master data.

attributes.name: aov
attributes.description: Average monetary value per order for this customer, calculated as historical revenue divided by historical order count. Key metric for customer spending behavior.

attributes.name: avg_inter_purchase_days
attributes.description: Average number of days between consecutive purchases. Used to predict next purchase timing and identify at-risk customers.

attributes.name: calculation_date
attributes.description: The date on which this CLTV calculation was performed. Used to track historical CLTV snapshots and model refresh cycles.

attributes.name: calculation_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to calculate CLTV for this record. Historical = past revenue only; Predictive = forecasted value; Hybrid = historical + predictive; RFM = recency-frequency-monetary segmentation.

attributes.name: churn_probability
attributes.description: Predicted probability (0.0000 to 1.0000) that the customer will churn within the next defined period. Generated by churn prediction model; used for proactive retention campaigns.

attributes.name: cltv_tier
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the customer based on their CLTV score. Used for segmentation, prioritization, and targeted marketing strategies.

attributes.name: confidence_score
attributes.description: Statistical confidence level (0.0000 to 1.0000) in the predicted future value. Higher scores indicate more reliable predictions based on data quality and model fit.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this CLTV record was first created in the lakehouse. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary values in this record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Ensures consistent currency context for multi-currency operations.

attributes.name: customer_tenure_days
attributes.description: Number of days since the customer's first purchase or account creation date. Used in CLTV model to normalize metrics and segment by lifecycle stage.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Source system from which the customer transaction and behavioral data was extracted for CLTV calculation. Typically Adobe Experience Platform for DTC or Salesforce for B2B wholesale accounts.

attributes.name: discount_sensitivity_score
attributes.description: Score (0.00 to 100.00) indicating the customer's responsiveness to promotional pricing and markdowns. High scores indicate price-driven behavior; low scores indicate brand loyalty.

attributes.name: first_purchase_date
attributes.description: Date of the customer's first completed order. Anchor date for tenure calculation and cohort analysis.

attributes.name: forecast_horizon_months
attributes.description: Number of months into the future for which the predicted future value is calculated (e.g., 12, 24, 36). Defines the time window for CLTV projection.

attributes.name: historical_orders
attributes.description: Total number of completed orders placed by the customer from their first purchase to the calculation date.

attributes.name: historical_revenue
attributes.description: Total gross revenue generated by the customer from their first purchase to the calculation date. Excludes returns and discounts unless specified in model logic.

attributes.name: last_purchase_date
attributes.description: Date of the customer's most recent completed order as of the calculation date. Used to calculate recency and identify dormant customers.

attributes.name: loyalty_member_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) showing whether the customer is enrolled in the brand's loyalty program. Loyalty members typically have higher CLTV.

attributes.name: model_version

attributes.name: nps_survey_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent NPS score was collected. Used to assess recency of sentiment data.

attributes.description: Forecasted revenue expected from this customer over a defined future period (typically 12-36 months). Generated by predictive CLTV model using historical behavior and cohort analysis.

attributes.name: primary_channel
attributes.description: The channel through which the customer has generated the majority of their revenue. Used for channel-specific CLTV analysis and personalization strategies.

attributes.name: purchase_frequency
attributes.description: Average number of purchases per time period (typically per year). Calculated as total orders divided by customer tenure in years.

attributes.name: recency_days
attributes.description: Number of days since the customer's last purchase as of the calculation date. Key component of RFM (Recency, Frequency, Monetary) segmentation.

attributes.name: retention_risk_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) marking customers at high risk of churn based on churn probability threshold or behavioral signals. Triggers retention workflow in CRM.

attributes.name: return_rate

attributes.name: total_cltv
attributes.description: Sum of historical revenue and predicted future value. Represents the total expected value of the customer relationship. Primary metric for retention prioritization and marketing investment decisions.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this CLTV record was last updated or recalculated. Reflects the most recent model refresh cycle.

attributes.description: Neck circumference measurement. Critical for dress shirts, formal wear, and outerwear sizing.
attributes.references: ISO 8559 Garment Construction and Anthropometric Surveys

attributes.name: preferred_brand_size
attributes.description: The customer's preferred size designation within the brand's sizing system for this apparel category (e.g., 'M', 'L', '32x34', '10', '42EU'). Complements body measurements for fit personalization.

attributes.name: profile_completeness_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage (0-100) indicating how complete this size profile is based on the number of measurements captured relative to the ideal set for the apparel category. Used to prompt customers to complete their profiles.

attributes.name: profile_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the size profile. Active profiles are used for fit recommendations; inactive profiles are retained but not applied; archived profiles are historical records.

attributes.name: return_rate_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this size profile has been effective in reducing the customer's return rate for sizing-related issues. Used to measure the business impact of fit personalization.

attributes.name: shoulder_width_measurement
attributes.description: Shoulder width measurement from shoulder point to shoulder point. Critical for tops, outerwear, and formal wear sizing.
attributes.references: ISO 8559 Garment Construction and Anthropometric Surveys

attributes.name: size_confidence_score
attributes.description: A calculated confidence score (0-100) indicating the reliability of this size profile based on measurement source, recency, and consistency with purchase history. Higher scores indicate more reliable fit recommendations.

attributes.name: sleeve_length_measurement
attributes.description: Sleeve length measurement from shoulder to wrist. Critical for tops, outerwear, and formal wear sizing.
attributes.references: ISO 8559 Garment Construction and Anthropometric Surveys

attributes.name: stylist_notes
attributes.description: Optional free-text notes from personal stylists or store associates regarding the customer's fit preferences, body shape considerations, or special sizing needs. Treated as confidential business data.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which the measurement value is expressed. Supports both metric (centimeters) and imperial (inches) systems, as well as regional sizing standards (US, UK, EU) for footwear and ready-to-wear sizes.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this size profile record was last modified. Used for audit trail and data synchronization.

attributes.name: virtual_try_on_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this size profile is enabled for virtual try-on experiences in the e-commerce platform. Requires sufficient measurement data and customer consent.

attributes.name: waist_measurement
attributes.description: Waist circumference measurement. Critical for bottoms, activewear, and outerwear sizing.
attributes.references: ISO 8559 Garment Construction and Anthropometric Surveys

attributes.name: weight
attributes.description: The customer's weight measurement. Optional field used for advanced fit modeling and size recommendations. Treated as confidential business data.

attributes.name: weight_unit
attributes.description: The unit in which weight is expressed (pounds or kilograms).

products.name: referral
products.description: Tracks customer referral events where an existing customer refers a new customer through a referral program. Captures referrer profile reference, referred profile reference, referral code used, referral channel (email, social share, in-store), referral date, conversion status (referred customer made first purchase), conversion date, reward issued to referrer, and program reference. Supports CAC reduction strategies and word-of-mouth growth programs.

attributes.name: referral_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the referral event. Primary key for the referral data product.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Referrals are often campaign-driven (refer-a-friend campaigns, seasonal referral bonuses). Tracks campaign-specific referral performance, referral program ROI, and enables campaign-level referral rewa

attributes.name: loyalty_program_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the referral program under which this referral was made. Links to the specific campaign or program offering referral incentives.

attributes.name: referral_profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the existing customer who initiated the referral. Links to the customer profile who is advocating for the brand.

attributes.name: referral_referred_customer_profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the new customer who was referred. Links to the customer profile who received the referral and may convert.

attributes.name: retail_store_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.retail_store. Business justification: In-store referral programs require store attribution for associate performance metrics, store-level referral campaign ROI tracking, and commission calculations. Store associates actively drive referra

attributes.name: sales_order_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the order that triggered the referral conversion. Links to the specific transaction that qualified the referral for reward issuance.

attributes.name: acceptance_date
attributes.description: The date when the referred customer accepted the referral by clicking the link or entering the code. Null if not yet accepted.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The channel or medium through which the referral was shared by the referrer. Indicates how the referral code or link was distributed to the referred customer. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: email|sms|social_media|in_store|mobile_app|website|whatsapp|messenger|other — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: conversion_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the conversion order placed by the referred customer. Used to calculate reward eligibility and track referral program ROI.

attributes.name: conversion_date
attributes.description: The date when the referred customer completed their first qualifying purchase or conversion event. Null if conversion has not yet occurred.

attributes.name: conversion_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the referred customer completed a qualifying conversion event, typically their first purchase. True indicates successful conversion; False indicates no conversion yet.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the country from which the referral was initiated. Used for geographic segmentation and compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this referral record was first created in the lakehouse. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the conversion amount. Indicates the currency in which the conversion transaction was conducted.

attributes.name: days_to_conversion
attributes.description: The number of days between the referral date and the conversion date. Measures the time lag from referral to purchase. Null if not yet converted.

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: The type of device used by the referrer when initiating the referral. Helps understand channel preferences and optimize referral program UX.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date when this referral expires and can no longer be used by the referred customer. After this date, the referral code becomes invalid.

attributes.name: fraud_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this referral has been flagged as potentially fraudulent. True indicates suspected fraud; False indicates legitimate referral.

attributes.name: fraud_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason why this referral was flagged as fraudulent. Null if fraud_flag is False. Used for fraud pattern analysis and prevention.

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: The IP address from which the referral was initiated. Used for fraud detection and geographic analysis. May be anonymized per privacy regulations.

attributes.name: link_url
attributes.description: The unique URL generated for the referrer to share with potential customers. Contains tracking parameters to attribute conversions back to this referral.

attributes.name: referral_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code used by the referrer to share with potential customers. This code tracks the referral attribution and is entered by the referred customer during signup or purchase.

attributes.name: referral_date
attributes.description: The date when the referral event was initiated by the referrer. Represents the business event timestamp when the referral code was generated or shared.

attributes.name: referral_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the referral. Tracks whether the referred customer has accepted the referral, made a qualifying purchase, or if the referral has expired or been declined.

attributes.name: referral_tier
attributes.description: The tier or level of the referral program under which this referral was made. Different tiers may offer different reward structures or benefits.

attributes.name: referral_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise timestamp when the referral event was recorded in the system. Captures the exact moment the referral was logged, including time zone information.

attributes.name: referred_customer_email
attributes.description: The email address of the referred customer at the time of referral. Used for tracking and communication purposes. May be null if referral was made without email capture.

attributes.name: referred_customer_phone
attributes.description: The phone number of the referred customer at the time of referral. Used for tracking and communication purposes. May be null if referral was made without phone capture.

attributes.name: reward_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date when the issued reward expires and can no longer be redeemed by the referrer. Null for rewards with no expiration.

attributes.name: reward_issued_date
attributes.description: The date when the reward was issued to the referrer. Null if reward has not yet been issued.

attributes.name: reward_issued_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the referrer has been issued their reward for this successful referral. True indicates reward has been granted; False indicates pending or not eligible.

attributes.name: reward_type
attributes.description: The type of reward issued to the referrer for the successful referral. Indicates the form of incentive provided as part of the referral program.

attributes.name: reward_value
attributes.description: The monetary or points value of the reward issued to the referrer. Quantifies the incentive amount granted for the successful referral.

attributes.name: source_campaign
attributes.description: The marketing campaign or initiative that prompted the referrer to make this referral. Used for campaign attribution and effectiveness analysis.

attributes.name: source_record_reference
attributes.description: The unique identifier of this referral record in the source operational system. Used for data lineage and reconciliation with upstream systems.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system that originated this referral record. Indicates whether the referral came from Adobe Experience Platform, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, mobile app, or other channels.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this referral record was last updated in the lakehouse. Tracks the most recent modification for change data capture and audit purposes.

products.name: attendance
products.description: This association product represents the Event participation relationship between consumer profiles and marketing events. It captures invitation management, RSVP tracking, attendance confirmation, and post-event engagement for each profile-event combination. Each record links one consumer profile to one marketing event with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific event participation instance.. Existence Justification: In apparel fashion marketing operations, consumer profiles are invited to and attend multiple marketing events over time (runway shows, pop-ups, VIP experiences, seasonal launches), and each marketing event hosts multiple consumer attendees. The business actively manages event attendance as an operational process with invitation management, RSVP tracking, check-in operations, and post-event engagement measurement. This is a recognized business entity called 'event attendance' or 'event registration' that marketing teams create, update, and analyze.

attributes.name: attendance_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for this event attendance record. Primary key.

attributes.name: event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the marketing event for which attendance is being tracked

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the consumer profile who was invited to or attended the event

attributes.name: attendance_status
attributes.description: Actual attendance outcome for this consumer at this event. Captured during or after the event through check-in systems or manual confirmation. Distinguishes confirmed attendees from no-shows.

attributes.name: check_in_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the consumer checked in at the event venue or virtual platform. Null if consumer did not attend. Used for attendance verification and engagement timing analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this attendance record was first created in the system (typically when invitation was generated or RSVP was received).

attributes.name: guest_count
attributes.description: Number of additional guests (plus-ones) brought by this consumer to the event. Defaults to 0 if consumer attended alone. Used for capacity planning and actual attendance reconciliation.

attributes.name: invitation_channel
attributes.description: Communication channel through which the invitation was delivered to this consumer (email, SMS, direct mail, in-app notification, sales associate outreach, VIP concierge). Used for channel effectiveness analysis.

attributes.name: invitation_sent_date
attributes.description: Date when the event invitation was sent to this consumer profile. Tracks the start of the engagement funnel for this profile-event combination.

attributes.name: post_event_survey_score
attributes.description: Consumer satisfaction or Net Promoter Score captured via post-event survey for this specific event experience. Scale typically 0.0 to 10.0. Null if survey not completed. Used for event effectiveness measurement.

attributes.name: rsvp_date
attributes.description: Date when the consumer submitted their RSVP response for this event. Null if no response received. Used to calculate response time and urgency of follow-up.

attributes.name: rsvp_status
attributes.description: Current RSVP response status from the consumer for this specific event. Tracks whether the consumer confirmed attendance, declined, or has not responded.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this attendance record was last modified (RSVP change, attendance confirmation, survey submission).

attributes.name: vip_access_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consumer was granted VIP or exclusive access privileges for this specific event (backstage access, meet-and-greet, priority seating, exclusive preview). VIP status is event-specific, not profile-level.

products.name: account_contact_role
products.description: This association product represents the Role-based relationship between wholesale_account and contact. It captures the functional assignment of individual contacts to wholesale accounts with specific responsibilities and authority levels. Each record links one wholesale_account to one contact with attributes that define the nature, scope, and temporal validity of that business relationship.. Existence Justification: In B2B wholesale apparel operations, a single wholesale account (e.g., a retail chain with 50 store locations) has multiple contacts serving different functional roles (regional buyers, logistics coordinators, finance contacts, store managers). Simultaneously, a regional buyer contact may manage purchasing relationships for multiple wholesale accounts (e.g., 10 different store entities within a franchise network or buying group). The business actively manages these account-contact role assignments with specific authority levels, functional responsibilities, and temporal validity.

attributes.name: account_contact_role_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for this account-contact role assignment record

attributes.name: contact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the contact person in this account role relationship

attributes.name: wholesale_account_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Account Contact Role - Wholesale Account Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the wholesale account in this contact role relationship

attributes.name: account_role_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the contact assumed their current role or position within the associated wholesale account or enterprise partner organization. Supports relationship tenure tracking and account history analysis. [Moved from contact: This date represents when the contact assumed their role for a specific account. When a contact manages multiple accounts, there must be a separate start date for each account relationship. This attribute belongs in the association as relationship_start_date.]

attributes.name: buying_authority_level
attributes.description: Level of purchasing decision-making authority this contact has for this specific wholesale account. Authority may vary by account even for the same contact person.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when this account contact role record was created in the system

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account-contact role assignment is currently active. Derived from relationship_end_date but denormalized for query performance.

attributes.name: is_billing_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact receives invoices and payment reminders for this wholesale account. Multiple billing contacts may exist per account.

attributes.name: is_decision_maker
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact has final purchasing decision authority for this wholesale account. Used to prioritize outreach and negotiation efforts.

attributes.name: is_primary_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact is the primary point of contact for this wholesale account in this role. Multiple contacts may exist but only one is primary per account.

attributes.name: is_shipping_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact receives shipping notifications and logistics updates for this wholesale account.

attributes.name: relationship_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this contact ended their role with this wholesale account. NULL indicates an active relationship. Used for historical analysis and contact turnover tracking.

attributes.name: relationship_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this contact began their role with this wholesale account. Used for relationship tenure analysis and historical tracking.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Functional role this contact performs for this specific wholesale account (e.g., Buyer, Logistics Coordinator, Finance Contact). A contact may have different roles for different accounts.

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when this account contact role record was last modified

products.name: targeting
products.description: This association product represents the targeting relationship between customer segments and marketing campaigns. It captures the operational assignment of specific customer segments to campaigns with segment-specific budget allocation, performance targets, and actual results. Each record links one segment to one campaign with attributes that exist only in the context of this targeting relationship, enabling multi-segment campaigns and segment participation across concurrent campaigns.. Existence Justification: In apparel fashion marketing operations, campaigns routinely target multiple customer segments simultaneously (e.g., a seasonal launch campaign targets both high-value loyalists and aspirational shoppers with different creative and budget allocations), and segments participate in multiple concurrent campaigns (a VIP segment may be targeted by seasonal, promotional, and retention campaigns running in parallel). The business actively manages segment-specific budget allocation, performance targets, personalization variants, and actual results for each campaign-segment pairing. This is operationally managed as 'campaign segment targeting' with distinct planning, activation, and measurement workflows.

attributes.name: targeting_id
attributes.description: Primary key for targeting

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the marketing campaign that is targeting this segment

attributes.name: customer_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the customer segment being targeted in this campaign

attributes.name: actual_conversions
attributes.description: Actual number of conversions (purchases, sign-ups, or other defined campaign actions) achieved from this segment within this campaign. Measured and updated as the campaign executes. Used to calculate segment-specific conversion rates and compare against target_conversion_count.

attributes.name: actual_reach
attributes.description: Actual number of unique customers from this segment who were exposed to this campaign (impressions, emails delivered, ads served). Measured and updated as the campaign executes. Used to calculate segment-specific reach rates and campaign penetration.

attributes.name: budget_allocation_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of the total campaign budget allocated to this segment. Calculated as (target_spend_amount / campaign.budget_allocated_amount) * 100. Sum of budget_allocation_percent across all segments for a campaign should equal 100%.

attributes.name: campaign_segment_targeting_reference
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for this campaign-segment targeting record. Primary key.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this segment targeting record was created in the system. Audit field for tracking when segments were added to campaigns.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date when this segment targeting concludes within the campaign. May differ from the campaign's overall end_date if segments are deactivated early due to budget exhaustion or performance issues. Enables dynamic segment optimization during campaign execution.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier of the individual who last modified this segment targeting record. Audit field for accountability in campaign optimization.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this segment targeting record was last updated. Audit field for tracking changes to targeting parameters, budget allocation, or status.

attributes.name: offer_code
attributes.description: Promotional offer or discount code specifically assigned to this segment within this campaign. Enables segment-specific offers (e.g., higher-value offers for high-value segments). Used for attribution and redemption tracking.

attributes.name: personalization_variant_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the creative or messaging variant used for this segment within this campaign. Enables segment-specific personalization where different segments receive tailored creative, offers, or messaging within the same campaign. References creative asset management system.

attributes.name: segment_priority_rank
attributes.description: Ordinal ranking of this segment's priority within this campaign (1 = highest priority). Used when campaigns target multiple segments with different strategic importance. Influences budget allocation decisions and creative personalization priority.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date when this segment targeting becomes active within the campaign. May differ from the campaign's overall start_date if segments are activated in phases or waves. Enables phased rollout strategies and A/B testing by segment.

attributes.name: target_conversion_count
attributes.description: Planned number of conversions (purchases, sign-ups, or other defined campaign actions) expected from this segment within this campaign. Used to calculate segment-specific CAC targets and measure campaign effectiveness by segment.

attributes.name: target_spend_amount
attributes.description: Planned marketing investment allocated to this specific segment within this campaign. Represents the portion of the campaign budget designated for reaching and converting this segment. Sum of target_spend_amount across all segments for a campaign should align with the campaign's budget_allocated_amount.

attributes.name: targeting_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this segment targeting within the campaign. Planned = scheduled but not yet active; Active = currently executing; Paused = temporarily suspended; Completed = finished execution; Cancelled = terminated before completion. Allows independent management of segment targeting within a campaign.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User identifier of the individual who created this segment targeting record. Audit field for accountability in campaign planning.

products.name: loyalty_tier
products.description: Master reference table for loyalty_tier. Referenced by current_tier_id.

attributes.name: loyalty_tier_id
attributes.description: Primary key for loyalty_tier

attributes.name: annual_fee_amount
attributes.description: Annual membership fee charged to maintain this tier status, if applicable. Zero for free tiers, positive amount for premium paid tiers. Expressed in the program's base currency.

attributes.name: birthday_reward_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether members of this tier receive special birthday rewards, discounts, or bonus points. True if birthday benefits are included, false otherwise.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this loyalty tier record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and tier lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: Standard discount percentage offered to members of this tier on eligible purchases (e.g., 5%, 10%, 15%). Applied at checkout for tier-based pricing benefits.

attributes.name: display_order
attributes.description: Sequence number controlling the display order of tiers in user interfaces and marketing materials. Lower numbers appear first. Used for consistent tier presentation across channels.

attributes.name: downgrade_protection_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether members are protected from immediate tier downgrade if they fail to meet qualification thresholds. True if grace period or soft landing is provided, false for immediate downgrade.

attributes.name: early_access_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether members of this tier receive early access to new product launches, seasonal collections, and exclusive sales events. True if early access is granted, false otherwise.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this loyalty tier is retired or no longer available for new assignments. Null for ongoing tiers. Existing members may retain tier status beyond this date based on program rules.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this loyalty tier becomes active and available for customer assignment. Supports phased rollout of new tier structures or seasonal programs.

attributes.name: exclusive_events_access
attributes.description: Indicates whether members of this tier receive invitations to exclusive brand events, fashion shows, VIP shopping experiences, or member-only gatherings. True if event access is granted, false otherwise.

attributes.name: free_shipping_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether members of this tier receive complimentary standard shipping on all orders. True if free shipping is a tier benefit, false otherwise.

attributes.name: invitation_only_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tier is available only by invitation rather than automatic qualification. True for exclusive VIP tiers requiring brand approval, false for standard qualification-based tiers.

attributes.name: max_members_limit
attributes.description: Maximum number of customers allowed in this tier at any given time. Used for exclusive invitation-only tiers. Null for unlimited tiers.

attributes.name: partner_benefits_description
attributes.description: Description of benefits provided through partner brands, co-branded programs, or affiliate networks (e.g., hotel upgrades, airline lounge access, dining rewards). Enhances tier value proposition through ecosystem partnerships.

attributes.name: points_earning_multiplier
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to base points earning rate for members in this tier (e.g., 1.0 for base tier, 1.5 for silver, 2.0 for gold). Rewards higher-tier members with accelerated points accumulation.

attributes.name: priority_support_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether members of this tier receive priority customer service through dedicated support channels, faster response times, or concierge services. True if priority support is available, false otherwise.

attributes.name: qualification_period_months
attributes.description: Number of months over which the qualification threshold must be met (e.g., 12 months for annual qualification, 3 months for quarterly). Defines the rolling window for tier evaluation.

attributes.name: qualification_threshold_amount
attributes.description: Minimum spend amount required to qualify for or maintain this loyalty tier within the qualification period. Expressed in the program's base currency.

attributes.name: qualification_threshold_points
attributes.description: Minimum loyalty points required to qualify for or maintain this tier within the qualification period. Alternative or complementary to spend-based qualification.

attributes.name: retention_period_months
attributes.description: Number of months a member retains this tier status after qualification, regardless of subsequent activity. Provides stability and prevents frequent tier fluctuations.

attributes.name: return_window_days
attributes.description: Extended return window in days offered to members of this tier (e.g., 30 days for base tier, 60 days for premium tiers). Provides flexibility for product returns beyond standard policy.

attributes.name: terms_and_conditions_url
attributes.description: URL to the legal terms and conditions governing this tier's benefits, qualification rules, and member obligations. Required for regulatory compliance and customer transparency.

attributes.name: tier_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the loyalty tier (e.g., BRONZE, SILVER, GOLD, PLATINUM, VIP). Used as a business identifier in external systems and customer communications.

attributes.name: tier_color_hex
attributes.description: Brand color associated with this tier in hexadecimal format (e.g., #CD7F32 for bronze, #C0C0C0 for silver, #FFD700 for gold). Used for visual representation in mobile apps, websites, and member cards.

attributes.name: tier_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the loyalty tier benefits, privileges, and value proposition. Used for customer education and marketing communications.

attributes.name: tier_icon_url
attributes.description: URL path to the tier badge or icon image used in digital channels. Provides visual identification of tier status in customer profiles and communications.

attributes.name: tier_level
attributes.description: Numeric ranking of the tier within the loyalty program hierarchy (e.g., 1=Bronze, 2=Silver, 3=Gold, 4=Platinum). Used for tier comparison and upgrade/downgrade logic.

attributes.name: tier_name
attributes.description: Human-readable display name of the loyalty tier (e.g., Bronze Member, Silver Elite, Gold Premier, Platinum VIP). Used in customer-facing applications and marketing materials.

attributes.name: tier_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the loyalty tier. Active tiers are available for customer assignment; inactive tiers are no longer offered but may have existing members; deprecated tiers are being phased out; planned tiers are under development.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this loyalty tier record was last modified. Tracks changes to tier benefits, thresholds, or configuration over time.

attributes.name: welcome_bonus_points
attributes.description: One-time bonus loyalty points awarded to customers upon first achieving this tier status. Used as an incentive for tier advancement.

attributes.name: upgraded_from_loyalty_tier_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on loyalty_tier (upgraded_from_loyalty_tier_id)

domains.name: order

Handles DTC e-commerce orders, wholesale EDI orders, retail POS orders, and replenishment. Owns ATP, ATS, RMA processing, and order orchestration across SAP S/4HANA SD and Salesforce Commerce Cloud.

attributes.name: concept_id

Audit trail for regulatory investigations and OFAC/BIS compli

attributes.name: profile_id
