attributes.description: Timestamp when this RMA line record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and processing time analysis.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the refund amount. Indicates the currency in which the refund will be processed.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount amount applied to this line item on the original order. Used for accurate refund calculation and promotional analysis.

attributes.name: disposition_action
attributes.description: The action to be taken with the returned merchandise. RESTOCK=return to sellable inventory, DESTROY=dispose of item, RTV=Return to Vendor, LIQUIDATE=sell through secondary channel, REPAIR=send for refurbishment, DONATE=charitable donation.

attributes.name: inspection_date
attributes.description: Date when the physical inspection of the returned item was completed. Used for tracking processing time and SLA compliance.

attributes.name: inspection_result
attributes.description: Result of the quality inspection performed on the returned item. PASS=item meets restocking criteria, FAIL=item does not meet criteria, PENDING=inspection in progress, NOT_INSPECTED=inspection not yet performed.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the RMA document. Used for ordering and referencing specific line items within the return authorization.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Sales Document Item

attributes.name: line_refund_amount
attributes.description: Total refund amount for this line item, calculated as quantity returned multiplied by unit refund amount, minus any restocking fees or adjustments.

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of this RMA line item. Tracks the line through the return workflow from receipt through final disposition and refund. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PENDING|RECEIVED|INSPECTED|APPROVED|REJECTED|REFUNDED|CLOSED — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Manufacturing lot or batch number of the returned item, if applicable. Used for quality traceability and vendor chargeback documentation.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional comments or special instructions related to this return line item. Used by customer service and warehouse staff.

attributes.name: original_unit_price
attributes.description: The original unit price paid by the customer at the time of purchase. Used for refund calculation and variance analysis.

attributes.name: quantity_returned
attributes.description: The number of units of this SKU being returned by the customer. Used for inventory reconciliation and refund calculation.

attributes.name: receiving_bin_location
attributes.description: Specific bin or staging location within the warehouse where the returned item is physically stored pending disposition. Enables precise inventory tracking.

attributes.name: refund_method
attributes.description: Method by which the refund will be issued to the customer. ORIGINAL_PAYMENT=refund to original payment method, STORE_CREDIT=issue store credit, GIFT_CARD=issue gift card, CHECK=mail check, BANK_TRANSFER=direct bank transfer.

attributes.name: refund_processed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the refund for this line item was successfully processed and issued to the customer. Used for SLA tracking and customer communication.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation if the return line item was rejected. Captures why the return was not accepted per return policy guidelines.

attributes.name: restocking_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee charged to the customer for processing the return, if applicable per return policy. Deducted from the total refund amount.

attributes.name: return_condition
attributes.description: Physical condition of the returned merchandise as assessed during inspection. Determines disposition action and potential restocking eligibility.

attributes.name: return_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating why the customer is returning this item. Used for quality analysis, vendor chargebacks, and product improvement initiatives.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number of the returned item, if applicable for serialized inventory. Enables individual unit tracking and warranty validation.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Tax amount to be refunded for this line item. Calculated based on applicable tax jurisdiction and original transaction tax treatment.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the returned quantity. EA=Each, PR=Pair, DZ=Dozen, CS=Case, BX=Box. Aligns with inventory and order management standards.

attributes.name: unit_refund_amount
attributes.description: The refund amount per unit for this SKU. May differ from original unit price due to promotions, discounts, or partial refund policies.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this RMA line record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: vendor_rma_number
attributes.description: RMA number issued by the vendor for items being returned to vendor (RTV). Used for tracking vendor returns and processing vendor credits.

attributes.name: warehouse_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the warehouse or distribution center where the returned item was received and inspected. Used for inventory tracking and logistics.

products.name: edi_transaction
products.description: Captures inbound and outbound EDI message transactions with wholesale trading partners per ANSI X12 standards. Includes document type (850 PO, 855 PO Ack, 856 ASN, 810 Invoice, 860 PO Change, 846 Inventory Inquiry, 997 Functional Ack), trading partner ID, transaction set control number, interchange control number, transmission timestamp, processing status, error/rejection codes, and functional acknowledgment status. Sourced from SAP EDI/ALE or SPS Commerce. Supports wholesale order automation, retailer compliance with vendor guides (e.g., Nordstrom, Macys routing guides), and chargeback avoidance through timely ASN transmission.

attributes.name: edi_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the EDI transaction record. Primary key.

attributes.name: order_purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.purchase_order. Business justification: Links EDI transaction messages (850 PO inbound from wholesale partners, 856 ASN inbound) to the purchase order they reference. Nullable FK populated based on document_type and direction. String column

attributes.name: processed_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: EDI exceptions and validation failures require manual intervention; tracking resolution ownership is critical for SLA compliance, chargeback dispute resolution, and trading partner relationship manage

attributes.name: sales_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.sales_order. Business justification: Links EDI transaction messages (810 Invoice, 856 ASN outbound) to the sales order they reference. Eliminates silo for edi_transaction. Nullable FK populated based on document_type. String column purch

attributes.name: trading_partner_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trading partner agreement or vendor routing guide that governs this EDI transaction. Ensures compliance with retailer-specific requirements (e.g., Nordstrom, Macys routing guides).

attributes.name: trading_partner_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the wholesale trading partner (retailer, distributor, or vendor) involved in this EDI transaction.

attributes.name: asn_number
attributes.description: Shipment identification number for 856 ASN document type. Links EDI transaction to shipment record.

attributes.name: chargeback_risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction has potential chargeback risk due to late transmission, missing data, or non-compliance with trading partner requirements.

attributes.name: communication_protocol
attributes.description: Protocol used to transmit or receive the EDI message. Common values: AS2 (Applicability Statement 2), SFTP (Secure File Transfer Protocol), FTP, VAN (Value-Added Network), API, HTTPS.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this EDI transaction record was first created in the data platform.

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether the EDI message was received (inbound) or sent (outbound) by the business.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: ANSI X12 transaction set identifier. Common values: 850 (Purchase Order), 855 (PO Acknowledgment), 856 (Advance Ship Notice), 810 (Invoice), 860 (PO Change Request), 846 (Inventory Inquiry/Advice), 997 (Functional Acknowledgment), 940 (Warehouse Shipping Order), 945 (Warehouse Shipping Advice), 753 (Request for Routing Instructions). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 850|855|856|810|860|846|997|940|945|753 — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: edi_standard_version
attributes.description: Version of the ANSI X12 standard used for this transaction (e.g., 004010, 005010). From ISA12 element.

attributes.name: error_code
attributes.description: Standard error or rejection code when validation or processing fails. May reference ANSI X12 997 acknowledgment codes or custom trading partner error codes.

attributes.name: error_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the error or rejection reason. Provides context for troubleshooting failed EDI transactions.

attributes.name: file_name
attributes.description: Name of the EDI file as received or sent. Used for file-based EDI transmission tracking and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: functional_ack_status
attributes.description: Status of the ANSI X12 997 Functional Acknowledgment for this transaction. Tracks whether acknowledgment was sent (for inbound) or received (for outbound).

attributes.name: functional_ack_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the 997 Functional Acknowledgment was sent or received for this transaction.

attributes.name: functional_group_control_number
attributes.description: Control number for the functional group (GS segment) containing this transaction set. Groups related transaction sets together.

attributes.name: integration_batch_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the integration batch or job that processed this EDI transaction into downstream operational systems.

attributes.name: interchange_control_number
attributes.description: Unique control number for the entire EDI interchange envelope per ANSI X12 ISA segment. Ensures end-to-end traceability.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Invoice number for 810 Invoice document type. Links EDI transaction to billing record.

attributes.name: payload_size_bytes
attributes.description: Size of the EDI message payload in bytes. Used for transmission monitoring and capacity planning.

attributes.name: processed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the EDI transaction was successfully processed and integrated into operational systems.

attributes.name: processing_status
attributes.description: Current processing state of the EDI transaction. Tracks lifecycle from receipt through validation, acknowledgment, and integration into operational systems. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: received|validated|accepted|rejected|processed|error|pending_ack — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Trading partner purchase order number referenced in this EDI transaction. Applicable for 850, 855, 856, 810, 860 document types. Links EDI transaction to business order.

attributes.name: receiver_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the EDI message receiver. Format depends on receiver_qualifier. From ANSI X12 ISA08.

attributes.name: receiver_qualifier
attributes.description: Qualifier identifying the type of receiver ID (e.g., 01=DUNS, 12=Phone, 14=UPC, ZZ=Mutually Defined). From ANSI X12 ISA07.

attributes.name: retry_count
attributes.description: Number of times transmission or processing of this EDI transaction was retried due to errors or failures.

attributes.name: segment_count
attributes.description: Number of segments in the EDI transaction set. Used for validation and completeness checking per ANSI X12 SE01 element.

attributes.name: sender_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the EDI message sender. Format depends on sender_qualifier (e.g., DUNS number, phone, custom ID). From ANSI X12 ISA06.

attributes.name: sender_qualifier
attributes.description: Qualifier identifying the type of sender ID (e.g., 01=DUNS, 12=Phone, 14=UPC, ZZ=Mutually Defined). From ANSI X12 ISA05.

attributes.name: sla_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the EDI transaction was processed within the agreed SLA timeframe per trading partner agreement.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system that generated or received this EDI transaction (e.g., SAP S/4HANA SD, SPS Commerce, Oracle Retail, Salesforce Commerce Cloud).

attributes.name: test_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a test transaction (true) or production transaction (false). From ANSI X12 ISA15 element (T=Test, P=Production).

attributes.name: transaction_set_control_number
attributes.description: Unique control number assigned to the transaction set within the functional group per ANSI X12 ST segment. Used for tracking and acknowledgment.

attributes.name: transmission_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the EDI message was transmitted or received. Captured from ISA interchange date/time or system receipt timestamp.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this EDI transaction record was last modified.

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Result of EDI syntax and business rule validation. Indicates whether the message conforms to ANSI X12 standards and trading partner-specific requirements.

products.name: order_payment
products.description: Payment record associated with a sales order, POS transaction, or wholesale invoice, capturing payment method (credit card, PayPal, Apple Pay, gift card, store credit, net terms, letter of credit, factoring), payment amount, currency, authorization code, payment gateway reference, payment status (authorized, captured, settled, refunded, failed, disputed), payment date, settlement date, and installment/BNPL plan details if applicable. Covers DTC digital payments via Salesforce Commerce Cloud, wholesale net-terms and LC payments via SAP FI/AR, and POS tender types. Supports payment reconciliation, chargeback management, and AR aging for wholesale accounts.
products.reference: SAP FI Accounts Receivable / SFCC Payment

attributes.name: order_payment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payment record. Primary key for the payment entity.

attributes.name: installment_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the installment or BNPL plan if applicable. Links to external financing provider or internal installment program. Null for non-installment payments.

attributes.name: payment_method_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.payment_method. Business justification: Payment transactions use stored payment methods. Direct link enables payment instrument analysis, fraud pattern detection by method, and eliminates denormalized card fields for PCI compliance and data

attributes.name: processed_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Manual payment processing (refunds, exceptions, installment adjustments) requires employee accountability for fraud prevention, SOX compliance, audit trails, and segregation of duties in financial ope

attributes.name: sales_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales order, POS transaction, or wholesale invoice that this payment is associated with. Links payment to the originating order transaction.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Total monetary amount of the payment transaction in the specified currency. Represents the gross payment value before any adjustments or fees.

attributes.name: authorization_code
attributes.description: Authorization or approval code returned by the payment processor or issuing bank. Used for payment verification and reconciliation. Business-confidential transaction identifier.
attributes.references: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS)

attributes.name: avs_response_code
attributes.description: Response code from Address Verification Service check. Indicates match status between billing address provided and address on file with card issuer. Used for fraud prevention.
attributes.references: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS)

attributes.name: billing_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the billing address associated with the payment method. Used for Address Verification Service (AVS) checks and fraud prevention.
attributes.references: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS), GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: billing_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the billing address (apartment, suite, unit number). Optional field for additional address details.
attributes.references: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS), GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: billing_city
attributes.description: City or municipality of the billing address. Used for AVS verification and tax calculation.
attributes.references: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS), GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: billing_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the billing address. Used for international payment processing and compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Country Codes, Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS)

attributes.name: billing_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal code or ZIP code of the billing address. Critical for AVS verification and fraud detection.
attributes.references: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS), GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: billing_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region of the billing address. Used for AVS verification and tax jurisdiction determination.
attributes.references: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS), GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Channel or interface through which the payment was initiated. Distinguishes between Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) digital channels, retail Point of Sale (POS), and wholesale Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) channels. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: e_commerce|mobile_app|pos|call_center|edi|wholesale_portal|marketplace — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: chargeback_date
attributes.description: Date when a chargeback was initiated by the cardholder or issuing bank. Null if no chargeback has occurred. Used for dispute management and financial reconciliation.
attributes.references: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS)

attributes.name: chargeback_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code provided by card network for the chargeback. Used to categorize disputes and identify root causes for fraud prevention.
attributes.references: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the payment amount. Supports multi-currency transactions across global markets.

attributes.name: cvv_response_code
attributes.description: Response code from CVV/CVC verification check. Indicates whether the card security code provided matches the issuer records. Used for fraud prevention.
attributes.references: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS)

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Date by which payment is due for net terms or trade credit transactions. Used for AR aging and collections management. Null for immediate payments.

attributes.name: fraud_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment has been flagged as potentially fraudulent by automated systems or manual review. True if flagged, false otherwise.
attributes.references: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS)

attributes.name: gateway_name
attributes.description: Name of the payment gateway or payment service provider that processed the transaction. Examples include Stripe, Adyen, PayPal, Authorize.Net, or internal payment systems.

attributes.name: gateway_transaction_reference
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier assigned by the payment gateway or processor. Used for tracing payment through external systems and for dispute resolution.

attributes.name: installment_number
attributes.description: Sequential number of this installment payment within the plan. For example, 1 for first payment, 2 for second payment. Null for non-installment payments.

attributes.name: installment_plan_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment is part of an installment or Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) plan. True if installment plan is active, false otherwise.

attributes.name: net_payment_amount
attributes.description: Net amount received after deducting processing fees and adjustments. Represents actual funds deposited to merchant account.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Date when the payment transaction was initiated or authorized. Represents the business event date for the payment.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Payment instrument or method used by the customer or wholesale account. Includes digital wallets, card payments, trade credit instruments, and Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) options. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: credit_card|debit_card|paypal|apple_pay|google_pay|gift_card|store_credit|net_terms|letter_of_credit|factoring|bnpl|wire_transfer|ach|cash|check — 15 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS)

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payment transaction. Tracks progression from authorization through settlement or failure states including dispute and chargeback scenarios. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: authorized|captured|settled|refunded|partially_refunded|failed|declined|voided|disputed|chargeback|pending — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: payment_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the payment transaction was initiated or authorized. Includes timezone information for accurate cross-region reconciliation.

attributes.name: processing_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee charged by the payment processor or gateway for this transaction. Used for Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) calculation and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique payment reference number or transaction identifier used for customer communication and reconciliation. Generated by payment gateway or internal system.
attributes.references: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS)

attributes.name: refund_amount
attributes.description: Total amount refunded to the customer for this payment. Null if no refund has been issued. May be partial or full refund of the original payment amount.

attributes.name: refund_date
attributes.description: Date when the refund was processed. Null if no refund has been issued. Used for returns processing and customer service tracking.

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: Fraud risk score assigned by payment gateway or internal fraud detection system. Higher scores indicate higher risk. Used for fraud prevention and order review workflows.
attributes.references: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS)

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: Date when the payment was settled and funds were transferred to the merchant account. May differ from payment date due to processing delays.

attributes.name: settlement_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the payment was settled. Used for cash flow analysis and reconciliation with bank statements.

attributes.name: terms
attributes.description: Payment terms for wholesale or trade accounts. Examples include Net 30, Net 60, 2/10 Net 30. Null for immediate DTC payments. Used for Accounts Receivable (AR) aging and credit management.

attributes.name: total_installments
attributes.description: Total number of installments in the payment plan. Used to calculate payment schedule and remaining balance. Null for non-installment payments.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payment record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

products.name: otif_metric
products.description: OTIF (On Time In Full) compliance record tracking delivery performance at the order, shipment, or PO level against committed SLAs. Captures order or PO reference, promised delivery date, actual delivery date, ordered quantity, delivered quantity, on-time flag, in-full flag, OTIF composite score, penalty flag, and retailer-specific OTIF threshold. Supports wholesale retailer compliance scorecards and 3PL SLA management.

attributes.name: otif_metric_id
attributes.description: Primary key for otif_metric

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer or wholesale account receiving the order. Used for customer-specific OTIF scorecard reporting.

attributes.name: sales_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales order, purchase order, or shipment being measured for OTIF compliance. Links to the order management system record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Sales Document Number

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific shipment or delivery being measured. Links to warehouse management or logistics system.

attributes.name: third_party_logistics_id
attributes.description: Reference to the 3PL or logistics service provider responsible for fulfillment. Used for 3PL SLA management and performance tracking.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.vendor. Business justification: OTIF measurement for inbound purchase orders requires tracking vendor on-time/in-full performance. Currently tracks _3pl_partner_id for outbound; adding vendor_id enables inbound supplier OTIF scoreca

attributes.name: warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fulfillment center or distribution center that processed the order. Used for facility-level OTIF performance analysis.

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: The actual date the order was delivered to the customer or received at the destination. Used to calculate on-time performance.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS - Proof of Delivery Date

attributes.name: actual_ship_date
attributes.description: The actual date the order was shipped from the fulfillment center. Used for ship-date-based OTIF compliance tracking.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS - Ship Confirm Date

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this OTIF record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: delivered_quantity
attributes.description: The actual quantity of units delivered to the customer. Used to calculate in-full compliance and fill rate.

attributes.name: delivery_variance_days
attributes.description: The number of days between promised and actual delivery date. Negative values indicate early delivery, positive values indicate late delivery, zero indicates on-time.

attributes.name: fill_rate_percent
attributes.description: The percentage of ordered quantity that was delivered, calculated as (delivered_quantity / ordered_quantity) * 100. Measures in-full performance independent of timing.

attributes.name: in_full_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the delivered quantity met or exceeded the ordered quantity within the acceptable tolerance. True=in full, False=short shipment.

attributes.name: in_full_tolerance_percent
attributes.description: The acceptable variance percentage for in-full compliance. For example, 5% tolerance means 95-105% of ordered quantity is considered in-full. Retailer-specific parameter.

attributes.name: measurement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the OTIF record was calculated and recorded. Used for reporting period assignment and historical trend analysis.

attributes.name: measurement_level
attributes.description: The granularity level at which OTIF is being measured: order (entire order), shipment (individual shipment), line_item (SKU-level), or po (purchase order level). Determines aggregation logic.

attributes.name: on_time_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the order was delivered on or before the promised delivery date. True=on time, False=late.

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the order channel: DTC (Direct-to-Consumer e-commerce), wholesale (B2B EDI orders), retail_pos (store point-of-sale), replenishment (automated stock replenishment), or transfer (inter-facility transfer).

attributes.name: ordered_quantity
attributes.description: The total quantity of units ordered by the customer. This is the baseline for in-full performance measurement.

attributes.name: otif_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: On Time In Full (OTIF) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Composite boolean indicator of whether the order met BOTH on-time AND in-full criteria. True=OTIF compliant, False=OTIF failure. This is the primary KPI for retailer scorecards.

attributes.name: otif_score
attributes.description: Numeric OTIF performance score expressed as a percentage (0.00 to 100.00). Calculated as the percentage of orders meeting both on-time and in-full criteria. Used for trend analysis and benchmarking.

attributes.name: otif_threshold_percent
attributes.business_glossary_term: On Time In Full (OTIF) Threshold Percentage
attributes.description: The retailer-specific or customer-specific OTIF compliance threshold percentage required for this order. Typically ranges from 85% to 98% depending on retailer SLA agreements.

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: The financial penalty or chargeback amount assessed by the retailer for OTIF non-compliance. Expressed in the order currency. Null if no penalty applied.

attributes.name: penalty_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the penalty amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Null if no penalty applied.

attributes.name: penalty_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this OTIF failure triggered a financial penalty or chargeback from the retailer. True=penalty applied, False=no penalty.

attributes.name: po_number
attributes.description: External purchase order number from the customer or retailer. Used for wholesale EDI orders and retailer compliance tracking.

attributes.name: promised_delivery_date
attributes.description: The committed delivery date communicated to the customer or retailer. This is the baseline for on-time performance measurement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Requested Delivery Date

attributes.name: quantity_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for ordered and delivered quantities. EA=Each, CS=Case, PK=Pack, DZ=Dozen, PR=Pair. Standard apparel industry UOM codes.

attributes.name: quantity_variance
attributes.description: The difference between ordered and delivered quantity (delivered_quantity - ordered_quantity). Negative values indicate short shipment, positive values indicate over-shipment.

attributes.name: reporting_period
attributes.description: The fiscal or calendar period (e.g., 2024-Q1, 2024-W15, 2024-03) to which this OTIF record is assigned for scorecard reporting. Format varies by retailer requirements.

attributes.name: requested_ship_date
attributes.description: The date the customer or retailer requested the order to be shipped from the warehouse. Used for ship-date-based OTIF calculations.

attributes.name: retailer_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the wholesale retailer or distribution partner. Used for retailer-specific OTIF threshold application.

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the root cause for OTIF failure. Used for trend analysis and corrective action planning. Null if OTIF compliant. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: warehouse_capacity|inventory_shortage|transportation_delay|system_error|supplier_delay|weather|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: root_cause_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing detailed explanation of the root cause for OTIF failure. Used for continuous improvement and dispute resolution. Null if OTIF compliant.

attributes.name: sla_tier
attributes.description: The service level tier associated with this order, determining OTIF thresholds and penalty structures. Premium=highest standards, Economy=relaxed standards.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this OTIF record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking, particularly for dispute resolution.

products.name: order_hold
products.description: Records holds placed on sales orders that prevent progression through the fulfillment workflow. Captures hold type (credit hold, fraud review, inventory shortage, compliance review, address verification), hold reason, hold placed by (user or system), hold placed timestamp, hold released timestamp, release reason, and hold resolution outcome. Supports order orchestration and exception management workflows in SAP SD.
products.reference: SAP SD Order Block / Delivery Block

attributes.name: order_hold_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the order hold record. Primary key.

attributes.name: primary_order_employee_id
attributes.description: User ID of the person who manually placed the hold, if applicable. Empty for system-generated holds.

attributes.name: sales_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales order on which this hold is placed. Links to the sales order transaction in SAP S/4HANA SD.

attributes.name: tertiary_order_last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: User ID of the person who last modified this hold record. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether explicit management approval is required to release this hold (true) or if it can be auto-released by system rules (false).

attributes.name: approver_role
attributes.description: Business role or job function authorized to approve release of this hold type. Examples include CREDIT_MANAGER, FRAUD_ANALYST, COMPLIANCE_OFFICER, WAREHOUSE_SUPERVISOR.

attributes.name: auto_release_eligible_flag

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: customer_notification_sent_flag

attributes.name: distribution_channel_code
attributes.description: SAP distribution channel code for the order. Examples include Direct-to-Consumer (DTC), wholesale, e-commerce, retail store.

attributes.name: duration_hours
attributes.description: Calculated duration in hours that the hold was active, from placement to release. Used for Service Level Agreement (SLA) compliance reporting and process improvement analysis.

attributes.name: escalation_level

attributes.name: escalation_timestamp

attributes.name: expiry_timestamp

attributes.name: external_hold_reference

attributes.name: hold_category

attributes.name: hold_code

attributes.name: hold_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the hold. Active holds prevent order progression; released holds allow fulfillment to continue.

attributes.name: hold_type

attributes.name: impact_amount

attributes.name: impact_currency_code

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this hold record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change to any field in the record.

attributes.name: placed_by_system_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the hold was automatically triggered by system rules (true) or manually applied by a user (false).

attributes.name: placed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the hold was applied to the sales order. Critical for Service Level Agreement (SLA) tracking and On Time In Full (OTIF) performance measurement.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to the hold. Critical holds require immediate attention and executive approval for release.

attributes.name: reason_code

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text description providing additional context about why the hold was placed. May include system-generated messages or user-entered notes.

attributes.name: related_document_number

attributes.name: release_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the user who released the hold, documenting the resolution or approval rationale.

attributes.name: release_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason the hold was released. Examples include APPROVED, RESOLVED, OVERRIDE, EXPIRED, CANCELLED.

attributes.name: released_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the hold was released, allowing the order to proceed through fulfillment. Null for active holds.

attributes.name: resolution_outcome
attributes.description: Final outcome of the hold review process. Determines whether the order proceeds, is cancelled, or requires further action.

attributes.name: sales_organization_code
attributes.description: SAP sales organization code associated with the order under hold. Determines approval workflow and business rules.

attributes.name: sla_breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the hold duration exceeded the defined Service Level Agreement (SLA) threshold for this hold type. Impacts On Time In Full (OTIF) metrics.

attributes.name: sla_target_hours
attributes.description: Target resolution time in hours defined for this hold type. Used to calculate Service Level Agreement (SLA) compliance.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the system or module that originated the hold. Examples include SAP_SD, FRAUD_ENGINE, CREDIT_MGMT, COMPLIANCE_SYSTEM.

attributes.name: source_system_code

products.name: quote
products.description: Pre-order quotation or proforma record for wholesale seasonal booking, capturing buyer interest during market week and trade shows before conversion to confirmed sales orders. Tracks quote number, wholesale account reference, season/delivery window, quoted styles and quantities, preliminary pricing (FOB/wholesale cost), quote revision history, validity period, buyer approval status, and conversion-to-order flag. Supports the 4-6 month pre-season booking cycle critical to apparel wholesale where buyers commit to seasonal assortments that later convert to firm EDI 850 purchase orders. Enables pipeline visibility, production planning inputs, and seasonal revenue forecasting.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.sustainability_target. Business justification: Wholesale quotes incorporate sustainability commitments (carbon-neutral delivery, sustainable packaging, minimum recycled content). Sustainability targets drive quote configuration and pricing for app

attributes.name: conversion_date

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this quote record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: delivery_window_end_date

attributes.name: distribution_channel_code

attributes.name: division_code

attributes.name: freight_amount

attributes.name: market_event_date

attributes.name: market_event_name

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: payment_terms

attributes.name: pricing_basis

attributes.name: quote_date
attributes.description: Date when the quote was created and presented to the wholesale buyer. Principal business event timestamp for the quote lifecycle.

attributes.name: quote_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique quote number used in communications with wholesale buyers during market week and trade shows. Externally visible identifier.

attributes.name: quote_status

attributes.name: quote_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the quote was generated, including time zone information for global wholesale operations.

attributes.name: quote_type

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number tracking quote revisions during buyer negotiations. Increments with each modification to quantities, pricing, or terms.

attributes.description: Timestamp when this quote record was last modified. Audit trail for tracking changes during negotiations and revisions.

attributes.description: Date after which the quote expires and pricing is no longer guaranteed. Critical for managing seasonal booking windows.

attributes.name: validity_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which the quote pricing and terms become valid. Defines the beginning of the quote acceptance window.

attributes.description: Primary key for allocation_rule

attributes.name: modified_by

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: product_category_filter

attributes.name: rounding_method

attributes.name: rule_code

attributes.name: rule_name

attributes.name: rule_owner

attributes.name: rule_status

attributes.name: rule_type
attributes.description: Classification of the allocation rule methodology (proportional distribution, priority-based, round-robin, geographic, channel-based, customer tier, product category).

attributes.name: rule_version
attributes.description: Version number of this allocation rule, incremented with each modification to support change tracking and audit.

attributes.name: created_by

attributes.name: fallback_allocation_rule_id

attributes.name: warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the physical location where inventory is held. References warehouse, distribution center (DC), retail store, or third-party logistics (3PL) facility.

attributes.name: aging_bucket
attributes.description: Classification of inventory based on time in stock and seasonal relevance. Current season represents fresh merchandise, prior season is last season carryover, aged is multi-season old inventory, and clearance is marked for liquidation. Drives markdown strategies and inventory valuation.

attributes.name: allocation_group
attributes.description: Classification code used to group inventory for allocation planning. Allocation groups define how inventory is distributed across channels and locations based on demand forecasts, store grades, and strategic priorities.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Allocation Strategy

attributes.name: atp_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity available for future customer commitments, including current ATS plus expected inbound receipts minus planned outbound allocations. Used for forward order promising and pre-order management.

attributes.name: ats_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity available for new customer orders. Calculated as on-hand quantity minus reserved quantity minus damaged/held quantity. This is the inventory pool visible to e-commerce and point-of-sale systems for order promising.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code indicating where the product was manufactured. Required for customs compliance, trade agreement qualification, and consumer labeling per FTC textile labeling requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 Country Codes, FTC Textile Fiber Products Identification Act

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this stock position record was first created in the data warehouse. Used for data lineage tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the unit cost. Supports multi-currency inventory valuation for global operations.

attributes.name: cycle_count_variance
attributes.description: Difference between system on-hand quantity and physical count quantity from the last cycle count. Positive values indicate physical surplus, negative values indicate shortage. Used to measure inventory accuracy and identify shrinkage.

attributes.name: damaged_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of inventory identified as damaged, defective, or unsellable. This inventory is physically present but excluded from available-to-sell calculations pending disposition decisions (repair, return to vendor, or disposal).

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which the inventory should not be sold or used. Applicable to items with shelf life such as cosmetics, fragrances, or performance fabrics with time-sensitive treatments. Null for non-perishable apparel.
attributes.references: Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) - Product Dating

attributes.name: held_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity placed on administrative hold for quality inspection, regulatory compliance review, or investigation. Inventory is physically present but temporarily unavailable for sale or allocation.

attributes.name: hs_code
attributes.description: International tariff classification code for the product. Used for customs clearance, duty calculation, and trade compliance. Essential for cross-border inventory movements and landed cost calculation.

attributes.name: in_transit_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity currently being transported to this location from suppliers, manufacturing facilities, or other distribution points. Includes goods in-transit via ocean freight, air freight, and ground transportation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Goods in Transit

attributes.name: last_adjustment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent inventory adjustment transaction at this location. Adjustments include cycle count corrections, damage write-offs, and system corrections. Used for audit trail and inventory accuracy monitoring.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS - Inventory Adjustment History

attributes.name: last_cycle_count_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent physical cycle count performed for this SKU at this location. Supports inventory accuracy monitoring and audit compliance.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS - Cycle Count Management

attributes.name: last_receipt_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent inventory receipt at this location. Used to track inventory freshness and identify slow-moving stock.

attributes.name: last_sale_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent sale or allocation of this SKU from this location. Used to identify dormant inventory and trigger markdown or transfer decisions.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository - Transaction History

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Manufacturing lot or batch identifier for traceability. Enables tracking of inventory by production run for quality control, recall management, and compliance with textile safety standards.

attributes.name: nos_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is designated as a never-out-of-stock item requiring continuous availability. NOS items receive priority replenishment and higher safety stock levels to prevent stockouts.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Replenishment Strategy

attributes.name: on_hand_quantity
attributes.description: Total physical inventory quantity currently present at the location. Represents the actual count of units physically available in the facility, verified through cycle counts and RFID tracking.

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Indicates the legal ownership of the inventory. Owned is company-owned stock, consignment is supplier-owned until sold, vendor-owned is VMI stock, and customer-owned is inventory held on behalf of wholesale customers.

attributes.name: reorder_point
attributes.description: Inventory level that triggers automatic replenishment. When on-hand quantity falls below the reorder point, a purchase order or transfer order is generated. Calculated as lead time demand plus safety stock.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Reorder Point Planning

attributes.name: replenishment_method
attributes.description: Strategy used to replenish inventory at this location. Automatic uses system-driven reorder points, manual requires planner intervention, VMI is supplier-managed, cross-dock bypasses storage, and drop-ship ships directly from supplier to customer.

attributes.name: reserved_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of inventory allocated to specific orders or commitments but not yet shipped. Includes customer orders, store allocations, and wholesale commitments that are pending fulfillment.

attributes.name: rfid_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU at this location is tracked using RFID technology. RFID enables real-time inventory visibility, automated cycle counting, and improved inventory accuracy.

attributes.name: safety_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum inventory buffer maintained to protect against demand variability and supply chain disruptions. Safety stock levels are calculated based on demand volatility, lead time variability, and desired service level.

attributes.name: snapshot_date
attributes.description: Business date for which this stock position record represents the inventory state. Enables point-in-time inventory analysis and historical trend reporting. Updated daily through batch processing.

attributes.name: stock_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the inventory at this location. Available indicates sellable stock, reserved is allocated to orders, quarantine is under quality review, damaged is unsellable, in-transit is being received, and blocked is administratively restricted.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS - Inventory Status Management

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: Cost per unit of inventory at this location. Represents the landed cost including product cost, freight, duties, and other acquisition costs. Used for inventory valuation and COGS calculation.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this stock position record was last modified. Tracks the most recent change to any attribute in the record for change data capture and audit purposes.

attributes.name: valuation_class
attributes.description: Financial accounting classification for inventory valuation. Determines the general ledger accounts used for inventory asset and cost of goods sold postings. Supports multi-GAAP reporting requirements.

attributes.name: vmi_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this inventory is managed under a vendor-managed inventory program where the supplier monitors stock levels and triggers replenishment. VMI programs shift inventory management responsibility to suppliers.

attributes.name: wos
attributes.description: Number of weeks the current on-hand inventory will last based on forecasted demand. Calculated as on-hand quantity divided by average weekly sales rate. Key metric for inventory health and replenishment planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Inventory Planning

products.name: stock_movement

Captures movement type, quantity, unit of measure, source and destination locations, reference document (PO, STO, RTV, delivery note, ASN), posting date, movement reason code, and adjustment approval reference. Serves as the single audit trail for all inventory quantity changes across all channels and locations.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp

attributes.name: approved_by

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the cost amounts (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Enables multi-currency inventory valuation for global operations.

attributes.name: destination_location_code
attributes.description: Business code for the destination location (e.g., warehouse code, store number, DC identifier). Human-readable identifier for reporting.

attributes.name: destination_location_type
attributes.description: Classification of the destination location to enable location-type-specific analytics and reporting.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date on the source document that triggered the movement (e.g., PO date, transfer order date, physical count date). May differ from posting date due to processing delays.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this stock movement record was last updated. Tracks changes for audit and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: movement_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the movement transaction type for reporting and analytics. Groups detailed movement types into business-meaningful categories.

attributes.name: movement_document_number
attributes.description: The externally-known business document number for this inventory movement (e.g., goods receipt number, transfer order number, adjustment document number). Used for audit trail and cross-system reconciliation.

attributes.name: movement_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of inventory moved in this transaction. Positive for receipts and negative for issues. Expressed in the base unit of measure.

attributes.name: movement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the stock movement transaction. Indicates whether the movement has been finalized in inventory records or is still in process.

attributes.name: movement_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the physical inventory movement occurred or was recorded in the warehouse management system. Used for real-time inventory tracking and RFID event correlation.

attributes.name: movement_type_code
attributes.description: Three-digit code classifying the nature of the inventory movement (e.g., 101=Goods Receipt from PO, 311=Transfer Posting, 551=Scrapping, 601=Goods Issue for Delivery). Aligns with SAP movement type taxonomy.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special instructions, or contextual information about the movement. Used by warehouse staff and inventory analysts.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the inventory movement was posted to the ledger and inventory balances were updated. This is the official date of record for inventory valuation and financial reporting.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the business reason for the movement, especially for adjustments, returns, and write-offs (e.g., damaged, obsolete, cycle count correction, customer return, quality hold release).

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text description providing additional context for the movement reason. Used when reason code alone is insufficient to explain the transaction.

attributes.name: reference_document_line_number
attributes.description: The line item number within the reference document that this movement relates to. Enables line-level traceability.

attributes.name: reference_document_number

attributes.name: reference_document_type

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this movement is a reversal of a previous transaction. True if this is a correcting entry that negates a prior movement.

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: The movement document number of the original transaction being reversed. Populated only when reversal_indicator is true. Enables audit trail of corrections.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number for serialized inventory items (e.g., high-value accessories, luxury goods). Enables item-level tracking and authentication.

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: The unique product identifier for the item being moved. Represents the specific product variant at the most granular level (style-color-size).

attributes.name: source_location_code
attributes.description: Business code for the source location (e.g., warehouse code, store number, DC identifier). Human-readable identifier for reporting.

attributes.name: source_location_type
attributes.description: Classification of the source location to enable location-type-specific analytics and reporting.

attributes.name: stock_type
attributes.description: Classification of inventory status indicating availability and ownership. Unrestricted stock is available for sale; other types have restrictions or special handling requirements.

attributes.name: total_cost
attributes.description: The total cost of the movement (movement_quantity × unit_cost). Posted to inventory accounts and used for financial reporting and COGS calculation.

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: The cost per unit of the inventory item at the time of movement. Used for inventory valuation and Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) calculation. Expressed in the company's functional currency.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which the movement quantity is expressed (EA=Each, CS=Case, PK=Pack, DZ=Dozen, PR=Pair, ST=Set). Aligns with product packaging hierarchy.

attributes.name: upc
attributes.description: The barcode identifier for the product. Used for scanning and point-of-sale transactions. May be GTIN-12, GTIN-13, or GTIN-14 format.

attributes.name: valuation_type
attributes.description: The inventory valuation method applied to this movement for financial accounting purposes. Determines how cost is calculated and posted to the general ledger.

Supports directed putaway, slotting optimization, and omnichannel fulfillment routing.

attributes.name: aisle_code

attributes.description: Identifier for the individual bin or position within the shelf. Represents the most granular storage unit.

attributes.name: nos_policy_code

attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Allocation Planning

products.name: inventory_cycle_count
products.description: Operational record of scheduled and ad-hoc physical inventory cycle count events at a location or zone level, including line-level SKU count details. Header captures count plan date, count type (full, partial, ABC-class, RFID-assisted), assigned counter, count status, and variance threshold. Line-level detail records expected quantity, counted quantity, variance, recount flag, and final approved quantity. Drives stock adjustment postings when variance exceeds tolerance.

attributes.name: inventory_cycle_count_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the inventory cycle count event. Primary key for the cycle count record.

attributes.name: lot_batch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.lot_batch. Business justification: Cycle counts often need to track lot/batch-specific inventory (especially for dye-lot consistency in apparel). inventory_cycle_count has lot_number string but no FK to lot_batch master. Adding lot_bat

attributes.description: Reference to the warehouse associate or employee assigned to perform the physical count.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.retail_store. Business justification: Store cycle counts must be attributed to specific retail stores for inventory accuracy KPIs, shrinkage reconciliation, and store operational performance tracking - critical for retail loss prevention

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.season. Business justification: Cycle counts are often scheduled by season for seasonal merchandise, especially pre-season and end-of-season. Essential for seasonal inventory accuracy audits and seasonal inventory reconciliation.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific SKU being counted in this cycle count line. Links to product master for item details.

attributes.name: warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the warehouse, distribution center, retail store, or 3PL facility where the cycle count is being performed.

attributes.name: zone_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific zone, aisle, or storage area within the location being counted. Enables zone-level cycle counting strategies.

attributes.name: abc_classification
attributes.description: ABC analysis classification of the SKU determining cycle count frequency: A (high value, frequent counts), B (medium value, moderate counts), C (low value, infrequent counts).

attributes.description: Financial value of the inventory adjustment calculated as variance quantity multiplied by unit cost. Impacts COGS and inventory valuation.

attributes.name: adjustment_document_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the inventory adjustment document posted to SAP or ERP system as a result of the approved variance.

attributes.name: adjustment_posted_flag
attributes.description: Indicator that the variance has been posted to inventory records and financial ledgers. True when adjustment posted, False when pending.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp

attributes.name: count_method

attributes.name: count_notes

attributes.name: count_number

attributes.name: count_reason
attributes.description: Business reason triggering the cycle count: scheduled (routine calendar-based), variance_triggered (system detected discrepancy), stock_adjustment (manual correction needed), audit (compliance or quality check), neveroutofstock (NOS item verification), receiving_discrepancy (inbound variance), returns_verification (RTV or customer return validation). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: scheduled|variance_triggered|stock_adjustment|audit|neveroutofstock|receiving_discrepancy|returns_verification — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: count_start_timestamp

attributes.name: count_status

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: planned|assigned|in_progress|completed|approved|rejected|recount_required — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: count_type
attributes.description: Classification of the cycle count methodology: full (complete location inventory), partial (sample-based), abc_class (frequency based on item value), rfid_assisted (RFID technology enabled), blind (no system quantity shown), targeted (specific SKU focus).

attributes.name: counted_quantity
attributes.description: Actual physical quantity counted by the assigned counter during the cycle count event.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the cycle count record was first created in the system, typically during count planning or scheduling.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the adjustment amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: expected_quantity
attributes.description: System-recorded quantity on hand for the SKU at the location prior to the physical count, sourced from perpetual inventory records.

attributes.name: inventory_status
attributes.description: Quality and availability status of the counted inventory: available (ATS), reserved (allocated to orders), quarantine (quality hold), damaged (not sellable), expired (past shelf life), return_to_vendor (RTV candidate).

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the cycle count record was last updated, tracking changes through the count lifecycle.

attributes.name: recount_flag
attributes.description: Indicator that the variance exceeds tolerance and a recount is required before posting adjustment. True when recount needed, False otherwise.

attributes.name: recount_number
attributes.description: Sequential number indicating how many times this item has been recounted. Zero for initial count, increments with each recount attempt.

attributes.name: scheduled_date

attributes.name: variance_percentage
attributes.description: Variance quantity expressed as a percentage of expected quantity, used to determine if recount threshold is exceeded.

attributes.name: variance_quantity
attributes.description: Calculated difference between expected quantity and counted quantity (counted minus expected). Positive indicates overage, negative indicates shortage.

attributes.name: policy_name
