attributes.description: Descriptive name of the NOS policy for business user identification.

attributes.name: policy_notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional notes, special instructions, or business context related to this NOS policy.

attributes.name: policy_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Never Out of Stock (NOS) Policy Status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the NOS policy indicating whether it is actively enforced in replenishment and allocation systems.

attributes.name: priority_replenishment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this NOS policy triggers priority replenishment processing, bypassing standard allocation queues.

attributes.name: review_frequency_days
attributes.description: Number of days between scheduled reviews of this NOS policy to assess continued relevance and parameter accuracy.

attributes.name: rfid_tracking_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) Tracking Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether items under this NOS policy require RFID tracking for real-time inventory visibility and accuracy.

attributes.name: safety_stock_multiplier
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to base safety stock calculation to determine buffer inventory levels for NOS items. Higher values provide greater protection against demand variability.

attributes.name: target_wos
attributes.description: Target inventory coverage expressed in weeks of supply. Represents the desired inventory level to maintain continuous availability.

attributes.name: vmi_program_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this NOS policy is part of a Vendor Managed Inventory program where the supplier monitors and replenishes stock.

products.name: reservation
products.description: Transactional record of inventory reservations that earmark stock for specific orders, channels, or events before physical allocation. Captures reservation type (sales order, e-commerce cart, wholesale commitment, event hold, photo shoot hold, sample pull, trunk show), reserved quantity, reservation expiry timestamp, priority rank, fulfillment channel, and soft vs hard reservation indicator. Feeds ATS and ATP calculations across omnichannel fulfillment.
products.reference: SAP MM Reservation / Manhattan Associates WMS Allocation Hold

attributes.name: reservation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the inventory reservation record. Primary key for the inventory reservation entity.

attributes.name: allocation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the allocation record if this reservation has been converted to a physical allocation. Null while reservation is still pending or active.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Allocation Management

attributes.name: cart_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ecommerce.cart. Business justification: When customers add high-demand apparel items to cart, inventory is soft-reserved to prevent overselling. Business process: cart-to-inventory reservation, ATS calculation, and abandoned cart inventory

attributes.name: checkout_session_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ecommerce.checkout_session. Business justification: Hard reservations are created during checkout to hold inventory while payment is processed. Business process: checkout inventory hold, payment-to-fulfillment handoff, and reservation expiry management

attributes.name: digital_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ecommerce.digital_order. Business justification: Final reservations are converted to committed allocations when digital order is placed. Business process: order-to-fulfillment inventory commitment, reservation-to-shipment tracking, and inventory acc

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer or wholesale account for whom inventory is reserved. Null for non-customer reservations such as photo shoots or events.

attributes.name: retail_store_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.retail_store. Business justification: BOPIS and ship-from-store inventory reservations must link to fulfilling retail store for omnichannel allocation, store fulfillment capacity planning, and store-level ATP calculation - critical for un

attributes.name: sales_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales order, purchase order, or wholesale order that triggered this reservation. Null for non-order reservations such as event holds or sample pulls.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Sales Order Management

attributes.name: sales_order_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.sales_order_line. Business justification: Reservations must link to specific order line (not just header) for line-level ATP confirmation, multi-line order partial fulfillment, SKU-level allocation accuracy, and line-item cancellation handlin

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: ATP allocation rules require product.sku attributes: lifecycle_stage (prioritize core vs. seasonal), ats_flag, nos_flag, and product_category for channel-specific reservation priority logic. String sk

attributes.name: warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse, distribution center, retail store, or Third-Party Logistics (3PL) facility where the inventory is reserved.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Standardized reason code for reservation cancellation: CUSTOMER_CANCEL (customer-initiated), CART_ABANDON (ecommerce cart timeout), INVENTORY_UNAVAILABLE (stock discrepancy), ORDER_MODIFY (order change), SYSTEM_ERROR (technical issue), BUSINESS_RULE (policy-driven cancellation).
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS - Cancellation Reason Taxonomy

attributes.name: cancelled_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the reservation was cancelled and inventory released. Null if reservation was not cancelled.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this reservation record was first inserted into the data platform. Supports data lineage and audit requirements.

attributes.name: expiry_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the reservation will automatically expire and release inventory back to Available to Sell (ATS) pool if not fulfilled or extended.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS - Reservation Expiry Management

attributes.name: extended_count
attributes.description: Number of times the reservation expiry has been extended beyond the original expiry timestamp. Used to track reservation aging and potential inventory lock issues.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS - Reservation Extension Tracking

attributes.name: fulfilled_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the reservation was converted to a physical allocation and inventory was committed for shipment or pickup. Null if not yet fulfilled.

attributes.name: fulfillment_channel
attributes.description: Sales and fulfillment channel for which inventory is reserved: ecommerce (online direct-to-consumer), retail_store (brick-and-mortar), wholesale (B2B partner), marketplace (third-party platform), bopis (buy online pick up in store), ship_from_store (store fulfillment for online orders).

attributes.name: hard_reservation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a hard reservation (true - guaranteed allocation, cannot be overridden) or soft reservation (false - tentative hold, can be reallocated based on priority).
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS - Reservation Type Logic

attributes.name: last_extended_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of the most recent reservation expiry extension. Null if reservation has never been extended.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS - Extension Audit Trail

attributes.name: last_updated_by
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that last modified the reservation record. Supports change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this reservation record was last modified in the data platform. Supports change tracking and data freshness monitoring.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special instructions, or business justification for the reservation.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority rank determining allocation sequence when multiple reservations compete for limited inventory. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS - Reservation Priority Logic

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the business reason for the reservation: CUSTOMER_ORDER (committed customer purchase), CART_HOLD (ecommerce shopping cart), WHOLESALE_COMMIT (B2B partner commitment), EVENT_RESERVE (marketing or promotional event), PHOTO_SHOOT (content creation), SAMPLE_REQUEST (product sampling).
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS - Reservation Reason Taxonomy

attributes.name: released_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the reservation was released and inventory returned to the Available to Sell (ATS) pool. Null if reservation is still active.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS - Reservation Release Tracking

attributes.name: reservation_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique reservation number used for tracking and reference across systems and channels.

attributes.name: reservation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the reservation: active (currently holding inventory), expired (reservation period elapsed), released (inventory returned to available pool), fulfilled (reservation converted to allocation), cancelled (reservation voided), pending (awaiting confirmation).

attributes.name: reservation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the inventory reservation was created in the system. Represents the business event time when stock was earmarked.

attributes.name: reservation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the reservation purpose: sales order (committed to customer order), ecommerce cart (held in online shopping cart), wholesale commitment (allocated to wholesale partner), event_hold (reserved for marketing or promotional event), photo_shoot_hold (reserved for photography or content creation), sample_pull (reserved for product sampling or showroom).
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS - Reservation Type Classification

attributes.name: reserved_quantity
attributes.description: Number of units earmarked under this reservation. Reduces Available to Sell (ATS) but not Available to Promise (ATP) until allocation occurs.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS - Inventory Reservation Quantity

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: Unique product identifier at the style-color-size level representing the specific item variant being reserved.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Originating system that created the reservation: SAP_SD (SAP Sales & Distribution), SFCC (Salesforce Commerce Cloud), OMS (Order Management System), WMS (Warehouse Management System), POS (Point of Sale), WHOLESALE_PORTAL (B2B ordering portal).

attributes.name: source_transaction_reference
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier from the source system that initiated this reservation, enabling end-to-end traceability.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit in which the reserved quantity is expressed: EA (each/piece), PR (pair for footwear), DZ (dozen), CS (case), PK (pack).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Unit of Measure

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that created the reservation record. Supports audit trail and accountability.

products.name: stock_valuation
products.description: Master record of inventory valuation parameters and current book value for each SKU at each valuation area. Captures valuation method (standard cost, moving average, FIFO), standard cost, moving average price, total stock value, last valuation date, currency, valuation class, markdown reserve, seasonal write-down percentage, and aged inventory provision. Supports COGS calculation, balance sheet inventory reporting, end-of-season markdown accounting, and inventory obsolescence provisioning critical for fashion's seasonal lifecycle.
products.reference: SAP MM Material Valuation / Accounting View

attributes.name: stock_valuation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the stock valuation record.

attributes.name: incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_incident. Business justification: Compliance incidents (product recalls, safety violations, regulatory penalties) directly impact inventory valuation through write-downs, obsolescence reserves, and net realizable value adjustments. Re

attributes.name: merchandise_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.merchandise_hierarchy. Business justification: Valuation reporting is organized by merchandise hierarchy (department/class/subclass). Essential for category-level inventory valuation reporting, financial analysis by category, and merchandise hiera

attributes.name: non_conformance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.non_conformance. Business justification: Non-conformances drive inventory write-downs, markdown reserves, and aged inventory provisions. Links quality issues to financial impact for accurate inventory valuation, COGS allocation, and financia

attributes.name: otb_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.otb_budget. Business justification: Inventory valuation is monitored against OTB budgets for financial planning. Essential for inventory financial planning, OTB variance analysis, and ensuring inventory value aligns with merchandise bud

attributes.name: retail_store_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.retail_store. Business justification: Store-level inventory valuation is required for store P&L reporting, shrinkage reserve calculation, markdown impact analysis, and financial statement preparation by retail location - fundamental to re

attributes.name: season_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the fashion season or collection to which this inventory belongs (e.g., Spring/Summer 2024, Fall/Winter 2024). Critical for seasonal lifecycle valuation.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the SKU being valued. Links to the product master.

attributes.name: sourcing_purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sourcing.sourcing_purchase_order. Business justification: Landed cost valuation for materials requires sourcing PO reference to allocate freight, duty, and agent commissions. Critical for accurate COGS calculation and margin analysis in apparel costing.

attributes.name: valuation_area_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the valuation area (plant, warehouse, distribution center, or store) where inventory is valued. Links to location master.

attributes.name: aged_inventory_provision
attributes.description: Provision amount for obsolete, slow-moving, or aged inventory that may not be sold at full value. Reflects inventory obsolescence risk.

attributes.name: cogs_allocation_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) Allocation Amount
attributes.description: Portion of inventory value allocated to COGS for goods sold during the period. Used for profit and loss calculation.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Cost center responsible for managing this inventory (e.g., warehouse operations, retail store). Used for management accounting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this valuation record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this valuation record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: current_unit_cost
attributes.description: The effective unit cost currently applied for valuation, based on the valuation method in use (standard cost or moving average price).

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year (1-12) to which this valuation record belongs.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year to which this valuation record belongs (e.g., 2024).

attributes.name: gl_account_number
attributes.description: General Ledger account number to which this inventory valuation is posted for balance sheet reporting.

attributes.name: inventory_turnover_days
attributes.description: Average number of days inventory remains in stock before being sold. Calculated as (average inventory value / COGS) × 365. Key metric for inventory efficiency.

attributes.name: inventory_write_down_amount
attributes.description: Total amount written down from book value to net realizable value when NRV is lower than cost. Impacts Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) and profitability.

attributes.name: last_cost_update_date
attributes.description: Date when the unit cost (standard cost or moving average price) was last updated or recalculated.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this valuation record was last updated or adjusted.

attributes.name: last_physical_count_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent physical inventory count or cycle count for this SKU at this valuation area. Used to assess valuation accuracy.

attributes.name: lifecycle_stage
attributes.description: Current stage in the product lifecycle: pre-season (not yet selling), in-season (active selling), end-of-season (markdown phase), clearance (deep discount), obsolete (no longer saleable).

attributes.name: markdown_reserve_amount
attributes.description: Reserve amount set aside to account for anticipated future markdowns on seasonal or slow-moving inventory. Reduces net realizable value.

attributes.name: markdown_reserve_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of total stock value reserved for anticipated markdowns, typically based on historical markdown rates and seasonal lifecycle stage.

attributes.name: moving_average_price
attributes.description: Weighted average unit cost recalculated with each goods receipt when moving average valuation method is used.

attributes.name: net_realizable_value
attributes.description: Estimated selling price in the ordinary course of business less estimated costs of completion and sale. Inventory must be valued at lower of cost or NRV.

attributes.name: price_variance_amount
attributes.description: Difference between standard cost and actual purchase price for goods received. Tracked separately in standard costing environments.

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: Profit center to which this inventory valuation is attributed for profitability analysis (e.g., product line, brand, region).

attributes.name: seasonal_write_down_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage write-down applied to inventory value for end-of-season or aged seasonal merchandise to reflect lower net realizable value.

attributes.name: standard_cost
attributes.description: Predetermined unit cost used for valuation when standard costing method is applied. Includes material, labor, and overhead components.

attributes.name: total_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of inventory on hand at the valuation area for this SKU at the valuation date.

attributes.name: total_stock_value
attributes.description: Total book value of inventory calculated as total stock quantity multiplied by current unit cost. Represents balance sheet inventory value.

attributes.name: valuation_adjustment_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for any manual adjustment made to the valuation (e.g., physical count variance, damage, theft, pricing error).

attributes.name: valuation_class
attributes.description: Classification code used for grouping materials for accounting purposes (e.g., finished goods, raw materials, trading goods). Maps to General Ledger (GL) accounts.

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: The date on which this valuation snapshot was taken. Typically end-of-month (EOM) or end-of-season for financial reporting.

attributes.name: valuation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the valuation record: active (current), frozen (locked for period close), adjusted (manual adjustment applied), written_off (inventory disposed), under_review (pending audit).

attributes.name: valuation_type
attributes.description: Method used to value inventory: standard cost (predetermined cost), moving average (weighted average of purchases), FIFO (First In First Out), LIFO (Last In First Out), or retail method (cost-to-retail ratio).

attributes.name: weeks_of_supply
attributes.description: Number of weeks the current inventory level will last based on forecasted or historical sales rate. Critical for replenishment planning.

products.name: quarantine_hold
products.description: Operational record of inventory placed under quarantine or quality hold status, preventing it from being sold or shipped. Captures hold reason (quality failure, regulatory hold, customs inspection, recall, damage), hold quantity, hold location, initiating event reference (quality inspection, supplier defect, CPSC recall), hold start date, expected release date, and disposition decision (return to stock, RTV, destroy).
products.reference: SAP MM Quality Management Block / Blocked Stock

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_incident. attributes.name: actual_release_timestamp

attributes.name: hold_initiated_by

attributes.name: hold_quantity

attributes.name: hold_quantity_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the hold quantity (EA=Each, CS=Case, PL=Pallet, CTN=Carton, PR=Pair).

attributes.name: hold_reason_code

attributes.name: hold_reason_description

attributes.name: hold_start_date

attributes.name: hold_start_timestamp

attributes.name: hold_status

attributes.name: initiating_event_reference

attributes.name: initiating_event_type
attributes.description: Type of event that triggered the quarantine hold (quality inspection failure, supplier defect notification, CPSC recall, customer complaint, internal audit finding, customs flag).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: notes

products.name: storefront_fulfillment_network
products.description: This association product represents the fulfillment network configuration between warehouse locations and digital storefronts. It captures the operational routing rules that determine which warehouses can fulfill orders for which storefronts, including allocation priority, service level agreements, and shipping cost tiers. Each record links one warehouse location to one digital storefront with attributes that govern order routing, inventory allocation, and fulfillment strategy in multi-region omnichannel operations.. Existence Justification: In multi-region apparel ecommerce operations, digital storefronts are served by multiple warehouse locations to optimize shipping costs, delivery speed, and inventory availability (e.g., US site ships from East Coast, West Coast, and Midwest DCs based on customer location and stock levels). Conversely, a single warehouse location serves multiple storefronts (e.g., EU distribution center fulfills orders for UK, Germany, France, and Spain storefronts). The business actively manages this fulfillment network configuration with specific allocation priorities, SLAs, and cost tiers for each storefront-warehouse pair.

attributes.description: Unique identifier for this storefront-warehouse fulfillment network configuration record. Primary key.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the digital storefront that can be served by this warehouse location

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the warehouse location that can fulfill orders for this storefront

attributes.name: allocation_priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking for this warehouse when fulfilling orders from this storefront. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used by order routing logic to determine which warehouse should fulfill an order when multiple warehouses can serve the storefront.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fulfillment network configuration record was created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this fulfillment network configuration became active and operational. Used for temporal tracking of network changes and historical analysis of fulfillment strategy evolution.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this fulfillment network configuration was or will be deactivated. Null if still active. Used to manage network reconfigurations, warehouse closures, or storefront market exits.

attributes.name: fulfillment_sla_hours
attributes.description: Service level agreement in hours for order fulfillment from this warehouse to customers of this storefront. Represents the committed time from order placement to shipment departure. Used for delivery promise calculations and warehouse performance measurement.

attributes.name: is_primary_fulfillment_location
attributes.description: Indicates whether this warehouse is the primary/default fulfillment location for this storefront. Typically one primary location per storefront with others serving as backup or overflow capacity.

attributes.name: shipping_cost_tier
attributes.description: Classification of shipping cost economics for this warehouse-storefront pair. Reflects distance, carrier rates, and zone-based pricing. Used to optimize fulfillment routing based on shipping cost considerations.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fulfillment network configuration record was last modified.

domains.name: merchandising
domains.description: Drives assortment planning, collection planning, OTB budgets, allocation strategies, pricing (MSRP, AUR, IMU, MMU, MU, MD), and GMROI optimization. Manages seasonal buy plans, pre-production planning, sell-through rate (STR) analysis, and merchandise financial planning via Oracle Retail Merchandising System and Anaplan.

products.name: assortment_plan
products.description: Master assortment planning entity capturing the seasonal merchandise assortment strategy by department, class, and subclass. Defines which styles, colorways, and sizes will be carried per channel and store cluster, aligned with OTB budgets and collection planning cycles. Sourced from Oracle Retail Merchandising System assortment planning module.

attributes.name: assortment_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the assortment plan record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key generated by the lakehouse ingestion pipeline from Oracle Retail Merchandising System assortment planning module.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Assortment Planning Module

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sourcing.sourcing_agreement. Business justification: Assortment plans reference master sourcing agreements that govern vendor relationships, pricing tiers, and capacity allocation for planned collections. Essential for validating plan feasibility agains

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Assortment plans are sized to support seasonal marketing campaigns. Merchandisers need campaign timing, expected lift, and channel mix to plan OTB budgets and style counts. This link enables campaign-

attributes.name: collection_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent collection or line plan in Centric PLM or Oracle Retail. Links the assortment plan to the upstream collection planning and product design lifecycle managed in Centric PLM collection management module.
attributes.references: Centric PLM – Collection Management; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: collection_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.collection_plan. Business justification: Assortment plans operationalize collection plans by defining the specific SKU-level assortments, store clusters, and channel strategies for a collection. The collection_plan defines the thematic visio

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Assortment plans are budgeted and tracked against cost centers for departmental P&L accountability. Merchandising teams must report plan performance (sales, margin, markdown) by cost center for financ

attributes.name: customer_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.segment. Business justification: Assortment plans target specific customer segments (Gen Z urban, affluent suburban, value-conscious families). Segment demographics and preferences drive category mix, price points, and style selectio

attributes.name: merchandise_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.merchandise_hierarchy. Business justification: Assortment plans have department_id, class_id, subclass_id but no FK to merchandise_hierarchy master. Adding merchandise_hierarchy_id FK normalizes merchandise classification and removes redundant hie

attributes.name: otb_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.otb_budget. Business justification: Assortment plans reference OTB budget amounts but have no FK to otb_budget master. Adding otb_budget_id FK normalizes budget reference and removes redundant otb_budget_amount. FK will reference mercha

attributes.name: primary_assortment_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the merchandise planner (employee) responsible for creating and managing this assortment plan. The planner owns OTB budget reconciliation, STR tracking, and markdown decisions. Sourced from Workday HCM employee master. Serves as the PARTY_REFERENCE for this entity.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Assortment Planning Module; Workday HCM

attributes.name: production_factory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.factory. Business justification: Strategic assortment plans designate preferred factories based on capability, capacity, and cost structure. Drives sourcing strategy and factory capacity reservation for seasonal collections.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Assortment plans drive revenue and margin by channel/brand, tracked via profit centers. Financial reporting requires linking planned vs actual performance (sales, GMROI, STR) to profit centers for seg

attributes.name: season_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.season. Business justification: Assortment plans are inherently seasonal; season_code exists but no FK to season master. Adding season_id FK normalizes season reference and removes redundant season_code. FK will reference merchandis

attributes.name: standard_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.quality_standard. Business justification: Assortment plans specify quality standards by product category, market, and channel. Standards define AQL levels, certifications, and testing requirements for planned assortments. Essential for qualit

attributes.name: store_cluster_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store cluster grouping used for assortment localization. Store clusters segment stores by volume tier, climate zone, or customer demographics to enable differentiated assortment depth and size curve optimization within Oracle Retail allocation module.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Allocation Module

attributes.name: sustainable_material_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.sustainable_material. Business justification: Assortment plans specify sustainable material requirements for collections. The sustainability_certified flag exists but needs FK to define which certified materials are planned. Merchandisers select

attributes.name: tertiary_assortment_approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee (typically a Director of Merchandising or VP of Planning) who approved the assortment plan and committed the OTB budget. Required for audit trail and financial governance under IFRS/GAAP internal controls.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Assortment Planning Module; IFRS/GAAP; ISO 9001

attributes.name: allocation_strategy
attributes.description: Inventory allocation methodology applied to this assortment plan. top_down = corporate-driven allocation to stores; bottom_up = store-requested replenishment; hybrid = combination approach; vmi = Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) where the supplier manages replenishment. Drives Oracle Retail allocation module configuration.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Allocation Module

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the assortment plan was formally approved and the OTB budget was committed. Marks the transition from 'submitted' to 'approved' status and triggers downstream PO generation and T&A calendar activation in SAP S/4HANA and Infor PLM.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Assortment Planning Module; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: aur_target
attributes.description: Planned Average Unit Retail (AUR) price for the assortment, representing the expected average selling price per unit across all styles and colorways in the plan. A key KPI in Anaplan merchandise financial planning used to project net sales and validate GMROI targets.
attributes.references: Anaplan – Merchandise Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Price Management

attributes.name: carry_forward_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of styles in this assortment plan that are carried forward from the prior season versus new introductions. A key collection planning metric used by merchants to balance newness investment against proven performers. Expressed as a percentage of total style count.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Assortment Planning Module; Anaplan – Merchandise Planning

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: Distribution channel for which this assortment plan is defined. Drives channel-specific assortment depth, pricing strategy, and OTB budget allocation. DTC (Direct-to-Consumer) includes both retail stores and e-commerce. Values: retail (brick-and-mortar stores), ecommerce (Salesforce Commerce Cloud digital storefront), wholesale (partner accounts), dtc (combined direct channels), outlet (off-price stores).
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Assortment Planning Module

attributes.name: colorway_count_planned
attributes.description: Number of distinct colorways planned across all styles in the assortment. Colorway depth is a key assortment decision in apparel fashion, balancing color story cohesion against inventory fragmentation risk.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Assortment Planning Module; Centric PLM – Collection Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the assortment plan record was first created in the Oracle Retail Merchandising System and ingested into the Databricks Silver Layer. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED for this entity. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Assortment Planning Module; ISO 8601

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary values in this assortment plan (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Ensures consistent financial reporting across multi-currency wholesale and DTC channels in SAP S/4HANA FI/CO and Anaplan.

attributes.name: imu_target_pct
attributes.description: Target Initial Markup (IMU) percentage for the assortment plan, expressed as a percentage of retail price. IMU = (Retail Price − Cost) / Retail Price × 100. Drives cost negotiation targets with suppliers and is a primary input to GMROI optimization in Anaplan merchandise financial planning.
attributes.references: Anaplan – Merchandise Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Price Management; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: is_final_version
attributes.description: Indicates whether this record represents the final approved version of the assortment plan (True) or a superseded draft/revision (False). Used to filter active plan versions in reporting and analytics without requiring version_number logic.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Assortment Planning Module

attributes.name: labor_compliance_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether suppliers fulfilling this assortment plan must hold active FLA (Fair Labor Association) or WRAP (Worldwide Responsible Accredited Production) certification. Enforced during supplier onboarding in Infor PLM sourcing and SAP S/4HANA MM vendor master.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Association (FLA); Worldwide Responsible Accredited Production (WRAP); ISO 45001

attributes.name: markdown_budget_amount
attributes.description: Total markdown (MD) budget allocated to this assortment plan for planned price reductions during the selling season. Markdown budget is a key input to MMU calculation and is managed in Anaplan merchandise financial planning and Oracle Retail Price Management.
attributes.references: Anaplan – Merchandise Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Price Management; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: mmu_target_pct
attributes.description: Target Maintained Markup (MMU) percentage after accounting for planned markdowns (MD), shrinkage, and employee discounts. MMU reflects the realized margin and is the primary profitability metric tracked in Anaplan merchandise financial planning alongside GMROI.
attributes.references: Anaplan – Merchandise Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Price Management; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: msrp_max
attributes.description: Highest Manufacturer's Suggested Retail Price (MSRP) point within the assortment plan's price architecture. Defines the ceiling price tier and is used alongside msrp_min to establish the price range strategy and IMU targets for the planned assortment.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Price Management; FTC – Pricing Disclosure Requirements

attributes.name: msrp_min
attributes.description: Lowest Manufacturer's Suggested Retail Price (MSRP) point within the assortment plan's price architecture. Defines the entry price tier for the planned assortment and is used in IMU (Initial Markup) and AUR (Average Unit Retail) calculations in Oracle Retail Price Management.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Price Management; FTC – Pricing Disclosure Requirements

attributes.name: otb_units_planned
attributes.description: Total number of units planned for procurement under this assortment plan's OTB budget. Used to calculate average unit cost, validate MOQ (Minimum Order Quantity) compliance with suppliers, and drive purchase order (PO) generation in SAP S/4HANA MM.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Assortment Planning Module; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: plan_code
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the assortment plan, assigned by the Oracle Retail Merchandising System. Used by merchants and planners to reference the plan across systems (e.g., ORM-AP-2025-FALL-WMN-001). Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this entity.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Assortment Planning Module

attributes.name: plan_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the assortment plan expires or the season closes. Marks the end of the active selling window and triggers end-of-season markdown (MD) and clearance processes. Serves as the EFFECTIVE_UNTIL for this entity. Nullable for open-ended NOS assortments.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Assortment Planning Module; Anaplan Merchandise Planning

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the assortment plan (e.g., 'Fall 2025 Women's Outerwear – North America DTC'). Used by merchants and planners to identify the plan in reporting dashboards and Anaplan merchandise financial planning views. Serves as the IDENTITY_LABEL for this entity.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Assortment Planning Module; Anaplan Merchandise Planning

attributes.name: plan_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the assortment plan becomes effective for in-season execution — i.e., the first floor-set or go-live date for the planned assortment. Used to align T&A (Time and Action) calendar milestones and pre-production (PP) sample review schedules. Serves as the EFFECTIVE_FROM for this MASTER_AGREEMENT-role entity.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Assortment Planning Module; Anaplan Merchandise Planning

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the assortment plan within the Oracle Retail Merchandising System workflow. Drives downstream OTB budget release, allocation activation, and collection planning milestones. Valid states: draft (initial creation), submitted (pending merchant approval), approved (OTB committed), active (in-season execution), closed (season ended), cancelled (plan voided). Serves as the LIFECYCLE_STATUS for this entity.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Assortment Planning Module

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the assortment plan by merchandise strategy. seasonal = time-bound seasonal collection; core = evergreen carry-forward styles; nos = Never Out of Stock (NOS) replenishment assortment; capsule = limited-edition capsule collection; collab = brand collaboration or licensed assortment. Drives OTB budget methodology and replenishment logic.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Assortment Planning Module

attributes.name: replenishment_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether styles within this assortment plan are eligible for automated replenishment (True) or are one-time buys with no replenishment (False). NOS (Never Out of Stock) assortments are always True. Drives replenishment trigger logic in Oracle Retail allocation and Manhattan Associates WMS.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Allocation Module; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: season_year
attributes.description: Four-digit calendar year associated with the merchandise season (e.g., 2025). Used for year-over-year sell-through rate (STR) comparisons and GMROI trend analysis in Anaplan financial planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Assortment Planning Module

attributes.name: size_range
attributes.description: Planned size range for the assortment (e.g., 'XS-3XL', '00-24', '5-13'). Defines the inclusive size offering for the plan and is used to validate size curve alignment with store cluster demographics and FTC textile labeling requirements.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Assortment Planning Module; FTC – Textile and Apparel Labeling Requirements

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this assortment plan record originated. ORM = Oracle Retail Merchandising System; ANAPLAN = Anaplan Merchandise Planning; CENTRIC = Centric PLM; MANUAL = manually entered override. Used for data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System; Anaplan; Centric PLM

attributes.name: sourcing_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3 country code of the primary manufacturing/sourcing country for this assortment plan (e.g., BGD=Bangladesh, VNM=Vietnam, CHN=China). Used for landed duty paid (LDP) cost modeling, HS Code tariff classification, and GSP eligibility assessment in SAP S/4HANA MM and Infor PLM sourcing.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; Infor PLM – Sourcing; SAP S/4HANA MM; FTC – Country of Origin Labeling

attributes.name: str_target_pct
attributes.description: Target Sell-Through Rate (STR) for the assortment plan, expressed as a percentage of units sold versus units received. STR = (Units Sold / Units Received) × 100. Used to set end-of-season inventory clearance expectations and validate OTB buy depth in Oracle Retail and Anaplan.
attributes.references: Anaplan – Merchandise Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Assortment Planning Module

attributes.name: style_count_planned
attributes.description: Number of distinct styles (parent product silhouettes) planned in the assortment, independent of colorway or size. Style count is a key assortment breadth metric used by merchants to balance newness versus carry-forward depth in collection planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Assortment Planning Module; Centric PLM – Collection Management

Mainline = full seasonal assortment; Capsule = focused limited assortment; Collaboration = co-branded with external partner; Limited_Edition = restricted volume; Carry_Over = NOS (Never Out of Stock) continuity styles; Core = foundational basics.

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: design_brief_url

attributes.name: dtc_allocation_pct
attributes.description: Planned percentage of total collection inventory allocated to Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) channels (own retail stores and e-commerce). Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.6000 = 60%). Used in channel allocation planning.

attributes.name: first_delivery_date

attributes.name: gender_target

attributes.name: imu_target_pct

attributes.name: last_delivery_date
attributes.description: Planned date of the final merchandise delivery for this collection. Defines the end of the inbound supply window and informs markdown timing and end-of-season clearance planning.
attributes.references: Centric PLM — Collection Management; SAP S/4HANA PP; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this collection plan record. Supports change tracking, incremental data loading, and audit compliance in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: line_architecture_version

attributes.name: otb_lock_date
attributes.description: Date on which the OTB (Open-to-Buy) budget for this collection plan is locked and committed. After this date, budget changes require formal approval. Managed in Anaplan Merchandise Planning.
attributes.references: Anaplan — Merchandise Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Price Management

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the collection plan record. Drives workflow routing in Centric PLM and Anaplan. Draft = initial creation; In_Review = pending creative/commercial sign-off; Approved = locked for production; Active = in-season execution; Closed = season ended; Cancelled = plan abandoned.
attributes.references: Centric PLM — Collection Management; Anaplan — Merchandise Planning

attributes.name: planned_aur_amount
attributes.description: Planned Average Unit Retail (AUR) price for the collection in the planning currency. Represents the expected average selling price per unit across all styles and channels, used in revenue and unit planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Price Management; Anaplan — Merchandise Planning

attributes.name: planned_cogs_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Planned Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) Amount
attributes.description: Total planned Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) for this collection plan in the planning currency. Used to calculate planned gross margin and GMROI targets in Anaplan financial planning.

attributes.name: planned_gross_margin_pct
attributes.description: Planned gross margin percentage for the collection, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.6200 = 62.00%). Derived from planned revenue and COGS targets; stored as a planning input in Anaplan to support IMU (Initial Markup) and MMU (Maintained Markup) targets.
attributes.references: Anaplan — Merchandise Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Price Management; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: planned_revenue_amount
attributes.description: Total planned net sales revenue target for this collection plan in the planning currency. Used as the top-line financial KPI for merchandise financial planning and GMROI optimization in Anaplan.

attributes.name: planned_str_pct
attributes.description: Target Sell-Through Rate (STR) for the collection, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.8500 = 85%). Represents the planned percentage of received inventory expected to sell at full price or planned markdown cadence before end of season.

attributes.name: price_tier_distribution

attributes.name: product_category_mix

attributes.references: Centric PLM — Collection Management; Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Assortment Planning; Anaplan — Merchandise Planning

attributes.name: range_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the formal range review meeting where the collection plan is presented to commercial and creative stakeholders for approval. A key milestone in the T&A (Time and Action) calendar.
attributes.references: Centric PLM — Collection Management; Anaplan — Merchandise Planning

attributes.name: season_type
attributes.description: Classification of the retail season type for this collection plan. Drives line architecture, delivery cadence, and OTB budget allocation. attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Assortment Planning; Centric PLM — Collection Management

attributes.name: sell_end_date
attributes.description: Planned date when the collection is retired from active selling. Triggers end-of-season markdown strategy and clearance allocation. Effective-until date for the collection's commercial lifecycle.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Assortment Planning; Anaplan — Merchandise Planning

attributes.name: sell_start_date

attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Assortment Planning; Salesforce Commerce Cloud; SAP Customer Activity Repository

attributes.name: sustainability_rating
attributes.description: Planned sustainability certification tier for the collection based on material sourcing and production standards. Reflects compliance with GOTS, BCI, OEKO-TEX, and FLA standards. Drives supplier selection and marketing claims.
attributes.references: Global Organic Textile Standard (GOTS); Better Cotton Initiative (BCI); OEKO-TEX Standard 100; Fair Labor Association (FLA); WRAP

attributes.name: sustainable_material_pct
attributes.description: Planned percentage of styles in the collection using certified sustainable materials (organic cotton, recycled polyester, BCI cotton, etc.). Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.4000 = 40%). Supports ESG reporting and FTC textile labeling compliance.
attributes.references: Global Organic Textile Standard (GOTS); Better Cotton Initiative (BCI); FTC — Textile and Apparel Labeling Requirements; ISO 14001

attributes.name: target_market_region
attributes.description: Primary geographic market region(s) for which this collection is planned (e.g., 'NAM', 'EMEA', 'APAC', 'GLOBAL'). Influences sizing standards, labeling requirements, and channel allocation strategy. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NAM|EMEA|APAC|LATAM|GLOBAL|DOMESTIC — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FTC — Textile and Apparel Labeling Requirements; CPSC — Product Safety Standards; GDPR; CCPA

attributes.name: target_sku_count
attributes.description: Planned total number of SKUs (Stock Keeping Units) across all styles, colors, and sizes in this collection. Drives warehouse capacity planning, OTB budget, and assortment depth decisions.

attributes.name: wholesale_allocation_pct

Includes weekly OTB recalculation triggers and variance thresholds for merchant alerts. Core financial control mechanism preventing over-buying and ensuring inventory investment aligns with sales plans. Managed in Anaplan with Oracle Retail integration.

attributes.name: otb_budget_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate key identifying each Open-to-Buy (OTB) budget master record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for the otb_budget data product.

The MFP sets top-down financial targets (planned sales, COGS, GM%, IMU%, markdown budget) for a season/depar

attributes.name: merchandise_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.merchandise_hierarchy. Business justification: OTB budgets have department_id, class_id but no FK to merchandise_hierarchy master. Adding merchandise_hierarchy_id FK normalizes merchandise classification and removes redundant hierarchy attributes.

attributes.name: retail_store_id
attributes.description: Reference to the channel or location (e.g., retail store, e-commerce, wholesale) for which this OTB budget is defined. Enables channel-level OTB tracking across DTC and wholesale.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: season_id
attributes.description: Reference to the merchandise season (e.g., Spring/Summer 2025, Fall/Winter 2025) to which this OTB budget belongs. Drives seasonal buy plan alignment in Anaplan.
attributes.references: Anaplan Merchandise Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: actual_receipts_cost
attributes.description: The actual merchandise receipt value at cost consumed by confirmed purchase orders (POs) for the OTB budget month to date. Used for open-to-buy cost-basis tracking and cash flow management. Expressed in the operating currency.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System; SAP S/4HANA MM; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: actual_receipts_retail
attributes.description: The actual merchandise receipt value at retail price consumed by confirmed buy plans and purchase orders (POs) for the OTB budget month to date. Compared against planned receipts to compute remaining OTB. Expressed in the operating currency.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System; SAP S/4HANA MM; Anaplan

attributes.name: alert_threshold_percent
attributes.description: The variance threshold percentage (e.g., 0.10 = 10%) at which a merchant alert is triggered for this OTB budget record. When actual receipts or sales deviate from plan by more than this threshold, an alert is raised for merchant review and OTB recalculation.
attributes.references: Anaplan Merchandise Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: alert_triggered
attributes.description: Indicates whether a merchant alert has been triggered for this OTB budget record due to variance exceeding the defined alert threshold. True = alert active and pending merchant review; False = within acceptable variance range.
attributes.references: Anaplan Merchandise Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: anaplan_model_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the Anaplan model and workspace from which this OTB budget record was sourced. Enables traceability back to the originating Anaplan planning model for reconciliation and audit.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The name or employee identifier of the merchant or planning manager who approved this OTB budget record. Required for financial control governance and audit trail.
attributes.references: Anaplan Merchandise Financial Planning; FLA — Labor Standards Compliance; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: The date on which this OTB budget record was formally approved by the merchant or planning manager. Marks the transition from submitted to approved status and authorizes buying activity.

attributes.name: bom_inventory_cost
attributes.description: The value of on-hand inventory at cost (landed duty paid) at the beginning of the OTB budget month. Used for COGS tracking and gross margin analysis. Expressed in the operating currency.
attributes.references: Anaplan Merchandise Financial Planning; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: bom_inventory_retail
attributes.description: The value of on-hand inventory at retail (selling) price at the beginning of the OTB budget month. Used as the opening inventory position in the OTB formula: OTB = Planned EOM Inventory + Planned Sales + Planned Markdowns - BOM Inventory. Expressed in the operating currency.
attributes.references: Anaplan Merchandise Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Price Management; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: budget_month
attributes.description: The calendar month (1–12) to which this OTB budget record applies. OTB is recalculated monthly; this field identifies the specific planning month within the budget year.
attributes.references: Anaplan Merchandise Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: budget_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the OTB budget record. Draft: under construction by planner. Submitted: pending merchant approval. Approved: authorized for buying. Locked: frozen for the period. Closed: period ended. Revised: re-opened for adjustment.
attributes.references: Anaplan Merchandise Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: budget_version
attributes.description: Version number of the OTB budget record, incremented each time the budget is revised or re-submitted. Supports version control and audit trail for merchandise financial planning changes in Anaplan.

attributes.name: budget_year
attributes.description: The fiscal or calendar year (e.g., 2025) to which this OTB budget record applies. Used for annual merchandise financial planning and year-over-year variance analysis.

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: The distribution channel for which this OTB budget is defined. Retail: physical stores. E-Commerce: digital storefront. Wholesale: B2B partners. DTC (Direct-to-Consumer): brand-owned channels. Outlet: off-price stores.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System; Salesforce Commerce Cloud

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this OTB budget record was first created in the Databricks Silver Layer. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and compliance with IFRS/GAAP record-keeping requirements.
attributes.references: IFRS/GAAP; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity and accountability)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this OTB budget record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Ensures consistent currency denomination across retail and cost values.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The last date through which this OTB budget record is effective. Typically the last day of the budget month. After this date, the budget is closed and actuals are reconciled.
attributes.references: Anaplan Merchandise Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The first date from which this OTB budget record is effective and binding for merchandise purchasing decisions. Typically the first day of the budget month.
attributes.references: Anaplan Merchandise Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: eom_inventory_target_retail
attributes.description: The planned ending inventory value at retail price at the end of the OTB budget month. This is the target stock position that feeds into the next month's BOM inventory and is a key driver of the OTB formula. Expressed in the operating currency.
attributes.references: Anaplan Merchandise Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: imu_percent
attributes.description: The Initial Markup (IMU) percentage applied to convert retail values to cost values for this OTB budget period. IMU = (Retail - Cost) / Retail. Used to derive OTB at cost from OTB at retail and to assess margin health.
attributes.references: Anaplan Merchandise Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Price Management

attributes.name: last_recalculation_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the OTB budget values were last recalculated in Anaplan. Supports audit trail and ensures merchants are working with the most current OTB position.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the merchant or planner to document assumptions, exceptions, or rationale for OTB budget decisions (e.g., promotional event impact, supply chain disruption, vendor delay). Supports audit trail and planning transparency.

attributes.name: otb_cost
attributes.description: The remaining open-to-buy dollars at cost available for the OTB budget month. Derived from OTB at retail adjusted by the Initial Markup (IMU) percentage. Used for purchase order (PO) commitment and cash flow management. Expressed in the operating currency.
attributes.references: Anaplan Merchandise Financial Planning; SAP S/4HANA MM; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: otb_retail
attributes.description: The remaining open-to-buy dollars at retail price available for the OTB budget month. Calculated as: Planned EOM Inventory + Planned Sales + Planned Markdowns - BOM Inventory - Actual Receipts at Retail. A positive value indicates buying capacity; negative indicates over-bought. Expressed in the operating currency.
attributes.references: Anaplan Merchandise Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: planned_gmroi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Planned Gross Margin Return on Investment (GMROI)
attributes.description: The planned Gross Margin Return on Investment (GMROI) for the OTB budget period. GMROI = Gross Margin / Average Inventory at Cost. Measures the return generated per dollar of inventory investment. Used to prioritize department and class-level OTB allocations.
attributes.references: Anaplan Merchandise Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: planned_markdown_retail
attributes.description: The planned markdown (MD) dollar amount at retail for the OTB budget month. Markdowns reduce the retail inventory value and are a key input to the OTB formula and Maintained Markup (MMU) calculation. Expressed in the operating currency.
attributes.references: Anaplan Merchandise Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Price Management; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: planned_receipts_cost
attributes.description: The total planned merchandise receipt value at cost (landed duty paid / LDP) for the OTB budget month. Used for cash flow planning, purchase order (PO) commitment tracking, and COGS forecasting. Expressed in the operating currency.
attributes.references: Anaplan Merchandise Financial Planning; SAP S/4HANA MM; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: planned_receipts_retail
attributes.description: The total planned merchandise receipt value at retail price for the OTB budget month. Represents the maximum retail value of goods the merchant plans to receive. Expressed in the operating currency.
attributes.references: Anaplan Merchandise Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: planned_sales_retail
attributes.description: The planned net sales revenue at retail price for the OTB budget month, as defined in the merchandise financial plan. Drives the OTB calculation and sell-through rate (STR) targets. Expressed in the operating currency.
attributes.references: Anaplan Merchandise Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: planned_sales_units
attributes.description: The planned number of units to be sold during the OTB budget month. Used alongside planned sales at retail to derive the Average Unit Retail (AUR) and validate unit-level buy quantities.
attributes.references: Anaplan Merchandise Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Assortment Planning

attributes.name: planned_sell_through_rate

attributes.references: Anaplan Merchandise Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System; SAP Customer Activity Repository

Drives procurement workflows in SAP S/4HANA MM.

attributes.name: fob_cost
attributes.description: Free on Board unit cost agreed with the vendor, representing the product cost at the point of origin before freight, duties, and insurance. Used as the base cost in COGS and IMU calculations. Expressed in the plan currency.

attributes.name: hs_code

attributes.name: imu_percent

attributes.references: Anaplan — Merchandise Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Price Management

attributes.name: in_dc_date
attributes.description: Planned date for merchandise to arrive at the distribution center. Drives inbound scheduling in Manhattan Associates WMS and store allocation timing. Critical for floor-set and launch date compliance.

attributes.name: incoterms
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) governing the transfer of risk and cost responsibility between buyer and vendor for this buy plan shipment. attributes.name: is_nos

attributes.name: ldp_cost
attributes.description: Landed Duty Paid unit cost inclusive of FOB cost, ocean/air freight, customs duties, insurance, and port handling charges. Represents the true total cost of goods at the destination DC. Used for COGS, GMROI, and IMU calculations.

attributes.name: msrp

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: planned_receipt_end_date

attributes.name: planned_str_percent

attributes.references: Anaplan — Merchandise Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Price Management

attributes.name: moq
attributes.description: The Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) required by the supplier for this buy plan line. Constrains the minimum units that can be ordered and may cause confirmed units to differ from planned units. Critical for buy plan feasibility analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Vendor Master; Infor PLM — Sourcing

attributes.name: msrp
attributes.description: The Manufacturer's Suggested Retail Price (MSRP) for the SKU on this buy plan line. Used to calculate Initial Markup (IMU) and supports wholesale pricing, retail pricing strategy, and GMROI analysis.
attributes.references: FTC — Pricing Disclosure Requirements; Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Price Management

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments associated with this buy plan line, capturing merchandiser annotations, supplier negotiation notes, or special handling instructions not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Assortment Planning

attributes.name: original_cancel_date
attributes.description: The original date by which the purchase order for this buy plan line must be cancelled if the supplier cannot fulfill. Established at the time of initial buy plan creation as part of the Time and Action (T&A) calendar.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Purchase Order; Infor PLM — T&A Calendar

attributes.name: planned_receipt_date
attributes.description: The planned date on which the units for this buy plan line are expected to be received at the distribution center or warehouse. Drives inventory flow planning, OTB timing, and Weeks of Supply (WOS) calculations.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Allocation; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: planned_sell_through_pct
attributes.description: The planned Sell-Through Rate (STR) percentage for this buy plan line, representing the expected proportion of units sold at full price or within the season. Used as a benchmark for post-season performance analysis and future buy plan calibration.
attributes.references: Anaplan — Merchandise Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Assortment Planning

attributes.name: planned_units
attributes.description: The total number of units planned for purchase on this buy plan line for the season. Represents the initial buy commitment before any revisions. Core quantity field for OTB tracking and inventory planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Assortment Planning; Anaplan — Merchandise Planning

attributes.name: pre_production_sample_status
attributes.description: The approval status of the Pre-Production (PP) sample for this buy plan line. PP sample approval is a prerequisite for production release in the T&A calendar. Tracked in the PLM system.
attributes.references: Infor PLM — Sourcing; Centric PLM — Collection Management; CPSC — Product Safety Standards

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: The high-level product category for this buy plan line (e.g., Tops, Bottoms, Outerwear, Footwear, Accessories). Used for cross-category OTB analysis and assortment balance reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Assortment Planning; Centric PLM — Collection Management

attributes.name: purchase_currency_code
attributes.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the unit cost is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, CNY). Required for multi-currency buy plan consolidation and financial reporting under IFRS/GAAP.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; IFRS/GAAP — Foreign Currency Transactions

attributes.name: revised_cancel_date
attributes.description: The most recently revised cancel date for this buy plan line, updated during the T&A (Time and Action) calendar review process. Tracks changes to delivery commitments and supplier negotiation outcomes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Purchase Order; Infor PLM — T&A Calendar

attributes.name: revised_units
attributes.description: The most recently revised unit quantity for this buy plan line, reflecting any adjustments made after the initial plan was set. Enables tracking of buy plan changes against original commitments and OTB impact analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Assortment Planning; Anaplan — Merchandise Planning

attributes.name: season_code
attributes.description: The merchandising season code to which this buy plan line belongs (e.g., SS25 for Spring/Summer 2025, FW25 for Fall/Winter 2025). Drives collection planning, OTB budgeting, and sell-through rate (STR) analysis by season.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Assortment Planning; Anaplan — Merchandise Planning

attributes.name: size_code
attributes.description: The size designation for this buy plan line (e.g., XS, S, M, L, XL, 28x30, 7.5). Represents the specific size within the size run being committed to in this purchase. Drives size curve analysis and allocation planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Assortment Planning

attributes.name: size_run_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this buy plan line represents a full size run, partial size run, core size run (best-selling sizes only), or extended size run (including plus/petite). Drives assortment breadth decisions and size curve planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Assortment Planning; Anaplan — Merchandise Planning

attributes.name: style_number
attributes.description: The alphanumeric style identifier assigned during product design and development in the PLM system. Represents the base product design before colorway and size differentiation. Used for cross-SKU reporting and collection planning.
attributes.references: Infor PLM — Product Design; Centric PLM — Collection Management

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: The negotiated cost per unit for this buy plan line, expressed in the purchase currency. May represent CMT (Cut Make Trim) cost or FOB (Free on Board) cost depending on the sourcing arrangement. Core input for COGS and GMROI calculations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Purchase Order; IFRS/GAAP — Inventory Costing

attributes.name: upc
attributes.description: The Universal Product Code (UPC) barcode identifier for the specific SKU on this buy plan line. Used for downstream POS scanning, warehouse receiving, and EDI transactions with suppliers.
attributes.references: GS1 US — UPC Barcode Standard; FTC Textile Labeling Requirements

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this buy plan line record was last modified, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Tracks the most recent change for audit and data freshness monitoring.

products.name: merchandise_hierarchy
products.description: Master reference for the merchandise classification hierarchy defining the organizational structure of product categories: Division > Department > Class > Subclass. Governs how assortments, OTB budgets, and financial plans are structured and reported. Managed in Oracle Retail Merchandising System as the foundational taxonomy.

attributes.name: merchandise_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each node in the merchandise hierarchy. Primary key for the merchandise_hierarchy data product in the Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORM) silver layer.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Merchandise Hierarchy

attributes.name: labeling_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.labeling_requirement. Business justification: Each merchandise class/subclass has specific FTC/CPSC labeling requirements (children's sleepwear, wool products, fur); hierarchy determines applicable label rules for all products in category.

attributes.name: parent_hierarchy_merchandise_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the immediate parent node in the merchandise hierarchy. A Division node has a null parent; a Department references its Division; a Class references its Department; a Subclass references its Class. Enables hierarchical roll-up for OTB, GMROI, and financial planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Merchandise Hierarchy

attributes.name: channel_applicability
attributes.description: Indicates which sales channels this merchandise hierarchy node applies to: all channels, retail stores, e-commerce (DTC digital), wholesale, or direct-to-consumer (DTC). Governs channel-specific assortment planning, OTB allocation, and pricing strategies in Oracle Retail and Salesforce Commerce Cloud.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Assortment Planning; Salesforce Commerce Cloud

attributes.name: class_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code identifying the Class level node within a Department (e.g., 'JKT' for Jackets, 'PNT' for Pants). Null for Division and Department-level records. Used in Oracle Retail for class-level assortment planning, price management, and STR analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Merchandise Hierarchy

attributes.name: class_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the Class (e.g., 'Jackets', 'Pants', 'T-Shirts', 'Sneakers'). Null for Division and Department-level records. Displayed in Oracle Retail assortment planning, allocation, and price management modules.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Merchandise Hierarchy

attributes.name: cpsc_regulated
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) Regulated Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether products in this merchandise hierarchy node are subject to Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) safety standards (e.g., childrens apparel flammability, drawstring regulations). Triggers mandatory safety testing and compliance documentation requirements in Infor PLM and quality management workflows.
attributes.references: Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) — Product Safety Standards for Apparel; CPSC 16 CFR Part 1610

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this merchandise hierarchy record was first created in the Oracle Retail Merchandising System and ingested into the Databricks silver layer. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and change management tracking.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System; ISO 8601; IFRS/GAAP Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code identifying the Department level node (e.g., 'ACT' for Activewear, 'OTW' for Outerwear). Null for Division-level records. Used in Oracle Retail for department-level OTB budgeting, allocation strategies, and merchandise financial planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Merchandise Hierarchy

attributes.name: department_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the Department (e.g., 'Activewear', 'Outerwear', 'Denim', 'Footwear'). Null for Division-level records. Denormalized for flat reporting in assortment planning, OTB dashboards, and Anaplan merchandise financial plans.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Merchandise Hierarchy

attributes.name: division_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code identifying the top-level Division to which this hierarchy node belongs (e.g., 'MNS' for Mens, 'WMN' for Womens, 'KDS' for Kids). Populated at all levels for denormalized reporting and OTB budget allocation in Anaplan.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Merchandise Hierarchy

attributes.name: division_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the top-level Division (e.g., 'Mens', 'Womens', 'Kids', 'Accessories'). Denormalized at all hierarchy levels to support flat reporting in Oracle Retail, Anaplan, and BI dashboards without requiring joins.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Merchandise Hierarchy

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date after which this merchandise hierarchy node is no longer active for new planning, OTB, or SKU assignment. Null indicates an open-ended, currently active node. Supports hierarchy versioning and historical reporting in Oracle Retail and Anaplan.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Merchandise Hierarchy

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this merchandise hierarchy node becomes effective and available for use in assortment planning, OTB budgeting, and SKU assignment in Oracle Retail Merchandising System. Supports temporal validity management for hierarchy restructuring.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Merchandise Hierarchy

attributes.name: erp_category_code
attributes.description: Corresponding material group or product category code in SAP S/4HANA (MM module) that maps to this merchandise hierarchy node. Ensures alignment between Oracle Retail merchandise taxonomy and SAP procurement, inventory valuation, and COGS reporting.
