attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Material Group; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: fiber_content_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether products in this merchandise hierarchy node require fiber content disclosure on product labels per FTC Textile and Apparel Labeling regulations. Drives compliance requirements in Infor PLM tech pack specifications and product labeling workflows.
attributes.references: Federal Trade Commission (FTC) — Textile Fiber Products Identification Act; FTC Textile and Apparel Labeling Requirements

attributes.name: gender_affinity
attributes.description: Gender classification associated with this merchandise hierarchy node, used to segment assortments, OTB budgets, and marketing campaigns. Aligns with Oracle Retail Merchandising System division and department structures for gender-based merchandise financial planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Merchandise Hierarchy; Apparel Industry Classification Standards

attributes.name: hierarchy_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code that uniquely identifies this hierarchy node within the Oracle Retail Merchandising System. Used as the business key in OTB budgets, assortment plans, and financial reporting across Oracle Retail and Anaplan.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Merchandise Hierarchy

attributes.name: hierarchy_depth
attributes.description: Numeric depth of this node in the hierarchy tree: 1=Division, 2=Department, 3=Class, 4=Subclass. Supports hierarchical traversal, roll-up aggregation, and level-specific filtering in OTB and GMROI reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Merchandise Hierarchy

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Indicates the level of this node within the four-tier merchandise classification structure: Division > Department > Class > Subclass. Governs how OTB budgets, assortment plans, and GMROI reporting are structured and rolled up in Oracle Retail Merchandising System.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Merchandise Hierarchy; National Retail Federation (NRF) Merchandise Hierarchy Standards

attributes.name: hierarchy_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the merchandise hierarchy node (e.g., 'Mens Activewear', 'Outerwear', 'Footwear'). Displayed in assortment planning, OTB reporting, and financial planning dashboards in Oracle Retail and Anaplan.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Merchandise Hierarchy

attributes.name: hierarchy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this merchandise hierarchy node. Active nodes are available for assortment planning, OTB budgeting, and SKU assignment. Inactive or archived nodes are retained for historical reporting but excluded from new planning cycles in Oracle Retail and Anaplan.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Merchandise Hierarchy

attributes.name: hs_code_prefix
attributes.description: The Harmonized System (HS) Code prefix (4-6 digit chapter/heading) associated with this merchandise hierarchy node, used for customs classification, import duty calculation, and trade compliance reporting. Supports LDP cost calculation and GSP eligibility assessment in SAP S/4HANA and supply chain operations.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) Harmonized System; FTC Textile and Apparel Labeling Requirements; U.S. Customs and Border Protection

attributes.name: is_nos_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Never Out of Stock (NOS) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether products in this merchandise hierarchy node are designated as Never Out of Stock (NOS) items requiring continuous replenishment. NOS-eligible nodes receive dedicated OTB budget allocation and automated replenishment triggers in Oracle Retail and Manhattan Associates WMS.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Allocation; NOS Planning Standards

attributes.name: is_private_label
attributes.description: Indicates whether this merchandise hierarchy node is designated for private label (own-brand) products as opposed to national or licensed brands. Affects sourcing strategy (CMT, OEM, ODM), IMU targets, and margin planning in Infor PLM and Anaplan.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System; Infor PLM — Sourcing

attributes.name: labor_compliance_standard
attributes.description: Labor compliance certification standard required for suppliers producing goods in this merchandise hierarchy node (e.g., FLA, WRAP, SA8000, SEDEX). Governs supplier qualification, factory audit requirements, and sourcing decisions in SAP S/4HANA MM and Infor PLM sourcing modules.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Association (FLA) — Labor Standards Compliance; Worldwide Responsible Accredited Production (WRAP); ISO 45001

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this merchandise hierarchy record was last updated in the Oracle Retail Merchandising System or the Databricks silver layer. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, change detection, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System; ISO 8601; IFRS/GAAP Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: lifestyle_category
attributes.description: Lifestyle or end-use category classification for this hierarchy node, distinguishing athletic performance, lifestyle, luxury, workwear, casual, and outdoor segments. Supports brand positioning, collection planning, and targeted marketing strategies in Adobe Experience Platform and Anaplan.
attributes.references: Apparel Industry Classification Standards; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: markdown_strategy
attributes.description: Markdown (MD) strategy designation for this merchandise hierarchy node, indicating the planned approach to price reductions during the selling season. Governs Oracle Retail Price Management markdown rules, Anaplan financial planning assumptions, and MMU maintenance targets.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management; Anaplan Merchandise Financial Planning

attributes.name: merchandise_hierarchy_description
attributes.description: Free-text business description of this merchandise hierarchy node, providing additional context about the product category, its scope, and any special planning or sourcing considerations. Maintained in Oracle Retail Merchandising System and used in buyer-facing assortment planning documentation.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Merchandise Hierarchy

attributes.name: merchandise_type
attributes.description: Broad merchandise type classification indicating the nature of products within this hierarchy node. Drives category-specific planning rules, margin targets, and allocation strategies in Oracle Retail and Anaplan merchandise financial planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Merchandise Hierarchy; NRF Merchandise Classification Standards

attributes.name: otb_budget_method
attributes.description: Indicates the Open-to-Buy (OTB) budget planning methodology applied to this merchandise hierarchy node: top-down (executive-driven), bottom-up (buyer-driven), or hybrid. Determines how Anaplan merchandise financial plans are structured and reconciled with Oracle Retail OTB budgets.
attributes.references: Anaplan Merchandise Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System — OTB

attributes.name: plm_category_code
attributes.description: Corresponding category code in the Infor PLM or Centric PLM system that maps to this merchandise hierarchy node. Enables cross-system alignment between the Oracle Retail merchandise taxonomy and the PLM product design and BOM management classification for collection planning and tech pack organization.
attributes.references: Infor PLM — BOM Management; Centric PLM — Collection Management

attributes.name: season_applicability
attributes.description: Seasonal classification indicating which selling seasons this hierarchy node is active for. Drives seasonal buy plan creation, OTB budget phasing, and collection planning cycles in Oracle Retail Merchandising System and Anaplan.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Assortment Planning; Anaplan Merchandise Planning

attributes.name: sort_sequence
attributes.description: Numeric ordering sequence for displaying this hierarchy node among its siblings within the same parent. Controls the display order in Oracle Retail Merchandising System screens, assortment planning tools, and reporting dashboards.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Merchandise Hierarchy

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this merchandise hierarchy record originated (e.g., ORM for Oracle Retail Merchandising System, SAP for SAP S/4HANA). Supports data lineage, master data management reconciliation, and silver layer provenance tracking in the Databricks lakehouse.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System; SAP S/4HANA; Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: subclass_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code identifying the Subclass level node within a Class (e.g., 'PUFF' for Puffer Jackets, 'WNDBRKR' for Windbreakers). Null for Division, Department, and Class-level records. The most granular level for SKU assignment, OTB allocation, and STR tracking.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Merchandise Hierarchy

attributes.name: subclass_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the Subclass (e.g., 'Puffer Jackets', 'Windbreakers', 'Slim Fit Jeans'). Null for Division, Department, and Class-level records. Used in Oracle Retail for the most granular assortment planning, allocation, and markdown optimization.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Merchandise Hierarchy

attributes.name: target_gmroi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Target Gross Margin Return on Investment (GMROI)
attributes.description: Target Gross Margin Return on Investment (GMROI) for this merchandise hierarchy node, calculated as gross margin dollars divided by average inventory cost. A primary KPI for merchandise financial planning and OTB budget justification in Anaplan and Oracle Retail.
attributes.references: Anaplan Merchandise Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: target_imu_pct
attributes.description: Target Initial Markup (IMU) percentage for products within this merchandise hierarchy node, representing the planned markup from cost to MSRP at the time of first receipt. A key financial planning metric in Anaplan OTB and Oracle Retail Price Management for setting pricing strategy and GMROI targets.
attributes.references: Anaplan Merchandise Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Price Management; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: target_str_pct
attributes.description: Target Sell-Through Rate (STR) percentage for this merchandise hierarchy node, representing the planned proportion of received inventory sold within a season. Used in Oracle Retail and Anaplan to evaluate assortment performance, trigger markdown decisions, and set OTB buy quantities.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Assortment Planning; Anaplan Merchandise Planning

attributes.name: target_wos
attributes.description: Target Weeks of Supply (WOS) for this merchandise hierarchy node, representing the planned number of weeks of inventory on hand relative to forecasted sales rate. Drives replenishment triggers, OTB phasing, and allocation strategies in Oracle Retail and Manhattan Associates WMS.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Allocation; Anaplan Demand Planning

products.name: price_master
products.description: Master pricing record for each style/SKU capturing MSRP, AUR (Average Unit Retail), IMU (Initial Markup), wholesale price, and cost price across channels and regions. Tracks price tier classification (luxury, premium, value), currency, and effective date ranges. Managed in Oracle Retail Price Management module.

attributes.name: price_master_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each price master record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Serves as the primary key for the price_master data product.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management — Internal Record Identifier

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales channel for which this price record is applicable (e.g., DTC retail store, e-commerce, wholesale). Supports channel-specific pricing strategies.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Channel Management

attributes.name: customer_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.segment. Business justification: Differential pricing strategies by customer segment (VIP early access pricing, employee discounts, wholesale vs retail). Segment-based price optimization and dynamic pricing models require linking pri

attributes.name: ftc_label_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.ftc_label. Business justification: Pricing records require FTC-compliant labeling (fiber content, care, RN/WPL, origin); price_master must link to approved label ensuring legal compliance before product can be sold.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Price changes trigger revenue recognition and markdown accounting entries to specific GL accounts. Finance requires this link to automate GL posting of price changes and ensure proper revenue/markdown

attributes.name: price_list_id
attributes.description: Reference to the price list or price zone under which this record is governed. Price lists segment pricing by channel, region, or customer tier in Oracle Retail Price Management.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Price Management Module

attributes.name: quality_certification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.quality_certification. Business justification: Certified products (organic, fair trade, GOTS) command premium pricing. Certifications justify MSRP and support brand claims. Essential for pricing strategy, regulatory compliance, and marketing claim

attributes.name: region_id
attributes.description: Reference to the geographic region or market for which this price record applies. Supports regional pricing strategies across domestic and international markets.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Location Hierarchy

attributes.name: season_id
attributes.description: Reference to the merchandise season (e.g., Spring/Summer, Fall/Winter) associated with this price record. Supports seasonal buy plan and OTB (Open-to-Buy) budget alignment.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Season Management; Anaplan — Merchandise Planning

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) for which this price record applies. A SKU represents the most granular sellable unit (style + color + size). Links to the product/SKU master.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Item Master

attributes.name: style_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent style record for which this pricing applies. A style may encompass multiple SKUs (colors and sizes). Enables style-level pricing analysis and rollup reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Item Master; Infor PLM — Product Design

attributes.name: vendor_cost_quote_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sourcing.vendor_cost_quote. Business justification: Retail pricing decisions reference vendor cost quotes to calculate IMU and validate margin targets. Essential for pricing strategy, ensuring retail prices achieve target margins based on actual source

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.vendor. Business justification: Wholesale and FOB cost pricing are negotiated per vendor; merchandising requires vendor-specific cost tracking for margin analysis, vendor performance evaluation, and buy plan costing accuracy in appa

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Workflow approval status of the price record within the Oracle Retail Price Management approval process. Prices must be approved before becoming active. Supports governance and audit trail for pricing decisions.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Price Approval Workflow; ISO 9001 — Quality Management

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Username or employee identifier of the merchandising manager or pricing analyst who approved this price record in Oracle Retail Price Management. Supports audit trail and pricing governance.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Price Approval Workflow; ISO 9001 — Quality Management

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the price record was formally approved in the Oracle Retail Price Management workflow. Provides a precise audit trail for pricing governance and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Price Approval Workflow; ISO 9001 — Quality Management

attributes.name: aur
attributes.description: Average Unit Retail (AUR) — the average price at which a unit is actually sold after accounting for promotions, markdowns (MD), and clearance events. A key KPI in merchandise financial planning and STR (Sell-Through Rate) analysis. Managed in Anaplan merchandise planning.
attributes.references: Anaplan — Merchandise Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: competitor_price
attributes.description: The observed or benchmarked competitor price for a comparable product at the time of pricing decision. Used to support competitive pricing analysis and market positioning strategy. Expressed in the currency defined by currency_code.
attributes.references: FTC — Pricing Disclosure Requirements; Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Price Management

attributes.name: cost_price
attributes.description: The landed cost price of the product including COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) components such as CMT (Cut Make Trim), materials, LDP (Landed Duty Paid) duties, and freight. Used as the denominator for IMU (Initial Markup) and MMU (Maintained Markup) calculations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Cost Management

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3 country code identifying the specific country market for which this price record applies. Supports country-level pricing compliance, VAT/tax treatment, and international trade reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3 — Country Codes; IFRS/GAAP — Geographic Segment Reporting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this price master record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation anchor for the price record lifecycle.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Price Management; ISO 9001 — Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which all monetary price fields (MSRP, wholesale price, cost price, AUR, markdown price) are expressed. Supports multi-currency pricing for international markets and regional price management.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; IFRS/GAAP — Foreign Currency Reporting

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this price record expires and is no longer applicable for transactions. Nullable for open-ended pricing. Used to manage price validity windows, promotional end dates, and seasonal clearance cutoffs.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Price Management; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this price record becomes active and applicable for transactions. Used to manage price change calendars, promotional windows, and seasonal pricing transitions in Oracle Retail Price Management.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Price Management; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: fob_cost
attributes.description: FOB (Free on Board) cost representing the factory gate price paid to the supplier before freight and duty charges. Used in sourcing negotiations, BOM (Bill of Materials) costing, and supplier performance benchmarking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Infor PLM — Sourcing; Incoterms 2020 — FOB

attributes.name: imu_percent
attributes.description: Initial Markup Percentage (IMU%) — the percentage markup applied at the time of first pricing, calculated as (MSRP - Cost Price) / MSRP × 100. A foundational metric in merchandise financial planning and OTB (Open-to-Buy) budget setting.
attributes.references: Anaplan — Merchandise Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Price Management

attributes.name: landed_duty_paid_cost
attributes.description: Total LDP (Landed Duty Paid) cost including FOB (Free on Board) price, import duties, freight, insurance, and customs clearance charges. Used as the true cost basis for margin calculations and sourcing decisions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Infor PLM — Sourcing; HS Code — Harmonized System for Duty Classification

attributes.name: markdown_percent
attributes.description: The percentage reduction from MSRP applied during a markdown (MD) event, calculated as (MSRP - Markdown Price) / MSRP × 100. Used to track markdown depth, promotional cadence, and margin erosion in merchandise financial planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Price Management; Anaplan — Merchandise Planning

attributes.name: markdown_price
attributes.description: The reduced selling price applied during a markdown (MD) event, clearance, or end-of-season promotion. Tracked separately from MSRP to enable markdown depth analysis and STR (Sell-Through Rate) optimization.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Price Management; Anaplan — Merchandise Planning

attributes.name: min_advertised_price
attributes.description: The minimum price at which wholesale partners and retailers are contractually permitted to advertise this product. Enforced to protect brand equity and prevent price erosion in wholesale and marketplace channels.
attributes.references: FTC — Resale Price Maintenance Guidelines; Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Price Management

attributes.name: mmu_percent
attributes.description: Maintained Markup Percentage (MMU%) — the actual markup percentage realized after all markdowns (MD), promotions, and shrinkage adjustments. Reflects true profitability versus the initial pricing plan. Used in GMROI (Gross Margin Return on Investment) analysis.
attributes.references: Anaplan — Merchandise Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: msrp
attributes.description: Manufacturer's Suggested Retail Price (MSRP) — the recommended consumer-facing selling price set by the brand. Used as the baseline for IMU (Initial Markup) calculation, wholesale negotiations, and consumer price communication. Expressed in the currency defined by the currency_code field.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Price Management; FTC — Pricing Disclosure Requirements

attributes.name: price_change_reason
attributes.description: Business justification or reason code for the price change event (e.g., seasonal markdown, competitive response, cost increase, promotional event, clearance). Supports pricing audit trail and merchandise financial planning analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Price Management; Anaplan — Merchandise Planning

attributes.name: price_elasticity_index
attributes.description: A numeric index representing the price sensitivity of demand for this SKU/style, derived from historical sales and pricing data in Anaplan. Used to optimize markdown timing, promotional depth, and AUR (Average Unit Retail) planning.
attributes.references: Anaplan — Demand Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: price_master_code
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the price master record as assigned in Oracle Retail Price Management. Used for cross-system reference and EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) integration with wholesale partners and ERP systems.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Price Management Module

attributes.name: price_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the price master record. Active records are currently in use; pending records are approved but not yet effective; expired records have passed their effective end date; superseded records have been replaced by a newer price version.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Price Management Module

attributes.name: price_tier
attributes.description: Classification of the product's price positioning within the brand's pricing architecture. Drives assortment planning, channel allocation, and marketing strategy. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: luxury|premium|mid_market|value|outlet|off_price — promote to reference product if tiers expand beyond 6]
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Price Management; Anaplan — Collection Planning

attributes.name: price_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the nature of the price record — regular everyday price, promotional price, clearance/end-of-season price, wholesale price, cost price, or internal transfer price. Governs which price is applied in each transaction context.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Price Management Module

attributes.name: price_version
attributes.description: Sequential version number of the price record, incremented each time the price is updated or superseded. Enables price history tracking and point-in-time pricing reconstruction for audit and analytics purposes.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Price Management; ISO 9001 — Document Version Control

attributes.name: price_zone_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the geographic or channel-based price zone to which this price record belongs. Price zones allow differentiated pricing across markets (e.g., US_EAST, EU_WEST, APAC) within Oracle Retail Price Management.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Price Zone Management

attributes.name: sales_channel_type
attributes.description: The type of sales channel for which this price is applicable. DTC (Direct-to-Consumer) retail, DTC e-commerce, wholesale, outlet, marketplace, or franchise. Enables channel-specific pricing strategy and margin analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Channel Management; Salesforce Commerce Cloud

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this price record originated. ORM = Oracle Retail Merchandising, SAP_SD = SAP Sales & Distribution, SFCC = Salesforce Commerce Cloud, ANAPLAN = Anaplan Planning, MANUAL = manually entered. Supports data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System; SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Salesforce Commerce Cloud

attributes.name: tax_inclusive_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the MSRP and selling prices include applicable taxes (VAT, GST, sales tax). True = tax-inclusive pricing (common in EU/UK markets); False = tax-exclusive pricing (common in US markets). Governs POS and e-commerce price display.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — Tax Management; IFRS/GAAP — Revenue Recognition; GDPR — Consumer Pricing Transparency

attributes.name: transfer_price
attributes.description: The internal price used for inter-company or inter-division product transfers (e.g., from distribution center to retail store, or between legal entities). Used in SAP S/4HANA FI/CO for intercompany accounting and IFRS transfer pricing compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; IFRS/GAAP — Transfer Pricing; OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines

attributes.name: upc_code
attributes.description: Universal Product Code (UPC) barcode identifier for the SKU. Used for POS (Point of Sale) scanning, RFID (Radio Frequency Identification) tagging, and retail shelf management. Conforms to GS1 UPC-A or EAN-13 standards.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) Standard

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this price master record was most recently modified. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, change data capture (CDC), and audit trail maintenance in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Price Management; ISO 9001 — Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: vat_rate_percent
attributes.description: The applicable VAT (Value Added Tax) or GST rate percentage for this product in the specified country/region. Used for tax-inclusive price calculation, consumer receipt display, and regulatory tax reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — Tax Management; IFRS/GAAP — Tax Reporting; EU VAT Directive

attributes.name: wholesale_price
attributes.description: The price at which the product is sold to wholesale partners, department stores, and distribution accounts. Used in wholesale margin analysis, partner negotiations, and GMROI (Gross Margin Return on Investment) reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Price Management; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

products.name: promotion
products.description: Master record for merchandise promotions including seasonal sales events, clearance promotions, bundle offers, and loyalty-linked price reductions. Captures promotion type, discount mechanics (percentage off, BOGO, fixed price), eligible merchandise scope, channel applicability, and planned versus actual promotional lift. Managed in Oracle Retail and SAP SD.

attributes.name: promotion_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the promotion record. Primary key for the promotion data product in the merchandising domain.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System; SAP SD

attributes.name: budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.budget. Business justification: Promotions consume markdown and promotional budget; must link to budget for spend tracking and variance analysis. Finance requires this link to monitor promotional spend against budget and forecast re

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Merchandising promotions (markdowns, discounts) are executed as part of marketing campaigns. This link tracks which campaign drives each pricing action, enabling integrated promotional planning and RO

attributes.name: circular_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.circular_program. Business justification: Promotions incentivize circular economy participation (e.g., 20% off when trading in old garments). Retailers run promotional campaigns tied to specific circular programs for customer engagement and s

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Promotion costs (advertising, discounts, loyalty rewards) are charged to marketing/merchandising cost centers. Finance requires this link to allocate promotional expenses and track cost center budget

attributes.name: customer_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.segment. Business justification: Promotions target customer segments beyond loyalty programs (student discounts, military offers, first-time buyer incentives). Segment-specific promotions drive acquisition and retention strategies wi

attributes.name: loyalty_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loyalty program associated with loyalty-linked promotions. Null for non-loyalty promotion types. Links to CRM (Customer Relationship Management) loyalty program master data in Adobe Experience Platform or Salesforce.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform; Salesforce CRM; GDPR Article 6 (Lawful Basis for Processing)

attributes.name: manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Promotions are created and managed by marketing or merchandising employees who define discount strategy, channel scope, and performance targets. Required for approval workflows, promotion effectivenes

attributes.name: merchandise_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.merchandise_hierarchy. Business justification: Promotions have department_id, class_id but no FK to merchandise_hierarchy master. Adding merchandise_hierarchy_id FK normalizes merchandise classification and removes redundant hierarchy attributes.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Promotions impact margin by channel/brand, tracked via profit centers for ROI analysis. Financial reporting requires linking promotional lift and cost to profit centers to measure promotional effectiv

attributes.name: promo_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.promo_code. Business justification: Marketing promo codes trigger merchandising promotions at checkout. This link connects the code distribution mechanism (marketing) to the discount rules and budget impact (merchandising). Essential fo

attributes.name: season_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.season. Business justification: Promotions are seasonal events (Spring Sale, Holiday Clearance); season_code exists but no FK to season master. Adding season_id FK normalizes season reference and removes redundant season_code. FK wi

attributes.name: source_promotion_id
attributes.description: Original promotion identifier as recorded in the source operational system (e.g., Oracle Retail promotion number, SAP SD condition record number). Enables traceability and reconciliation between the Databricks Silver Layer and source systems of record.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System; SAP SD Condition Records

attributes.name: actual_lift_pct
attributes.description: Realized percentage increase in unit sales or revenue achieved by this promotion compared to baseline, captured post-promotion from SAP CAR POS data and Salesforce Commerce Cloud. Compared against planned_lift_pct for STR (Sell-Through Rate) analysis and future promotion planning.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR); Anaplan Financial Planning

attributes.name: actual_revenue
attributes.description: Realized gross revenue generated during the promotion period, sourced from SAP CAR POS transactions and Salesforce Commerce Cloud order data. Compared against planned_revenue for post-promotion performance analysis and GMROI optimization.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR); Salesforce Commerce Cloud; IFRS 15

attributes.name: actual_units
attributes.description: Realized number of units sold during the promotion period, sourced from SAP CAR POS and Salesforce Commerce Cloud. Used in STR (Sell-Through Rate) analysis and post-promotion inventory reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR); Salesforce Commerce Cloud

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Workflow approval state of the promotion record within the merchandising governance process. Pending: awaiting review; Approved: authorized by merchandising director or finance; Rejected: not approved; Escalated: referred to senior leadership. Distinct from promotion_status which tracks operational lifecycle.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System; SAP SD Workflow

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the merchandising manager or director who authorized this promotion. Supports audit trail requirements for pricing governance and FTC compliance on promotional advertising claims.
attributes.references: Federal Trade Commission (FTC) - Promotional Advertising Guidelines; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the promotion was formally approved by the authorized merchandising stakeholder. Supports audit trail and compliance with FTC promotional advertising disclosure requirements. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Federal Trade Commission (FTC) - Promotional Advertising Guidelines; Oracle Retail

attributes.name: channel_applicability
attributes.description: Sales channel(s) where the promotion is valid. Retail_store: physical POS via SAP CAR; ecommerce: digital storefront via Salesforce Commerce Cloud; wholesale: B2B distribution partners; dtc: Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) channels; all: applicable across all channels. Drives channel-specific promotional lift analysis.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR); Salesforce Commerce Cloud; Oracle Retail

attributes.name: coupon_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric coupon or voucher code that customers enter at POS or e-commerce checkout to activate the promotion when coupon_required is True (e.g., SAVE20, LOYALTY10). Null when coupon_required is False.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud; SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR)

attributes.name: coupon_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer must present or enter a coupon code to redeem the promotion. True = coupon code required at POS or e-commerce checkout; False = automatic/stackable promotion applied without customer action.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System; SAP SD

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the promotion record was first created in the source system (Oracle Retail or SAP SD). Supports data lineage, audit trail, and GDPR/CCPA data governance requirements. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity and Accountability); CCPA; Oracle Retail

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code applicable to all monetary fields on this promotion record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency operations across international retail and wholesale channels.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS/GAAP Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: discount_rate
attributes.description: Markdown (MD) percentage applied to the original MSRP or AUR (Average Unit Retail) for percentage-off promotion types. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 25.00 = 25% off). Null for non-percentage promotion types such as fixed_price or bogo. Used in IMU/MMU (Initial Markup/Maintained Markup) impact analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the promotion expires and is no longer applicable. Nullable for open-ended evergreen promotions. Used to calculate WOS (Weeks of Supply) impact and OTB (Open-to-Buy) planning in Anaplan.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System; Anaplan Merchandise Planning

attributes.name: fixed_price_amount
attributes.description: Absolute promotional selling price applied to eligible items for fixed_price promotion types (e.g., $29.99). Null for percentage-off or BOGO mechanics. Represents the promotional AUR (Average Unit Retail) override in Oracle Retail Price Management.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management; SAP SD Condition Type PR00

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes where the promotion is valid (e.g., USA|CAN|GBR). Null = global applicability. Supports multi-market promotional planning and compliance with regional consumer protection regulations.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3 Country Codes; FTC Promotional Guidelines; GDPR

attributes.name: gmroi_impact
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gross Margin Return on Investment (GMROI) Impact
attributes.description: Estimated or realized GMROI (Gross Margin Return on Investment) impact of the promotion, calculated as gross margin dollars generated per dollar of inventory investment during the promotional period. A core KPI in apparel merchandising financial planning. Classified confidential as it reveals margin strategy.
attributes.references: Anaplan Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: is_loyalty_exclusive
attributes.description: Indicates whether this promotion is exclusively available to loyalty program members. True = restricted to loyalty members only (tracked via Adobe Experience Platform or CRM); False = available to all customers. Supports CLTV (Customer Lifetime Value) and loyalty program ROI analysis.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform; Salesforce CRM; GDPR Article 6

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the promotion record was most recently modified in the source system. Tracks changes to promotion terms, dates, or discount mechanics for audit and data lineage purposes. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity and Accountability); CCPA; Oracle Retail

attributes.name: markdown_budget
attributes.description: Allocated markdown (MD) budget for this promotion, representing the maximum planned reduction in gross margin approved by the merchandising team. Expressed in currency_code. Managed in Anaplan OTB (Open-to-Buy) financial planning. Classified confidential as it reflects internal pricing strategy.
attributes.references: Anaplan Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Price Management; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: merchandise_scope
attributes.description: Level of the merchandise hierarchy to which the promotion applies. Determines eligible SKUs (Stock Keeping Units) in Oracle Retail: all_merchandise (storewide), department (e.g., Footwear), class (e.g., Running Shoes), subclass (e.g., Men's Running), sku (specific SKU), style (all colorways of a style). Drives assortment planning and allocation strategies.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System; Oracle Retail Assortment Planning

attributes.name: minimum_purchase_amount
attributes.description: Minimum transaction value (in local currency) a customer must reach to qualify for the promotion. Used for threshold-based promotions (e.g., spend $100 get 20% off). Supports AOV (Average Order Value) uplift strategies in Salesforce Commerce Cloud and SAP CAR.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System; SAP SD

attributes.name: minimum_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum number of units a customer must purchase to qualify for the promotion. Relevant for BOGO, bundle, and quantity-threshold promotions. Aligns with MOQ (Minimum Order Quantity) concepts in wholesale channel promotions.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System; SAP SD

attributes.name: planned_lift_pct
attributes.description: Forecasted percentage increase in unit sales or revenue expected from this promotion compared to baseline, as planned in Anaplan merchandise financial planning. Used to set OTB (Open-to-Buy) budgets and evaluate GMROI (Gross Margin Return on Investment) impact pre-promotion.
attributes.references: Anaplan Demand Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: planned_revenue
attributes.description: Forecasted gross revenue expected to be generated during the promotion period, as modeled in Anaplan merchandise financial planning. Expressed in the currency defined by currency_code. Used for OTB budget setting and GMROI planning.
attributes.references: Anaplan Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: planned_units
attributes.description: Forecasted number of units expected to be sold during the promotion period, as planned in Anaplan demand planning. Used to set inventory allocation targets and ATS (Available to Sell) thresholds in Manhattan Associates WMS.
attributes.references: Anaplan Demand Planning; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking used to resolve conflicts when multiple non-stackable promotions apply to the same transaction or item. Lower number = higher priority. Managed in Oracle Retail Price Management and SAP SD condition access sequences.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management; SAP SD Condition Access Sequence

attributes.name: promotion_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code used to identify and reference the promotion across Oracle Retail, SAP SD, and customer-facing channels (e.g., SUMMER25, BOGO-DENIM). Used in EDI transactions, POS systems, and e-commerce storefronts.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System; SAP SD Module SD-BF (Pricing and Conditions)

attributes.name: promotion_description
attributes.description: Free-text business description of the promotion's terms, conditions, and marketing narrative as communicated to customers and store associates (e.g., 'Get 25% off all women's outerwear this weekend only'). Used in POS displays, e-commerce banners, and marketing collateral.
attributes.references: Federal Trade Commission (FTC) - Promotional Advertising Disclosure Requirements; Oracle Retail

attributes.name: promotion_name
attributes.description: Human-readable business name of the promotion as displayed in merchandising systems and marketing materials (e.g., 'Summer Clearance 2025', 'Buy One Get One Denim'). Used in Oracle Retail and Anaplan merchandise financial planning.

attributes.name: promotion_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the promotion record within Oracle Retail and SAP SD workflow. Draft: under construction; Approved: authorized by merchandising; Active: currently running; Paused: temporarily suspended; Expired: past end date; Cancelled: terminated before activation.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System; SAP SD

attributes.name: promotion_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the promotion's discount mechanic. Drives how the discount is calculated at POS and in e-commerce. Values: percentage_off (e.g., 20% off), fixed_price (e.g., $29.99), bogo (Buy One Get One), bundle (multi-item offer), loyalty (loyalty program linked reduction), clearance (end-of-season markdown). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: percentage_off|fixed_price|bogo|bundle|loyalty|clearance|gift_with_purchase|threshold_discount — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System; SAP SD Condition Types

attributes.name: sell_through_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of available promotional inventory sold during the promotion period (units sold / units available × 100). A key KPI in apparel merchandising for evaluating promotion effectiveness and informing future markdown (MD) and clearance strategies. Sourced post-promotion from Oracle Retail and SAP CAR.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System; SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR)

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this promotion record originated. Oracle_retail: Oracle Retail Merchandising System; sap_sd: SAP S/4HANA Sales and Distribution; salesforce_cc: Salesforce Commerce Cloud; anaplan: Anaplan planning platform; manual: manually entered. Supports data lineage in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System; SAP S/4HANA SD; Salesforce Commerce Cloud

attributes.name: stackable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this promotion can be combined with other active promotions on the same transaction. True = can stack with other promotions; False = exclusive promotion, cannot be combined. Critical for margin protection and MMU (Maintained Markup) management.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management; SAP SD Condition Exclusion Groups

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the promotion becomes effective and eligible for application at POS, e-commerce, and wholesale channels. Aligns with the T&A (Time and Action) calendar in Anaplan merchandise planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System; Anaplan Merchandise Planning

attributes.name: usage_limit_per_customer
attributes.description: Maximum number of times a single customer can redeem this promotion. Null = unlimited per customer. Enforced at POS via SAP CAR and at e-commerce checkout via Salesforce Commerce Cloud to prevent abuse.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud; SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR)

attributes.name: usage_limit_total
attributes.description: Maximum total number of times this promotion can be redeemed across all customers and transactions. Null = unlimited redemptions. Used for limited-time flash sales and exclusive loyalty offers to control promotional liability.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System; Salesforce Commerce Cloud

products.name: allocation_plan
products.description: Merchandise allocation plan defining how available inventory is distributed across retail stores, e-commerce fulfillment centers, and wholesale accounts. Captures allocation strategy (initial allocation, replenishment, push, transfer), store cluster assignments, size curve profiles, priority rules, and planned versus actual allocated units by style/colorway. Managed in Oracle Retail Allocation module.

attributes.name: allocation_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the merchandise allocation plan record within the Oracle Retail Allocation module.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Allocation Module

attributes.name: allocator_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Allocation plans are created and owned by allocation analysts who determine store-level distribution strategy, size curve application, and replenishment rules. Required for approval workflows, audit t

attributes.name: buy_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.buy_plan. Business justification: Allocation plans distribute inventory that was committed via buy plans. The buy_plan commits to purchasing X units of a style from a vendor; the allocation_plan determines how to distribute those unit

attributes.name: class_merchandise_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the merchandise class within the Oracle Retail hierarchy (below department, above subclass), used to scope the allocation plan to a specific product grouping such as 'Outerwear' or 'Athletic Footwear'.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Merchandise Hierarchy

attributes.name: colorway_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific style/colorway combination being allocated. A colorway represents a distinct color variant of a style, one level above the SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) in the product hierarchy.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Master; Infor PLM

attributes.name: compliance_certification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_certification. Business justification: Allocation plans cannot distribute product without valid certifications (safety, sustainability); allocation approval gates depend on compliance status to prevent shipping non-compliant inventory.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Allocation planning costs (labor, systems, logistics overhead) are charged to merchandising operations cost centers. Finance requires this link to allocate allocation planning expenses for departmenta

attributes.name: customer_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.segment. Business justification: Store allocations consider local customer segment demographics (allocate more activewear to fitness-focused markets, more workwear to business districts). Segment mix by geography drives size curves a

attributes.name: destination_distribution_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.distribution_center. Business justification: Store allocations often route through regional DCs before final delivery. Destination DC link enables multi-echelon allocation planning, inter-DC transfer planning, and regional replenishment strategi

attributes.name: distribution_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the source warehouse or distribution center from which allocated inventory will be shipped. Managed in Manhattan Associates WMS and SAP S/4HANA WM module.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA WM

attributes.name: merchandise_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the merchandise department (e.g., Men's Apparel, Women's Footwear) within the Oracle Retail merchandise hierarchy under which this allocation plan is organized.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Merchandise Hierarchy

attributes.name: order_purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the source purchase order (PO) from which inventory is being allocated. Links the allocation plan to the procurement event in SAP S/4HANA MM module.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Purchase Order Management

attributes.name: otb_budget_id
attributes.description: Reference to the OTB (Open-to-Buy) budget record that governs the financial envelope for this allocation plan. Links to the Anaplan merchandise financial planning budget to ensure allocation activity stays within approved spend.
attributes.references: Anaplan Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Assortment Planning

attributes.name: production_factory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.factory. Business justification: Allocation plans track factory of origin for inventory traceability, quality control, and compliance documentation. Required for country-of-origin labeling and audit trails in retail operations.

attributes.name: season_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.season. Business justification: Allocation plans distribute seasonal merchandise; season_code exists but no FK to season master. Adding season_id FK normalizes season reference and removes redundant season_code. FK will reference me

attributes.name: size_curve_id
attributes.description: Reference to the size curve profile that defines the percentage distribution of units across sizes (e.g., XS/S/M/L/XL) for this allocation plan. Derived from historical sell-through rate (STR) data by store cluster and product category.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Allocation Module

attributes.name: store_cluster_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store cluster grouping used to drive allocation distribution logic. Store clusters segment retail locations by performance tier, geography, climate, or customer demographics to enable targeted allocation strategies.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Allocation Module; Oracle Retail Assortment Planning

attributes.name: style_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific product style being allocated. A style represents a distinct design within the product hierarchy, above colorway and SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) level.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Master; Infor PLM

attributes.name: subclass_merchandise_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the merchandise subclass within the Oracle Retail hierarchy (most granular classification level), scoping the allocation plan to a specific product type such as 'Puffer Jackets' or 'Running Shoes'.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Merchandise Hierarchy

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.work_order. Business justification: Connects allocation plans to production batches for inventory lot control, quality traceability, and production date tracking. Required for FIFO/LIFO inventory management and quality issue resolution.

attributes.name: allocation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the allocation strategy applied in this plan. 'Initial' distributes new receipts to stores; 'replenishment' refills depleted stock; 'push' proactively sends inventory based on forecasts; 'transfer' moves stock between locations; 'pre_pack' allocates pre-assembled size sets.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Allocation Module

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The name or employee identifier of the merchandise planner or manager who approved the allocation plan for execution. Supports governance and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Allocation Module; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: The date on which the allocation plan was formally approved for execution by the authorized merchandise planner or manager.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Allocation Module; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: available_to_sell_units
attributes.description: The number of units confirmed as ATS (Available to Sell) at the time of allocation plan creation. Represents the inventory pool from which allocations are drawn, net of committed and reserved quantities.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Allocation Module; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The distribution channel to which inventory is being allocated. Retail store covers brick-and-mortar locations; ecommerce covers fulfillment centers serving digital orders; wholesale covers partner accounts; DTC (Direct-to-Consumer) covers owned digital and physical channels.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Allocation Module

attributes.name: cost_per_unit
attributes.description: The unit cost (COGS - Cost of Goods Sold basis) of the item being allocated, expressed in the operating currency. Used for GMROI (Gross Margin Return on Investment) analysis and financial planning reconciliation in Anaplan.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; Anaplan Financial Planning; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this allocation plan record was first captured in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and GDPR/CCPA data governance requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; CCPA; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary values in this allocation plan record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Ensures consistent financial reporting across multi-currency wholesale and international retail operations.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the allocation plan expires or is no longer valid for execution. Nullable for open-ended replenishment plans. Aligns with season end dates and OTB (Open-to-Buy) budget periods.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Allocation Module; Anaplan Merchandise Planning

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which the allocation plan becomes active and inventory distribution should commence. Used to align allocation execution with the merchandise floor set calendar and T&A (Time and Action) calendar.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Allocation Module; Anaplan Merchandise Planning

attributes.name: in_store_date
attributes.description: The planned date on which allocated inventory is expected to arrive and be available on the retail floor or in the fulfillment center. Critical for floor set planning, marketing campaign alignment, and NOS (Never Out of Stock) compliance.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Allocation Module; SAP Customer Activity Repository

attributes.name: is_manual_override
attributes.description: Indicates whether any allocation quantities in this plan have been manually overridden by a planner, deviating from the system-calculated distribution. Supports audit trail requirements and exception reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Allocation Module; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: is_nos_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Never Out of Stock (NOS) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the items in this allocation plan are designated as NOS (Never Out of Stock) items, requiring continuous replenishment allocation to maintain minimum stock levels across all qualifying locations.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Allocation Module

attributes.name: is_size_curve_override
attributes.description: Indicates whether the default size curve profile has been manually overridden by the merchandise planner for this allocation plan. When True, the size_curve_id reflects a custom profile rather than the system-recommended curve.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Allocation Module

attributes.name: max_store_units
attributes.description: The maximum number of units that can be allocated to any single store location in this plan. Prevents over-stocking and ensures equitable distribution across the store network.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Allocation Module

attributes.name: min_store_units
attributes.description: The minimum number of units that must be allocated to each qualifying store location in this plan. Ensures NOS (Never Out of Stock) compliance and prevents under-stocking of key locations.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Allocation Module

attributes.name: msrp
attributes.description: The MSRP (Manufacturer's Suggested Retail Price) for the allocated item at the time of plan creation. Used as the baseline for IMU (Initial Markup) calculations and markdown (MD) planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Price Management; FTC Pricing Guidelines

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for merchandise planners to capture contextual notes, exceptions, or business rationale associated with the allocation plan (e.g., 'Adjusted for regional weather event', 'Held pending PO confirmation').
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Allocation Module

attributes.name: plan_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the allocation plan was created or initiated by the merchandise planner. Represents the principal real-world event time for this allocation planning transaction.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Allocation Module

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the allocation plan, typically referencing the season, collection, or merchandise category (e.g., 'Fall 2025 Outerwear Initial Push').
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Allocation Module

attributes.name: plan_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the allocation plan, used in cross-system references, buyer communications, and Oracle Retail Allocation module tracking. Follows the format ALLOC-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Allocation Module

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the allocation plan within the Oracle Retail Allocation workflow. Controls whether the plan is editable, executable, or archived. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|approved|in_progress|completed|cancelled|on_hold — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Allocation Module

attributes.name: priority_rule
attributes.description: The business rule governing how inventory is prioritized across locations when supply is constrained. Options include sales volume ranking, store grade, cluster rank, manual override, OTB (Open-to-Buy) balance, or WOS (Weeks of Supply) target. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sales_volume|store_grade|cluster_rank|manual|otb_balance|wos_target — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Allocation Module

attributes.name: ship_date
attributes.description: The planned date on which inventory is scheduled to ship from the distribution center to allocated store or fulfillment locations. Drives warehouse pick/pack scheduling in Manhattan Associates WMS.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Allocation Module

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the originating operational system that created or last updated this allocation plan record. Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System; Anaplan Merchandise Planning

attributes.name: str_target_pct
attributes.description: The target STR (Sell-Through Rate) percentage for this allocation plan, expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 85.00 = 85%). Used to evaluate allocation effectiveness and inform markdown (MD) timing decisions.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Price Management; Anaplan Merchandise Planning

attributes.name: total_actual_units
attributes.description: The total number of units actually allocated and confirmed for distribution across all locations. May differ from planned units due to inventory availability, ATS (Available to Sell) constraints, or manual overrides.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Allocation Module

attributes.name: total_planned_units
attributes.description: The total number of units planned for distribution across all locations in this allocation plan. Represents the gross planned allocation quantity before any adjustments or overrides.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Allocation Module

attributes.name: unallocated_units
attributes.description: The number of units from the available inventory pool that remain unallocated after the plan is executed. Represents residual inventory requiring further allocation decisions or return to the warehouse.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Allocation Module

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this allocation plan record was most recently modified in the data platform. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; CCPA; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: wos_target
attributes.description: The target WOS (Weeks of Supply) used to calculate allocation quantities per location. Drives replenishment allocation logic by ensuring each store receives enough inventory to cover the defined number of selling weeks based on forecasted sales velocity.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Allocation Module; Anaplan Demand Planning

products.name: allocation_detail
products.description: Line-level allocation transaction capturing the specific units allocated per SKU per location (store, DC, or channel) within an allocation plan. Records planned allocation quantity, actual shipped quantity, allocation date, and variance. Feeds WMS fulfillment and store receiving workflows in Manhattan Associates WMS.

attributes.name: allocation_detail_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each allocation detail line record within the allocation plan. Primary key for this entity in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Allocation Module

attributes.name: allocation_analyst_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Detailed allocation decisions at SKU-location level are made by specific analysts for manual overrides, exception handling, and store-specific adjustments. Essential for accountability, quality contro

attributes.name: allocation_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent allocation plan header under which this detail line was created. Links the line-level allocation to its governing plan in Oracle Retail Merchandising System.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Allocation Module

attributes.name: inspection_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.inspection. Business justification: Detail-level inspection results determine if specific allocated quantities can ship. Failed inspections trigger allocation adjustments and replenishment delays. Essential for store-level quality contr

attributes.name: order_purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Purchase Order (PO) from which inventory is being allocated. Links the allocation detail to the sourcing event in SAP S/4HANA MM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Purchase Order; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: product_safety_test_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.product_safety_test. Business justification: Individual SKU allocations require passed safety tests; cannot ship product failing CPSC, ASTM, or EN standards. Links allocation to test result for shipment release approval.

attributes.name: production_factory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.factory. Business justification: Detail-level factory tracking enables shipment-specific origin documentation, customs compliance, and quality issue root cause analysis. Essential for supply chain traceability and regulatory complian

attributes.name: retail_store_id
attributes.description: Reference to the destination location (retail store, distribution center, or fulfillment channel) receiving the allocated units. Drives WMS fulfillment and store receiving workflows in Manhattan Associates WMS.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Location Master; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the outbound shipment record in Manhattan Associates WMS that fulfilled this allocation detail line. Links the allocation to the physical shipment for OTIF (On Time In Full) tracking and logistics reconciliation.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) being allocated. Identifies the exact product variant (style, color, size) targeted by this allocation line.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Item Master; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: sourcing_purchase_order_line_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Sourcing Purchase Order Line Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sourcing.sourcing_purchase_order_line. Business justification: Detail-level allocation tied to specific PO lines. Enables precise inventory flow tracking from factory to location, reconciliation of received vs. allocated quantities, and SKU-level supply chain vis

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.work_order. Business justification: Detail-level production batch tracking enables lot-specific quality control, recall management, and production date verification. Critical for compliance, traceability, and quality assurance processes

attributes.name: actual_receipt_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the destination location confirmed receipt of the allocated units. Used for OTIF compliance measurement and inventory availability updates.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS – Receiving; SAP Customer Activity Repository

attributes.name: actual_ship_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which allocated units were physically shipped from the distribution center. Used for OTIF variance analysis and supply chain performance reporting.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS – Fulfillment; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: allocation_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the allocation was created and authorized in Oracle Retail Merchandising System. Used for OTB (Open-to-Buy) period alignment and merchandise financial planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Allocation Module; Anaplan Merchandise Planning

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to determine the allocation quantity for this line: sales_history (based on historical sales velocity), store_grade (based on store tier/grade), capacity (based on store capacity), manual (planner override), or model_stock (based on ideal stock model). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sales_history|store_grade|capacity|manual|model_stock — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Allocation Module; Anaplan Demand Planning

attributes.name: allocation_number
attributes.description: Externally visible business identifier for the allocation detail line, used for cross-system reference between Oracle Retail Merchandising System, Manhattan Associates WMS, and SAP S/4HANA. Follows the format ALLOC-YYYYMMDD-NNNN.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Allocation Module

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the allocation detail line. Tracks progression from planning through fulfillment: draft (in planning), approved (authorized), released (sent to WMS), shipped (dispatched from DC), received (confirmed at destination), cancelled (voided). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|approved|released|shipped|received|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Allocation Module; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: approved_qty
attributes.description: The number of units formally approved for allocation after review and authorization. May differ from planned quantity due to inventory availability constraints or OTB budget adjustments.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Allocation Module

attributes.name: asr_number
attributes.description: The Advance Shipment Receipt number generated by Manhattan Associates WMS when the allocation is released for fulfillment. Used by destination locations to pre-receive and reconcile inbound inventory against the allocation.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS – Receiving; EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) Standards

attributes.name: ats_qty
attributes.description: The Available to Sell (ATS) quantity for this SKU at the time the allocation was created, representing total on-hand and on-order inventory minus existing commitments. Determines the maximum allocatable quantity and is sourced from Oracle Retail Merchandising System inventory positions.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Inventory; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason for cancellation when allocation_status is 'cancelled'. Common reasons include inventory shortage, OTB budget cut, assortment change, or supplier failure. Required for cancelled lines to support merchandise planning post-mortems.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Allocation Module

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: The commerce channel to which units are being allocated: retail (physical store), ecommerce (digital storefront via Salesforce Commerce Cloud), wholesale (B2B distribution), or dtc (Direct-to-Consumer). Supports channel-level sell-through rate (STR) and ATS (Available to Sell) analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Allocation Module; Salesforce Commerce Cloud

attributes.name: class_code
attributes.description: Merchandise class code within the department hierarchy for the allocated SKU (e.g., Tops, Bottoms, Outerwear). Supports class-level allocation analysis and assortment planning in Oracle Retail Merchandising System.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Merchandise Hierarchy

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this allocation detail record was first created in the source system. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SLA compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); IFRS Audit Requirements

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary values on this allocation detail line (unit_cost, msrp). Supports multi-currency operations across international wholesale and DTC (Direct-to-Consumer) channels.

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Merchandise department classification code for the allocated SKU (e.g., Men's Apparel, Women's Footwear, Accessories). Used for department-level allocation reporting and OTB budget tracking in Oracle Retail Merchandising System.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Merchandise Hierarchy

attributes.name: is_pre_pack
attributes.description: Indicates whether the allocated units are configured as pre-packs (assorted size/color combinations packed together) rather than individual units. Pre-pack allocations require different WMS handling and store receiving procedures in Manhattan Associates WMS.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS – Pre-Pack Fulfillment; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: is_replenishment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this allocation detail line is a replenishment allocation (true) triggered by store inventory depletion, as opposed to an initial buy allocation (false) for a new season or collection. Supports NOS (Never Out of Stock) and VMI (Vendor Managed Inventory) program tracking.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Replenishment; Anaplan Demand Planning

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number of this detail record within the parent allocation plan, used for ordering and referencing individual allocation lines during fulfillment and receiving.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Allocation Module

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: Classification of the destination location receiving the allocation: store (retail store), dc (distribution center), warehouse (storage facility), or channel (e-commerce or wholesale channel). Determines the fulfillment workflow in Manhattan Associates WMS.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Location Master; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: msrp
