attributes.description: Reference to the vendor providing the allowance or co-op funding.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.work_order. Business justification: Vendor allowances often tied to specific production runs for quality claims, late delivery penalties, or markdown support. Essential for vendor performance management and cost recovery.

attributes.name: accrual_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the financial accrual period during which the allowance is earned.

attributes.name: accrual_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the financial accrual period during which the allowance is earned.

attributes.name: actual_performance_amount
attributes.description: Actual sales or purchase amount achieved during the accrual period, used to calculate earned allowance.

attributes.name: actual_performance_units
attributes.description: Actual unit quantity sold or purchased during the accrual period, used to calculate earned allowance.

attributes.name: agreement_amount
attributes.description: Total contracted or committed allowance amount agreed with the vendor.

attributes.name: agreement_end_date
attributes.description: Effective end date of the vendor allowance agreement or accrual period. Nullable for open-ended agreements.

attributes.name: agreement_start_date
attributes.description: Effective start date of the vendor allowance agreement or accrual period.

attributes.name: allowance_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier or reference number for the vendor allowance agreement, used in vendor negotiations and financial reporting.

attributes.name: allowance_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage rate applied to calculate the allowance (e.g., 5% of net sales, 2% markdown allowance). Nullable if allowance is fixed amount.

attributes.name: allowance_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the vendor allowance: draft (under negotiation), active (in effect), claimed (submitted for payment), partially settled, fully settled, expired, disputed, or cancelled. attributes.name: allowance_type
attributes.description: Category of vendor allowance: markdown money (MDA), advertising allowance, volume rebate, defective allowance, Return to Vendor (RTV) credit, promotional funding, or freight allowance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: markdown_money|advertising_allowance|volume_rebate|defective_allowance|rtv_credit|promotional_funding|freight_allowance — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the allowance agreement or claim was approved.

attributes.name: claim_reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number or claim ID provided by the vendor for tracking the allowance claim.

attributes.name: claim_submission_deadline
attributes.description: Final date by which the allowance claim must be submitted to the vendor for payment.

attributes.name: claimed_amount
attributes.description: Amount of allowance formally claimed from the vendor for settlement.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vendor allowance record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this allowance record.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Reason for dispute if the allowance status is disputed. Nullable if no dispute exists.

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_date
attributes.description: Date on which a disputed allowance was resolved. Nullable if no dispute or not yet resolved.

attributes.name: earned_amount
attributes.description: Amount of allowance earned based on performance criteria (sales volume, markdown taken, promotional activity) during the accrual period.

attributes.name: gmroi_impact_percent
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gross Margin Return on Investment (GMROI) Impact Percent
attributes.description: Estimated or actual impact of this allowance on Gross Margin Return on Investment (GMROI) for the associated merchandise.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding the vendor allowance agreement, claim, or settlement.

attributes.name: outstanding_amount
attributes.description: Remaining allowance amount not yet settled (claimed minus settled).

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Payment terms negotiated for the allowance settlement (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, Upon Receipt).

attributes.name: performance_threshold_amount
attributes.description: Minimum sales or purchase volume required to qualify for the allowance. Nullable if no threshold applies.

attributes.name: performance_threshold_units

products.name: seasonal_vendor_capacity_agreement
products.description: This association product represents the seasonal capacity commitment contract between a merchandise season and a vendor. It captures the negotiated commercial terms, capacity allocations, performance targets, and operational parameters that govern the vendor-season partnership. Each record links one season to one vendor with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific seasonal engagement, including capacity blocks, CMT rates, lead times, and quality targets that are renegotiated per season.. Existence Justification: In apparel merchandising operations, each season requires capacity from 10-20 vendors to diversify sourcing risk and meet volume requirements, while each vendor simultaneously commits capacity blocks across 4+ concurrent seasons (Spring/Summer, Fall/Winter, Holiday, Resort) for multiple brands. The business actively manages seasonal vendor capacity agreements as distinct operational entities with season-specific negotiated terms including capacity commitments, CMT rates, lead times, and performance targets that are renegotiated each season based on volume forecasts, factory loading, and market conditions.

attributes.name: actual_quality_aql
attributes.description: The actual defect rate (AQL) observed for shipments from this vendor for this season. Calculated from quality inspection results. Compared against quality_target_aql for vendor scorecard.

products.name: collection_seeding
products.description: This association product represents the seeding event between collection_plan and influencer. It captures the operational process of seeding collection merchandise to influencers for launch amplification, content creation, and performance attribution. Each record links one collection_plan to one influencer with attributes that exist only in the context of this seeding relationship, including logistics, deliverables, exclusivity terms, and performance metrics.. Existence Justification: In apparel fashion, collection seeding to influencers is an operational marketing process where a single collection is seeded to multiple influencers for launch amplification, and each influencer receives merchandise from multiple collections across seasons. The business actively manages seeding programs with collection-specific logistics (quantity, timing), contractual deliverables (content count, exclusivity windows), and performance attribution (revenue, engagement). This is not an analytical correlation but an operational relationship that marketing teams create, track, and measure as part of influencer partnership management.

products.name: capacity_booking
products.description: This association product represents the capacity reservation contract between a merchandise season and a manufacturing factory. It captures the strategic capacity planning process where merchandising teams book production capacity at specific factories for upcoming seasons. Each record links one season to one factory with negotiated capacity commitments, availability windows, pricing tiers, and booking terms that exist only in the context of this seasonal capacity agreement.. Existence Justification: In apparel fashion, seasonal capacity planning is a strategic operational process where merchandising teams book production capacity at multiple factories for each upcoming season (Spring/Summer, Fall/Winter, etc.), and each factory simultaneously serves multiple brands and seasons. This is not a reference or ownership relationship—it is an active capacity reservation contract that production planners and sourcing teams manage throughout the planning cycle, adjusting commitments, negotiating pricing, and tracking availability windows specific to each season-factory pairing.

domains.name: store

Tracks store-level STR, ASP, AUR, and traffic analytics via SAP Customer Activity Repository.
domains.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository / POS Standards

products.name: retail_store

Captures store identity, format (flagship, outlet, pop-up, shop-in-shop, concession), trading area classification, gross and net selling square footage, register inventory (terminal count, types, configurations), lease terms and rent structure, regional/district/territory hierarchy, climate zone, and operational status (pre-open, trading, temporarily closed, permanently closed). SSOT for store-level dimensional attributes referenced by POS, inventory, workforce, and omnichannel systems. Conforms to NRF ARTS RetailStore entity. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA Real Estate and SAP Customer Activity Repository.

Sustainability teams track REC allocation by facility for carbon accounting, RE100 complian

attributes.name: waste_record_id

Facilities teams track water consumption by location for sustainability reporting, utility management, water stewardship programs, and opera

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line of the retail store location. Used for logistics, lease documentation, customer store-finder, and regulatory filings. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for the retail store (suite, floor, unit, mall name, or building identifier). Supplements address_line1 for precise location identification in complex retail environments such as shopping malls or department stores.
attributes.references: FTC Textile Labeling Requirements; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: annual_base_rent
attributes.description: Annual base rent amount payable under the store lease agreement in the store's local currency. Used for occupancy cost analysis, GMROI (Gross Margin Return on Investment) calculation, and store profitability modelling. Excludes turnover/percentage rent and service charges.
attributes.references: IFRS 16 Lease Accounting; IFRS/GAAP; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality in which the retail store is located. Used for geographic reporting, tax jurisdiction determination, and regional performance analytics.

attributes.name: climate_zone
attributes.description: Köppen-based climate zone classification for the store's geographic location. Drives seasonal assortment planning, markdown timing, and inventory allocation decisions for weather-sensitive apparel categories (outerwear, swimwear, knitwear).
attributes.references: Köppen Climate Classification; Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Assortment Planning

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date on which the store permanently ceased trading operations. Nullable for active stores. Used for store network rationalization reporting, lease surrender tracking, and historical performance analysis. Populated only when operational_status is permanently_closed.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS RetailStore Entity; SAP S/4HANA Real Estate Module

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the country in which the retail store operates (e.g., USA, GBR, FRA, DEU). Drives currency, tax, regulatory compliance, and international reporting hierarchies.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the retail store master record was first created in the system of record (SAP S/4HANA Real Estate / SAP Customer Activity Repository). Used for data lineage, audit trail, and record lifecycle management in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity and Accountability); ISO 9001 Record Management

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the primary trading currency of the store (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Used for POS transaction recording, financial consolidation, and MSRP/AUR reporting in local currency.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary operational email address for the retail store location. Used for internal communications, vendor coordination, and omnichannel order notifications. Classified as confidential organizational contact data.

attributes.name: fitting_room_count
attributes.description: Total number of fitting rooms (changing rooms/dressing rooms) available in the store. Used for store capacity planning, customer experience benchmarking, and visual merchandising layout design. Relevant for apparel conversion rate analytics.

attributes.name: gross_selling_sqft
attributes.description: Total gross interior square footage of the retail store including all selling, back-of-house, stockroom, and ancillary areas. Used for lease cost-per-square-foot analysis, capital expenditure planning, and store portfolio benchmarking.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS RetailStore Entity; IFRS 16 Lease Accounting

attributes.name: headcount_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum approved headcount (number of employees) for the store as defined in the workforce plan. Used for labour scheduling, Workday HCM position management, and compliance with local employment regulations. Drives OTB labour cost budgeting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; Fair Labor Association (FLA); ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety

attributes.name: is_bopis_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS) Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the store is configured and operationally enabled to fulfil Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS) orders. Drives omnichannel order routing logic in Salesforce Commerce Cloud and SAP Customer Activity Repository. True = BOPIS active; False = BOPIS not available at this location.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS Omnichannel Standards; Salesforce Commerce Cloud Order Management

attributes.name: is_rfid_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the store is equipped with Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) infrastructure for inventory tracking, cycle counting, and loss prevention. RFID-enabled stores support real-time inventory accuracy and ATS (Available to Sell) visibility. True = RFID infrastructure active.
attributes.references: GS1 RFID Standards; NRF ARTS RetailStore Entity; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: is_ship_from_store_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the store is configured to fulfil e-commerce orders by shipping directly to customers from store inventory. Enables distributed fulfilment network capabilities. Drives order routing in Salesforce Commerce Cloud and Manhattan Associates WMS. True = ship-from-store active.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS Omnichannel Standards; Manhattan Associates WMS; Salesforce Commerce Cloud

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the retail store location in decimal degrees (WGS84). Used for store-finder applications, trade area mapping, proximity-based marketing, and omnichannel routing (BOPIS, ship-from-store).

attributes.name: lease_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the current lease agreement for the store premises. Used for lease renewal pipeline management, store closure planning, and IFRS 16 lease liability amortization schedule. Nullable for month-to-month or perpetual arrangements.
attributes.references: IFRS 16 Lease Accounting; SAP S/4HANA Real Estate Module

attributes.name: lease_start_date
attributes.description: Commencement date of the current lease agreement for the store premises as recorded in SAP S/4HANA Real Estate module. Used for lease term tracking, IFRS 16 right-of-use asset calculation, and lease renewal planning.
attributes.references: IFRS 16 Lease Accounting; SAP S/4HANA Real Estate Module

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the retail store location in decimal degrees (WGS84). Used alongside latitude for geospatial analytics, trade area delineation, and omnichannel fulfillment routing.

attributes.name: net_selling_sqft
attributes.description: Net productive selling floor area in square feet, excluding stockroom, fitting rooms, cash wrap, and back-of-house. Primary denominator for sales-per-square-foot (SPF) KPI, visual merchandising density planning, and fixture capacity modelling.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS RetailStore Entity; ICSC Retail Space Standards

attributes.name: opening_date
attributes.description: Date on which the store first opened for trading to customers. Used for store age calculations, comparable store (comp-store) sales analysis, and new store ramp-up performance benchmarking.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS RetailStore Entity; SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR)

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the store location within Apparel Fashion's retail network. Pre-open indicates the store is in fit-out or pre-launch phase; trading indicates active selling operations; temporarily_closed covers seasonal or refurbishment closures; permanently_closed indicates the store has ceased operations. Drives inclusion/exclusion in POS reporting, inventory allocation, and workforce scheduling.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS RetailStore Entity; SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR)

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary customer-facing telephone number for the retail store location. Used for customer service, click-and-collect (BOPIS) coordination, and store directory listings. Classified as confidential organizational contact data.

attributes.name: pos_system_type
attributes.description: Classification of the POS terminal configuration deployed in the store. Fixed terminals are traditional counter-based registers; mobile POS (mPOS) enables floor-based selling; self-checkout enables customer-operated transactions; mixed indicates a combination. Drives IT infrastructure planning and customer experience design.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS RetailStore Entity; SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR)

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the retail store location. Used for trade area analysis, catchment modelling, demographic profiling, and logistics routing.

attributes.name: region_name
attributes.description: Name of the geographic region within Apparel Fashion's retail organizational hierarchy (e.g., North America, EMEA, APAC). Top tier of the region/district/territory hierarchy used for regional performance reporting and resource allocation.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS RetailStore Entity; SAP S/4HANA Organizational Structure

attributes.name: register_count
attributes.description: Total number of active Point of Sale (POS) terminals (registers) installed in the store. Used for transaction throughput capacity planning, queue management, and SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) terminal configuration management.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS RetailStore Entity; SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR)

attributes.name: remodel_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent store remodel or significant capital refurbishment. Used to assess store condition age, plan future capital expenditure cycles, and correlate store investment with post-remodel sales uplift.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS RetailStore Entity; SAP S/4HANA Real Estate Module

attributes.name: rent_structure_type
attributes.description: Classification of the rent payment structure under the store lease. Fixed rent is a flat periodic payment; turnover rent is a percentage of net sales; fixed_plus_turnover combines a base rent with a sales-linked top-up; concession_percentage applies to shop-in-shop and concession formats. Drives financial planning and OTB (Open-to-Buy) modelling.
attributes.references: IFRS 16 Lease Accounting; SAP S/4HANA Real Estate Module

attributes.name: standard_trading_hours
attributes.description: Standard weekly operating hours for the store expressed as a structured string (e.g., 'Mon-Sat 09:00-21:00; Sun 11:00-18:00'). Used for customer-facing store finder, workforce scheduling in Workday HCM, and daily sales reconciliation cut-off timing in SAP Customer Activity Repository.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS RetailStore Entity; SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR)

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region in which the retail store is located. Used for tax jurisdiction mapping, regional hierarchy assignment, and regulatory compliance reporting.

attributes.name: stockroom_sqft
attributes.description: Total square footage of the store's back-of-house stockroom area. Used for inventory capacity planning, WMS (Warehouse Management System) configuration, and the calculation of net-to-gross selling area ratio. Informs replenishment frequency and NOS (Never Out of Stock) capability.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS RetailStore Entity; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: store_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the store, used across SAP S/4HANA, SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR), Oracle Retail, and EDI integrations. Conforms to NRF ARTS store numbering convention. Unique across all store formats and geographies.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS RetailStore Entity; SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR)

attributes.name: store_format
attributes.description: Operational format classification of the store that determines merchandising strategy, assortment depth, pricing authority, and capital investment profile. Flagship stores carry full-price full-assortment; outlet stores carry clearance/off-price; pop-up stores are temporary; shop-in-shop and concession operate within a host retailer's space.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS RetailStore Entity; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: store_name
attributes.description: Official trading name of the retail store location as displayed on signage, customer receipts, and marketing materials. Used for customer-facing communications and brand management reporting.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Tax authority jurisdiction code assigned to the store location for sales tax, VAT, or GST calculation and remittance. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA FI/CO tax configuration. Used for POS transaction tax determination and regulatory tax reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; IFRS/GAAP; FTC Regulatory Reporting

attributes.name: territory_name
attributes.description: Name of the territory or cluster within the district hierarchy. Lowest tier of the organizational hierarchy above individual store level, used for territory manager assignments and localized assortment planning.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS RetailStore Entity; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the store's local operating time zone (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London). Critical for accurate POS transaction timestamping, daily sales reconciliation, and omnichannel order cut-off time management in SAP Customer Activity Repository.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; NRF ARTS RetailStore Entity

attributes.name: trading_area_classification
attributes.description: Classification of the retail trading environment in which the store operates. Determines foot traffic patterns, trading hours, lease structure, and competitive benchmarking peer group. Used in store performance analytics and site selection models. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: high_street|shopping_mall|outlet_center|airport|resort|standalone|department_store — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NRF ARTS RetailStore Entity; International Council of Shopping Centers (ICSC)

products.name: pos_transaction
products.description: Captures every point-of-sale transaction processed at a retail store register, including sale, return, exchange, void, and no-sale events. Records transaction date/time, register ID, cashier/associate, tender split (cash, credit, debit, mobile wallet, gift card, store credit), total amount, tax by jurisdiction, discount applied, loyalty points earned/redeemed, and channel flag (in-store, BOPIS pickup, endless aisle). Conforms to NRF ARTS POSLog standard for transaction classification. Primary transactional heartbeat of the store domain. Sourced from SAP Customer Activity Repository.

attributes.name: pos_transaction_id

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: POS transactions track campaign attribution via promo codes and campaign-specific offers. Essential for measuring in-store campaign ROAS, conversion rates, and incremental sales lift—core retail marke

attributes.name: cashier_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales associate or cashier who processed the transaction. Used for associate-level performance tracking, commission calculation, and loss prevention audits.

attributes.name: digital_storefront_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ecommerce.digital_storefront. attributes.name: loyalty_program_id

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the identified customer (loyalty member or registered account) associated with this transaction. Nullable for anonymous/walk-in transactions. Enables Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV) and loyalty analytics.

attributes.description: Reference to the specific POS register (terminal) at which the transaction was processed within the store. Supports register-level reconciliation and shrinkage analysis.

attributes.description: Reference to the retail store where this POS transaction was processed. Links to the store master in the Store Operations domain.

attributes.name: return_original_transaction_pos_transaction_id
attributes.description: For RETURN or EXCHANGE transaction types, references the original sale transaction being returned against. Enables return merchandise authorization (RMA) traceability and shrinkage analysis. Null for non-return transactions.

attributes.name: rma_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.rma. Business justification: In-store returns with defects or warranty claims generate RMA records for vendor credit processing (RTV authorization). Business process: store return disposition triggers formal RMA when item require

attributes.name: sales_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the associated omnichannel sales order in SAP S/4HANA SD or Salesforce Commerce Cloud for BOPIS, ship-from-store, or endless aisle transactions. Null for standard in-store transactions. Enables cross-channel order traceability.

attributes.name: business_date
attributes.description: The fiscal/retail business date to which this transaction is attributed for daily sales reconciliation and End-of-Month (EOM) reporting. May differ from the wall-clock date for transactions processed after midnight during extended trading hours.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS POSLog Standard; SAP Customer Activity Repository; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: Identifies the omnichannel fulfillment mode under which the transaction was processed. IN_STORE: standard in-store purchase; BOPIS: Buy Online Pick Up In Store; SHIP_FROM_STORE: store fulfills an online order; ENDLESS_AISLE: in-store kiosk ordering; CURBSIDE: curbside pickup. Supports Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) analytics.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS POSLog Standard; Salesforce Commerce Cloud; SAP Customer Activity Repository

attributes.name: coupon_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric coupon or voucher code scanned or entered at the POS to apply a discount. Supports coupon redemption tracking, campaign attribution, and fraud detection in loss prevention.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this transaction record was first ingested into the Silver layer of the Databricks Lakehouse from SAP Customer Activity Repository. Audit trail field for data lineage and ETL reconciliation.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the transaction was denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency retail operations and international store reporting.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value of all discounts and markdowns (MD) applied to the transaction, including promotional discounts, employee discounts, coupon redemptions, and loyalty-funded discounts. Used in Maintained Markup (MMU) and Sell-Through Rate (STR) analysis.
attributes.references: IFRS/GAAP; Oracle Retail Merchandising System; SAP Customer Activity Repository

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: Total pre-discount, pre-tax merchandise value of all items in the transaction at their selling price. Represents the sum of line-item extended prices before any adjustments. Used in Average Unit Retail (AUR) and Average Selling Price (ASP) calculations.

attributes.name: item_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual unit items (units) included in the transaction across all line items. Used for basket size analytics, Average Order Value (AOV) benchmarking, and store traffic conversion metrics.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository; NRF ARTS POSLog Standard

attributes.name: line_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct line items (SKU entries) in the transaction. Differs from item_count when multiple units of the same SKU are purchased. Used for transaction complexity analysis.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS POSLog Standard; SAP Customer Activity Repository

attributes.name: loyalty_points_earned
attributes.description: Number of loyalty reward points earned by the customer on this transaction based on the applicable loyalty program earn rate. Used for loyalty liability accrual and Customer Relationship Management (CRM) analytics.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository; Adobe Experience Platform; IFRS 15

attributes.name: loyalty_points_redeemed
attributes.description: Number of loyalty reward points redeemed by the customer as a form of payment or discount on this transaction. Used for loyalty liability reduction and redemption rate analytics.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository; Adobe Experience Platform; IFRS 15

attributes.name: manager_override_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a manager authorization override was required to complete this transaction (e.g., for price overrides, high-value returns, or discount exceptions). Critical for loss prevention and exception-based reporting.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository; NRF ARTS POSLog Standard

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Final amount tendered by the customer: gross_amount minus discount_amount plus tax_amount. Represents the total cash obligation of the transaction. Primary revenue figure for daily sales reconciliation and KPI reporting.
attributes.references: IFRS/GAAP; NRF ARTS POSLog Standard; SAP Customer Activity Repository

attributes.name: price_override_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a manual price override was applied to one or more items in this transaction, bypassing the system-calculated selling price. Used in loss prevention audits and markdown (MD) exception reporting.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: receipt_delivery_method
attributes.description: Method by which the transaction receipt was delivered to the customer: PRINT (paper receipt), EMAIL (digital email receipt), SMS (text message receipt), NONE (no receipt requested). Supports sustainability reporting and digital engagement analytics.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository; GDPR Article 4; CCPA

attributes.name: receipt_number
attributes.description: Customer-facing receipt identifier printed on the physical or digital receipt. May differ from transaction_number in some POS configurations. Used for customer service, return authorization, and receipt lookup.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS POSLog Standard; SAP Customer Activity Repository

attributes.name: return_reason_code
attributes.description: Coded reason for a merchandise return (e.g., DEFECTIVE, WRONG_SIZE, CHANGED_MIND, GIFT_RETURN). Populated only for RETURN and EXCHANGE transaction types. Used in product quality analysis, CPSC compliance, and Return to Vendor (RTV) decisions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DEFECTIVE|WRONG_SIZE|CHANGED_MIND|GIFT_RETURN|WRONG_ITEM|NOT_AS_DESCRIBED — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CPSC Product Safety Standards; NRF ARTS POSLog Standard; SAP Customer Activity Repository

attributes.name: rfid_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the items in this transaction were verified via Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) scanning at the point of sale. Supports inventory accuracy, shrinkage reduction, and omnichannel Available to Sell (ATS) reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository; GS1 RFID Standards

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total sales tax collected across all applicable tax jurisdictions for this transaction. Aggregated from jurisdiction-level tax lines. Supports tax remittance reporting and compliance with FTC and state tax authorities.
attributes.references: IFRS/GAAP; FTC Textile Labeling Requirements; SAP Customer Activity Repository

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the primary tax jurisdiction (state, county, municipality) applicable to this transaction for sales tax calculation and remittance. Supports multi-jurisdiction tax compliance reporting.
attributes.references: FTC Textile Labeling Requirements; IFRS/GAAP; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO

attributes.name: tender_cash_amount
attributes.description: Amount of the transaction settled by cash tender. Used in daily cash drawer reconciliation and loss prevention audits. Part of the tender split breakdown.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS POSLog Standard; SAP Customer Activity Repository; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: tender_credit_amount
attributes.description: Amount of the transaction settled by credit card tender. Supports PCI DSS compliance reporting and payment reconciliation. Part of the tender split breakdown.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS POSLog Standard; PCI DSS; SAP Customer Activity Repository

attributes.name: tender_debit_amount
attributes.description: Amount of the transaction settled by debit card tender. Supports payment reconciliation and PCI DSS compliance. Part of the tender split breakdown.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS POSLog Standard; PCI DSS; SAP Customer Activity Repository

attributes.name: tender_gift_card_amount
attributes.description: Amount of the transaction settled by gift card redemption. Used for gift card liability tracking, breakage analysis, and revenue recognition per IFRS/GAAP deferred revenue rules.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS POSLog Standard; IFRS 15; SAP Customer Activity Repository

attributes.name: tender_mobile_wallet_amount
attributes.description: Amount of the transaction settled via mobile wallet payment (e.g., Apple Pay, Google Pay, Samsung Pay). Tracks digital payment adoption trends and supports omnichannel payment analytics.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS POSLog Standard; PCI DSS; SAP Customer Activity Repository

attributes.name: tender_store_credit_amount
attributes.description: Amount of the transaction settled using store credit (issued from prior returns or promotions). Supports Return to Vendor (RTV) and return merchandise authorization liability tracking.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS POSLog Standard; IFRS 15; SAP Customer Activity Repository

attributes.name: training_mode_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction was processed in POS training/demo mode and should be excluded from financial reporting and sales analytics. Critical for data quality and accurate daily sales reconciliation.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS POSLog Standard; SAP Customer Activity Repository; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the transaction as printed on the customer receipt and recorded in SAP Customer Activity Repository. Unique within a store and business date combination. Conforms to NRF ARTS POSLog SequenceNumber.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS POSLog Standard; SAP Customer Activity Repository

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the transaction in the POS workflow. COMPLETED: fully tendered and closed; VOIDED: reversed before completion; SUSPENDED: parked mid-transaction for later recall; CANCELLED: abandoned; PENDING: awaiting tender confirmation (e.g., BOPIS pickup).
attributes.references: NRF ARTS POSLog Standard; SAP Customer Activity Repository

attributes.name: transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the transaction was initiated at the register, as recorded by the POS system. Principal business event timestamp. Stored in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for intraday traffic analytics and hourly sales reporting.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS POSLog Standard; SAP Customer Activity Repository

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the transaction event per NRF ARTS POSLog standard. SALE: standard purchase; RETURN: merchandise returned for refund; EXCHANGE: simultaneous return and sale; VOID: cancelled transaction before completion; NO_SALE: register opened without a sale; LAYAWAY: deferred payment purchase.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS POSLog Standard; SAP Customer Activity Repository

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this transaction record was last modified in the Silver layer (e.g., due to post-void processing, tax adjustment, or data correction). Supports audit trail and change data capture (CDC) tracking.

attributes.name: void_reason_code
attributes.description: Coded reason for voiding a transaction (e.g., OPERATOR_ERROR, CUSTOMER_CHANGED_MIND, SYSTEM_ERROR, MANAGER_OVERRIDE). Populated only for VOID transaction types. Used in loss prevention and exception reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: OPERATOR_ERROR|CUSTOMER_CHANGED_MIND|SYSTEM_ERROR|MANAGER_OVERRIDE|PRICE_OVERRIDE|DUPLICATE_TRANSACTION — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NRF ARTS POSLog Standard; SAP Customer Activity Repository

attributes.name: workstation_number
attributes.description: Human-readable identifier of the POS workstation/terminal as configured in SAP Customer Activity Repository (e.g., REG-01, KIOSK-03). Used for register-level reconciliation and store layout analytics.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS POSLog Standard; SAP Customer Activity Repository

products.name: pos_transaction_line
products.description: Individual line-item detail within a POS transaction. Records SKU, UPC, style, colorway, size, quantity sold, unit retail price (AUR), markdown amount, IMU, MMU, COGS, and line-level discount reason. Enables STR, ASP, and AUR analytics at the SKU-store-day grain. Sourced from SAP Customer Activity Repository.

attributes.name: pos_transaction_line_id
attributes.description: Primary key for pos_transaction_line

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Line-level campaign attribution enables SKU-level campaign performance analysis. Merchandising teams use this to understand which products respond to campaigns, informing future assortment and promoti

attributes.name: defect_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.quality_defect. Business justification: Retail stores capture quality defect codes on damaged/defective items at POS for warranty claims, vendor chargebacks, and quality feedback loops. Essential for root cause analysis and supplier perform

attributes.name: ftc_label_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.ftc_label. Business justification: POS systems validate FTC fiber content and care labeling compliance at sale to ensure consumer protection, prevent mislabeling penalties, and support regulatory audits requiring proof of compliant lab

attributes.name: pos_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent POS transaction header. Establishes the header-detail relationship between the transaction and its individual line items. Aligns with TRANSACTION_LINE role HEADER_REFERENCE category.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository — POS Transaction Header

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loyalty program member associated with this transaction line, if the customer identified themselves. Enables customer-level purchase history, CLTV analysis, and personalized marketing attribution.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform — Customer Data Platform; GDPR Article 4; CCPA

attributes.name: promotion_id
attributes.description: Reference to the promotion or markdown event applied to this line item, if any. Links to the promotion master for promotional effectiveness analysis and markdown event attribution.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Price Management; SAP Customer Activity Repository

attributes.name: retail_store_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retail store where this POS transaction line was recorded. Enables store-level STR, ASP, AUR, and traffic analytics at the store-SKU-day grain.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository — Store Master; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: sales_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales associate who processed or assisted with this transaction line. Used for associate-level sales performance tracking, commission calculation, and clienteling analytics.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository — Cashier/Associate ID; Workday HCM

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) sold on this line. Represents the most granular sellable unit combining style, colorway, and size. Aligns with TRANSACTION_LINE role RESOURCE_REFERENCE category.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Material Master; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: class_code
attributes.description: Merchandise class code within the department hierarchy for the SKU sold (e.g., TOPS, BOTTOMS, OUTERWEAR, SNEAKERS). Supports class-level STR, markdown analysis, and assortment planning within Oracle Retail.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Merchandise Hierarchy

attributes.name: cogs
attributes.description: Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) for this line item representing the total cost of the units sold. Used to calculate gross margin, GMROI, and MMU at the SKU-store-day grain. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA material valuation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Material Valuation; IFRS/GAAP COGS Reporting

attributes.name: colorway_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific colorway (color variant) of the style sold on this line. Used for colorway-level sell-through analysis and markdown decision-making within collection planning.
attributes.references: Centric PLM — Colorway Master; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this line item (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency retail operations and financial consolidation reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS/GAAP Financial Reporting

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Merchandise department classification code for the SKU sold (e.g., MENS, WOMENS, KIDS, FOOTWEAR, ACCESSORIES). Enables department-level sales reporting, OTB management, and assortment performance analytics.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Merchandise Hierarchy; SAP Customer Activity Repository

attributes.name: discount_reason_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the business reason for any discount or markdown applied to this line item (e.g., EMPLOYEE, LOYALTY, COUPON, CLEARANCE, PROMO, DAMAGE). Used for discount analytics, shrinkage investigation, and promotional effectiveness reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EMPLOYEE|LOYALTY|COUPON|CLEARANCE|PROMO|DAMAGE|PRICE_MATCH|MANAGER_OVERRIDE — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository — Discount Reason; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: fulfillment_type
attributes.description: Indicates the omnichannel fulfillment method for this line item. Distinguishes standard in-store purchases from BOPIS (Buy Online Pick Up In Store), ship-from-store, curbside pickup, and endless aisle orders. Critical for DTC omnichannel analytics.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository — Fulfillment Mode; Salesforce Commerce Cloud Order Management

attributes.name: imu_pct
attributes.description: Initial Markup (IMU) percentage for this SKU at the time of the transaction, representing the difference between the original retail price and COGS as a percentage of retail. Key metric for margin planning and merchandise financial performance.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Margin Management; SAP Customer Activity Repository

attributes.name: ingestion_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this record was ingested into the Databricks Silver layer from the source system. Used for data freshness monitoring, SLA compliance tracking, and incremental load auditing.
attributes.references: Data Governance — Audit Trail; SAP Customer Activity Repository ETL

attributes.name: is_clearance_item
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SKU on this line was designated as a clearance item at the time of sale. Clearance items are end-of-lifecycle SKUs being liquidated. Distinct from is_markdown_item which covers all markdowns including promotional.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Price Management; SAP Customer Activity Repository

attributes.name: is_markdown_item
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SKU on this line was sold at a marked-down price at the time of the transaction. True if the item was on permanent or promotional markdown. Used to segment full-price vs. markdown sales for AUR and margin analytics.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Price Management; SAP Customer Activity Repository

attributes.name: is_rfid_scanned
attributes.business_glossary_term: Is Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) Scanned Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item was identified via RFID (Radio Frequency Identification) tag scan rather than traditional barcode/UPC scan at the POS. Supports RFID adoption tracking, inventory accuracy measurement, and shrinkage reduction analytics.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository — Item Identification Method; GS1 RFID Standards

attributes.name: line_discount_amount
attributes.description: Additional point-of-sale discount amount applied to this specific line item beyond the ticketed markdown, such as employee discounts, loyalty rewards, or coupon redemptions. Distinct from markdown_amount which reflects price management markdowns.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository — POS Discount; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: line_extended_amount
attributes.description: Total net sales amount for this line item (unit_retail_price × quantity_sold minus line_discount_amount). Represents the actual revenue recognized for this line. Used in daily sales reconciliation and financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository — Line Net Amount; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number identifying the position of this item within the parent POS transaction. Used for ordering and referencing individual items within a receipt. Aligns with TRANSACTION_LINE role LINE_SEQUENCE category.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository — POS Line Item Sequence

attributes.name: line_type
attributes.description: Classification of the transaction line indicating whether it represents a sale, return, exchange, void, or layaway. Drives revenue recognition logic, inventory adjustment direction, and return analytics.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository — Transaction Type; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: markdown_amount
attributes.description: Total markdown (MD) dollar amount applied to this line item, calculated as the difference between the original retail price and the unit retail price multiplied by quantity. Tracks permanent and promotional markdowns for MMU and margin analytics.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Price Management; SAP Customer Activity Repository

attributes.name: mmu_pct
attributes.description: Maintained Markup (MMU) percentage for this line item, reflecting the actual margin achieved after all markdowns and discounts. Calculated as (unit_retail_price - unit_cost) / unit_retail_price. Core KPI for merchandise financial planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Margin Management; Anaplan Merchandise Planning

attributes.name: msrp
attributes.description: The manufacturer's suggested retail price (MSRP) for the SKU at the time of the transaction. Used as the baseline for markdown calculation, IMU computation, and price integrity reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Price Management; FTC Pricing Regulations

attributes.name: original_retail_price
attributes.description: The original ticketed retail price of the SKU before any markdowns or promotional discounts were applied in this transaction. Used to calculate markdown amount and sell-through performance relative to initial pricing.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Price Management; SAP Customer Activity Repository

attributes.name: quantity_sold
attributes.description: Number of units sold on this transaction line. Positive for sales, negative for returns/voids. Core metric for sell-through rate (STR), weeks of supply (WOS), and inventory depletion analytics. Aligns with TRANSACTION_LINE role LINE_QUANTITY category.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository — POS Quantity; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this record in the Silver layer, reflecting corrections, late-arriving data, or restatements from the source system. Supports data quality monitoring and change data capture.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository — Record Update Time; Data Governance — Audit Trail

attributes.name: register_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the POS register or terminal where this transaction line was processed. Used for register-level reconciliation, shrinkage investigation, and store operations auditing.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository — Terminal ID; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: return_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for a product return when line_type is RETURN or EXCHANGE (e.g., DEFECTIVE, WRONG_SIZE, CHANGED_MIND, DAMAGED). Null for non-return lines. Used for quality analysis, vendor chargebacks, and after-sales service reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DEFECTIVE|WRONG_SIZE|CHANGED_MIND|DAMAGED|WRONG_ITEM|NOT_AS_DESCRIBED|OTHER — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository — Return Reason; CPSC Product Safety Standards

attributes.name: season_code
attributes.description: Season identifier for the collection to which the sold SKU belongs (e.g., SS25, FW24, HO24). Used for season-level sell-through rate (STR) tracking, end-of-season markdown analysis, and collection performance reporting.
attributes.references: Centric PLM — Collection Management; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: size_code
attributes.description: Size designation of the SKU sold (e.g., XS, S, M, L, XL, 32x30, 8.5). Enables size-curve analytics, size-level STR reporting, and replenishment decisions at the store-SKU-size grain.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Size Scale; ISO 8559 Clothing Size Designation

attributes.name: source_system_line_reference
attributes.description: The native transaction line identifier from the source system (SAP Customer Activity Repository). Preserves the original system reference for data lineage, reconciliation, and audit trail purposes in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository — POS Line Item ID; Data Governance — Lineage

attributes.name: style_number
attributes.description: The style-level identifier for the product sold, representing the design without colorway or size differentiation. Enables style-level sell-through rate (STR) and performance analytics across colorways and sizes.
attributes.references: Centric PLM — Style Master; Infor PLM — Product Design

attributes.name: subclass_code
attributes.description: Merchandise subclass code providing the most granular merchandise hierarchy classification below class (e.g., T-SHIRTS, DENIM, RUNNING_SHOES). Enables fine-grained assortment analytics and category management reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Merchandise Hierarchy

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Sales tax amount applied to this line item based on the applicable tax jurisdiction and product tax classification. Required for financial reconciliation, tax reporting, and COGS analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — Tax Determination; IFRS/GAAP Tax Reporting

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the POS transaction occurred. Primary grain dimension for daily sales reconciliation, STR reporting, and store performance KPI dashboards.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository — Business Date; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO

attributes.name: transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the POS transaction line was processed at the register. Used for intraday traffic analytics, peak hour analysis, and time-of-day sales pattern reporting.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository — Transaction Time; ISO 8601

attributes.name: unit_retail_price
attributes.description: The actual retail price charged per unit on this line after all markdowns and promotions have been applied. Represents the AUR (Average Unit Retail) at the transaction level. Core input for ASP and AUR analytics. Aligns with TRANSACTION_LINE role LINE_VALUE_OR_RESULT category.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository — Unit Selling Price; Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Price Management

attributes.name: upc
attributes.description: Universal Product Code (UPC) barcode value scanned at the POS terminal for this line item. 12-digit UPC-A or 14-digit GTIN standard. Used for item identification, inventory reconciliation, and RFID-based shrinkage tracking.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) Standard; FTC Textile Labeling Requirements

products.name: daily_sales_summary
products.description: End-of-day store-level sales reconciliation record capturing total net sales, gross sales, returns, markdowns, units sold, transaction count, AUR, ASP, STR, and cash/card/digital tender breakdown. Used for daily sales reconciliation, OTB tracking, and store performance reporting. Sourced from SAP Customer Activity Repository daily close process.

attributes.name: daily_sales_summary_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each daily sales summary record. Primary key for the daily_sales_summary data product in the store domain.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Daily summaries aggregate campaign-driven sales for executive dashboards and weekly business reviews. Standard metric in retail: "sales by campaign by store by day" for performance tracking and budget

attributes.name: fiscal_week_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.fiscal_week. Business justification: Daily sales summaries are aggregated and reported by fiscal week. Currently daily_sales_summary has fiscal_week (INT), fiscal_period (INT), and fiscal_year (INT) as denormalized attributes. Adding fis

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Daily sales summaries post to GL as journal entries for revenue recognition and cash reconciliation. Standard retail accounting practice; enables audit trail from store operations to financial stateme

attributes.name: reconciliation_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Store managers/supervisors reconcile daily sales to resolve variances between POS totals and physical cash/card settlements. Critical audit trail for financial controls, loss prevention investigations

attributes.name: retail_store_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retail store for which this daily sales summary was generated. Links to the store master record.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Store Master

attributes.name: adjustment_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for any post-close adjustment applied to this daily sales summary. Only populated when is_adjusted = True. Used for audit trail and financial control reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: system_correction|manual_override|return_reclass|shrinkage_update|tax_correction|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO - Adjustment Audit; IFRS/GAAP Financial Controls; ISO 9001

attributes.name: asp
attributes.description: Average selling price (ASP) per transaction on the business date, calculated as net sales amount divided by transaction count. Distinct from AUR which is per unit; ASP reflects basket-level pricing performance.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - KPI Reporting

attributes.name: aur
attributes.description: Average unit retail (AUR) price achieved on the business date, calculated as net sales amount divided by net units sold. Key KPI for pricing effectiveness and markdown impact analysis in apparel retail.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - KPI Reporting; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: bopis_order_count
attributes.business_glossary_term: Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS) Order Count
attributes.description: Number of buy-online-pick-up-in-store (BOPIS) orders fulfilled at this store on the business date. Key omnichannel fulfillment metric used to assess store capacity utilization and DTC channel performance.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud - Order Management; SAP Customer Activity Repository

attributes.name: business_date
attributes.description: The retail business date (trading day) for which this end-of-day sales summary applies. Represents the fiscal trading day, which may differ from the calendar date for overnight operations.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Daily Close Process

attributes.name: card_tender_amount
attributes.description: Total sales amount tendered via credit or debit card on the business date. Reconciled against card processor settlement reports as part of daily sales reconciliation. Includes all card network types (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, etc.).
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Tender Reconciliation; PCI DSS Compliance

attributes.name: cash_tender_amount
attributes.description: Total sales amount tendered in cash on the business date. Used for daily cash reconciliation, safe count verification, and bank deposit preparation as part of end-of-day store close procedures.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Tender Reconciliation; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO

attributes.name: closing_inventory_units
attributes.description: Total on-hand inventory unit count at the end of the business date after all sales, returns, receipts, and adjustments. Used for weeks-of-supply (WOS) calculation and next-day opening inventory.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Inventory Position; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: conversion_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of customer visits that resulted in a completed purchase transaction on the business date (transaction count / customer traffic count), expressed as a decimal. Key store performance KPI for associate effectiveness and visual merchandising impact.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Store KPI Reporting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this daily sales summary record was first created in the data platform. Represents the audit trail creation event for data lineage and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 - Data Integrity; CCPA; ISO 9001 Record Management

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this daily sales summary record (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP'). Supports multi-currency store operations in international markets.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS/GAAP Financial Reporting

attributes.name: customer_traffic_count
attributes.description: Total number of customer visits (door count) recorded at the store on the business date via traffic counting systems. Used to calculate conversion rate (transaction count / traffic count) as a store performance KPI.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Traffic Analytics

attributes.name: digital_tender_amount
attributes.description: Total sales amount tendered via digital payment methods (mobile wallets, gift cards, buy-now-pay-later, loyalty points redemption) on the business date. Tracked separately for digital payment adoption analytics.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Tender Reconciliation

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total value of employee discounts, loyalty program discounts, and coupon redemptions applied to transactions on the business date. Distinct from markdowns which are price-level changes; discounts are transaction-level adjustments.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Promotion and Discount Aggregation

attributes.name: gift_card_tender_amount
attributes.description: Total sales amount tendered via gift cards on the business date. Tracked separately from other digital tenders for gift card liability reconciliation and breakage accounting per IFRS/GAAP deferred revenue standards.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Tender Reconciliation; IFRS 15 Deferred Revenue

attributes.name: gross_sales_amount
attributes.description: Total gross sales revenue for the business date before deducting returns, markdowns, or discounts. Represents the sum of all POS transaction line amounts at full selling price prior to any adjustments.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Daily Sales Aggregation; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: is_adjusted
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this daily sales summary record has been subject to a post-close adjustment (True). Adjusted records require additional audit scrutiny and are tracked for financial control compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO - Adjustment Audit; IFRS/GAAP Financial Controls

attributes.name: is_reconciled
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the daily sales summary has been formally reconciled (True) or is still pending reconciliation (False). Used to filter confirmed records for financial reporting and OTB updates.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Reconciliation Workflow; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO

attributes.name: markdown_amount
attributes.description: Total markdown (MD) dollar value applied to transactions on the business date, including permanent markdowns, promotional discounts, and clearance price reductions. Used for maintained markup (MMU) and gross margin analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Price Management; SAP Customer Activity Repository

attributes.name: net_sales_amount
attributes.description: Total net sales revenue for the business date after deducting returns and markdowns from gross sales. The primary revenue figure used for store performance reporting, OTB tracking, and STR calculation.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Daily Sales Aggregation; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: opening_inventory_units
attributes.description: Total on-hand inventory unit count at the start of the business date (beginning of day). Used as the denominator for daily sell-through rate (STR) calculation and OTB tracking.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Inventory Position; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: pos_close_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the POS end-of-day close process was completed for this store on the business date. Represents the principal business event timestamp for this summary record. Sourced from SAP Customer Activity Repository daily close process.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Daily Close Process

attributes.name: reconciliation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the daily sales summary was formally reconciled and approved by the store manager or back-office team. Distinct from POS close timestamp; represents the human-verified sign-off event.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Reconciliation Workflow; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO

attributes.name: return_transaction_count
attributes.description: Total number of return transactions processed at the store on the business date. Used to calculate return rate and assess customer satisfaction and product quality issues.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Return Transaction Aggregation

attributes.name: returns_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value of customer merchandise returns processed at the store on the business date. Subtracted from gross sales to derive net sales. Sourced from SAP CAR return transaction aggregation.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Return Transaction Processing; IFRS 15

attributes.name: ship_from_store_order_count
attributes.description: Number of e-commerce orders fulfilled via ship-from-store on the business date. Reflects the store's contribution to omnichannel fulfillment and impacts available-to-sell (ATS) inventory levels.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud - Order Management; Manhattan Associates WMS - Fulfillment

attributes.name: shrinkage_amount
attributes.description: Estimated or recorded shrinkage (inventory loss due to theft, damage, or administrative error) value for the business date. Used for loss prevention reporting and COGS adjustment. Sourced from cycle count variances and known loss events.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Loss Prevention; WRAP Standards; ISO 9001

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this daily sales summary was sourced (e.g., 'SAP_CAR' for SAP Customer Activity Repository). Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR); Salesforce Commerce Cloud; Internal Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: store_number
attributes.description: The externally-known alphanumeric store identifier as assigned in the retail merchandising and POS systems (e.g., 'STR-0042'). Used for cross-system reconciliation and reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Store Master; SAP Customer Activity Repository

attributes.name: str
attributes.description: Sell-through rate (STR) for the business date, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0325 = 3.25%). Calculated as units sold divided by beginning-of-day on-hand inventory units. Used for inventory productivity and OTB management.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - KPI Reporting; Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Allocation

attributes.name: summary_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the daily sales summary record. 'open' indicates the trading day is in progress; 'pending_reconciliation' indicates end-of-day close initiated; 'reconciled' indicates cash and card tenders have been balanced; 'closed' indicates the record is finalized; 'adjusted' indicates a post-close correction was applied; 'voided' indicates the record was invalidated. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: open|pending_reconciliation|reconciled|closed|adjusted|voided — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - POS Reconciliation Workflow

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total sales tax collected on transactions for the business date. Required for tax remittance reporting and financial reconciliation. Varies by jurisdiction and product category per applicable tax regulations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO - Tax Reporting; FTC Textile Labeling; State Sales Tax Regulations

attributes.name: transaction_count
attributes.description: Total number of completed POS sales transactions (excluding voids and returns) processed at the store on the business date. Used as the denominator for average order value (AOV) and average unit retail (AUR) calculations.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - POS Transaction Aggregation

attributes.name: units_per_transaction
attributes.description: Average number of units sold per sales transaction on the business date (units sold divided by transaction count). A key store productivity KPI used to measure associate selling effectiveness and cross-sell performance.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Store KPI Reporting

attributes.name: units_returned
attributes.description: Total number of individual units returned by customers on the business date. Used to calculate gross units sold and return rate metrics for store performance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Return Transaction Aggregation

attributes.name: units_sold
attributes.description: Total number of individual units (SKUs) sold on the business date, net of returns. Used for sell-through rate (STR) calculation, average unit retail (AUR) computation, and inventory depletion tracking.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Unit Sales Aggregation; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this daily sales summary record was last modified in the data platform. Captures post-close adjustments, corrections, or reconciliation updates for audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 - Data Integrity; CCPA; ISO 9001 Record Management

attributes.name: void_transaction_count
attributes.description: Total number of voided POS transactions on the business date. Elevated void counts may indicate training issues, fraud risk, or system errors and are monitored as part of loss prevention.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - POS Transaction Audit; WRAP Loss Prevention Standards

products.name: traffic_count
products.description: Captures customer foot-traffic counts at the store and zone level, recorded by traffic counting sensors (IR beam-break, stereoscopic video analytics, thermal). Stores hourly and daily entry counts, conversion rate (transactions ÷ traffic), dwell-time metrics, and bounce rate. Enables store performance KPI analysis including traffic-to-conversion ratios, peak-hour staffing optimization, and lease negotiation support (traffic as rent justification). Conforms to retail traffic analytics industry standards.

attributes.name: traffic_count_id
attributes.description: Primary key for traffic_count

attributes.name: fiscal_week_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.fiscal_week. Business justification: Traffic counts are analyzed by fiscal week for store performance reporting. Currently traffic_count has fiscal_week_code (BIGINT) which is a denormalized reference. Adding fiscal_week_id FK allows joi

attributes.name: retail_store_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retail store where the traffic count was recorded. Links to the store master entity for store attributes such as name, location, and format.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Store Operations

attributes.name: zone_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific zone or area within the store where the traffic sensor is installed (e.g., entrance, fitting room corridor, footwear section). Enables zone-level traffic analysis for visual merchandising optimization.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Store Operations

attributes.name: avg_dwell_time_seconds
attributes.description: Average time in seconds that customers spent inside the store or zone during the counting period, as measured by stereoscopic video analytics or thermal sensors. Indicates customer engagement depth and supports visual merchandising effectiveness analysis.

attributes.name: bopis_order_count
attributes.business_glossary_term: Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS) Order Count
attributes.description: Number of Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS) orders collected at the store during the counting period. Enables separation of omnichannel-driven traffic from organic walk-in traffic for pure conversion rate analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud - Order Management; SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR)

attributes.name: bounce_rate
attributes.description: Proportion of visitors who entered the store or zone but exited within a very short dwell threshold (typically under 30 seconds) without engaging, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.1500 = 15%). Indicates storefront or window display effectiveness.

attributes.name: capture_rate
attributes.description: Ratio of store entries to total passing pedestrian traffic (entry_count ÷ passing_traffic_count), expressed as a decimal. Key metric for lease negotiation support and storefront effectiveness benchmarking.

attributes.name: conversion_rate
attributes.description: Ratio of POS transactions to total entry count (transactions ÷ entry_count) for the counting period, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.2500 = 25%). Core store performance KPI for traffic-to-sales effectiveness analysis.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Store Operations; Retail Traffic Analytics Industry Standard

attributes.name: count_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the traffic count was recorded (yyyy-MM-dd). Used for daily aggregation, trend analysis, and lease negotiation reporting.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Store Operations

attributes.name: count_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether the sensor captures bidirectional traffic (both entries and exits), inbound only, or outbound only. Affects how entry_count and exit_count values should be interpreted.

attributes.name: count_hour
attributes.description: Hour of the day (0–23) for which this traffic count record applies. Enables hourly granularity for peak-hour staffing optimization and intraday traffic pattern analysis.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Store Operations

attributes.name: count_period_type
attributes.description: Granularity of the traffic count record indicating whether the record represents an hourly, daily, weekly, or monthly aggregation. Supports multi-granularity reporting in the silver layer.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this traffic count record was first created in the silver layer lakehouse (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports data lineage, audit trail, and incremental load processing.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 - Data Integrity and Accountability; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (0.00–100.00) representing the assessed quality and reliability of the traffic count record, based on sensor uptime, calibration status, and anomaly detection. Used to weight records in analytics and flag low-confidence data.
attributes.references: Internal Data Quality Standard; Retail Traffic Analytics Industry Standard

attributes.name: day_of_week
attributes.description: Day of the week corresponding to the count_date. Used for weekly traffic pattern analysis, staffing models, and comparative performance reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Monday|Tuesday|Wednesday|Thursday|Friday|Saturday|Sunday — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: entry_count
attributes.description: Total number of customer entries (inbound foot-traffic) recorded by the sensor during the counting period. Core traffic KPI used for store performance analysis, lease negotiation, and staffing optimization.
attributes.references: Retail Traffic Analytics Industry Standard; SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR)

attributes.name: exit_count
attributes.description: Total number of customer exits (outbound foot-traffic) recorded by the sensor during the counting period. Used alongside entry_count to calculate net occupancy and validate sensor accuracy.

attributes.name: gap_filled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any portion of the traffic count for this period was estimated or interpolated due to sensor downtime or data loss (True = gap-filled). Supports data lineage transparency and analytics confidence scoring.

attributes.name: is_holiday
attributes.description: Indicates whether the count_date falls on a public or retail holiday (True = holiday). Enables holiday-adjusted traffic benchmarking and year-over-year comparable analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Assortment Planning

attributes.name: is_promotional_period
