attributes.description: Indicates whether the counting period coincides with an active promotional or markdown event (True = promotional period). Enables traffic lift analysis attributable to marketing and promotional activities.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Price Management; SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR)

attributes.name: is_store_open
attributes.description: Indicates whether the store was open for trading during the counting period (True = open). Used to exclude closed-period records from traffic KPI calculations and to identify after-hours sensor anomalies.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Store Operations

attributes.name: max_occupancy_count
attributes.description: Peak simultaneous occupancy count recorded within the counting period, derived from cumulative entry minus exit counts. Used for compliance with fire safety occupancy limits and store capacity management.
attributes.references: Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) - Product Safety Standards; Local Fire Safety Regulations

attributes.name: passing_traffic_count
attributes.description: Number of pedestrians passing in front of the store entrance without entering, as measured by external-facing sensors. Used to calculate store capture rate (entry_count ÷ passing_traffic_count) for lease negotiation and location performance benchmarking.

attributes.name: peak_hour_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the counting period falls within a designated peak trading hour for the store (True = peak hour). Used for staffing optimization and scheduling decisions.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Store Operations

attributes.name: period_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact timestamp marking the end of the traffic counting period (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Together with period_start_timestamp defines the precise observation window.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Store Operations

attributes.name: period_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact timestamp marking the beginning of the traffic counting period (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for precise temporal alignment of hourly and sub-hourly records.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Store Operations

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of the traffic count record indicating data quality state. 'active' = validated sensor data; 'estimated' = gap-filled via interpolation; 'adjusted' = manually corrected; 'excluded' = removed from KPI calculations; 'pending_review' = flagged for data quality review.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Store Operations; Internal Data Quality Standard

attributes.name: sensor_code
attributes.description: Reference to the specific traffic counting sensor device that recorded this observation. Enables sensor-level data quality monitoring and calibration tracking.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Store Operations

attributes.name: sensor_type
attributes.description: Technology type of the traffic counting sensor that generated this record. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ir_beam_break|stereoscopic_video|thermal|time_of_flight|wifi_bluetooth — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: sensor_uptime_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the counting period during which the sensor was operational and recording valid data (0.00–100.00). Used to assess data completeness and determine whether gap-filling or estimation is required.
attributes.references: Internal Data Quality Standard; Retail Traffic Analytics Industry Standard

attributes.name: ship_from_store_count
attributes.description: Number of ship-from-store fulfillment orders processed at the store during the counting period. Supports omnichannel fulfillment traffic analysis and store-as-warehouse capacity planning.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud - Order Management; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: source_record_reference
attributes.description: Native identifier of this traffic count record in the originating source system (e.g., SAP CAR internal record key). Enables traceability from the silver layer back to the bronze/raw layer for audit and reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Store Operations; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational source system from which this traffic count record was ingested (e.g., 'SAP_CAR', 'SENSORMATIC', 'IRISYS'). Supports data lineage and multi-source reconciliation in the silver layer.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Store Operations; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: staff_count_scheduled
attributes.description: Number of sales associates scheduled to be on the store floor during the counting period. Used to calculate traffic-to-staff ratio for staffing optimization and labor productivity analysis.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Human Resources; SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR)

attributes.name: temperature_celsius
attributes.description: Ambient outdoor temperature in degrees Celsius at the store location during the counting period. Used as a quantitative weather covariate in traffic regression models and seasonal demand planning.
attributes.references: Retail Traffic Analytics Industry Standard; Anaplan - Demand Planning

attributes.name: transaction_count
attributes.description: Number of Point of Sale (POS) transactions completed at the store during the same counting period. Used as the numerator in conversion rate calculation (transactions ÷ traffic). Sourced from SAP Customer Activity Repository.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - POS; Store Operations

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this traffic count record was last modified in the silver layer lakehouse (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Tracks adjustments, corrections, and reprocessing events for data lineage.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 - Data Integrity and Accountability; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: Prevailing weather condition at the store location during the counting period. Used as an external factor in traffic variance analysis and demand forecasting models. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: clear|cloudy|rain|snow|storm|extreme_heat — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Retail Traffic Analytics Industry Standard; Anaplan - Demand Planning

attributes.name: week_number
attributes.description: ISO calendar week number (1–53) of the count_date. Supports weekly traffic trend analysis and year-over-year comparisons aligned to the retail fiscal calendar.

products.name: associate
products.description: Store-domain view of sales associates and floor staff assigned to a retail store. Captures associate role (sales associate, keyholder, department lead, store manager), assigned store, department, employment type, hire date, and active status. Distinct from the workforce domain employee master — this entity tracks store-operational assignment and role context for POS attribution, commission, and scheduling purposes.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Primary key for associate

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Cross-reference to the workforce domain employee master record (Workday HCM). Enables linkage between store-operational assignment context and HR/payroll data without duplicating the employee master.

attributes.name: initiative_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.sustainability_initiative. Business justification: Store associates participate in sustainability initiatives (waste sorting, energy conservation, circular program ambassadors, customer education). HR and sustainability teams track associate participa

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store department (e.g., Footwear, Apparel, Accessories, Fitting Room) to which the associate is assigned for floor coverage and commission attribution.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Department Reference

attributes.name: retail_store_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retail store to which this associate is currently assigned. Used for store-level POS attribution, scheduling, and performance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository — Store Master

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the associate's store assignment. Controls POS login eligibility, scheduling inclusion, and commission accrual. 'transferred' indicates the associate has moved to another store.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository — Operator Status; Internal Store Operations Policy

attributes.name: associate_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the associate, used on POS terminals, scheduling systems, and commission reports. Sourced from SAP Customer Activity Repository operator configuration.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository — Operator Master

attributes.name: bopis_fulfillment_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS) Fulfillment Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the associate is authorized and trained to fulfill Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS) orders. Supports omnichannel fulfillment assignment in Salesforce Commerce Cloud and SAP Customer Activity Repository.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Order Management; SAP Customer Activity Repository — BOPIS Configuration

attributes.name: commission_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the associate is eligible to earn sales commission. Eligibility is determined by store role, employment type, and department assignment per the compensation policy.
attributes.references: Internal Compensation Policy; SAP Customer Activity Repository — Commission Configuration

attributes.name: commission_plan_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the commission plan structure assigned to the associate (e.g., tiered, flat-rate, department-specific). References the commission plan configuration in SAP Customer Activity Repository.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository — Commission Plan; Internal Compensation Policy

attributes.name: commission_rate
attributes.description: Individual commission rate applied to the associate's attributed net sales, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0250 = 2.50%). Used for commission accrual calculations in SAP FI/CO. Confidential compensation data.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — Commission Rate Master; Internal Compensation Policy

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the store associate record was first created in the Silver Layer data product. Audit trail field for data lineage and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability)

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the associate's employment arrangement. Determines scheduling eligibility, benefit entitlements, and labor cost categorization. Sourced from Workday HCM worker type.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Worker Type; Fair Labor Association (FLA) Labor Standards

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Legal given name of the store associate as recorded in Workday HCM. Used for scheduling displays, POS operator identification, and customer-facing name badges.

attributes.name: hire_date
attributes.description: Date the associate was originally hired by the company. Used for tenure calculations, anniversary recognition, and benefit eligibility determination. Sourced from Workday HCM.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Hire Date; Fair Labor Association (FLA)

attributes.name: keyholder_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the associate holds store key access and is authorized to open or close the store. Keyholders have elevated POS and alarm system permissions.
attributes.references: Internal Store Operations Policy; SAP Customer Activity Repository — Operator Permissions

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: Primary language spoken by the associate, expressed as an IETF BCP 47 language tag (e.g., en-US, es-MX, fr-FR). Used for customer service routing and multilingual store staffing analytics.
attributes.references: IETF BCP 47 Language Tag Standard; Internal Store Operations Policy

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Legal family name of the store associate as recorded in Workday HCM. Combined with first_name for full identity display on POS, commission statements, and performance reports.

attributes.name: last_performance_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the associate's most recent formal performance review. Used to track review cycle compliance and identify associates overdue for evaluation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Performance Management; Fair Labor Association (FLA)

attributes.name: loss_prevention_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the associate has an active loss prevention alert or investigation flag. Confidential — access restricted to store management and loss prevention teams. Used for shrinkage management.
attributes.references: Internal Loss Prevention Policy; CPSC Compliance; GDPR Article 9

attributes.name: nps_score_avg
attributes.description: Average Net Promoter Score (NPS) received by the associate from customer satisfaction surveys attributed to their POS transactions. Ranges from -100 to 100. Used for associate-level service quality monitoring.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform — Customer Satisfaction Analytics; Internal NPS Program

attributes.name: performance_rating
attributes.description: Most recent formal performance rating assigned to the associate during the annual or mid-year review cycle. Confidential HR data used for promotion eligibility, commission tier adjustments, and workforce planning.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Performance Management; Fair Labor Association (FLA)

attributes.name: pos_login_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Point of Sale (POS) Login Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the associate is currently authorized to log in to POS terminals. Set to false during suspension, leave, or post-termination to prevent unauthorized transactions.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository — Operator Access Control; Internal Security Policy

attributes.name: pos_operator_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code used to identify the associate on POS terminals for transaction attribution, cash drawer assignment, and sales performance tracking. Configured in SAP Customer Activity Repository.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository — POS Operator Configuration

attributes.name: preferred_name
attributes.description: Preferred or commonly-used name of the associate for scheduling boards, name badges, and internal communications. May differ from legal first name.

attributes.name: primary_department_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code identifying the associate's primary assigned department within the store (e.g., FTWR for Footwear, APRL for Apparel). Used for floor coverage planning and department-level sales attribution.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Department Code; SAP Customer Activity Repository

attributes.name: product_knowledge_tier
attributes.description: Certified level of product knowledge attained by the associate across the brand's apparel, footwear, and accessories categories. Drives assignment to high-value customer interactions and specialist floor zones.
attributes.references: Internal Training and Certification Policy; Centric PLM — Product Knowledge Program

attributes.name: rfid_badge_code
attributes.description: Unique RFID chip identifier embedded in the associate's access badge. Used for store entry/exit access control, time and attendance tracking, and loss prevention audit trails.
attributes.references: Internal Security Policy; ISO/IEC 18000 RFID Standard; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: sales_floor_zone
attributes.description: Designated zone or area of the sales floor to which the associate is assigned (e.g., Front-of-House, Back Wall, Fitting Room, Cash Wrap). Supports visual merchandising coverage and traffic analytics.
attributes.references: Internal Store Operations Policy; SAP Customer Activity Repository — Zone Configuration

attributes.name: scheduled_hours_per_week
attributes.description: Standard contracted or scheduled weekly hours for the associate. Used for labor cost planning, overtime threshold monitoring, and workforce scheduling in the store operations context.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Scheduled Weekly Hours; Fair Labor Association (FLA) Labor Standards

attributes.name: secondary_department_code
attributes.description: Code for a secondary department the associate is cross-trained to cover. Enables flexible floor scheduling and cross-department sales attribution during peak periods.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Department Code; SAP Customer Activity Repository

attributes.name: ship_from_store_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the associate is authorized to process ship-from-store fulfillment orders, including picking, packing, and carrier handoff. Supports omnichannel DTC fulfillment operations.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Order Management; Manhattan Associates WMS — Ship-From-Store

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this associate record was sourced (e.g., SAP_CAR for SAP Customer Activity Repository, WORKDAY_HCM for Workday HCM). Supports data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Lineage Policy

attributes.name: store_assignment_end_date
attributes.description: Date the associate's assignment to the current store ended due to transfer, termination, or leave. Null if the assignment is currently active. Enables historical store assignment tracking.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository — Operator Assignment; Internal Store Operations Policy

attributes.name: store_assignment_start_date
attributes.description: Date the associate was assigned to the current store. Distinct from hire_date — an associate may transfer between stores. Used for store-level tenure and performance benchmarking.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository — Operator Assignment; Internal Store Operations Policy

attributes.name: store_role
attributes.description: Operational role of the associate within the retail store context. Drives POS operator permissions, commission tier eligibility, scheduling authority, and floor coverage responsibilities. Distinct from HR job title in Workday HCM.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository — Operator Role Configuration; Internal Store Operations Policy

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date the associate's employment was formally terminated. Null for active employees. Used for access revocation, final commission settlement, and workforce analytics.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Termination Date; Fair Labor Association (FLA)

attributes.name: training_completion_date
attributes.description: Date the associate completed mandatory onboarding and product training for their current store role. Used to confirm readiness for floor assignment and POS activation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Learning Management; Internal Training Policy

attributes.name: uniform_size_bottom
attributes.description: Apparel size for the associate's uniform bottom garment. Used by store operations for uniform inventory management and replenishment ordering.
attributes.references: Internal Store Operations Policy; ISO 8559-1 Garment Sizing

attributes.name: uniform_size_top
attributes.description: Apparel size for the associate's uniform top garment. Used by store operations for uniform inventory management and replenishment ordering.
attributes.references: Internal Store Operations Policy; ISO 8559-1 Garment Sizing

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the store associate record in the Silver Layer. Used for change data capture, incremental processing, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability)

attributes.name: work_email
attributes.description: Corporate email address assigned to the associate for internal communications, scheduling notifications, and system access. Sourced from Workday HCM.

attributes.name: work_phone
attributes.description: Work or store-assigned phone number for the associate, used for scheduling contact and store operations communication.

products.name: shift
products.description: Records scheduled and actual work shifts for store associates, including shift date, start/end times, actual clock-in/out, break durations, role during shift, and store assignment. Supports labor scheduling, overtime tracking, and payroll integration with Workday HCM. Distinct from workforce payroll — this entity is the store-operational shift record.

attributes.name: shift_id
attributes.description: Primary key for shift

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Labor costs by shift must allocate to cost centers for accurate departmental expense tracking. Essential for labor budget management, productivity analysis, and store-level profitability. Shift-level

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store supervisor or manager responsible for overseeing this shift. Used for escalation, override authorization, and shift performance accountability.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Human Resources; SAP Customer Activity Repository

attributes.name: payroll_run_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the payroll period to which this shift's hours are attributed (e.g., PP-2024-26 for the 26th pay period of 2024). Used to batch shift records for payroll export to Workday HCM.

attributes.name: retail_store_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retail store where this shift is assigned. Links to the store master record in SAP Customer Activity Repository.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository - Store Operations

attributes.name: shift_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store associate (employee) assigned to this shift. Sourced from Workday HCM employee master.

attributes.name: shift_covering_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the associate who covered this shift in the event of a no-show, swap, or emergency absence. Null if no coverage was arranged. Supports shift swap tracking and labor scheduling analytics.

attributes.name: shift_original_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the associate originally scheduled for this shift before a swap or reassignment occurred. Populated only when shift_swap_flag is True. Enables full audit trail of schedule changes.

attributes.name: workday_position_id
attributes.description: External position identifier from Workday HCM corresponding to the associate's role at the time of the shift. Used for payroll integration and labor cost allocation.

attributes.name: absence_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for a no-show or partial absence (e.g., sick leave, personal leave, emergency, unauthorized). Populated when no_show_flag is True or shift is cancelled. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sick_leave|personal_leave|emergency|unauthorized|bereavement|jury_duty|weather — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Human Resources; Fair Labor Association (FLA) - Labor Standards

attributes.name: actual_break_minutes
attributes.description: Total actual break time taken by the associate in minutes as recorded by the time and attendance system. Compared against scheduled break duration for compliance and payroll accuracy.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Association (FLA) - Labor Standards; ISO 45001

attributes.name: actual_hours_worked
attributes.description: Total number of hours the associate actually worked during the shift, computed from clock-in/clock-out minus break durations. Used for payroll processing, overtime calculation, and labor productivity KPIs.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Payroll; Fair Labor Association (FLA) - Labor Standards; ISO 45001

attributes.name: break_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total scheduled break time in minutes for the shift (sum of all meal and rest breaks). Used to compute net hours worked and ensure compliance with labor rest-period regulations.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Association (FLA) - Labor Standards; ISO 45001

attributes.name: clock_in_method
attributes.description: Method used by the associate to record their clock-in time (e.g., POS terminal, mobile app, biometric scanner, RFID badge, manager manual entry). Supports time and attendance audit and fraud detection.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository - Store Operations; RFID

attributes.name: clock_in_time
attributes.description: Actual date and time the associate clocked in for the shift as recorded by the time and attendance system. Null if the associate has not yet clocked in or was a no-show.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Payroll; Fair Labor Association (FLA) - Labor Standards

attributes.name: clock_out_method
attributes.description: Method used by the associate to record their clock-out time. Mirrors clock_in_method for symmetry and audit completeness.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository - Store Operations; RFID

attributes.name: clock_out_time
attributes.description: Actual date and time the associate clocked out at the end of the shift. Null if the shift is still in progress or the associate did not clock out (requires manager resolution).
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Payroll; Fair Labor Association (FLA) - Labor Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this shift record was first created in the system, either by the scheduling system or manually by a manager. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; CCPA; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the labor cost amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency store operations in international markets.

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Store department or zone to which the associate is assigned during this shift (e.g., Menswear, Footwear, Accessories, Stockroom, Checkout). Used for labor allocation reporting and department-level productivity analysis.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository - Store Operations

attributes.name: early_departure_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the associate clocked out before the scheduled end time. True = early departure occurred. Used for attendance tracking and SLA compliance in store staffing.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository - Store Operations; SLA

attributes.name: labor_cost_amount
attributes.description: Estimated or actual labor cost for this shift in the store's operating currency, computed from actual hours worked multiplied by the applicable pay rate. Used for store-level labor cost reporting and GMROI analysis.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Payroll; Anaplan - Financial Planning; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: manager_override_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a store manager manually overrode the clock-in, clock-out, or break time for this shift record. True = override applied; False = no override. Triggers additional audit review in payroll processing.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Payroll; Fair Labor Association (FLA) - Labor Standards

attributes.name: no_show_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the associate failed to appear for a scheduled shift without prior notification. True = no-show recorded. Feeds into attendance management and disciplinary workflows in Workday HCM.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Human Resources; Fair Labor Association (FLA) - Labor Standards

attributes.name: omnichannel_fulfillment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the associate's role during this shift includes omnichannel fulfillment duties such as BOPIS (Buy Online Pick Up In Store) or ship-from-store. True = omnichannel duties assigned. Used for labor allocation and fulfillment capacity planning.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository - Store Operations; Salesforce Commerce Cloud - Order Management; DTC

attributes.name: override_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason provided by the manager when a shift time override is applied (e.g., system outage, forgotten clock-out, emergency). Required when manager_override_flag is True.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Payroll; Fair Labor Association (FLA) - Labor Standards

attributes.name: overtime_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours worked beyond the standard shift threshold that qualify for overtime pay, as determined by applicable labor regulations and the associate's employment contract. Feeds directly into Workday HCM payroll processing.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Payroll; Fair Labor Association (FLA) - Labor Standards; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: pay_rate_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the pay rate tier applicable to this shift (e.g., standard, overtime, holiday, training). References the compensation rate table in Workday HCM. Classified confidential as it reveals compensation structure.

attributes.name: payroll_export_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shift record has been successfully exported to Workday HCM for payroll processing. True = exported; False = pending export. Used to prevent duplicate payroll submissions.

attributes.name: payroll_export_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this shift record was exported to Workday HCM for payroll processing. Null if payroll_export_flag is False. Supports payroll reconciliation and audit.

attributes.name: role_during_shift
attributes.description: The operational role the associate performs during this specific shift (e.g., Sales Associate, Cashier, Floor Supervisor, Stock Associate, Visual Merchandiser, BOPIS Fulfillment). May differ from the associate's primary job title. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sales_associate|cashier|floor_supervisor|stock_associate|visual_merchandiser|bopis_fulfillment|keyholder|manager_on_duty — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository - Store Operations; Workday HCM

attributes.name: schedule_adherence_minutes
attributes.description: Variance in minutes between the scheduled start time and actual clock-in time. Positive value = late arrival; negative value = early arrival. Used for store operations KPI reporting and associate performance management.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository - Store Operations; KPI

attributes.name: schedule_source
attributes.description: Indicates the origin of the shift schedule record — whether generated automatically by Workday HCM scheduling, entered manually by a manager, or adjusted post-generation. Supports audit and schedule quality analysis.

attributes.name: scheduled_end_time
attributes.description: The planned end date and time of the shift as defined in the labor scheduling system. Used to compute scheduled shift duration and planned labor cost.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Human Resources; SAP Customer Activity Repository

attributes.name: scheduled_hours
attributes.description: Total number of hours the associate is scheduled to work for this shift, derived from scheduled start and end times minus planned break duration. Stored explicitly for scheduling and OTB labor budget comparisons.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Payroll; Anaplan - Financial Planning

attributes.name: scheduled_start_time
attributes.description: The planned start date and time of the shift as defined in the labor scheduling system. Used to measure schedule adherence and compute planned labor hours.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Human Resources; SAP Customer Activity Repository

attributes.name: shift_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the shift is scheduled or occurred. Used as the primary business date for labor scheduling, daily sales reconciliation, and store performance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository - Store Operations

attributes.name: shift_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the shift record, used in scheduling systems, payroll exports, and store operations reporting. Format: SHF-YYYYMMDD-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository - Store Operations

attributes.name: shift_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the shift record. 'scheduled' = future shift confirmed; 'in_progress' = associate currently clocked in; 'completed' = shift ended and reconciled; 'cancelled' = shift removed before start; 'no_show' = associate did not clock in for a scheduled shift.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Human Resources; SAP Customer Activity Repository

attributes.name: shift_type
attributes.description: Classification of the shift for labor scheduling and payroll purposes. Drives overtime eligibility, holiday pay rates, and training hour tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: regular|overtime|on_call|split|holiday|training — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Payroll; Fair Labor Association (FLA) - Labor Standards

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this shift record was ingested (SAP Customer Activity Repository, Workday HCM, or manual entry). Supports data lineage and reconciliation in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository; Workday HCM

attributes.name: swap_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shift was the result of a shift swap between two associates. True = shift was swapped. Used to track schedule changes and ensure proper payroll attribution.

attributes.name: training_shift_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shift is designated as a training shift where the associate is undergoing onboarding, product knowledge training, or compliance training rather than performing standard operational duties.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Talent Management; Fair Labor Association (FLA) - Labor Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this shift record was last modified, including clock-in/out updates, manager overrides, or status changes. Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Silver layer pipeline.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; CCPA; Internal Data Governance Standard

products.name: bopis_order
products.description: Manages Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS) fulfillment orders assigned to a specific retail store. Captures order reference (from order domain), assigned store, pick status, pick associate, ready-for-pickup timestamp, customer notification status, pickup confirmation, and expiry/cancellation details. Enables omnichannel fulfillment SLA tracking.

attributes.name: bopis_order_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS) Order ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the BOPIS order fulfillment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: BOPIS orders result from digital marketing campaigns (email, social, paid search). Attribution critical for omnichannel campaign measurement: understanding which campaigns drive online-to-offline conv

attributes.name: cart_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ecommerce.cart. Business justification: BOPIS orders originate from online shopping carts; linking enables cart-to-pickup conversion analysis, abandoned cart recovery for in-store pickup, and omnichannel funnel optimization critical to buy-

attributes.name: digital_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ecommerce.digital_order. Business justification: BOPIS fulfillment is the store-side execution of a digital order; this link is essential for end-to-end omnichannel order lifecycle tracking, SLA monitoring, and reconciling digital order status with

attributes.name: primary_bopis_pick_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store associate who picked the items for this BOPIS order.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer who placed the BOPIS order.

attributes.name: retail_store_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retail store assigned to fulfill this BOPIS order.

attributes.name: sales_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating sales order from the order domain that this BOPIS fulfillment is assigned to.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.work_order. Business justification: BOPIS fulfillment may prioritize inventory from specific production lots for quality consistency, recall management, or to clear aging inventory from particular factory runs—supports lot-level invento

attributes.name: assigned_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the BOPIS order was assigned to the fulfilling store.

attributes.name: cancellation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context about the BOPIS order cancellation.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason why the BOPIS order was cancelled.

attributes.name: cancelled_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the BOPIS order was cancelled, either by customer request, store action, or system expiry.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this BOPIS order record was first created in the system. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: curbside_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer requested curbside pickup service for this BOPIS order.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the order total amount.

attributes.name: customer_notified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the customer was notified that their BOPIS order is ready for pickup.

attributes.name: expiry_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the BOPIS order will expire if not picked up. Typically set based on store policy (e.g., 3-7 days after ready notification).

attributes.name: fulfillment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the BOPIS order fulfillment workflow. Tracks progression from assignment through pickup or cancellation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: assigned|picking|picked|ready_for_pickup|picked_up|cancelled|expired — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: item_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct items (SKUs) included in this BOPIS order.

attributes.name: notification_method
attributes.description: The communication channel used to notify the customer that their order is ready for pickup.

attributes.name: order_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the originating sales order. Used for customer communication and operational tracking.

attributes.name: order_placed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the customer placed the original online order. Principal business event timestamp.

attributes.name: order_total_amount
attributes.description: The total monetary value of the BOPIS order including all items, taxes, and fees.

attributes.name: pick_complete_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when all items for this BOPIS order were successfully picked and staged.

attributes.name: pick_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the store associate began picking items for this BOPIS order.

attributes.name: pickup_location_type
attributes.description: The type of pickup location within or near the store where the customer will collect their order.

attributes.name: pickup_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the customer picked up the BOPIS order from the store.

attributes.name: pickup_verification_method
attributes.description: The method used to verify customer identity and authorize order handoff at pickup.

attributes.name: priority_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this BOPIS order has been marked as priority for expedited fulfillment (e.g., VIP customer, urgent request).

attributes.name: ready_for_pickup_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the BOPIS order was marked ready for customer pickup and customer notification was triggered.

attributes.name: sla_actual_minutes
attributes.description: The actual number of minutes elapsed from order assignment to ready-for-pickup status. Used for SLA compliance tracking.

attributes.name: sla_met_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the BOPIS order fulfillment met the defined SLA target time. True if actual time is less than or equal to target time.

attributes.name: sla_target_minutes
attributes.description: The target number of minutes from order assignment to ready-for-pickup status, as defined by store operations policy.

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text special instructions or notes from the customer regarding pickup preferences or requirements.

attributes.name: unit_count
attributes.description: Total number of units (quantity across all items) included in this BOPIS order.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this BOPIS order record was last modified. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: vehicle_description
attributes.description: Description of the customer's vehicle (make, model, color) for curbside pickup identification.

products.name: ship_from_store
products.description: Tracks ship-from-store fulfillment requests where a retail store acts as a mini-DC to fulfill e-commerce or wholesale orders. Records order reference, assigned store, SKU, quantity, pick/pack/ship timestamps, carrier, tracking number, and OTIF status. Supports omnichannel fulfillment performance and store-level capacity management.

attributes.name: ship_from_store_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each ship-from-store fulfillment record in the Silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity. Role: TRANSACTION_HEADER.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS — Outbound Fulfillment Order

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store sales associate or fulfillment associate assigned to pick and pack this ship-from-store order. Links to the workforce/employee master in Workday HCM. [PARTY_REFERENCE category]
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Employee Master; SAP Customer Activity Repository — Associate

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Ship-from-store fulfillment driven by ecommerce campaigns. Tracking this link measures campaign impact on store-fulfilled digital orders, critical for distributed order management and omnichannel prof

attributes.name: carbon_emission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.carbon_emission. Business justification: Ship-from-store fulfillment generates Scope 3 Category 9 (downstream transportation) emissions. Sustainability teams calculate emissions per shipment using carrier, distance, and weight data for carbo

attributes.name: digital_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ecommerce.digital_order. Business justification: Ship-from-store fulfillment executes digital orders using store inventory; critical for distributed order management, store-as-warehouse operations, and reconciling digital order promises with actual

attributes.name: retail_store_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retail store acting as the fulfillment mini-distribution center for this ship-from-store request. Links to the store master record in SAP Customer Activity Repository.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository — Store Master

attributes.name: sales_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating sales order (e-commerce or wholesale) that triggered this ship-from-store fulfillment request. Links to the order management system record in Salesforce Commerce Cloud or SAP S/4HANA SD.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Order Management; SAP S/4HANA SD Sales Order

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.logistics_shipment. Business justification: Ship-from-store fulfillment creates outbound logistics shipments that must be tracked for carrier handoff, delivery status, OTIF compliance, and customer service inquiries. Core omnichannel fulfillmen

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) being fulfilled in this ship-from-store request. Represents the sellable unit at the color/size level as managed in the product master.
attributes.references: Infor PLM — Product Master; SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.work_order. Business justification: Ship-from-store operations track production origin for quality traceability, lot-level inventory management, and recall coordination—ensures customers receive consistent quality and enables targeted r

attributes.name: business_date
attributes.description: The retail business date on which this ship-from-store fulfillment request was processed, aligned to the store's fiscal calendar. Used for daily sales reconciliation, store-level STR (Sell-Through Rate) reporting, and OTB (Open-to-Buy) budget tracking.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository — Business Date; Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Fiscal Calendar

attributes.name: cancellation_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason a ship-from-store fulfillment request was cancelled. Used for root cause analysis, store capacity management, and inventory accuracy improvement initiatives.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Rejection Reason; Manhattan Associates WMS — Cancellation Codes

attributes.name: carrier_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the parcel carrier used to ship the order from the store to the customer or destination. Used for carrier performance analytics and 3PL (Third-Party Logistics) cost allocation.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS — Carrier Master; SAP S/4HANA SD Shipping Conditions

attributes.name: carrier_service_level
attributes.description: The shipping service tier selected for this fulfillment (e.g., ground, 2-day, overnight). Drives carrier cost, delivery promise, and customer experience SLA compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS — Shipping Method; SAP S/4HANA SD Route

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this ship-from-store record was first captured in the data platform. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and Silver layer ingestion tracking. [RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category]

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this record (shipping_cost_amount, retail_value_amount). Supports multi-currency operations across international retail markets.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS/GAAP Multi-Currency Reporting

attributes.name: destination_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line of the shipment destination (customer delivery address or alternate store). Classified as restricted PII per GDPR Article 4 and CCPA as it identifies the customer's physical location.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Order Shipping Address

attributes.name: destination_city
attributes.description: City of the shipment destination address. Used for carrier zone determination, delivery time estimation, and geographic fulfillment analytics. Classified as restricted PII as part of the customer delivery address.

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code of the shipment destination. Used for international shipping compliance, customs documentation, and cross-border fulfillment analytics.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; FTC Textile Labeling Requirements; HS Code Compliance

attributes.name: destination_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the shipment destination. Used for carrier zone calculation, delivery time estimation, and geographic demand analytics. Classified as restricted PII as part of the customer delivery address.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; Universal Postal Union Standards

attributes.name: destination_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-2 state or province code of the shipment destination. Used for carrier zone mapping, tax jurisdiction determination, and regional fulfillment performance analytics.

attributes.name: exception_code
attributes.description: Standardized code capturing the type of exception encountered during the ship-from-store fulfillment process. Used for exception management workflows, store associate coaching, and process improvement analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ITEM_NOT_FOUND|DAMAGED_ITEM|LABEL_FAILURE|CARRIER_PICKUP_MISSED|ADDRESS_INVALID|SYSTEM_TIMEOUT — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: fulfillment_request_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the ship-from-store fulfillment request, used for cross-system traceability across Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Manhattan Associates WMS, and SAP S/4HANA SD. Corresponds to the outbound delivery document number in WMS. [BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category]
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS — Outbound Delivery; SAP S/4HANA SD Delivery Document

attributes.name: fulfillment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the ship-from-store fulfillment request, tracking progression from assignment through pick, pack, ship, and delivery. EXCEPTION indicates a fulfillment problem requiring intervention. [LIFECYCLE_STATUS category] [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PENDING|ASSIGNED|PICKING|PACKED|SHIPPED|DELIVERED|CANCELLED|EXCEPTION — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS — Outbound Order Status; SAP S/4HANA SD Delivery Status

attributes.name: fulfillment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fulfillment channel that triggered this ship-from-store request. ECOM_DTC = Direct-to-Consumer e-commerce order; BOPIS = Buy Online Pick Up In Store; WHOLESALE = wholesale partner order; STORE_TRANSFER = inter-store inventory transfer; SHIP_TO_STORE = ship to alternate store for customer pickup. [CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE category]
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Order Management; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: in_full_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shipped_quantity equals the ordered_quantity, confirming complete fulfillment. Enables decomposed OTIF analysis separating fullness from timeliness dimensions.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS — Fill Rate KPI

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for store associates or fulfillment managers to capture operational notes, exception details, or special handling instructions related to this ship-from-store request. Not used for structured analytics.

attributes.name: on_time_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the order was shipped on or before the promised_ship_date, independent of quantity completeness. Enables decomposed OTIF analysis separating timeliness from fullness dimensions.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS — SLA Compliance; SAP Customer Activity Repository

attributes.name: ordered_quantity
attributes.description: The number of units of the SKU requested for fulfillment in this ship-from-store record. Represents the demand quantity as received from the originating sales order.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Order Quantity; Manhattan Associates WMS — Requested Quantity

attributes.name: otif_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ship-from-store fulfillment met the OTIF (On Time In Full) standard — shipped on or before the promised_ship_date with the full shipped_quantity equal to ordered_quantity. Core KPI for omnichannel fulfillment performance and store capacity management.
attributes.references: OTIF Industry Standard; Manhattan Associates WMS — Fulfillment KPI

attributes.name: pack_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the packing of the ship-from-store order was completed and the parcel was sealed and labeled. Used to measure pack cycle time and overall fulfillment throughput.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS — Pack Completion Timestamp

attributes.name: package_weight_kg
attributes.description: Actual weight of the packed parcel in kilograms as measured at the store packing station. Used for carrier rate calculation, dimensional weight billing reconciliation, and shipping cost allocation.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS — Parcel Weight; ISO 80000-4 Mass Measurement

attributes.name: partial_fulfillment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates that the shipped_quantity is less than the ordered_quantity, resulting in a partial shipment. Triggers downstream processes such as backorder creation, customer notification, or alternate store sourcing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Partial Delivery; Salesforce Commerce Cloud Order Management

attributes.name: pick_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the store associate completed the pick operation for this fulfillment request. Used to measure pick cycle time and store fulfillment throughput performance.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS — Pick Completion Timestamp

attributes.name: picked_quantity
attributes.description: The actual number of units physically picked from store inventory during the pick operation. May differ from ordered_quantity due to inventory discrepancies, shrinkage, or partial fulfillment scenarios.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS — Pick Confirmation Quantity

attributes.name: promised_delivery_date
attributes.description: The customer-facing delivery date committed at the time of order placement. Distinct from promised_ship_date; used for customer experience SLA tracking and carrier service level selection.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Order Management Delivery Promise

attributes.name: promised_ship_date
attributes.description: The committed date by which the store must ship the order to meet the customer-facing delivery promise. Used as the SLA (Service Level Agreement) target for OTIF measurement and store performance KPI reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Order Delivery Promise; SAP S/4HANA SD Schedule Line

attributes.name: request_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the ship-from-store fulfillment request was created and assigned to the store, representing the principal business event time. Used for OTIF (On Time In Full) SLA measurement and store capacity planning. [BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category]
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS — Order Receipt Timestamp; Salesforce Commerce Cloud Order Management

attributes.name: retail_value_amount
attributes.description: The total retail selling value (AUR × shipped_quantity) of the merchandise shipped in this fulfillment request, at the current selling price. Used for store-level revenue attribution, omnichannel sales reporting, and shrinkage risk assessment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Net Value; Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Price Management

attributes.name: rfid_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SKU was verified using RFID (Radio Frequency Identification) scanning during the pick or pack operation. Supports inventory accuracy, shrinkage reduction, and omnichannel fulfillment quality assurance programs.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository — RFID Integration; GS1 RFID Standards

attributes.name: ship_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the parcel was tendered to the carrier and the shipment was confirmed. Used as the primary timestamp for OTIF (On Time In Full) compliance measurement against the SLA target.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS — Ship Confirmation; SAP S/4HANA SD Goods Issue Posting

attributes.name: shipped_quantity
attributes.description: The actual number of units packed and handed to the carrier for shipment. Used in OTIF (On Time In Full) calculation and sell-through rate (STR) reporting at the store level.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS — Ship Confirmation; SAP S/4HANA SD Goods Issue

attributes.name: shipping_cost_amount
attributes.description: Actual carrier shipping cost incurred for this ship-from-store parcel in the transaction currency. Used for omnichannel fulfillment cost analysis, store P&L allocation, and COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — Cost Allocation; Manhattan Associates WMS — Freight Cost

attributes.name: shipping_label_reference
attributes.description: Internal identifier for the shipping label generated by the WMS for this parcel. Used to reconcile label costs, void labels on cancellations, and audit label generation events in Manhattan Associates WMS.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record that originated this ship-from-store fulfillment request. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and Silver layer provenance tracking across the omnichannel technology stack.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; Salesforce Commerce Cloud; SAP S/4HANA WM; SAP Customer Activity Repository

attributes.name: store_inventory_deducted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shipped_quantity has been successfully deducted from the store's on-hand inventory in the WMS and ERP systems. Used to detect inventory reconciliation failures and ensure ATS (Available to Sell) accuracy.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS — Inventory Adjustment; SAP S/4HANA MM — Goods Issue

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: The carrier-assigned parcel tracking number generated at the time of shipment label creation. Used for customer shipment visibility, carrier claim management, and post-ship exception resolution.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS — Parcel Tracking; Salesforce Commerce Cloud Order Tracking

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this ship-from-store record was last modified in the data platform, capturing status transitions, carrier updates, or exception resolutions. [RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category]

products.name: return_transaction
products.description: Records customer merchandise returns processed at a retail store, including original POS transaction reference, return reason code (fit, quality defect, changed mind, wrong item), SKU, quantity, condition assessment, refund method (original tender, store credit, exchange), processing associate, and disposition routing (restock to floor, return to vendor/RTV, damage write-off, outlet transfer). Supports return rate analysis by reason, RTV processing workflows, loss prevention flagging of serial returners, and warranty claim tracking.

attributes.name: return_transaction_id
attributes.description: Primary key for return_transaction

attributes.name: approving_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Store managers approve high-value returns, no-receipt returns, and policy exceptions (manager_override_flag). Critical fraud prevention control, return abuse detection, and policy compliance tracking

attributes.name: circular_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.circular_enrollment. Business justification: Returns trigger circular program enrollment (take-back programs, recycling incentives, trade-in offers). Circular economy teams link returns to enrollment for material recovery tracking, customer enga

attributes.name: defect_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.quality_defect. Business justification: Returns frequently cite quality defects (stitching failures, fabric flaws, sizing issues) as return reasons. Linking enables systematic quality issue tracking, supplier accountability, and product imp

attributes.name: digital_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ecommerce.digital_order. Business justification: Store returns of online purchases require linking to the originating digital order for return authorization validation, refund processing, cross-channel return rate analytics, and reconciling digital

attributes.name: pos_transaction_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Original Point of Sale (POS) Transaction ID
attributes.description: Reference to the original POS transaction at which the merchandise being returned was purchased. Used to validate return eligibility, original tender, and purchase date. Maps to store.pos_transaction.store_pos_transaction_id.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - POS Transaction

attributes.name: primary_return_sku_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) being returned. Enables return rate analysis by product, style, color, and size.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Master

attributes.name: processing_associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the sales associate or cashier who processed the return transaction at the Point of Sale (POS). Used for associate performance tracking and loss prevention audit trails.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Employee Master

attributes.name: product_safety_test_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.product_safety_test. Business justification: Returns flagged for safety issues (skin irritation, flammability, choking hazards) link to product safety tests for root cause analysis, CPSC reporting obligations, and recall determination—critical f

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the customer initiating the return. Used for loss prevention serial-returner flagging, Customer Relationship Management (CRM) history, and Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV) analytics.

attributes.name: retail_store_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the retail store location where the return was processed. Links to the store master record.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Store Master

attributes.name: return_shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.return_shipment. Business justification: Store returns requiring logistics handling (RTV to vendor, DC consolidation, warranty claims) generate return shipments that must be tracked for freight cost allocation, vendor chargebacks, and dispos

attributes.name: rma_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.rma. Business justification: Store returns with disposition_code requiring vendor return (RTV) create RMA records for vendor credit and quality tracking. Business process: defective/damaged returns trigger RMA workflow for vendor

attributes.name: sourcing_purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sourcing.sourcing_purchase_order. Business justification: Quality-driven returns require traceability to originating sourcing PO for vendor chargebacks, quality claims, RTV authorization, and supplier performance scorecards. Essential for cost recovery and v

attributes.name: business_date
attributes.description: Fiscal or retail business date on which the return is recorded for daily sales reconciliation and End of Month (EOM) reporting. May differ from return_timestamp date for late-night transactions.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Fiscal Calendar

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the return transaction record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and Silver layer ingestion tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; Internal Data Governance Standard; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this return transaction (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency retail operations.

attributes.name: days_since_purchase
attributes.description: Number of calendar days elapsed between the original purchase date and the return transaction date. Used for return policy compliance validation and return window analytics. Stored as a business attribute to avoid repeated calculation in reporting.
attributes.references: FTC Consumer Protection Guidelines; Internal Return Policy

attributes.name: disposition_code
attributes.description: Routing decision for the physical merchandise after the return is processed. 'restock_floor' returns item to selling floor inventory; 'rtv' initiates Return to Vendor (RTV) workflow; 'damage_writeoff' records as shrinkage/loss; 'outlet_transfer' routes to outlet channel; 'quarantine' holds for quality inspection or loss prevention review.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS - Return Disposition; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: item_condition_code
attributes.description: Condition assessment of the returned merchandise as evaluated by the processing associate at Point of Sale (POS). Drives disposition routing decisions: new_with_tags and new_without_tags are eligible for floor restock; worn and damaged route to outlet transfer or damage write-off; defective routes to Return to Vendor (RTV).
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Return Condition Codes; CPSC Product Safety Standards

attributes.name: loss_prevention_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this return transaction has been flagged by the loss prevention system as suspicious, such as for serial returner behavior, wardrobing, or return fraud patterns. Triggers loss prevention review workflow.
attributes.references: Internal Loss Prevention Policy; FLA Labor Standards

attributes.name: loyalty_points_reversed
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points deducted from the customer's account as a result of the return transaction. Reverses the points originally earned on the purchase.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Loyalty Management; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: manager_override_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a store manager override was required to approve this return transaction, such as when the return falls outside standard policy (e.g., beyond return window, missing receipt, high-value item). Critical for loss prevention monitoring.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Override Management; Internal Loss Prevention Policy

attributes.name: original_order_channel
attributes.description: Sales channel through which the original purchase was made. Enables cross-channel return analysis (e.g., online purchase returned in-store) and Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) return rate reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud - Order Management; SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR)

attributes.name: original_purchase_date
attributes.description: Date on which the merchandise was originally purchased. Used to calculate days since purchase for return policy eligibility validation and warranty period determination.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - POS Transaction; FTC Consumer Protection Guidelines

attributes.name: original_tender_type
attributes.description: Payment method used in the original purchase transaction. Required to determine refund eligibility and routing when refund_method is 'original_tender'. Sourced from the original POS transaction record.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Tender Management; PCI DSS

attributes.name: quantity_returned
attributes.description: Number of units of the Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) being returned in this transaction. Used for inventory restock calculations and return rate analysis.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - POS Transaction

attributes.name: receipt_number
attributes.description: Receipt number printed on the return transaction receipt provided to the customer. Used for customer service inquiries and return transaction lookup.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Receipt Management

attributes.name: receipt_presented_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer presented the original purchase receipt at the time of return. Affects return policy eligibility, refund method options, and loss prevention risk scoring.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Return Management; Internal Loss Prevention Policy

attributes.name: refund_method
attributes.description: Method by which the refund is issued to the customer. 'original_tender' returns funds to the original payment instrument; 'store_credit' issues a store credit balance; 'exchange' swaps for another item; 'gift_card' issues a gift card; 'cash' provides cash refund regardless of original tender.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Tender Management; FTC Consumer Protection Guidelines

attributes.name: register_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the Point of Sale (POS) register or workstation at which the return was processed. Used for daily cash reconciliation and loss prevention audit trails.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Register Master

attributes.name: return_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the return was initiated or processed. Supports omnichannel return analytics including Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS) returns and ship-from-store returns.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud - Order Management; SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR)

attributes.name: return_discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount amount that was applied to the original purchase and is being reversed or credited back as part of the return. Ensures accurate net refund calculation.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 - Revenue from Contracts with Customers; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: return_gross_amount
attributes.description: Total gross merchandise value of the returned items before any adjustments, calculated as unit_retail_price multiplied by quantity_returned. Used for return rate and Sell-Through Rate (STR) impact analysis.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 - Revenue from Contracts with Customers; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: return_net_amount
attributes.description: Net amount refunded to the customer after applying discounts and taxes. Equals return_gross_amount minus return_discount_amount plus return_tax_amount. Used for financial reconciliation and daily sales reporting.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 - Revenue from Contracts with Customers; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: return_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable return authorization number printed on the return receipt and used for customer-facing communication, warranty claims, and Return to Vendor (RTV) processing. Generated by SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR).
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Return Management

attributes.name: return_policy_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific return policy applied to this transaction (e.g., standard 30-day, extended holiday, loyalty member extended window, final sale). Determines return eligibility and refund method options.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Policy Management; FTC Consumer Protection Guidelines

attributes.name: return_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code selected by the associate at Point of Sale (POS) explaining why the customer is returning the merchandise. Drives return rate analysis by reason, warranty claim routing, and Return to Vendor (RTV) eligibility. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fit|quality_defect|changed_mind|wrong_item|damaged_in_transit|warranty_claim|gift_return|size_exchange|color_exchange|duplicate_order — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Return Reason Codes; FTC Textile Labeling Requirements

attributes.name: return_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative provided by the associate or customer elaborating on the return reason beyond the standardized return_reason_code. Supports qualitative analysis and warranty claim documentation.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Return Management

attributes.name: return_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the return transaction workflow. 'pending' indicates awaiting manager approval; 'approved' indicates authorized but refund not yet issued; 'completed' indicates fully processed with refund issued; 'rejected' indicates denied by loss prevention or policy; 'voided' indicates cancelled after initial entry.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Return Management

attributes.name: return_tax_amount
attributes.description: Tax amount being refunded to the customer as part of the return transaction. Calculated based on the applicable tax jurisdiction and original tax paid.
attributes.references: IFRS 15; GAAP ASC 606; Tax Jurisdiction Compliance

attributes.name: return_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the return transaction was processed at the Point of Sale (POS) terminal. Principal business event timestamp for the return. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - POS Transaction

attributes.name: rfid_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the returned item's Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) tag was scanned and verified during the return process. Supports inventory accuracy and loss prevention authentication.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - RFID Integration; GS1 RFID Standards

attributes.name: rtv_authorization_number
attributes.description: Vendor-issued Return to Vendor (RTV) authorization number assigned when disposition_code is 'rtv'. Required for vendor credit processing and Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) transaction matching with the supplier.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Vendor Return Management; EDI Standards

attributes.name: serial_returner_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer associated with this return has been identified as a serial returner based on return frequency thresholds. Distinct from loss_prevention_flag which covers broader fraud patterns. Used for targeted loss prevention intervention.
attributes.references: Internal Loss Prevention Policy; GDPR Article 22 (automated decision-making)

attributes.name: store_credit_voucher_number
attributes.description: Voucher or store credit account number issued to the customer when refund_method is 'store_credit'. Used for store credit redemption tracking and liability reporting.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Gift Card and Store Credit Management; IFRS 15

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Tax jurisdiction code applicable to the return transaction for tax reversal calculation. Ensures correct tax credit is applied based on the store's geographic tax authority.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO - Tax Management; FTC Textile Labeling Requirements

attributes.name: unit_retail_price
attributes.description: Original selling price per unit at the time of the initial purchase transaction, used as the basis for refund calculation. Aligns with Average Unit Retail (AUR) reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Price Management; IFRS 15

attributes.name: upc_code
attributes.description: Universal Product Code (UPC) barcode of the returned item as scanned at Point of Sale (POS). Used for item verification, inventory reconciliation, and Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) cross-validation.
attributes.references: GS1 UPC Standard; SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the return transaction record was last modified in the data platform, such as when disposition is updated or loss prevention flag is set. Used for change data capture and audit compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; Internal Data Governance Standard; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity)

attributes.name: warranty_claim_number
attributes.description: Warranty claim reference number assigned when the return is associated with a product defect or warranty issue. Links the return to the warranty claim tracking workflow in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Warranty Management; CPSC Product Safety Standards

products.name: visual_merchandising_plan
products.description: Captures visual merchandising directives, planogram assignments, and compliance audit results for a store or store cluster. Includes fixture layout, product placement by zone/wall/table/window, seasonal collection display guidelines, mannequin styling instructions, signage specifications, compliance deadline, audit scores, non-compliant zones, and corrective action tracking. After merge with vm_compliance_check, this entity is SSOT for both the plan and its execution verification. Sourced from Oracle Retail Merchandising System and Centric PLM collection management.

attributes.name: visual_merchandising_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the visual merchandising plan record. Primary key for this entity in the Silver Layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: campaign_id
