attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: VM plans execute campaign creative in-store: window displays for seasonal launches, mannequin styling for brand campaigns. Direct operational link between marketing creative direction and store visual

attributes.name: collection_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product collection or capsule whose display guidelines are governed by this plan. Sourced from Centric PLM collection management.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the regional visual merchandising manager who approved and published this plan. Used for escalation routing and accountability tracking.
attributes.references: Workday HCM (Human Resources); Internal VM Compliance Policy

attributes.name: labeling_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.labeling_requirement. Business justification: VM plans must validate displayed products meet jurisdiction-specific labeling requirements (CA Prop 65 warnings, EU care symbols, bilingual Canadian labels) before floor sets to prevent non-compliant

attributes.name: retail_store_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the retail store or store cluster to which this visual merchandising plan applies. Links to the store master entity.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (POS; Store Operations)

attributes.name: season_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retail season (e.g., Spring/Summer, Fall/Winter) for which this visual merchandising plan is designed. Aligns with Oracle Retail Merchandising System season calendar.

attributes.name: vm_associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the visual merchandising associate or field representative responsible for executing and auditing this plan at the store level. References the workforce/associate master.
attributes.references: Workday HCM (Human Resources); Internal VM Compliance Policy

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the individual who formally approved this visual merchandising plan for publication and distribution to stores.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the visual merchandising plan was formally approved and authorized for distribution to store teams.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; Internal VM Governance Policy

attributes.name: audit_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the most recent visual merchandising compliance audit was conducted for this plan.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; Internal VM Compliance Policy

attributes.name: audit_score
attributes.description: Numeric compliance audit score (0.00–100.00) assigned during the most recent VM compliance audit. Reflects the degree to which the store has executed the plan per directive. Populated after merge with vm_compliance_check.
attributes.references: Internal VM Compliance Policy; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: audit_status
attributes.description: Current status of the compliance audit for this visual merchandising plan. Drives corrective action workflows and escalation triggers.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; Internal VM Compliance Policy

attributes.name: collection_display_guidelines
attributes.description: Narrative description of the seasonal collection display guidelines, including brand story, lifestyle theme, hero product callouts, and cross-category adjacency rules. Sourced from Centric PLM collection management.
attributes.references: Centric PLM (Collection Management; Material Libraries; Tech Packs)

attributes.name: color_blocking_direction
attributes.description: Prescribed color sequencing strategy for merchandise presentation on fixtures and walls. Drives visual consistency across stores within the same cluster.

attributes.name: compliance_deadline
attributes.description: The hard deadline by which store teams must complete the floor set and submit photographic or audit evidence of compliance. May precede the effective_start_date to allow pre-opening setup.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Association (FLA); Internal VM Compliance Policy

attributes.name: corrective_action_deadline
attributes.description: The date by which the store team must resolve all non-compliant zones and resubmit evidence for re-audit. Drives escalation workflows in SAP Customer Activity Repository.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; Internal VM Compliance Policy

attributes.name: corrective_action_notes
attributes.description: Free-text description of the corrective actions prescribed by the VM field team or regional manager to remediate non-compliant zones identified during the audit.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; Internal VM Compliance Policy

attributes.name: corrective_action_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a corrective action is required following the compliance audit. Set to True when audit_status is 'failed' or non_compliant_zone_count exceeds the acceptable threshold.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; Internal VM Compliance Policy

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this visual merchandising plan record was first created in the source system (Oracle Retail Merchandising System or Centric PLM). Audit trail field.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity)

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the visual merchandising plan expires and the floor set is expected to be transitioned to the next plan. Nullable for open-ended or permanent plans.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the visual merchandising plan becomes active and store teams are required to have the floor set completed. Drives compliance deadline tracking.

attributes.name: fixture_layout_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the prescribed fixture configuration for the store floor (e.g., gondola arrangement, wall system, freestanding unit layout). References the fixture library in Oracle Retail or Centric PLM.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (Assortment Planning); Centric PLM

attributes.name: mannequin_count
attributes.description: Total number of mannequins specified in the visual merchandising plan, including window and interior mannequins. Drives mannequin styling instruction tracking.

attributes.name: mannequin_styling_notes
attributes.description: Free-text instructions for mannequin outfit composition, accessory pairings, pose direction, and wig/hair styling as specified by the VM creative team. Sourced from Centric PLM tech pack directives.
attributes.references: Centric PLM (Collection Management; Material Libraries; Tech Packs)

attributes.name: non_compliant_zone_count
attributes.description: Number of merchandising zones found to be non-compliant during the most recent audit. Used to prioritize corrective action and track improvement over audit cycles.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; Internal VM Compliance Policy

attributes.name: non_compliant_zone_notes
attributes.description: Free-text description of the specific zones, fixtures, or product placements found to be non-compliant during the audit, including the nature of each deviation from the plan directive.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; Internal VM Compliance Policy

attributes.name: omnichannel_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this visual merchandising plan includes omnichannel fulfillment zone directives such as BOPIS (Buy Online Pick Up In Store) or ship-from-store staging area setup.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (POS; Store Operations); Salesforce Commerce Cloud (Order Management)

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the visual merchandising plan (e.g., 'SS25 Athleisure Front Window Launch'). Used in reporting dashboards and store communications.

attributes.name: plan_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the visual merchandising plan, used in communications with store teams, regional managers, and VM field representatives. Format: VM- followed by 4–20 alphanumeric characters.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (Price Management; Assortment Planning)

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the visual merchandising plan. Tracks progression from authoring through field execution. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|approved|published|active|expired|cancelled — promote to reference product if additional states are needed]

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the visual merchandising plan by its business purpose. Seasonal plans govern full-floor resets; promotional plans support campaign activations; window plans govern storefront displays. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: seasonal|promotional|event|permanent|window|capsule — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]

attributes.name: planogram_document_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the planogram PDF or digital asset stored in the content management system. Provides store teams direct access to the fixture layout and product placement diagrams.
attributes.references: Centric PLM (Collection Management; Material Libraries; Tech Packs)

attributes.name: planogram_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the planogram document associated with this plan (e.g., v1.0, v2.3). Tracks revisions issued to stores after initial publication. Sourced from Oracle Retail Merchandising System planogram management.

attributes.name: product_placement_zone_notes
attributes.description: Narrative instructions describing product placement by zone, wall, table, and window. Captures hero product positioning, color blocking direction, and adjacency rules for the floor set.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (Assortment Planning); Centric PLM

attributes.name: published_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the visual merchandising plan was published and made available to store teams via the distribution channel (e.g., Oracle Retail portal, intranet).
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System; Internal VM Governance Policy

attributes.name: signage_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes detailing specific signage placement instructions, size requirements, and messaging guidelines for this visual merchandising plan.
attributes.references: FTC Textile and Apparel Labeling Requirements; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: signage_specification_code
attributes.description: Code referencing the signage package specification (e.g., price tickets, lifestyle imagery, campaign headers, promotional banners) prescribed for this plan. Links to the signage asset library.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (Price Management); Centric PLM

attributes.name: size_run_display_standard
attributes.description: Standard governing how size runs are displayed on the sales floor (e.g., full size run on fixture, key sizes only on mannequin). Aligns with Oracle Retail size curve and assortment planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (Assortment Planning); Internal VM Standard

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this visual merchandising plan was sourced. ORM = Oracle Retail Merchandising System; CENTRIC_PLM = Centric PLM; MANUAL = manually entered.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; Oracle Retail Merchandising System; Centric PLM

attributes.name: store_cluster_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the store cluster or tier grouping (e.g., flagship, A-tier, B-tier, outlet) to which this plan applies when a single plan governs multiple stores. Aligns with Oracle Retail store grading.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (Assortment Planning; Allocation)

attributes.name: sustainability_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the visual merchandising plan materials (fixtures, signage, packaging) comply with the company's sustainability standards, including GOTS, BCI, and OEKO-TEX requirements for display materials.
attributes.references: Global Organic Textile Standard (GOTS); Better Cotton Initiative (BCI); OEKO-TEX Standard 100

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this visual merchandising plan record was last modified. Tracks revisions to planogram versions, compliance scores, or corrective action updates.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity)

attributes.name: window_display_count
attributes.description: Number of storefront window displays included in this visual merchandising plan. Used to track window execution compliance separately from interior floor sets.

attributes.name: zone_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct merchandising zones (e.g., front-of-store, mid-floor, back wall, window) covered by this visual merchandising plan.

products.name: vm_compliance_check
products.description: Records the results of visual merchandising compliance audits conducted at a store, capturing plan reference, audit date, auditor (store manager or field VM team), compliance score, non-compliant zones, corrective action notes, and re-audit date. Enables brand consistency enforcement across the retail fleet.

attributes.name: vm_compliance_check_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each visual merchandising compliance audit record. Primary key for the vm_compliance_check data product.

attributes.name: auditor_associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the individual who conducted the audit — either the store manager or a field visual merchandising team member. Links to the workforce/associate master.

attributes.name: district_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the retail district to which the audited store belongs. Enables district-level compliance aggregation and benchmarking across the store fleet.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository — Store Operations; Internal Store Hierarchy

attributes.name: district_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: District managers review and approve visual merchandising compliance audits, especially for critical violations requiring corrective action. Essential approval workflow for brand standards enforcement

attributes.name: prior_audit_compliance_check_vm_compliance_check_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prior Audit Visual Merchandising (VM) Compliance Check ID
attributes.description: Reference to the immediately preceding compliance check record for this store and VM plan, enabling trend analysis and comparison of compliance scores across audit cycles.

attributes.name: re_audit_compliance_check_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Re-Audit Visual Merchandising (VM) Compliance Check ID
attributes.description: Reference to the subsequent re-audit compliance check record created after corrective actions are completed. Enables chaining of audit and re-audit records for full remediation lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: retail_store_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the retail store where the visual merchandising compliance audit was conducted. Links to the store master record.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository — Store Master

attributes.name: visual_merchandising_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the visual merchandising plan or directive that this compliance check is evaluated against. Ties the audit to a specific seasonal or campaign VM directive issued by the brand.
attributes.references: Centric PLM — Collection Management; Internal VM Directive

attributes.name: acknowledgement_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the store manager formally acknowledged the audit findings. Populated only when store_manager_acknowledgement_flag is True.

attributes.name: audit_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the visual merchandising compliance audit was physically conducted in the store.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository — Store Operations

attributes.name: audit_notes
attributes.description: General free-text observations and comments recorded by the auditor during the compliance check. Captures context not covered by structured fields, such as store-specific circumstances, staffing constraints, or positive observations.

attributes.name: audit_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible, human-readable reference number assigned to this compliance audit (e.g., VM-2024-000123). Used for cross-referencing with field VM team communications and store operations reports.

attributes.name: audit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the compliance audit record. Tracks progression from initial capture through review and final disposition.

attributes.name: audit_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time at which the compliance audit was initiated in the store, including timezone offset. Supports intraday scheduling and field team coordination.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository — Store Operations

attributes.name: audit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the audit by its business trigger. Routine audits occur on a scheduled cadence; seasonal reset audits validate new collection floor sets; campaign launch audits confirm marketing activation compliance; spot checks are unannounced; re-audits follow a failed prior check.

attributes.name: auditor_role
attributes.description: Job role of the individual who conducted the audit. Distinguishes between internal store management audits and field visual merchandising team audits, which may carry different authority levels.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Talent Management; Internal VM Compliance Framework

attributes.name: compliance_score
attributes.description: Overall percentage compliance score achieved by the store for this audit, expressed as a value between 0.00 and 100.00. Calculated by the auditor based on the number of compliant zones versus total zones assessed. Enables fleet-wide brand consistency benchmarking.
attributes.references: Internal VM Compliance Framework; ISO 9001 — Quality Management

attributes.name: compliance_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum compliance score percentage required for the store to be considered passing for this audit period. Captured at time of audit to preserve the standard in effect, as thresholds may change over time.

attributes.name: compliant_zones_count
attributes.description: Number of assessed zones that were found to be fully compliant with the VM plan directives. Used alongside total_zones_assessed to validate the compliance_score.

attributes.name: corrective_action_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the store must complete all corrective actions identified during the audit. Used to track remediation timeliness and SLA compliance.
attributes.references: Internal VM Compliance Framework; ISO 9001 — Corrective Action

attributes.name: corrective_action_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing the specific corrective actions required to bring non-compliant zones into alignment with the VM plan. Recorded by the auditor at time of inspection and communicated to store management for remediation.
attributes.references: Internal VM Compliance Framework; ISO 9001 — Corrective Action

attributes.name: corrective_action_status
attributes.description: Current status of the corrective action remediation process following a failed or partially compliant audit. Tracks whether the store has addressed the identified non-compliance issues within the required timeframe.
attributes.references: Internal VM Compliance Framework; ISO 9001 — Corrective Action

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this compliance audit record was first created in the system. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 — Quality Records; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: critical_violation_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of any critical brand standard violations identified. Populated only when critical_violation_flag is True. Documents the nature and location of the violation for escalation and remediation tracking.

attributes.name: critical_violation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any critical brand standard violations were identified during the audit (True = at least one critical violation present). Critical violations typically require immediate corrective action and may trigger escalation to district or regional management.
attributes.references: Internal VM Compliance Framework; Fair Labor Association (FLA) — Brand Standards

attributes.name: fixture_layout_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the physical fixture layout and product adjacency on the sales floor matched the VM plan floor map directive during this audit.

attributes.name: floor_set_date
attributes.description: Date on which the store completed the most recent floor set or VM reset prior to this audit. Contextualizes the audit relative to how recently the store implemented the VM directive.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Assortment Planning; Internal Store Operations

attributes.name: folding_hanging_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Folding and Hanging Standards Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether product folding, hanging, and presentation standards (e.g., size sequencing, color blocking, facing direction) were compliant with the VM directive during this audit.

attributes.name: lighting_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether store lighting (accent, ambient, and feature lighting) was set in accordance with the VM plan specifications during this audit.

attributes.name: mannequin_styling_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether mannequin styling and outfit coordination across the store floor was compliant with the VM plan directive. Mannequin presentation is a key brand consistency indicator in apparel retail.

attributes.name: non_compliant_zone_count
attributes.description: Total number of zones found to be non-compliant during the audit. Provides a quick numeric summary for KPI dashboards and trend analysis without parsing the non_compliant_zones text field.

attributes.name: non_compliant_zones
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or free-text description of the specific store zones or sections found to be non-compliant during the audit (e.g., 'Front Window Display, Denim Wall, Checkout Counter'). Enables targeted corrective action assignment.

attributes.name: pass_fail_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the store passed (True) or failed (False) the compliance audit based on whether the compliance_score met or exceeded the compliance_threshold. Drives escalation and corrective action workflows.

attributes.name: photo_evidence_count
attributes.description: Number of photographic evidence images captured and attached to this compliance audit record. Photos document both compliant and non-compliant zones and are stored in the associated document management system.
attributes.references: Internal VM Compliance Framework; ISO 9001 — Quality Records

attributes.name: photo_evidence_reference
attributes.description: External reference identifier or URL path to the photo evidence package stored in the document management or digital asset management system for this audit record.
attributes.references: Internal VM Compliance Framework; ISO 9001 — Quality Records

attributes.name: re_audit_date
attributes.description: Scheduled or actual date for the follow-up re-audit to verify that corrective actions have been completed and the store is now compliant. Populated only when re_audit_required_flag is True.

attributes.name: re_audit_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a follow-up re-audit is required for this store (True = re-audit scheduled or required). Typically set to True when the store fails the initial audit or when critical violations are identified.

attributes.name: season_code
attributes.description: Merchandising season code associated with the VM plan being audited (e.g., SS24 for Spring/Summer 2024, FW24 for Fall/Winter 2024). Aligns the audit to the relevant collection planning cycle.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Assortment Planning; Centric PLM — Collection Management

attributes.name: signage_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether in-store signage (promotional, price, directional, and brand signage) was compliant with the VM plan and current marketing campaign directives during this audit.
attributes.references: Internal VM Compliance Framework; FTC — Retail Advertising Standards

attributes.name: store_manager_acknowledgement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the store manager has formally acknowledged receipt of the audit findings and corrective action requirements (True = acknowledged). Required for audit closure in many brand compliance frameworks.
attributes.references: Internal VM Compliance Framework; ISO 9001 — Management Review

attributes.name: total_zones_assessed
attributes.description: Total number of visual merchandising zones or sections evaluated during the audit (e.g., front window, entrance table, wall fixtures, fitting room corridor). Provides the denominator for compliance scoring.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this compliance audit record was most recently modified. Tracks updates such as corrective action status changes, re-audit scheduling, and manager acknowledgements.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 — Quality Records; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: vm_directive_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the VM plan or directive document against which this audit was conducted (e.g., 'v2.1'). Ensures auditability when VM directives are updated mid-season.
attributes.references: Centric PLM — Collection Management; Internal VM Compliance Framework

attributes.name: window_display_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the store's front window display was found to be compliant with the VM plan directive during this audit. Window displays are a high-visibility brand touchpoint and are tracked separately.

products.name: markdown_event
products.description: Records markdown pricing events executed at the store level, including SKU, original MSRP, markdown price, markdown percentage, effective date, end date, markdown reason (clearance, seasonal, competitive), and authorization reference. Supports MD tracking, GMROI analysis, and OTB reconciliation. Sourced from Oracle Retail Price Management.

attributes.name: markdown_event_id
attributes.description: Primary key for markdown_event

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Markdown events are coordinated with marketing campaigns (seasonal clearance, flash sales). Business tracks which campaigns justify markdowns and measures promotional markdown effectiveness vs. campai

attributes.name: compliance_certification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_certification. Business justification: Markdown events on certified sustainable/organic products (GOTS, OEKO-TEX) require certification validation to ensure marketing claims during sales remain compliant with FTC Green Guides and prevent g

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Markdowns create inventory valuation adjustments requiring GL posting for accurate gross margin and inventory valuation. Critical for financial reporting compliance and margin analysis. Each markdown

attributes.name: merchandise_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the merchandise hierarchy node (department, class, subclass) to which the SKU belongs at the time of the markdown event. Enables hierarchical MD analysis and category-level GMROI reporting.

attributes.name: non_conformance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.non_conformance. Business justification: Markdowns triggered by quality issues (fabric defects, construction flaws, color inconsistencies) require NCR linkage for cost recovery from suppliers and quality-driven margin impact analysis. Critic

attributes.name: otb_budget_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Open-to-Buy (OTB) budget record impacted by this markdown event. Supports OTB reconciliation workflows in Anaplan by linking markdown-driven inventory reductions to planned buy budgets.
attributes.references: Anaplan (Merchandise Planning); Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: price_change_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent price change event in the merchandising domain from which this store-level markdown event originates. Supports traceability from store execution back to the central pricing decision.

attributes.name: primary_markdown_employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the merchandising manager or authorized personnel who approved the markdown event in Oracle Retail Price Management. Supports authorization audit and segregation of duties compliance.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management; FLA Labor Standards; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: promotion_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the marketing promotion or campaign associated with this markdown event, if applicable. Links promotional markdowns to campaign performance tracking in Adobe Experience Platform and SAP Customer Activity Repository.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository; Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: retail_store_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the retail store at which this markdown event is executed. Links to the store master record for store-level MD tracking and performance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (POS; Store Operations)

attributes.name: season_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the merchandise season (e.g., Spring/Summer, Fall/Winter) associated with this markdown event. Supports seasonal MD analysis, OTB reconciliation, and collection lifecycle tracking.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System; Centric PLM

attributes.name: site_promotion_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ecommerce.site_promotion. Business justification: Store markdowns often align with or reference coordinated digital promotions to maintain omnichannel price consistency, enable unified promotional effectiveness tracking, and support cross-channel mar

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) subject to the markdown event. Enables SKU-level MD tracking, sell-through rate (STR) analysis, and GMROI reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System; Infor PLM

attributes.name: sourcing_purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sourcing.sourcing_purchase_order. Business justification: Markdown decisions require landed cost context from sourcing PO for accurate margin analysis, IMU/MMU calculations, and vendor cost reconciliation. Critical for pricing strategy and profitability repo

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.vendor. Business justification: Markdown events often require vendor negotiation for markdown allowances or return-to-vendor (RTV) authorization. Real business process: buyers negotiate vendor-funded markdowns or cost recovery on sl

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.work_order. Business justification: Markdowns resulting from production quality issues, overruns, or late deliveries require work order linkage for factory chargeback calculations, vendor performance scorecards, and cost recovery negoti

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the markdown event was formally approved in Oracle Retail Price Management. Represents the principal business event timestamp for the markdown authorization lifecycle.

attributes.name: authorization_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or code from the authorization workflow that approved this markdown event. Typically sourced from Oracle Retail Price Management approval chain. Required for audit compliance and financial controls.

attributes.name: channel_applicability
attributes.description: Specifies the retail channel(s) to which this markdown event applies. Supports omnichannel pricing consistency, BOPIS (Buy Online Pick Up In Store), and ship-from-store fulfillment scenarios.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud; SAP Customer Activity Repository; NRF Omnichannel Standards

attributes.name: cost_price
attributes.description: Unit cost of goods sold (COGS) for the SKU at the time of the markdown event. Used to calculate gross margin impact of the markdown and support GMROI analysis. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA MM module.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this markdown event record was first created in the source system (Oracle Retail Price Management). Used for audit trail, data lineage, and Silver Layer ingestion tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this markdown event record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency retail operations and financial consolidation.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the markdown price becomes active and is applied at the store POS. Aligns with the Oracle Retail Price Management effective date field. Used for OTB reconciliation and fiscal period reporting.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the markdown event expires and the price reverts (for temporary/promotional markdowns). Null for permanent markdowns. Used for event duration analysis and POS price management.

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the markdown event within the Oracle Retail Price Management workflow. Controls whether the markdown is visible and applied at the POS.

attributes.name: initial_markup_pct
attributes.description: Initial Markup (IMU) percentage at the time the SKU was first priced for the season, expressed as a decimal. Provides the baseline for measuring markdown erosion of margin and maintained markup (MMU) tracking.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System; NRF Retail Glossary

attributes.name: maintained_markup_pct
attributes.description: Maintained Markup (MMU) percentage after applying the markdown, reflecting the actual margin retained post-markdown. Calculated as (markdown_price minus cost_price) / markdown_price. Critical for GMROI analysis and financial planning in Anaplan.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System; Anaplan; NRF Retail Glossary

attributes.name: markdown_amount
attributes.description: Absolute monetary reduction applied to the original retail price (original_retail_price minus markdown_price). Expressed in the store's operating currency. Used for financial impact reporting and GMROI analysis.

attributes.name: markdown_event_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the markdown event as assigned by Oracle Retail Price Management. Used for cross-system reference, audit trails, and reconciliation with source system records.

attributes.name: markdown_level
attributes.description: Granularity at which the markdown event is defined and applied within the merchandise hierarchy. SKU-level markdowns are the most granular; department-level markdowns apply broadly across a category.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management; NRF Retail Glossary

attributes.name: markdown_pct
attributes.description: Percentage reduction from the original retail price to the markdown price, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.3000 = 30%). Key metric for MD depth analysis, OTB reconciliation, and maintained markup (MMU) tracking.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management; NRF Retail Glossary

attributes.name: markdown_price
attributes.description: The new selling price for the SKU after the markdown event is applied. This is the price presented to customers at POS during the markdown event period. Core field for AUR and ASP reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management; FTC Pricing Regulations

attributes.name: markdown_reason_code
attributes.description: Business reason driving the markdown event. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: clearance|seasonal|competitive|slow_seller|overstock|damage|end_of_line — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management; NRF Retail Glossary

attributes.name: markdown_type
attributes.description: Classification of the markdown event by pricing permanence. Permanent markdowns reduce the ongoing retail price; temporary markdowns revert after the event period; promotional markdowns are tied to a campaign; clearance markdowns are end-of-lifecycle reductions.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management; NRF Retail Glossary

attributes.name: msrp_price
attributes.description: The original Manufacturer's Suggested Retail Price (MSRP) for the SKU prior to any markdown. Serves as the baseline for markdown percentage calculation and IMU/MMU analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management; FTC Pricing Regulations

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments entered by the merchandising team regarding the markdown event. May include competitive intelligence, vendor negotiation context, or store-specific execution instructions.

attributes.name: on_hand_qty
attributes.description: Store-level on-hand inventory quantity for the SKU at the time the markdown event is created. Captured to support sell-through rate (STR) analysis, weeks of supply (WOS) calculation, and OTB reconciliation.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: original_retail_price
attributes.description: The store's current selling price for the SKU immediately before this markdown event is applied. May differ from MSRP due to prior price changes. Used as the direct basis for markdown amount and percentage calculations.

attributes.name: pos_applied_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the markdown price has been successfully pushed to and activated at the store Point of Sale (POS) system (SAP Customer Activity Repository). True when the markdown is live at POS; False when pending or failed.

attributes.name: price_label_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether physical price label reprinting is required for store fixtures and merchandise as part of this markdown event. Drives visual merchandising and store operations task management.
attributes.references: FTC Pricing Regulations; Oracle Retail Price Management

attributes.name: price_zone_code
attributes.description: Oracle Retail Price Management price zone code identifying the geographic or store-cluster pricing zone to which this markdown event applies. Supports zone-based pricing strategy and regional MD analysis.

attributes.name: rfid_repriced_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether RFID-tagged units for this SKU have been repriced and relabeled in the store as part of the markdown event execution. Supports RFID-enabled inventory accuracy and shrinkage control.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository; RFID Standards (GS1)

attributes.name: sell_through_rate
attributes.description: Ratio of units sold during the markdown event to on-hand quantity at event start, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.6500 = 65% STR). Key KPI for markdown effectiveness and inventory liquidation performance. Sourced or calculated from SAP Customer Activity Repository data.
attributes.references: NRF Retail Glossary; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: source_record_reference
attributes.description: Native primary key or record identifier of this markdown event in the originating source system (Oracle Retail Price Management). Enables exact record traceability and idempotent Silver Layer upserts.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this markdown event record was sourced (e.g., ORM = Oracle Retail Merchandising, SAP_CAR = SAP Customer Activity Repository). Supports data lineage and Silver Layer provenance tracking.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management; SAP Customer Activity Repository

attributes.name: units_sold_during_event
attributes.description: Total number of units of the SKU sold at the markdown price during the event period. Populated at event close or via daily reconciliation from SAP Customer Activity Repository. Supports STR and markdown effectiveness analysis.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository; Oracle Retail Price Management

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this markdown event record was last modified in the source system. Tracks amendments to markdown pricing, status changes, or date adjustments post-creation.

products.name: shrinkage_incident
products.description: Documents inventory shrinkage events identified at a store, including shrinkage type (external theft/shoplifting, internal/employee theft, administrative error, vendor fraud, damage/spoilage), discovery method (cycle count variance, RFID exception, video analytics, EAS alarm, receiving audit), affected SKUs with style/color/size detail, quantity and retail value lost, incident date, loss prevention case reference, and resolution status. Supports shrinkage rate KPI (target <1.5% of net sales), LP investigation workflows, and high-shrink SKU/category identification for fixture security decisions.

attributes.name: shrinkage_incident_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each shrinkage incident record in the store loss prevention system. Primary key for this entity. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — represents a discrete loss event with its own lifecycle, investigation workflow, and financial impact.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the store associate who discovered or reported the shrinkage incident. For internal theft cases, this may reference the subject of the investigation. Supports LP investigation workflows and associate accountability tracking.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Human Resources; SAP Customer Activity Repository

attributes.name: defect_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.quality_defect. Business justification: Shrinkage from damaged goods requires defect classification for vendor chargebacks, cost recovery, and quality reporting. Apparel retailers track whether shrinkage resulted from manufacturing defects

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the Loss Prevention (LP) investigator or agent assigned to this incident case. Used to track investigator workload, case assignment, and resolution accountability.
attributes.references: Internal Loss Prevention Case Management Standard; Workday HCM

attributes.name: fiscal_week_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the fiscal week in which the shrinkage incident was discovered. Enables shrinkage rate KPI reporting aligned to the retail fiscal calendar (4-4-5 or 4-5-4 week structure) and weekly STR (Sell-Through Rate) performance context.
attributes.references: Anaplan — Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Merchandise Financial Plan

attributes.name: incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_incident. Business justification: Shrinkage incidents involving counterfeit goods, non-compliant imports, or trademark violations escalate to compliance incidents requiring regulatory notification (CBP, brand protection), linking loss

attributes.name: involved_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.profile. Business justification: Loss prevention incidents involving identified customers (apprehensions, banned individuals, organized retail crime suspects) require customer profile linkage for case management, banned customer list

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Shrinkage losses require GL posting for inventory write-offs and loss recognition. Essential for accurate financial statements and shrinkage reserve management. Links operational loss prevention to fi

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the store department or selling floor zone where the shrinkage incident occurred or was discovered. Supports spatial shrinkage analysis for fixture security and visual merchandising decisions.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository — Store Operations; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: pos_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Point of Sale (POS) transaction associated with this shrinkage incident, where applicable (e.g., a fraudulent return, a mis-scan event, or a void transaction linked to suspected internal theft). Null for incidents not tied to a specific POS transaction.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository — POS Transaction Management

attributes.name: receiving_shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.logistics_shipment. Business justification: Shrinkage discovered during store receiving (shortage, damage) must be traced to inbound shipment for vendor claim filing, carrier liability determination, and supply chain quality metrics. Required f

attributes.name: retail_store_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the retail store where the shrinkage incident was discovered or occurred. Links to the store master record for location, region, and format context.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository — Store Master

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the primary Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) affected by the shrinkage incident, representing the specific style, color, and size combination. For multi-SKU incidents, references the highest-value or primary SKU; additional SKUs are captured in the shrinkage_incident_line product.
attributes.references: Infor PLM — BOM Management; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: store_cycle_count_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cycle count or physical inventory event that identified the shrinkage variance, where discovery_method is cycle_count_variance or physical_inventory. Null for incidents discovered by other methods.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Inventory Management; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: waste_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.waste_record. Business justification: Shrinkage (damaged, unsellable, or stolen goods) becomes waste when disposed. Loss prevention and sustainability teams track disposition for waste accounting, diversion programs, and circular economy

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.work_order. Business justification: Shrinkage investigation traces to production work order when defects (missing security tags, incorrect labeling, quality issues) originate at factory level—enables root cause analysis and factory acco

attributes.name: apprehension_made
attributes.description: Indicates whether a suspect was apprehended in connection with this shrinkage incident. Used to measure LP team effectiveness and track apprehension rates by store, shrinkage type, and time period.
attributes.references: Internal Loss Prevention Case Management Standard; FLA — Labor Standards

attributes.name: color_code
attributes.description: Standardized color code of the affected SKU as defined in the PLM system. Used alongside style_number and size_code to fully identify the affected product variant for shrinkage pattern analysis.
attributes.references: Infor PLM — Product Design; Centric PLM — Material Libraries

attributes.name: cost_value_lost
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) Value Lost
attributes.description: Total cost value (Cost of Goods Sold / COGS) of the units lost in this incident at the time of discovery. Used for financial write-off entries in the general ledger and EBITDA impact reporting. Distinct from retail_value_lost which reflects selling price.
attributes.references: IFRS/GAAP — Inventory Write-Down; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — Cost Accounting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this shrinkage incident record was first created in the system, including time-zone offset. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SLA compliance tracking for incident reporting timeliness.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity; IFRS/GAAP — Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the monetary values recorded in this incident (retail_value_lost, cost_value_lost). Supports multi-currency reporting for international store portfolios.

attributes.name: discovery_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the shrinkage event was first identified or detected by store operations or loss prevention. Distinct from incident_date when the event occurred prior to detection.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository — Store Operations

attributes.name: discovery_method
attributes.description: The operational process or technology that first identified the shrinkage event. Supports analysis of detection effectiveness by method and investment decisions for loss prevention technology. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cycle_count_variance|rfid_exception|video_analytics|eas_alarm|receiving_audit|pos_exception|physical_inventory — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository — Store Operations; RFID Journal Industry Standard

attributes.name: discovery_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the shrinkage event was first identified, including time-zone offset. Used for intraday loss pattern analysis and correlation with POS transaction timelines.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository — Store Operations

attributes.name: eas_alarm_triggered
attributes.description: Indicates whether an Electronic Article Surveillance (EAS) alarm was triggered in connection with this shrinkage incident. Used to evaluate EAS system effectiveness and correlate alarm events with confirmed shrinkage.

attributes.name: gl_posting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the financial write-off for this shrinkage incident has been posted to the General Ledger (GL) in SAP S/4HANA FI/CO. Supports financial close reconciliation and shrinkage expense reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — Financial Accounting; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: incident_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the shrinkage event is estimated or confirmed to have occurred. May differ from the discovery date when shrinkage is identified retrospectively through cycle count variance or RFID exception reporting.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository — Store Operations

attributes.name: incident_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the circumstances of the shrinkage incident, including how it occurred, who was involved, and any relevant contextual details. Used by LP investigators for case documentation and root cause analysis.
attributes.references: Internal Loss Prevention Case Management Standard

attributes.name: incident_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the shrinkage incident record within the loss prevention workflow. Drives investigation routing and KPI reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: open|under_investigation|resolved|closed|escalated|voided — promote to reference product if additional statuses are needed]

attributes.name: inventory_adjustment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal inventory adjustment has been posted in the inventory management system (SAP S/4HANA MM) to reflect the confirmed shrinkage loss. Ensures financial and operational inventory records are reconciled.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Inventory Management; IFRS/GAAP — Inventory Write-Down

attributes.name: lp_case_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric reference number assigned by the Loss Prevention (LP) department or case management system to track the investigation associated with this shrinkage incident. Used for cross-referencing with LP investigation workflows and law enforcement reports.
attributes.references: Internal Loss Prevention Case Management Standard

attributes.name: merchandise_category
attributes.description: The merchandise hierarchy category of the affected product (e.g., Outerwear, Footwear, Accessories, Activewear). Supports high-shrink category identification for fixture security decisions and assortment risk reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Assortment Planning; Internal Merchandise Hierarchy Standard

attributes.name: multi_sku_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shrinkage incident involves more than one Stock Keeping Unit (SKU). When true, additional affected SKUs are captured in the shrinkage_incident_line detail product. Supports accurate total incident valuation.
attributes.references: Internal Loss Prevention Case Management Standard; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: organized_retail_crime_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this incident has been classified as Organized Retail Crime (ORC) based on LP investigation findings. ORC incidents are escalated to regional LP teams and may be reported to law enforcement task forces. Supports ORC trend analysis and network-level investigation.
attributes.references: NRF Organized Retail Crime Survey; FTC — Retail Security Guidelines

attributes.name: police_report_number
attributes.description: Official law enforcement report number filed in connection with this shrinkage incident, where applicable (primarily external theft cases). Used for insurance claims, legal proceedings, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: Internal Loss Prevention Case Management Standard; FTC — Retail Security Guidelines

attributes.name: quantity_lost
attributes.description: Number of units confirmed lost or unaccounted for as a result of this shrinkage incident. Used as the primary quantitative measure for shrinkage rate KPI calculation and inventory adjustment.
attributes.references: NRF Shrinkage Survey; SAP S/4HANA MM — Inventory Management

attributes.name: recovery_quantity
attributes.description: Number of units recovered following the shrinkage incident (e.g., merchandise recovered from a shoplifter, items found misplaced). Used to calculate net shrinkage after recovery and to assess LP recovery effectiveness.
attributes.references: NRF Shrinkage Survey; SAP S/4HANA MM — Inventory Management

attributes.name: recovery_value
attributes.description: Retail value of merchandise recovered following the shrinkage incident. Used to calculate net financial impact after recovery and to report on LP recovery performance.
attributes.references: IFRS/GAAP — Inventory Adjustment; NRF Shrinkage Survey

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: Date on which the shrinkage incident was formally resolved and the case closed. Used to calculate case resolution cycle time and LP team performance metrics.
attributes.references: Internal Loss Prevention Case Management Standard

attributes.name: resolution_type
attributes.description: The outcome or resolution method applied to close this shrinkage incident. Drives financial treatment (write-off vs. recovery vs. insurance claim) and vendor chargeback (Return to Vendor / RTV) processing.
attributes.references: IFRS/GAAP — Inventory Write-Down; Internal Loss Prevention Case Management Standard

attributes.name: retail_value_lost
attributes.description: Total retail selling value of the units lost in this incident, calculated as quantity_lost multiplied by the current retail price at time of discovery. Expressed in the store's operating currency. Used as the primary monetary measure for shrinkage rate KPI (target <1.5% of net sales) and financial write-off processing.
attributes.references: IFRS/GAAP — Inventory Write-Down; NRF Shrinkage Survey; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO

attributes.name: rfid_exception_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shrinkage incident was triggered or corroborated by a Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) inventory exception, such as an item present in RFID scan but absent from physical count, or vice versa. Supports RFID ROI analysis for loss prevention.
attributes.references: RFID Journal Industry Standard; SAP Customer Activity Repository

attributes.name: season_code
attributes.description: The merchandise season code associated with the affected SKU at the time of the incident (e.g., SS25, FW24). Supports seasonal shrinkage trend analysis and collection-level risk assessment for future season planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Assortment Planning; Centric PLM — Collection Management

attributes.name: shrinkage_type
attributes.description: Primary classification of the shrinkage event by root cause. External theft covers shoplifting and organized retail crime; internal theft covers employee theft; administrative error covers mis-scans, pricing errors, and paperwork discrepancies; vendor fraud covers short-shipment or substitution fraud; damage/spoilage covers unsaleable goods. Drives LP investigation routing and shrinkage rate decomposition reporting.
attributes.references: National Retail Federation (NRF) Shrinkage Survey Classification; CPSC Product Safety Standards

attributes.name: size_code
attributes.description: Size designation of the affected SKU (e.g., XS, S, M, L, XL, 32x30). Combined with style_number and color_code to fully identify the product variant involved in the shrinkage event.
attributes.references: Infor PLM — Product Design; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: store_zone
attributes.description: Specific area or zone within the store where the incident occurred (e.g., fitting room, entrance, stockroom, sales floor, cash wrap). Supports hotspot mapping for LP resource deployment and fixture security planning.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository — Store Operations

attributes.name: style_number
attributes.description: The product style identifier from the Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) system representing the design-level grouping above SKU. Enables high-shrink style identification for fixture security and visual merchandising decisions.
attributes.references: Infor PLM — Product Design; Centric PLM — Collection Management

attributes.name: unit_retail_price
attributes.description: The retail selling price per unit of the affected SKU at the time the incident was discovered. Used to validate retail_value_lost calculation and to track whether high-price items are disproportionately targeted. Aligns with AUR (Average Unit Retail) KPI tracking.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Price Management; SAP Customer Activity Repository

attributes.name: upc
attributes.description: Universal Product Code (UPC) barcode of the affected SKU. Used for cross-referencing with POS transaction records, receiving audits, and EAS alarm logs to validate shrinkage claims.
attributes.references: GS1 US — UPC Standard; SAP Customer Activity Repository

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this shrinkage incident record, including time-zone offset. Used for change tracking, data freshness monitoring, and audit compliance in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity; IFRS/GAAP — Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: video_evidence_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether video surveillance footage has been captured and retained as evidence for this shrinkage incident. Supports LP investigation documentation and legal proceedings.
attributes.references: Internal Loss Prevention Case Management Standard; FTC — Retail Security Guidelines

products.name: store_cycle_count
products.description: Records scheduled and ad-hoc physical inventory cycle counts performed at a store, capturing count date, count method (manual, RFID scan, barcode scan), zone/department scope, counted SKUs with style/color/size detail, system on-hand quantity, physical count quantity, variance units, variance value at retail, count status (open, in-progress, reconciled, approved), and counter associate. Supports inventory accuracy KPI (target >98%), shrinkage identification, and NRF ARTS InventoryCount conformance.

attributes.name: store_cycle_count_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each physical inventory cycle count event at a retail store. Primary key for this record. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — represents a discrete inventory count business event with a defined lifecycle (open → in-progress → reconciled → approved).
attributes.references: NRF ARTS InventoryCount Standard; ISO 9001 Inventory Control

attributes.name: count_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cycle count schedule or plan that generated this count event. Links scheduled counts to their originating plan for compliance tracking against the store's annual cycle count calendar.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS InventoryCount Standard; SAP CAR Cycle Count Schedule

attributes.name: fiscal_week_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.fiscal_week. Business justification: Cycle counts are scheduled and reported by fiscal week for inventory accuracy tracking. Currently store_cycle_count has fiscal_week_code (BIGINT) which is a denormalized reference. Adding fiscal_week_

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Inventory adjustments from cycle counts post to GL for perpetual inventory accuracy. Required for financial statement accuracy and inventory valuation compliance. Each variance adjustment creates acco

attributes.name: primary_store_counter_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales associate or stock associate who performed the physical count. Supports accountability tracking and count accuracy analysis by associate. Sourced from Workday HCM employee records.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS InventoryCount Standard; Fair Labor Association (FLA) Labor Standards

attributes.name: retail_store_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retail store location where the cycle count was performed. Links to the store master record in SAP Customer Activity Repository.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS Store Standard; SAP CAR Store Master

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) — the unique style/color/size combination — that was counted in this cycle count record. Each row represents one SKU counted within the count event. Links to the product SKU master.
attributes.references: GS1 Standards; NRF ARTS Item Standard; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: adjustment_document_number
attributes.description: The SAP S/4HANA material document number generated when the inventory adjustment was posted following cycle count approval. Provides the audit trail link between the cycle count record and the financial inventory posting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Document; IFRS/GAAP Audit Trail

attributes.name: adjustment_posted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the approved inventory variance has been posted as an inventory adjustment transaction in the system of record (SAP S/4HANA MM). True = adjustment posted; False = pending posting. Critical for financial close and inventory accuracy KPI reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Inventory Adjustment; IFRS/GAAP Inventory Valuation; NRF ARTS

attributes.name: arts_conformance_version
attributes.description: The version of the NRF Association for Retail Technology Standards (ARTS) InventoryCount schema to which this record conforms. Supports regulatory and standards audit documentation.

attributes.name: bopis_reserved_qty
attributes.business_glossary_term: Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS) Reserved Quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of this SKU reserved for Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS) orders at the time of the cycle count. Excluded from Available to Sell (ATS) calculation and must be reconciled separately during omnichannel fulfillment accuracy review.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS Omnichannel Standard; Salesforce Commerce Cloud Order Management

attributes.name: color_code
attributes.description: Standardized color code for the counted SKU as defined in the product master. Enables color-level variance analysis and supports visual merchandising accuracy reporting.
attributes.references: Centric PLM Material Library; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: count_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the physical inventory cycle count was conducted. Used for scheduling, trend analysis, and reconciliation against system on-hand as of that date. Principal business event date for this transaction.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS InventoryCount Standard; Oracle Retail Merchandising System Inventory

attributes.name: count_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the physical count was completed at the store. Used to calculate count duration and to close the inventory freeze window. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS InventoryCount Standard; SAP CAR Inventory Count

attributes.name: count_method
attributes.description: The physical counting technique used during the cycle count. Manual counts are hand-tallied; rfid_scan uses Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) readers; barcode_scan uses handheld scanners; hybrid combines methods. Impacts count accuracy benchmarking and equipment utilization reporting.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS InventoryCount Standard; RFID in Retail Best Practices; GS1 Standards

attributes.name: count_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the cycle count event, used in store operations, reconciliation reports, and audit trails. Format: CC-{YYYY}-{MM}-{SEQNUM}. Sourced from SAP Customer Activity Repository inventory count document number.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS InventoryCount Standard; SAP CAR Inventory Count Document

attributes.name: count_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the physical count was initiated at the store. Used to measure count duration and to freeze system on-hand snapshot for variance calculation. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS InventoryCount Standard; SAP CAR Inventory Count

attributes.name: count_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the cycle count event. Drives operational actions: open (scheduled, not started), in_progress (counting underway), reconciled (variances reviewed), approved (supervisor sign-off complete), cancelled (count voided). Sourced from SAP CAR inventory count status.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS InventoryCount Standard; SAP CAR Inventory Count Status

attributes.name: count_type
attributes.description: Classification of the count event by its trigger or scope. Scheduled counts are planned per the cycle count calendar; ad_hoc counts are triggered by discrepancy alerts; full_store counts cover all zones; spot_check counts target high-risk SKUs; post_shrinkage counts follow a shrinkage incident. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: scheduled|ad_hoc|full_store|spot_check|post_shrinkage|post_receipt|post_transfer — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NRF ARTS InventoryCount Standard; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cycle count record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data governance and lineage tracking in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver layer. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity; IFRS/GAAP Audit Trail; ISO 9001

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary variance values in this record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency retail operations and financial consolidation.

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Merchandise department code scoped for this cycle count (e.g., Mens Apparel, Womens Footwear, Accessories). Aligns with Oracle Retail Merchandising System department hierarchy for inventory accuracy reporting by department.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System Department Hierarchy; NRF ARTS

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: The specific type of physical location within the store where the SKU was found during the count. Enables location-level accuracy analysis and supports visual merchandising compliance checks.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS Store Layout Standard; SAP CAR Storage Location

attributes.name: physical_count_qty
attributes.description: The actual quantity of units physically counted and verified on the store floor or stockroom for this SKU during the cycle count. This is the raw count result entered by the counter associate.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS InventoryCount Standard; SAP CAR Inventory Count

attributes.name: recount_qty
attributes.description: The quantity recorded during a mandatory recount triggered when the initial physical count variance exceeds the tolerance threshold. Null if no recount was performed. Used to validate or override the original physical count.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS InventoryCount Standard; SAP CAR Inventory Count Recount

attributes.name: recount_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a recount was triggered for this SKU because the initial variance exceeded the store's tolerance threshold. True = recount was required and performed; False = variance within acceptable tolerance.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS InventoryCount Standard; SAP CAR Inventory Count

attributes.name: retail_unit_price
attributes.description: The current retail selling price (Average Unit Retail — AUR) of the SKU at the time of the cycle count. Used to calculate variance retail value and supports Manufacturers Suggested Retail Price (MSRP) compliance checks.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System Price Management; NRF ARTS; FTC Pricing Regulations

attributes.name: rfid_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SKU count was verified using Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) scanning technology. True = RFID scan confirmed; False = counted by manual or barcode method only. Supports RFID accuracy benchmarking.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS RFID Standard; GS1 RFID Standards

attributes.name: season_code
attributes.description: The merchandise season code associated with the counted SKU (e.g., SS25, FW24). Enables seasonal inventory accuracy analysis and supports Open-to-Buy (OTB) and sell-through rate (STR) reporting by season.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System Season; Centric PLM Collection Management

attributes.name: ship_from_store_reserved_qty
attributes.description: The quantity of this SKU reserved for ship-from-store fulfillment orders at the time of the cycle count. Supports omnichannel inventory accuracy and Available to Promise (ATP) reconciliation.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS Omnichannel Standard; Salesforce Commerce Cloud Order Management

attributes.name: size_code
attributes.description: Size designation for the counted SKU (e.g., XS, S, M, L, XL, 32x30, 8.5). Enables size-level inventory accuracy analysis and supports size curve (Size Curve) reporting for replenishment decisions.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System Size Scale; NRF ARTS

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this cycle count record was sourced (e.g., SAP Customer Activity Repository, Manhattan Associates WMS). Supports data lineage and Silver layer reconciliation in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Standards

attributes.name: style_number
attributes.description: The product style identifier representing the base design, independent of color and size. Used for style-level inventory accuracy analysis and alignment with Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) records in Centric PLM and Infor PLM.
attributes.references: Centric PLM Style Master; Infor PLM Product Design; NRF ARTS

attributes.name: system_on_hand_qty
attributes.description: The inventory quantity recorded in the system of record (SAP S/4HANA MM or SAP CAR) at the time the cycle count was initiated. Serves as the baseline for variance calculation. Represents the book inventory position before physical count.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Inventory Management; SAP CAR; NRF ARTS InventoryCount

attributes.name: upc
attributes.description: Universal Product Code (UPC) barcode value for the counted SKU. Used for barcode scan reconciliation and cross-reference with point-of-sale (POS) and warehouse management system (WMS) records. Conforms to GS1 GTIN-12 or GTIN-14 format.
attributes.references: GS1 GTIN Standard; FTC Textile Labeling Requirements

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cycle count record was last modified, including status changes, recount entries, variance reason updates, and adjustment postings. Audit trail field for data governance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity; IFRS/GAAP Audit Trail; ISO 9001

attributes.name: variance_cost_value
attributes.description: The monetary value of the inventory variance expressed at cost (Cost of Goods Sold — COGS basis). Used for financial inventory write-down reporting and EBITDA impact analysis. Expressed in the store's operating currency.
attributes.references: IFRS/GAAP Inventory Valuation; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; NRF ARTS

attributes.name: variance_notes
attributes.description: Free-text narrative entered by the counter associate or supervisor to describe the circumstances of the inventory variance. Supports loss prevention investigation and audit documentation.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS InventoryCount Standard; ISO 9001 Nonconformance Documentation

attributes.name: variance_pct
attributes.description: The inventory variance expressed as a percentage of system on-hand quantity (variance_qty / system_on_hand_qty × 100). Used to measure inventory accuracy against the target KPI of greater than 98% accuracy per NRF best practices.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS InventoryCount Standard; ISO 9001 Inventory Accuracy KPI

attributes.name: variance_qty
attributes.description: The unit difference between physical count quantity and system on-hand quantity (physical_count_qty minus system_on_hand_qty). Negative values indicate shrinkage or unrecorded outbound movement; positive values indicate unrecorded inbound or phantom inventory.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS InventoryCount Standard; ISO 9001 Inventory Accuracy KPI

attributes.name: variance_reason_code
attributes.description: Coded reason assigned during reconciliation to explain the root cause of the inventory variance. Used for shrinkage classification, loss prevention reporting, and process improvement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: shrinkage|receiving_error|transfer_error|mis_sort|damage|admin_error|unknown|vendor_short_ship|return_processing_error — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NRF ARTS InventoryCount Standard; CPSC; FLA Labor Standards

attributes.name: variance_retail_value
attributes.description: The monetary value of the inventory variance expressed at retail price (variance_qty multiplied by the current retail price of the SKU). Used for shrinkage dollar reporting, loss prevention analysis, and financial reconciliation. Expressed in the store's operating currency.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS InventoryCount Standard; IFRS/GAAP Inventory Valuation; CPSC

attributes.name: zone_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code identifying the physical zone or area within the store that was counted (e.g., sales floor, stockroom, fitting room, receiving dock). Enables zone-level inventory accuracy analysis and targeted shrinkage investigation.
attributes.references: NRF ARTS Store Zone Standard; SAP CAR Store Layout

products.name: campaign_participation
products.description: This association product represents the participation of individual retail stores in marketing campaigns. It captures store-level budget allocation, performance targets, actual results, and operational compliance for each store-campaign combination. Each record links one retail store to one campaign with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific store's participation in this specific campaign.. Existence Justification: In apparel fashion retail operations, marketing campaigns are executed across multiple store locations with store-specific budget allocations, performance targets, and compliance tracking. A single national or regional campaign (e.g., Spring 2024 Collection Launch) runs simultaneously across dozens or hundreds of stores, while each store participates in multiple concurrent campaigns (brand awareness, seasonal clearance, local events). Marketing operations actively manage this many-to-many relationship by allocating budgets per store-campaign pair, setting store-level targets, tracking store-level sales attribution, and monitoring execution compliance.

attributes.name: campaign_participation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each store-campaign participation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to campaign. Identifies which campaign the store is participating in.

attributes.name: retail_store_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to retail_store. Identifies which store is participating in the campaign.

attributes.name: budget_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for store_budget_allocated_amount and store_actual_sales_amount. Typically matches the store's local currency_code.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
