attributes.description: Timestamp when this store-campaign participation record was created in the system.

attributes.name: store_actual_sales_amount
attributes.description: Actual sales revenue generated by this store attributable to this campaign. Used for campaign ROI analysis at store level.

attributes.name: store_budget_allocated_amount
attributes.description: Budget amount allocated specifically to this store for this campaign. Part of the campaign's total budget is distributed across participating stores.

attributes.name: store_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this store is compliant with campaign execution requirements (signage, merchandising, staff training, promotional pricing). Used for campaign audit and quality control.

attributes.name: store_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this specific store's participation in the campaign ended. May differ from the campaign's overall end_date due to early termination or extended participation.

attributes.name: store_participation_status
attributes.description: Current status of this store's participation in the campaign. Values: planned, active, paused, completed, cancelled. Allows stores to opt in/out or pause participation independently.

attributes.name: store_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this specific store began participating in the campaign. May differ from the campaign's overall start_date due to phased rollouts or regional timing.

attributes.name: store_target_impressions
attributes.description: Target number of impressions or customer touchpoints this specific store is expected to generate for this campaign.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this store-campaign participation record was last updated.

products.name: storefront_fulfillment
products.description: This association product represents the fulfillment configuration between retail_store and digital_storefront. It captures the operational rules governing how physical stores fulfill orders originating from digital storefronts, including BOPIS (Buy Online Pick-up In Store), ship-from-store capabilities, inventory allocation percentages, and fulfillment priority rankings. Each record links one retail_store to one digital_storefront with attributes that exist only in the context of this omnichannel fulfillment relationship.. Existence Justification: In omnichannel apparel fashion operations, a single physical retail store can fulfill orders originating from multiple digital storefronts (e.g., a flagship store in NYC fulfills for both the US DTC site and the outlet microsite), and a single digital storefront sources inventory and fulfillment capacity from multiple physical stores across its service geography. The business actively manages this many-to-many relationship through fulfillment configuration records that specify BOPIS eligibility, ship-from-store capabilities, inventory allocation percentages, fulfillment priority rankings, and service level agreements for each store-storefront pair.

attributes.name: storefront_fulfillment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each store-to-storefront fulfillment configuration record. Primary key.

attributes.name: digital_storefront_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Store Storefront Fulfillment - Digital Storefront Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the digital storefront that sources inventory and fulfillment from this store

attributes.name: retail_store_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Store Storefront Fulfillment - Retail Store Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the physical retail store location that provides fulfillment services

attributes.name: bopis_enabled_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Buy Online Pick-up In Store Enabled
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether Buy Online Pick-up In Store (BOPIS) fulfillment is enabled for this store-storefront combination. A store may offer BOPIS for some digital storefronts but not others based on operational capacity, brand alignment, or regional strategy. This is relationship-specific configuration.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fulfillment configuration record was created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this store-storefront fulfillment configuration became or will become active. Used for temporal tracking of fulfillment network changes, seasonal capacity adjustments, and new store launches. This is relationship-specific temporal data that tracks when this particular fulfillment link was established.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date when this store-storefront fulfillment configuration ended or will end. Null if the configuration is currently active. Used to track historical fulfillment network topology, store closures, or strategic channel realignments. This is relationship-specific temporal data that tracks when this particular fulfillment link was terminated.

attributes.name: fulfillment_priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking for this store when fulfilling orders from this digital storefront. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used by order routing algorithms to determine which store should fulfill an order when multiple stores are eligible. This attribute exists only in the context of the store-storefront relationship because the same store may have different priorities for different storefronts based on geography, brand affinity, or capacity.

attributes.name: inventory_allocation_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of the store's available inventory that is allocated for fulfillment of orders from this digital storefront. Allows stores to reserve inventory capacity across multiple digital channels. Sum of allocation percentages across all storefronts for a given store may exceed 100% in overbooking scenarios. This is relationship-specific data because allocation rules vary by storefront based on channel strategy and demand patterns.

attributes.name: service_level_agreement_hours
attributes.description: Target number of hours within which this store commits to fulfill orders from this digital storefront (e.g., 2 hours for BOPIS, 24 hours for ship-from-store). Service level agreements may vary by store-storefront combination based on customer expectations, competitive positioning, and operational capacity. This is relationship-specific operational data.

attributes.name: ship_from_store_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether ship-from-store fulfillment is enabled for this store-storefront combination. Determines if the store can pack and ship orders placed on this digital storefront directly to customers. A store may ship for some storefronts but not others based on shipping infrastructure, labor capacity, or channel strategy. This is relationship-specific configuration.

attributes.name: updated_by_user
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system process that last updated this fulfillment configuration record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fulfillment configuration record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

products.name: store_cluster
products.description: Master reference table for store_cluster. Referenced by store_cluster_id.

attributes.name: store_cluster_id
attributes.description: Primary key for store_cluster

attributes.name: average_store_size_sqft
attributes.description: Average retail floor space in square feet across all stores in the cluster.

attributes.name: climate_zone
attributes.description: Primary climate zone classification for the cluster used for seasonal merchandise planning and allocation.

attributes.name: cluster_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the store cluster used in operational systems and reporting.

attributes.name: cluster_description
attributes.description: Detailed business description of the cluster purpose, characteristics, and strategic rationale for grouping.

attributes.name: cluster_manager_email
attributes.description: Business email address of the cluster manager for operational communication.

attributes.name: cluster_manager_name
attributes.description: Name of the regional or cluster manager responsible for stores in this cluster.

domains.name: ecommerce
domains.description: Operates digital storefronts, online catalog management, site merchandising, cart and checkout flows, digital payments, and DTC channel performance. Owns web session data, conversion metrics, AOV, CAC measurement, personalization, and digital customer journey touchpoints powered by Salesforce Commerce Cloud.
domains.references: GDPR, CCPA, PCI-DSS, Salesforce Commerce Cloud

products.name: digital_storefront
products.description: Master record for each digital storefront or site instance operated by Apparel Fashion, including DTC brand sites, regional storefronts, outlet microsites, and channel classification (DTC web, mobile app, PWA, social commerce). Captures site identity, locale, currency, brand affiliation, domain URL, launch date, platform version, operational status, and channel type. Serves as the top-level anchor for all site-level configuration, catalog assignments, channel performance attribution, CAC measurement, and AOV benchmarking.

attributes.name: loyalty_program_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether a loyalty program is active and integrated with this storefront.

attributes.name: mobile_app_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether a dedicated mobile application is available for this storefront.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this storefront record was last modified.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the digital storefront.

attributes.name: payment_gateway

attributes.name: personalization_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether AI-driven personalization features are enabled for this storefront.

attributes.name: platform_version
attributes.description: Version of the e-commerce platform powering this storefront (e.g., Salesforce Commerce Cloud version).

attributes.name: primary_language

attributes.name: pwa_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether Progressive Web App functionality is enabled for this storefront.

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Business region code for the storefront (e.g., 'NA' for North America, 'EMEA' for Europe/Middle East/Africa, 'APAC' for Asia-Pacific).

attributes.name: retirement_date

attributes.name: seo_description
attributes.description: Default SEO meta description for the storefront homepage used for search engine optimization.

attributes.name: seo_title
attributes.description: Default SEO title tag for the storefront homepage used for search engine optimization.

attributes.name: shipping_origin_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the primary shipping origin for orders from this storefront.

attributes.name: social_commerce_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether social commerce integrations (Instagram Shopping, Facebook Shops) are enabled.

attributes.name: storefront_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the digital storefront, used for external references and integrations.

attributes.name: storefront_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the digital storefront (e.g., 'Apparel Fashion US', 'Outlet Store EU').

attributes.name: storefront_type
attributes.description: Business classification of the storefront purpose (flagship brand site, regional site, outlet microsite, seasonal campaign site).

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Tax jurisdiction code applicable to transactions on this storefront for sales tax calculation.

attributes.name: timezone
attributes.description: IANA timezone identifier for the storefront's operational timezone (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London').

products.name: web_session
products.description: Captures individual shopper web sessions on the digital storefront, including session start/end timestamps, device type, browser, OS, referral source, UTM parameters, landing page, exit page, page views, bounce flag, session duration, and key behavioral events (search queries, product page views, filter usage, size/color selection patterns). Sourced from the commerce platform tag layer. Foundational for conversion funnel analysis, CAC measurement, personalization triggering, digital customer journey mapping, and cookie consent state tracking during the browsing session.

attributes.name: web_session_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the web session on the digital storefront. Primary key.

attributes.name: digital_storefront_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ecommerce.digital_storefront. Business justification: Web sessions occur on a specific digital storefront. The session captures storefront-specific behavior (landing page, exit page, channel). This is a standard N:1 relationship - many sessions belong to

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the customer associated with this session. Null for anonymous sessions.

attributes.name: add_to_cart_count
attributes.description: Number of times the user added items to the shopping cart during the session.

attributes.name: bounce_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the session was a bounce (single page view with no interaction). True if bounce, False otherwise.

attributes.name: browser
attributes.description: Web browser used during the session (e.g., Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge).

attributes.name: browser_version
attributes.description: Version number of the web browser used during the session.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Marketing channel through which the user arrived at the digital storefront. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: organic|paid_search|social|email|direct|referral|display|affiliate — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: checkout_initiated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the user initiated the checkout process during the session. True if initiated, False otherwise.

attributes.name: conversion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the session resulted in a conversion event (e.g., purchase, signup). True if converted, False otherwise.

attributes.name: cookie_consent_status
attributes.description: Status of the user's cookie consent during the session for GDPR and CCPA compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this session record was first created in the data platform.

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: Type of device used to access the digital storefront during this session.

attributes.name: exit_page_url
attributes.description: The last page URL visited by the user before ending the session.

attributes.name: geographic_city
attributes.description: City name derived from the session IP address geolocation.

attributes.name: geographic_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code derived from the session IP address (e.g., USA, GBR, FRA).

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or state derived from the session IP address.

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: Internet Protocol address of the device used during the session. May be anonymized for privacy compliance.

attributes.name: landing_page_url
attributes.description: The first page URL visited by the user when entering the digital storefront in this session.

attributes.name: language_preference
attributes.description: Two-letter ISO language code representing the user's browser language preference (e.g., en, es, fr).

attributes.name: operating_system
attributes.description: Operating system of the device used during the session (e.g., iOS, Android, Windows, macOS).

attributes.name: operating_system_version
attributes.description: Version number of the operating system used during the session.

attributes.name: page_views
attributes.description: Total number of pages viewed during the session.

attributes.name: product_page_views
attributes.description: Number of product detail pages viewed during the session.

attributes.name: referral_source
attributes.description: The referring URL or source that directed the user to the digital storefront.

attributes.name: search_query_count
attributes.description: Number of search queries performed by the user during the session.

attributes.name: session_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Total duration of the session in seconds, calculated from start to end timestamp.

attributes.name: session_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the web session ended or timed out. Null for active sessions.

attributes.name: session_source_platform
attributes.description: The commerce platform or application that captured this session data (e.g., Salesforce Commerce Cloud).

attributes.name: session_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the web session was initiated on the digital storefront.

attributes.name: session_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the web session.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this session record was last updated in the data platform.

attributes.name: utm_campaign
attributes.description: UTM parameter identifying the specific marketing campaign name.

attributes.name: utm_content
attributes.description: UTM parameter used to differentiate similar content or links within the same campaign.

attributes.name: utm_medium
attributes.description: UTM parameter identifying the marketing medium (e.g., cpc, email, social, organic).

attributes.name: utm_source
attributes.description: UTM parameter identifying the source of the traffic (e.g., google, facebook, newsletter).

attributes.name: utm_term
attributes.description: UTM parameter identifying paid search keywords or terms.

products.name: site_catalog
products.description: Defines the online product catalog published to each digital storefront, including catalog name, associated storefront, active date range, catalog type (seasonal, evergreen, outlet), publication status, and total SKU count. Manages which product assortment is visible and shoppable on each site at any given time. Links to the product domain for SKU-level detail while owning the digital publication lifecycle.

attributes.name: site_catalog_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the site catalog. Primary key.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Catalogs are often campaign-specific (holiday gift guide, seasonal launch catalog). Enables campaign performance reporting by catalog and supports merchandising-marketing alignment on featured assortm

attributes.name: circular_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.circular_program. Business justification: Links seasonal/regional catalogs to applicable take-back, resale, or rental programs for EPR compliance and customer communication. Real business need: EU textile EPR regulations require catalogs to r

attributes.name: digital_storefront_id
attributes.description: Reference to the digital storefront where this catalog is published.

attributes.name: merchandiser_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Catalogs are curated by merchandising employees who manage assortment, pricing, and publication workflows. Links enable workload tracking, approval routing, and performance measurement for catalog man

attributes.name: parent_catalog_site_catalog_id
attributes.description: Reference to a parent catalog if this catalog is a subset or variant. Nullable for top-level catalogs. Enables catalog inheritance and hierarchical merchandising.

attributes.name: price_book_id
attributes.description: Reference to the price book that governs pricing for products in this catalog. Links to merchandising domain for price management.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Price Management

attributes.name: season_id
attributes.description: Reference to the merchandising season this catalog represents (e.g., Spring 2024, Fall/Winter 2023). Links to the merchandising domain for seasonal planning context.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Season Management

attributes.name: active_from_date
attributes.description: The date when this catalog becomes visible and shoppable on the storefront. Part of the catalog's effective date range.

attributes.name: active_sku_count
attributes.description: The number of SKUs currently active and available for purchase within this catalog. Subset of total SKU count, excluding out-of-stock or discontinued items.

attributes.name: active_to_date
attributes.description: The date when this catalog is no longer visible on the storefront. Nullable for catalogs with no planned end date (evergreen catalogs).

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The approval workflow status for this catalog. Catalogs must be approved before they can be published to the storefront.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this catalog was approved for publication. Nullable if not yet approved.

attributes.name: catalog_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the catalog used in system integrations and reporting.

attributes.name: catalog_description
attributes.description: Detailed business description of the catalog's purpose, target audience, and merchandising strategy. Used for internal planning and external marketing copy.

attributes.name: catalog_name
attributes.description: Business name of the catalog (e.g., Spring 2024 Collection, Outlet Clearance, Holiday Gift Guide).

attributes.name: catalog_priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking used when multiple catalogs are active on the same storefront. Higher values take precedence for product display and search ranking.

attributes.name: catalog_type
attributes.description: Classification of the catalog by merchandising strategy: seasonal (time-bound collection), evergreen (year-round core), outlet (clearance), promotional (campaign-driven), exclusive (member-only), or limited edition (special release).

attributes.name: country_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes where this catalog is available (e.g., USA,CAN,MEX). Empty for global catalogs.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this catalog record was first created in the system. Immutable audit field.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The primary currency for pricing in this catalog (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). All product prices are displayed in this currency unless overridden by customer locale.

attributes.name: default_locale
attributes.description: The primary language and region locale for this catalog (e.g., en_US, fr_FR, de_DE). Determines default product names, descriptions, and pricing display.

attributes.name: external_catalog_reference
attributes.description: The catalog identifier from an external system (e.g., Oracle Retail, legacy PLM). Used for system integration and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: The geographic reach of this catalog: global (available worldwide), regional (multi-country region), or country-specific (single market).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this catalog record was last updated. Tracks content changes, SKU additions/removals, and metadata updates.

attributes.name: merchandising_theme
attributes.description: The creative or marketing theme for this catalog (e.g., Summer Essentials, Back to School, Holiday Gift Guide, Sustainability Collection). Used for site merchandising and campaign alignment.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for internal notes, special instructions, or merchandising commentary about this catalog. Not displayed to customers.

attributes.name: promotion_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether products in this catalog are eligible for promotional discounts and offers. False for outlet or already-discounted catalogs.

attributes.name: publication_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the catalog: draft (being prepared), scheduled (approved for future publication), published (live and shoppable), suspended (temporarily hidden), or archived (no longer active).

attributes.name: published_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this catalog was first published to the storefront. Nullable for catalogs that have never been published.

attributes.name: search_indexing_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether products in this catalog are included in site search results. May be disabled for exclusive or hidden catalogs.

attributes.name: seo_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether products in this catalog are indexed by external search engines (Google, Bing). Disabled for member-only or pre-launch catalogs.

attributes.name: target_customer_segment
attributes.description: The primary customer segment this catalog is merchandised for (e.g., VIP Members, New Customers, Youth, Professional Athletes). Used for personalization and targeted marketing.

attributes.name: total_sku_count
attributes.description: The total number of unique SKUs included in this catalog. Used for catalog size tracking and assortment breadth analysis.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: The version number of this catalog. Incremented each time the catalog is republished with changes. Supports catalog versioning and rollback.

products.name: ecommerce_catalog_product_listing
products.description: Represents the published listing of a specific SKU or style on a digital storefront catalog, including listing status (active, suppressed, out-of-stock), display sequence, featured flag, online exclusive flag, digital price override, SEO title, SEO meta description, canonical URL, and go-live/expiry dates. Distinct from the product master — this entity owns the digital merchandising and publication attributes for each SKU on each site.

attributes.name: ecommerce_catalog_product_listing_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the catalog product listing record. Primary key for this entity representing a specific SKU or style published on a digital storefront.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Individual product listings are featured in campaigns (new arrival hero products, seasonal hero SKUs). Supports product-level campaign performance analysis and merchandising effectiveness measurement.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary digital catalog category where this product is classified. Determines default browse placement.

attributes.name: concept_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to design.concept. Business justification: E-commerce catalogs are merchandised by design concept for thematic storytelling and campaign cohesion. Merchandisers group products by concept to create concept-driven landing pages and seasonal narr

attributes.name: ecolabel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.ecolabel. Business justification: Associates product listings with eco-certifications (GOTS, Fair Trade, OEKO-TEX) for PDP badge display, faceted search filtering, and marketing claims compliance. Real business need: consumer-facing s

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user or merchandiser who published or last updated this product listing. Supports accountability and workflow tracking.

attributes.name: ftc_label_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.ftc_label. Business justification: Online product detail pages must display FTC-compliant labeling information (fiber content, care, country of origin). Digital merchandising teams link catalog listings to approved FTC labels to ensure

attributes.name: merchandise_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.merchandise_hierarchy. Business justification: Catalog listings need merchandise hierarchy for site navigation tree construction, category page generation, faceted search filtering, and merchandising performance reporting. This is how digital stor

attributes.name: product_safety_test_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.product_safety_test. Business justification: Digital merchandising requires safety test clearance before publishing SKUs to online catalogs. Merchandising teams verify test completion and pass/fail status during catalog setup to ensure only comp

attributes.name: site_catalog_id
attributes.description: Reference to the digital storefront or e-commerce site where this product is listed. Supports multi-site catalog management.

attributes.name: size_scale_id
attributes.description: Reference to the size chart or fit guide associated with this product listing. Helps customers select appropriate size.

attributes.name: sketch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to design.design_sketch. Business justification: Digital merchandisers trace listed products to originating design sketches for creative attribution, design performance ROI analysis, and designer productivity measurement. Essential for design-to-com

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product master SKU being listed on the digital catalog. Links this listing to the core product entity.

attributes.name: standard_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.quality_standard. Business justification: Product listings must display applicable quality/sustainability certifications (OEKO-TEX, GOTS, Fair Trade) for regulatory compliance and customer transparency. Quality standards drive product badging

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.vendor. Business justification: Digital merchandising requires vendor attribution for catalog products to manage vendor-funded digital promotions, co-op advertising budgets, and measure vendor performance by online sales channel. Dr

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.work_order. Business justification: Pre-order catalog listings must reference specific production work orders to calculate accurate expected ship dates, manage inventory promises, and coordinate go-live timing with production completion

attributes.name: average_rating
attributes.description: Calculated average customer rating score for this product listing, typically on a 1-5 scale. Displayed to influence purchase decisions.

attributes.name: badge_color
attributes.description: Hexadecimal color code or predefined color name for the product badge. Controls visual presentation of promotional badges.

attributes.name: badge_text
attributes.description: Optional promotional or informational badge text displayed on the product tile or detail page (e.g., Sale, Limited Edition, Sustainable).

attributes.name: browsable_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this product listing should appear in category browse pages and navigation menus.

attributes.name: canonical_url
attributes.description: The canonical URL path for this product listing. Used for SEO to prevent duplicate content issues and establish the authoritative product page.

attributes.name: digital_price_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the digital price override. Required when digital price override is populated.

attributes.name: digital_price_override
attributes.description: Optional price override specific to the digital channel. When populated, this price supersedes the standard retail price for online transactions.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management - Channel Pricing

attributes.name: display_sequence
attributes.description: Numeric ordering value controlling the position of this product in catalog browse and search results. Lower values appear first.

attributes.name: expected_ship_date
attributes.description: Expected date when pre-order or back-ordered items will ship to customers. Manages customer expectations for delayed fulfillment.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date when this product listing expires and is automatically removed from the digital storefront. Supports time-limited offerings.

attributes.name: go_live_date
attributes.description: The date when this product listing becomes active and visible to customers on the digital storefront. Supports scheduled product launches.

attributes.name: inventory_display_mode
attributes.description: Controls how inventory availability is displayed to customers on the product listing (exact quantity, low stock warning, simple in-stock indicator, or hidden).

attributes.name: is_bestseller
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this product qualifies as a bestseller based on sales velocity and should be merchandised accordingly.

attributes.name: is_featured
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this product is featured or promoted on the digital storefront. Featured products receive priority placement.

attributes.name: is_new_arrival
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this product should be displayed with new arrival badge or in new arrivals collection.

attributes.name: is_online_exclusive
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this product is available exclusively through the digital channel and not in physical retail stores.

attributes.name: listing_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this catalog product listing record was first created in the system. Audit trail for listing lifecycle.

attributes.name: listing_status
attributes.description: Current publication status of the product listing on the digital storefront. Determines visibility and availability to customers.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud - Product Status Management

attributes.name: listing_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this catalog product listing record was last modified. Tracks merchandising changes and content updates.

attributes.name: locale_code
attributes.description: Language and region locale code for this product listing (e.g., en_US, fr_FR). Supports multi-language and multi-region catalog management.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1 Language Codes and ISO 3166-1 Country Codes

attributes.name: low_stock_threshold
attributes.description: Inventory quantity threshold below which the low stock warning is displayed to customers. Drives urgency messaging.

attributes.name: personalization_segment
attributes.description: Customer segment or persona code used for personalized product recommendations and targeted merchandising on the digital storefront.

attributes.name: pre_order_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this product is available for pre-order before official release date. Supports launch campaigns.

attributes.name: recommendation_priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority score used by recommendation engines to rank this product in personalized product suggestions and cross-sell opportunities.

attributes.name: review_count
attributes.description: Total number of customer reviews submitted for this product listing. Provides social proof and credibility.

attributes.name: searchable_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this product listing should be included in site search results and search engine indexing.

attributes.name: seo_keywords
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of keywords and phrases for search engine optimization and internal site search relevance.

attributes.name: seo_meta_description
attributes.description: Meta description tag content for search engine results pages. Summarizes product listing in 150-160 characters to drive click-through.

attributes.name: seo_title
attributes.description: Optimized page title for search engine indexing and display in search results. Typically 50-60 characters for optimal display.
attributes.references: SEO Best Practices - Title Tag Optimization

attributes.name: shipping_restriction_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this product has shipping restrictions (e.g., hazardous materials, oversized, international restrictions).

attributes.name: suppression_reason
attributes.description: Code or description explaining why this product listing is suppressed from the digital storefront (e.g., quality issue, compliance, inventory).

attributes.name: tax_category_code
attributes.description: Tax classification code for this product listing. Determines applicable sales tax rates and rules for digital transactions.

attributes.name: three_sixty_view_url
attributes.description: URL to the interactive 360-degree product view asset. Provides immersive product visualization experience.

attributes.name: url_slug
attributes.description: Human-readable URL-friendly identifier derived from product name. Used in constructing the product detail page URL path.

attributes.name: video_url
attributes.description: URL to the primary product video showcasing the item. Enhances product presentation and conversion rates.

products.name: cart
products.description: Captures the complete shopping cart state for each shopper on the digital storefront, including cart header (creation timestamp, last modified, status, currency, applied promotions, estimated shipping/tax) and line-item detail (SKU, style, colorway, size, quantity, unit price, line subtotal, discount, gift flag, add-to-cart timestamp). Tracks pre-checkout purchase intent at both aggregate and SKU level. Critical for abandoned cart recovery, AOV optimization, and product affinity modeling.

attributes.name: cart_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the shopping cart instance. Primary key.

attributes.name: billing_address_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer address selected for billing. May be null if address not yet selected.

attributes.name: digital_storefront_id
attributes.description: Reference to the digital storefront where this cart was created. Enables multi-brand and multi-locale cart tracking.

attributes.name: fulfillment_distribution_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.distribution_center. Business justification: Carts check real-time inventory availability against specific DC pools to calculate ATP and display accurate stock status. Critical for preventing overselling and enabling DC-specific inventory reserv

attributes.name: merged_from_cart_id
attributes.description: Reference to another cart that was merged into this cart. Occurs when a guest shopper logs in and their guest cart is merged with their authenticated cart.

attributes.name: packaging_sustainability_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.packaging_sustainability. Business justification: Associates cart sessions with packaging sustainability profiles for checkout-time carbon footprint display and packaging preference capture (e.g., plastic-free option). Real business need: checkout fl

attributes.name: payment_method_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer payment method selected for this cart. May be null if payment method not yet selected.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer who owns this cart. Links to authenticated or guest customer profile.

attributes.name: promotion_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary promotion applied to the cart. Links to the merchandising promotion master.

attributes.name: sales_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales order created when this cart was successfully converted. Null if cart has not been converted.

attributes.name: shipping_address_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer address selected for shipping. May be null if address not yet selected.

attributes.name: web_session_id
attributes.description: Unique session identifier from the e-commerce platform tracking the shopper's browsing session. Used for abandoned cart recovery and session analytics.

attributes.name: ab_test_variant
attributes.description: Identifier for the A/B test variant or experience shown to this shopper. Used for conversion rate optimization and multivariate testing analysis.

attributes.name: abandoned_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the cart was classified as abandoned based on inactivity threshold. Triggers abandoned cart recovery campaigns.

attributes.name: cart_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the shopping cart. Active = shopper is actively browsing; Abandoned = shopper left without checkout; Converted = cart was successfully checked out; Merged = cart was merged with another; Expired = cart aged out per retention policy; Saved = shopper explicitly saved for later.

attributes.name: cart_type
attributes.description: Classification of cart purpose. Standard = regular shopping cart; Wishlist = saved items for future purchase; Registry = gift registry or wedding registry; Subscription = recurring order cart.

attributes.name: channel_source
attributes.description: Marketing channel or traffic source that brought the customer to the cart. Used for Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) and channel attribution analysis.

attributes.name: converted_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the cart was successfully converted to a sales order. Marks the completion of the purchase journey.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the cart was first created. Marks the beginning of the shopping session.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary values in this cart. Determined by the digital storefront locale.

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: Type of device used to create and interact with the cart. Used for device-specific analytics and responsive design optimization.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount applied to the cart from all promotions, coupon codes, and markdowns. Reduces the subtotal.

attributes.name: expiration_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the cart will expire and be purged from the system per data retention policy. Typically 30-90 days from last modification.

attributes.name: gift_message
attributes.description: Optional gift message text entered by the customer for gift orders. Printed on packing slip or gift card.

attributes.name: gift_wrap_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has requested gift wrapping for items in this cart. May incur additional charges.

attributes.name: guest_checkout_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cart belongs to a guest (non-authenticated) shopper. Guest carts have limited personalization and no saved payment methods.

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: IP address of the device used to create the cart. Used for fraud detection and geographic analytics. May be considered PII under GDPR.

attributes.name: item_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct line items (SKUs) in the cart. Does not account for quantity per line.

attributes.name: locale_code
attributes.description: Locale code (language and region) for the cart, determining language, currency, and regional preferences. Format: language_REGION (e.g., en_US, fr_FR, de_DE).

attributes.name: loyalty_points_applied
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points the customer has elected to redeem against this cart. Converted to discount amount based on points-to-currency ratio.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the cart (item added, removed, quantity changed, or promotion applied). Used to calculate cart abandonment time windows.

attributes.name: personalization_segment
attributes.description: Customer segment code used for personalized pricing, product recommendations, and targeted promotions. Driven by Adobe Experience Platform or similar CDP.

attributes.name: shipping_amount
attributes.description: Estimated shipping cost for the cart. Final shipping cost is determined at checkout based on selected shipping method and destination.

attributes.name: shipping_method_code
attributes.description: Code representing the selected or estimated shipping method (e.g., standard, express, overnight). Used to calculate shipping cost and delivery estimate.

attributes.name: subtotal_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all line item subtotals before discounts, taxes, and shipping. Represents the gross merchandise value in the cart.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Estimated sales tax or VAT amount for the cart. Final tax is calculated at checkout based on shipping address.

attributes.name: total_amount
attributes.description: Total cart value including subtotal, discounts, estimated tax, and estimated shipping. Represents the expected order total if the cart is converted.

attributes.name: unit_count
attributes.description: Total quantity of all units across all line items in the cart. Sum of all line item quantities.

attributes.name: user_agent
attributes.description: Browser user agent string capturing browser type, version, and operating system. Used for compatibility testing and device analytics.

products.name: digital_order
products.description: Master record for orders placed through the DTC e-commerce channel. Captures order number, placement timestamp, storefront, channel (web, mobile app, PWA), order status, subtotal, discount total, shipping cost, tax amount, grand total, currency, AOV contribution, payment status, fulfillment status, and customer-facing order confirmation details. This entity is the SSOT for DTC digital order capture within the ecommerce domain — it owns the moment of purchase and initial order state. The order domain owns the downstream enterprise-wide order lifecycle (allocation, fulfillment routing, shipment tracking, delivery confirmation) once the order enters the OMS.

products.name: ab_test
products.description: Master record for A/B and multivariate tests run on the digital storefront, covering the full test lifecycle from hypothesis through outcome. Captures test name, hypothesis, type (layout, copy, pricing, CTA, recommendation), start/end dates, traffic split, control/treatment variants, success metric, significance threshold, status, and per-variant results (impressions, conversions, CVR, AOV, revenue per visitor, confidence level, lift, winner flag). Supports continuous site optimization and evidence-based rollout decisions.

attributes.name: ab_test_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the A/B or multivariate test. Primary key for the ab_test data product.

attributes.name: concept_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to design.concept. Business justification: E-commerce teams A/B test concept-driven merchandising strategies (concept-based landing pages, thematic product groupings). Test results inform which design concepts resonate with digital customers,

attributes.name: digital_storefront_id
attributes.description: Reference to the digital storefront where this test is executed. Links to the digital_storefront product.

attributes.name: owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: A/B tests are owned by product managers, merchandisers, or UX designers for experimentation programs. Links enable performance tracking, workload management, and accountability for test design/analysi

attributes.name: additional_variants_count
attributes.description: Number of additional treatment variants beyond the primary treatment. Zero for simple A/B tests, one or more for A/B/n or multivariate tests. Detailed variant data stored in related variant detail table.

attributes.name: confidence_level_percent
attributes.description: Statistical confidence level achieved by the test results, typically 95.00 or 99.00. Represents the probability that the observed difference is not due to random chance. Calculated from p-value: confidence = (1 - p_value) * 100.

attributes.name: control_aov
attributes.description: Average Order Value (AOV) for orders from the control variant, calculated as total revenue divided by number of orders. Measured in the storefronts default currency.

attributes.name: control_conversion_rate_percent
attributes.description: Conversion rate for the control variant, calculated as (control_conversions / control_impressions) * 100. Baseline performance metric against which treatment variants are compared.

attributes.name: control_conversions
attributes.description: Total number of conversions (successful outcomes per primary success metric) from the control variant. For conversion rate tests, this is completed purchases; for CTR tests, this is clicks.

attributes.name: control_impressions
attributes.description: Total number of unique visitors or sessions exposed to the control variant during the test period. Used as denominator in conversion rate calculations.

attributes.name: control_revenue_per_visitor
attributes.description: Revenue per visitor for the control variant, calculated as total revenue divided by impressions. Combines conversion rate and order value into a single metric. Measured in the storefronts default currency.

attributes.name: control_traffic_split_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of test traffic allocated to the control variant. In a 50/50 A/B test this would be 50.00. In multivariate tests may be lower to accommodate multiple treatment variants.

attributes.name: control_variant_name
attributes.description: Name of the control variant (baseline experience). Typically 'Control' or 'Original'. This is the existing experience against which treatment variants are compared.
attributes.references: Experimentation Best Practices - Control Group Definition

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this test record was first created in the system. Follows ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for audit trail and record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date when the test concluded or is scheduled to conclude. Null for tests still running. Used to calculate test duration and determine when results are final.

attributes.name: hypothesis
attributes.description: The business hypothesis being tested, describing the expected outcome and rationale. Example: 'Changing the CTA button color from blue to orange will increase click-through rate by 15% because it creates stronger visual contrast.'

attributes.name: lift_percent
attributes.description: Percentage improvement (or decline if negative) of the treatment variant over the control for the primary success metric. Calculated as ((treatment_metric - control_metric) / control_metric) * 100. Example: 15.50 means the treatment performed 15.5% better than control.

attributes.name: minimum_detectable_effect_percent
attributes.description: The smallest percentage improvement in the primary metric that the test is designed to detect with statistical confidence. Used in sample size calculation. Example: 5.00 means the test can reliably detect a 5% or greater improvement.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this test record was last modified. Follows ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Updated whenever test configuration or results are changed. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, observations, learnings, or special considerations about the test. May include information about external factors (seasonality, promotions, site issues) that affected results.

attributes.name: p_value
attributes.description: The probability that the observed difference between variants occurred by random chance. Lower values indicate stronger evidence of a real effect. Values below the significance threshold (typically 0.05) indicate statistical significance.

attributes.name: planned_duration_days
attributes.description: Planned duration of the test in days, determined during test design based on required sample size and traffic volume to achieve statistical significance.
attributes.references: Experimentation Best Practices - Statistical Power Analysis

attributes.name: primary_success_metric
attributes.description: The primary Key Performance Indicator (KPI) used to determine test success. Conversion rate (CVR): percentage of visitors who complete purchase, AOV: Average Order Value, revenue per visitor (RPV): total revenue divided by visitors, click-through rate (CTR): clicks divided by impressions, add-to-cart rate: products added to cart divided by product views, bounce rate: single-page sessions, time on page: average session duration on tested page. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: conversion_rate|aov|revenue_per_visitor|click_through_rate|add_to_cart_rate|bounce_rate|time_on_page — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud - Analytics & KPI Framework

attributes.name: rollout_date
attributes.description: Date when the winning variant was or will be rolled out to production for all users. Null if no rollout planned or decision pending.

attributes.name: rollout_decision
attributes.description: Business decision on how to implement test results. Full rollout: deploy winning variant to 100% of traffic, Partial rollout: deploy to subset of traffic or segments, No rollout: keep original experience, Pending: decision not yet made, Rollback: reverse a previous rollout.

attributes.name: secondary_success_metrics
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of additional metrics monitored to understand broader test impact. Examples: engagement rate, return rate, customer satisfaction score. Used to detect unintended consequences.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud - Analytics & KPI Framework

attributes.name: significance_threshold
attributes.description: The p-value threshold required to declare a statistically significant result, typically 0.0500 (95% confidence) or 0.0100 (99% confidence). Lower values require stronger evidence but reduce false positive risk.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date when the test began running and traffic allocation started. Used to calculate test duration and align with business calendar events.

attributes.name: test_category
attributes.description: Category of the test element being optimized: layout (page structure), copy (messaging/text), pricing (price display/strategy), cta (call-to-action buttons), recommendation (product suggestions), navigation (site navigation), checkout (purchase flow), personalization (targeted content). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: layout|copy|pricing|cta|recommendation|navigation|checkout|personalization — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud - A/B Test Management

attributes.name: test_code
attributes.description: Business-friendly unique code for the test, used for tracking and reporting purposes. Typically follows a naming convention like EXP_HOMEPAGE_CTA_Q1.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud - A/B Test Management

attributes.name: test_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the A/B test describing the experiment focus, such as 'Homepage Hero Banner CTA Optimization' or 'Product Detail Page Layout Test'.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud - A/B Test Management

attributes.name: test_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the test. Draft: being designed, Scheduled: approved and awaiting start, Running: actively collecting data, Paused: temporarily stopped, Completed: finished with results, Cancelled: terminated early, Archived: historical record. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|scheduled|running|paused|completed|cancelled|archived — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud - A/B Test Management

attributes.name: test_type
attributes.description: Type of experiment being conducted. A/B tests compare two variants, multivariate tests multiple variables simultaneously, split_url tests different page URLs, redirect tests send traffic to entirely different pages.

attributes.name: traffic_allocation_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of total site traffic allocated to this test. Remaining traffic sees the default experience. Typical values range from 10% to 100% depending on risk tolerance and traffic volume.

attributes.name: treatment_aov
attributes.description: Average Order Value (AOV) for orders from the primary treatment variant, calculated as total revenue divided by number of orders. Measured in the storefronts default currency.

attributes.name: treatment_conversion_rate_percent
attributes.description: Conversion rate for the primary treatment variant, calculated as (treatment_conversions / treatment_impressions) * 100. Compared against control to determine test outcome.

attributes.name: treatment_conversions
attributes.description: Total number of conversions (successful outcomes per primary success metric) from the primary treatment variant. For conversion rate tests, this is completed purchases; for CTR tests, this is clicks.

attributes.name: treatment_impressions
attributes.description: Total number of unique visitors or sessions exposed to the primary treatment variant during the test period. Used as denominator in conversion rate calculations.

attributes.name: treatment_revenue_per_visitor
attributes.description: Revenue per visitor for the primary treatment variant, calculated as total revenue divided by impressions. Combines conversion rate and order value into a single metric. Measured in the storefronts default currency.

attributes.name: treatment_traffic_split_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of test traffic allocated to the primary treatment variant. In a 50/50 A/B test this would be 50.00. Sum of all variant splits must equal 100.

attributes.name: treatment_variant_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary treatment variant (new experience being tested). Examples: 'Variant A', 'Orange CTA', 'New Layout'. For multivariate tests, this may represent the first treatment; additional variants tracked separately.
attributes.references: Experimentation Best Practices - Treatment Group Definition

attributes.name: winner_variant
attributes.description: Declared winner of the test based on statistical analysis. Control: original experience wins, Treatment: new experience wins, Inconclusive: no statistically significant difference, Ongoing: test still running or analysis incomplete.

products.name: storefront_carrier_service
products.description: This association product represents the service configuration between digital storefronts and carriers. It captures the operational relationship where each storefront offers specific carrier services to customers at checkout, with distinct service levels, rates, SLAs, and availability settings per storefront-carrier combination. Each record links one digital storefront to one carrier with attributes that define how that carrier service is presented and managed within that specific storefront context.. Existence Justification: In apparel fashion e-commerce operations, digital storefronts offer multiple carrier service options to customers at checkout (FedEx Express, UPS Ground, USPS Priority, regional carriers, etc.), and each carrier serves multiple storefronts across different brands, regions, and markets. The business actively manages storefront-carrier service configurations as operational entities, setting service levels, priority rankings, rate cards, SLAs, and availability flags per storefront-carrier pair. This is not a derived analytical relationship but an operational configuration that ecommerce teams create, update, and disable as part of checkout experience management and carrier performance optimization.

products.name: storefront_fulfillment_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the fulfillment assignment between digital storefronts and distribution centers in the omnichannel apparel network. It captures the operational routing rules that determine which DCs can fulfill orders from which storefronts, including priority sequencing, inventory allocation percentages, shipping cutoff times, and effective date ranges. Each record links one digital storefront to one distribution center with attributes that govern order routing, ATP calculation, and fulfillment orchestration across the logistics network.. Existence Justification: In apparel omnichannel operations, digital storefronts fulfill orders from multiple distribution centers to provide inventory breadth, geographic coverage, and redundancy, while each distribution center serves multiple storefronts across different brands, regions, and channels. The business actively manages these fulfillment assignments as operational configuration, setting priority sequences, allocation percentages, cutoff times, and effective date ranges for each storefront-DC pairing to optimize order routing, ATP calculation, and delivery promises.

products.name: storefront_factory_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the allocation contract between digital storefronts and manufacturing factories. It captures the business rules governing which factories can fulfill orders from which storefronts, including priority sequencing, capacity allocation percentages, and lead time commitments. Each record links one digital storefront to one factory with attributes that exist only in the context of this sourcing relationship, enabling order routing logic, production planning, and multi-brand factory allocation strategies.. Existence Justification: In apparel fashion multi-brand retail operations, digital storefronts (regional sites, brand-specific sites, outlet microsites) source production from multiple factories based on capacity, capability, and geographic optimization, while factories simultaneously produce for multiple storefronts across different brands and regions. The business actively manages storefront-factory allocation rules as a sourcing strategy, setting priority sequences for order routing, allocating factory capacity percentages across storefronts, and negotiating storefront-specific lead times. This is an operational relationship managed by production planning and sourcing teams, not an analytical correlation.

products.name: shipment
products.description: Core master record for every inbound and outbound shipment movement in the apparel supply chain. Captures shipment type (FOB, LDP, DTC, wholesale, inter-facility transfer), origin and destination facilities, carrier assignment, transport mode (ocean FCL/LCL, air, ground, courier, rail), booking reference, ETD/ETA and actual departure/arrival timestamps, carton count, gross weight, cubic volume, freight cost estimate, insurance value, current milestone status, and priority flag. Serves as the SSOT for shipment identity across the logistics domain, linking to purchase orders, sales orders, 3PL partners, customs entries, and freight bookings. Supports both pre-retail (factory-to-DC) and post-retail (DC-to-store, DC-to-consumer) movements.
