attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.routing_guide. Business justification: Freight bookings should follow approved routing guide rules for carrier selection and lane assignment. N:1 relationship (many bookings follow one routing guide). Enables compliance tracking and rate v

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shipment that this booking covers. Links to the shipment master record for tracking goods movement.

attributes.name: sourcing_purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sourcing.sourcing_purchase_order. Business justification: Freight bookings for inbound shipments are created based on sourcing PO ship windows, ex-factory dates, and delivery requirements to ensure on-time arrival for apparel seasonal launches.

attributes.name: third_party_logistics_id
attributes.description: Reference to the 3PL provider managing the freight booking and logistics coordination. Links to the 3PL partner master data.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customs broker responsible for clearing the shipment through customs at the destination. Links to the customs broker master data.

attributes.name: booking_date
attributes.description: Date when the freight booking was formally placed with the carrier or freight forwarder. Represents the principal business event timestamp for this transaction.

attributes.name: booking_notes
attributes.description: Additional notes or comments related to the freight booking. Captures operational details, exceptions, or coordination information.

attributes.name: booking_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique booking reference number assigned by the carrier or freight forwarder. Used for tracking and communication with logistics partners.
attributes.references: International Air Transport Association (IATA) Cargo Standards, International Maritime Organization (IMO) Standards

attributes.name: booking_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the freight booking. Tracks progression from draft through confirmation, execution, and completion or cancellation.

attributes.name: collection_season_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the apparel collection season (e.g., Spring/Summer 2024, Fall/Winter 2024) that this freight booking supports. Critical for seasonal collection launch planning.

attributes.name: confirmed_space_allocation
attributes.description: Confirmed cargo space allocated by the carrier for this booking, measured in cubic meters (CBM) or container equivalent units (TEU). Supports capacity planning.
attributes.references: International Organization for Standardization (ISO) Container Standards

attributes.name: container_quantity
attributes.description: Number of containers booked for this freight booking. Applicable for FCL (Full Container Load) shipments.

attributes.name: container_type
attributes.description: Type of shipping container used for the booking. Includes standard dry containers, high-cube, refrigerated (reefer), and specialized containers. Applicable for ocean freight FCL bookings.
attributes.references: International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 6346 Container Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this freight booking record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: cut_off_date
attributes.description: Final date and time by which cargo must be delivered to the carrier or terminal to meet the scheduled departure. Critical for operational planning.
attributes.references: International Maritime Organization (IMO) Standards, IATA Cargo Standards

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the destination country where the shipment will be delivered. Three-letter uppercase code.

attributes.name: estimated_arrival_date
attributes.description: Estimated date when the carrier is scheduled to arrive at the port of discharge or destination terminal.

attributes.name: estimated_departure_date
attributes.description: Estimated date when the carrier is scheduled to depart from the port of loading or origin terminal.

attributes.name: freight_charge_amount
attributes.description: Total freight charge amount for this booking as per the rate agreement. Excludes surcharges, duties, and taxes.
attributes.references: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS), Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP)

attributes.name: freight_charge_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the freight charge amount. Indicates the currency in which the freight charge is denominated.

attributes.name: gsp_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Generalized System of Preferences (GSP) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the shipment is eligible for GSP duty-free treatment. True if eligible, False otherwise. Supports duty optimization.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) GSP Standards, U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP)

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the shipment contains hazardous materials requiring special handling and documentation. True if hazardous, False otherwise.
attributes.references: International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG) Code, IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations

attributes.name: incoterm_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) code defining the responsibilities, costs, and risks between buyer and seller for this shipment. Examples: FOB (Free on Board), CIF (Cost Insurance and Freight), DDP (Delivered Duty Paid). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: insurance_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether cargo insurance is required for this booking. True if insurance is required, False otherwise.

attributes.name: insurance_value_amount
attributes.description: Declared value of the cargo for insurance purposes. Used to calculate insurance premiums and coverage limits.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this freight booking record was last updated. Audit trail for record modifications.

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the country of origin where the shipment originates. Three-letter uppercase code.

attributes.name: port_of_discharge_code
attributes.description: UN/LOCODE for the port or terminal where goods are unloaded from the carrier. Five-character alphanumeric code.
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE (United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations)

attributes.name: port_of_loading_code
attributes.description: UN/LOCODE (United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations) for the port or terminal where goods are loaded onto the carrier. Five-character alphanumeric code.
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE (United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations)

attributes.name: rate_agreement_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the negotiated rate agreement or contract with the carrier that governs pricing for this booking. Links to carrier contract master data.

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Type of freight service booked. FCL (Full Container Load), LCL (Less than Container Load), air charter, express courier, ocean freight, road freight, rail freight, or courier service. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FCL|LCL|AIR_CHARTER|AIR_EXPRESS|OCEAN_FREIGHT|ROAD_FREIGHT|RAIL_FREIGHT|COURIER — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: International Chamber of Commerce (ICC) Incoterms, IATA Cargo Standards

attributes.name: space_allocation_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the confirmed space allocation. CBM (Cubic Meters), TEU (Twenty-foot Equivalent Unit), FEU (Forty-foot Equivalent Unit), KG (Kilograms), or LBS (Pounds).
attributes.references: International Organization for Standardization (ISO) Measurement Standards

attributes.name: special_handling_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing any special handling requirements for the shipment, such as temperature control, fragile handling, hazardous materials, or priority processing.
attributes.references: International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG) Code, IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations

attributes.name: vessel_name
attributes.description: Name of the vessel (for ocean freight) or flight number (for air freight) assigned to transport the shipment. Null for road or rail freight.
attributes.references: International Maritime Organization (IMO) Ship Identification, IATA Flight Standards

attributes.name: voyage_number
attributes.description: Voyage number for ocean freight or flight number for air freight. Identifies the specific journey leg for the shipment.
attributes.references: International Maritime Organization (IMO) Standards, IATA Cargo Standards

products.name: customs_entry
products.description: Manages customs clearance declarations for apparel and footwear imports and exports. Stores entry type (formal, informal, in-bond), entry number, filing date, port of entry, importer of record, customs broker, declared value, duty amount, applicable trade program (GSP, FTA), HS code references, country of origin, and clearance status. Tracks holds, exams, and release dates. Manages associated trade compliance documents including certificates of origin, commercial invoices, and ISF (10+2) filings as structured attributes. Critical for FTC labeling compliance and trade compliance reporting across all sourcing countries.
products.reference: Customs Entry / Import Declaration — CBP ACE / SAP GTS

attributes.name: customs_entry_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the customs entry declaration record.

attributes.name: bill_of_lading_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.bill_of_lading. Business justification: Customs entries reference the bill of lading for the arriving cargo. N:1 relationship (multiple customs entry line items can reference one BOL). Normalizes bill_of_lading_number string to FK.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.carrier. Business justification: Customs entry records the carrier that transported the goods. Currently stored as carrier_code string; normalize to FK for referential integrity and to enable carrier performance analysis by customs c

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Import duties are allocated to requesting departments for cost accountability. Cost center managers need visibility into duty costs for their purchase orders to manage budgets and explain variances.

attributes.name: customs_broker_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Customs broker/specialist who filed entry must be tracked for regulatory compliance, CBP audits, and performance metrics. Required for trade compliance reporting and broker certification tracking in a

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Duty payments post to specific GL accounts for financial reporting. Month-end close requires customs duty accrual and payment posting to correct GL accounts for balance sheet and P&L accuracy.

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.logistics_shipment. Business justification: Customs entries are filed for specific shipments arriving at port. N:1 relationship (multiple customs entries can relate to one consolidated shipment). Normalizes bill_of_lading_number which can be re

attributes.name: sourcing_purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sourcing.sourcing_purchase_order. Business justification: Customs entries must reference sourcing PO for duty calculation, landed cost allocation, compliance documentation, and reconciling declared values with PO terms in apparel import operations.

attributes.name: supplier_factory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.supplier_factory. Business justification: Customs entries require supplier factory-of-origin for certificate-of-origin validation, GSP eligibility verification, factory-specific duty rates, and compliance with country-of-origin marking requir

attributes.name: third_party_logistics_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.third_party_logistics. Business justification: Customs entries are filed by customs brokers, which are a type of 3PL service provider. N:1 relationship. Normalizes customs_broker_name and customs_broker_license_number to FK. The third_party_logist

attributes.name: trade_compliance_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.trade_compliance_record. Business justification: Every customs entry filing must reference the trade compliance classification that determined the declared HS code, duty rate, and origin. Core customs clearance workflow ensuring duty calculations ma

attributes.name: arrival_date
attributes.description: Date when the vessel or aircraft arrived at the U.S. port. Establishes the timeline for entry filing and duty payment deadlines.

attributes.name: bond_amount_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Customs Bond Amount United States Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: Face value of the customs bond in U.S. dollars. For single transaction bonds, typically 2-3 times the estimated duties. For continuous bonds, minimum $50,000 or 10% of duties paid in prior year, whichever is greater.

attributes.name: bond_type
attributes.description: Type of customs bond securing the entry. Single: covers one transaction; Continuous: covers all transactions for one year (minimum $50,000); None: no bond required (e.g., informal entries under $2,500). Bonds guarantee payment of duties and compliance with regulations.

attributes.name: certificate_of_origin_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the certificate of origin document supporting the claimed country of origin and trade preference eligibility. Required for many FTA and GSP claims. Format varies by issuing authority.

attributes.name: clearance_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the customs entry. Filed: submitted to CBP; Accepted: entry accepted for processing; Hold: flagged for review; Exam: selected for physical or documentary examination; Released: goods authorized for delivery; Liquidated: final duty determination made; Cancelled: entry voided. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: filed|accepted|hold|exam|released|liquidated|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: commercial_invoice_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the commercial invoice from the foreign seller. Primary document supporting the declared value and description of goods. Required for all formal entries.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code identifying where the goods were manufactured, produced, or grown. Determines applicable duty rates and eligibility for trade preference programs. Critical for FTC country-of-origin labeling compliance for apparel.
attributes.references: 19 CFR Part 134 - Country of Origin Marking, ISO 3166-1, FTC Textile and Wool Acts

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this customs entry record was first created in the system. Represents initial data capture, not the customs filing date.

attributes.name: declared_value_usd
attributes.description: Total declared customs value of the imported goods in U.S. dollars. Represents the transaction value (price paid or payable) adjusted for international freight, insurance, and other costs as required by customs valuation rules. Basis for duty calculation.

attributes.name: duty_amount_usd
attributes.description: Total customs duty assessed on the entry in U.S. dollars. Calculated by applying the applicable tariff rate to the dutiable value. May be reduced or eliminated under trade preference programs.

attributes.name: entry_filing_date
attributes.description: Date when the customs entry was officially filed with the customs authority. Critical for calculating duty payment deadlines and compliance with entry filing timelines.

attributes.name: entry_number
attributes.description: Official customs entry number assigned by customs authority. Format: XXX-NNNNNNN-N (port code, sequential number, check digit). Required for all formal entries and used as the primary reference for customs clearance tracking and audit.
attributes.references: U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) Entry Filing Requirements

attributes.name: entry_summary_date
attributes.description: Date when the entry summary (CBP Form 7501) was filed with CBP. Must be filed within 10 working days of entry release. Contains final classification, valuation, and duty calculation.

attributes.name: entry_type
attributes.description: Classification of customs entry based on value threshold and processing requirements. Formal entries required for shipments over $2,500 USD; informal for lower values; in-bond for goods in transit; warehouse for deferred duty payment; FTZ (Free Trade Zone) for goods entering foreign trade zones.

attributes.name: exam_type
attributes.description: Type of physical or documentary examination conducted by CBP or Partner Government Agency. Intensive: full container exam; Tailored: targeted inspection; Compliance: verification of entry accuracy; PGA: inspection by FDA, USDA, or other agency; None: no exam required.

attributes.name: ftz_admission_number
attributes.description: Admission number assigned when goods are admitted into a Foreign Trade Zone. Allows duty deferral or elimination. Null if goods did not enter an FTZ.

attributes.name: harbor_maintenance_fee_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Harbor Maintenance Fee (HMF) United States Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: Fee assessed at 0.125% of cargo value for commercial cargo shipped through identified U.S. ports. Used to fund harbor maintenance and dredging. Not applicable to air shipments.

attributes.name: hold_reason_code
attributes.description: CBP-assigned code indicating the reason for entry hold or exam. Examples: 01 (intensive exam), 02 (tailored exam), 03 (compliance measurement), PGA (Partner Government Agency hold). Null if no hold.
attributes.references: CBP Automated Commercial Environment (ACE) Hold Codes

attributes.name: importer_of_record_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the entity responsible for ensuring imported goods comply with all laws and regulations and for paying duties, taxes, and fees. The IOR is legally liable for the accuracy of the customs declaration.

attributes.name: importer_of_record_number
attributes.description: IRS-assigned Employer Identification Number (EIN) or CBP-assigned importer number used to identify the importer of record. Format: XX-NNNNNNN.

attributes.name: isf_filing_number
attributes.description: Reference number for the ISF (10+2) filing submitted to CBP at least 24 hours before ocean cargo is loaded at foreign port. Required for all ocean shipments to the U.S. Links security data to the entry.

attributes.name: line_item_count
attributes.description: Total number of line items (distinct HS code classifications) on this customs entry. Each line represents a different product classification with its own duty rate and origin.

attributes.name: liquidation_date
attributes.description: Date when CBP made the final determination of duties, taxes, and fees owed. Liquidation typically occurs within 314 days of entry but may be extended. After liquidation, the entry is considered final unless protested.

attributes.name: merchandise_processing_fee_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Merchandise Processing Fee (MPF) United States Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: CBP-assessed fee for processing formal entries. Calculated as 0.3464% of entered value with minimum $27.75 and maximum $538.40 per entry (rates subject to periodic adjustment). Informal entries have fixed MPF rates.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this customs entry record was last updated. Tracks changes to entry status, liquidation, or other attributes throughout the entry lifecycle.

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which estimated duties, taxes, and fees must be paid to CBP. Typically 10 working days after entry release for non-periodic monthly statement filers. Late payment incurs interest charges.
attributes.references: 19 CFR 24.1 - Payment of Duties and Fees

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method used to pay customs duties and fees. ACH (Automated Clearing House): electronic funds transfer; Check: paper check; Statement: periodic monthly statement for approved importers; Bond: continuous customs bond for deferred payment; Other: alternative payment arrangements.

attributes.name: port_of_entry_code
attributes.description: Four-digit Schedule D port code identifying the U.S. port where goods are entered for customs clearance. Examples: 2704 (Los Angeles/Long Beach), 4601 (New York/Newark), 5301 (Miami).

attributes.name: port_of_unlading_code
attributes.description: Four-digit Schedule D port code identifying where goods were physically unloaded from the arriving vessel or aircraft. May differ from port of entry for in-bond shipments.

attributes.name: protest_filed_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal protest has been filed challenging CBP's liquidation decision. Protests must be filed within 180 days of liquidation. True if protest filed; False if no protest.

attributes.name: reconciliation_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this entry is filed under CBP's reconciliation program, which allows importers to file entries with estimated data and reconcile with final data within 15 months. True if reconciliation entry; False if standard entry.

attributes.name: release_date
attributes.description: Date when CBP authorized release of the goods from customs custody, allowing delivery to the importer. Critical for calculating dwell time and measuring OTIF (On Time In Full) performance against carrier and 3PL (Third-Party Logistics) SLAs (Service Level Agreements).

attributes.name: surety_code
attributes.description: Three-digit code identifying the surety company that issued the customs bond. Surety must be on the Treasury Department's list of approved sureties.

attributes.name: total_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of goods covered by this entry, summed across all line items. Unit of measure varies by commodity (pieces, dozens, kilograms, square meters, etc.).

attributes.name: total_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total gross weight of the shipment in kilograms, including packaging. Used for freight calculation and certain duty assessments. Required for all entries.

attributes.name: trade_program_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the trade preference program under which duty reduction or elimination is claimed. GSP (Generalized System of Preferences), USMCA (United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement), FTA (Free Trade Agreement), AGOA (African Growth and Opportunity Act), CBI (Caribbean Basin Initiative), ATPA (Andean Trade Preference Act), NONE (no preference claimed). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: GSP|USMCA|FTA|AGOA|CBI|ATPA|NONE — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Primary mode of transportation used to bring goods into the U.S. Ocean: vessel; Air: aircraft; Truck: highway; Rail: railroad; Courier: express consignment. Affects processing requirements and fee calculations.

attributes.name: voyage_flight_number
attributes.description: Vessel voyage number or aircraft flight number on which the goods arrived. Links the entry to the specific conveyance manifest filed by the carrier.

products.name: hs_code
products.description: Reference master for Harmonized System (HS) tariff classification codes applicable to apparel, footwear, and accessories. Stores HS code, chapter, heading, subheading, full description, applicable duty rate, preferential duty rates by trade agreement, restricted/prohibited flag, CPSC safety classification, FTC fiber content labeling requirement flag, and effective date range. Enables accurate duty calculation, GSP utilization, and customs entry filing across all import/export lanes.
products.reference: HS Code — World Customs Organization / HTS Schedule

attributes.name: hs_code_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the HS code record. Primary key.

attributes.name: labeling_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.labeling_requirement. Business justification: HS codes trigger specific FTC labeling requirements by product category (textile, wool, fur) and jurisdiction. Customs clearance and retail compliance verification require matching HS classification t

attributes.name: antidumping_duty_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this HS code is subject to antidumping duties for imports from specific countries due to unfair pricing practices.
attributes.references: US International Trade Commission (USITC) Antidumping Orders

attributes.name: chapter
attributes.description: The two-digit chapter number of the HS code representing the broad product category (e.g., Chapter 61 for knitted apparel, Chapter 62 for woven apparel, Chapter 64 for footwear).

attributes.name: countervailing_duty_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this HS code is subject to countervailing duties for imports from specific countries due to foreign government subsidies.
attributes.references: US International Trade Commission (USITC) Countervailing Duty Orders

attributes.name: cpsc_regulated_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) Regulated Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether products under this HS code are subject to CPSC safety standards and testing requirements (e.g., flammability standards for children's sleepwear, lead content limits).
attributes.references: Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) Regulations 16 CFR

attributes.name: cpsc_regulation_reference
attributes.description: Specific CPSC regulation citation applicable to this HS code (e.g., 16 CFR 1610 for flammability, 16 CFR 1501 for small parts). Null if not CPSC regulated.
attributes.references: Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) Code of Federal Regulations

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this HS code record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: duty_rate_unit
attributes.description: Indicates whether the duty rate is ad valorem (percentage of value), specific (per unit/weight), or compound (combination of both).

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this HS code classification and associated duty rates become effective. Critical for time-based duty calculations and compliance.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) HS Amendment Cycles

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: The date until which this HS code classification and duty rates remain valid. Null for currently active codes. Used to manage HS code changes during WCO amendment cycles.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) HS Amendment Cycles

attributes.name: environmental_certification_required
attributes.description: Environmental or sustainability certifications required or recommended for products under this HS code (e.g., OEKO-TEX Standard 100, GOTS, BCI). Null if no specific requirements.
attributes.references: OEKO-TEX Standard 100, Global Organic Textile Standard (GOTS), Better Cotton Initiative (BCI)

attributes.name: ftc_labeling_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Trade Commission (FTC) Labeling Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether products under this HS code require FTC-mandated fiber content labeling, country of origin marking, or care labeling per Textile and Wool Acts.
attributes.references: Federal Trade Commission (FTC) Textile and Wool Acts 16 CFR Part 303

attributes.name: ftc_labeling_requirement
attributes.description: Specific FTC labeling requirements for this HS code including fiber content disclosure, country of origin, manufacturer identification, and care instructions. Null if not required.
attributes.references: Federal Trade Commission (FTC) 16 CFR Part 303 and Part 300

attributes.name: general_duty_rate
attributes.description: The standard Most Favored Nation (MFN) duty rate expressed as a percentage or specific rate applicable to imports from countries without preferential trade agreements. Used for Landed Duty Paid (LDP) calculations.

attributes.name: gsp_beneficiary_countries
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3-letter country codes eligible for GSP treatment for this HS code. Null if GSP not applicable.
attributes.references: Generalized System of Preferences (GSP) Country List

attributes.name: gsp_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Generalized System of Preferences (GSP) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this HS code is eligible for duty-free treatment under the US Generalized System of Preferences program when imported from designated beneficiary developing countries.
attributes.references: Generalized System of Preferences (GSP) - US Trade Representative

attributes.name: heading
attributes.description: The four-digit heading number providing a more specific product classification within the chapter (e.g., 6109 for T-shirts, singlets, and other vests).

attributes.name: hs_code
attributes.description: The full Harmonized System tariff classification code (6 to 10 digits) used for international trade classification of apparel, footwear, and accessories. This code determines duty rates, trade statistics, and regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) Harmonized System Convention

attributes.name: hs_code_description
attributes.description: Full official description of the product classification including material composition, construction method, and intended use as defined by the Harmonized System nomenclature.

attributes.name: hs_code_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this HS code. Active codes are used for current classifications. Deprecated codes have been replaced by new codes in HS updates. Superseded codes reference the replacement code. Pending codes are scheduled for future activation.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) HS Amendment Procedures

attributes.name: hs_version
attributes.description: The version year of the Harmonized System nomenclature (e.g., HS2017, HS2022) under which this code is classified. WCO updates the HS every 5 years.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) HS Nomenclature Versions

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this HS code record was last modified. Updated whenever duty rates, descriptions, or regulatory flags change. Critical for maintaining accurate duty calculations.

attributes.name: national_extension
attributes.description: Additional digits beyond the 6-digit subheading added by individual countries for more granular classification (e.g., US uses 10-digit HTS codes). May be null for base 6-digit codes.
attributes.references: US International Trade Commission (USITC) Harmonized Tariff Schedule

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, guidance, or special instructions for proper classification under this HS code including exclusions, inclusions, and edge cases. Used by customs brokers and compliance teams.
attributes.references: US Customs and Border Protection (CBP) Classification Rulings

attributes.name: origin_criteria
attributes.description: Rules of origin criteria that must be met for products under this HS code to qualify for preferential duty treatment (e.g., tariff shift rules, regional value content thresholds, substantial transformation tests).
attributes.references: US Customs and Border Protection (CBP) Rules of Origin

attributes.name: preferential_duty_rate
attributes.description: Reduced duty rate available under preferential trade agreements such as USMCA, GSP, or bilateral free trade agreements. Null if no preferential rate applies.
attributes.references: Generalized System of Preferences (GSP) - US Trade Representative

attributes.name: restricted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this HS code is subject to import or export restrictions, quotas, licensing requirements, or prohibitions by customs authorities.
attributes.references: US Customs and Border Protection (CBP) Restrictions and Prohibitions

attributes.name: restriction_type
attributes.description: Type of restriction or special requirement applicable to this HS code. Null if restricted_flag is false.
attributes.references: US International Trade Commission (USITC) Trade Remedies

attributes.name: section_301_duty_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this HS code is subject to additional Section 301 tariffs imposed on imports from specific countries (e.g., China tariffs).

attributes.name: section_301_duty_rate
attributes.description: Additional duty rate percentage imposed under Section 301 trade actions. Null if not subject to Section 301 duties.
attributes.references: US Trade Representative (USTR) Section 301 Tariff Lists

attributes.name: short_description
attributes.description: Abbreviated description of the HS code for operational use in warehouse management, shipping documents, and internal systems.

attributes.name: subheading
attributes.description: The six-digit subheading providing internationally standardized product classification. This is the minimum level required for international trade.

attributes.name: superseded_by_hs_code
attributes.description: The new HS code that replaces this code when status is superseded. Used to maintain continuity during HS version transitions. Null for active codes.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) HS Correlation Tables

attributes.name: textile_category
attributes.description: Textile category classification used for quota administration and trade monitoring (historically used for Multi-Fiber Arrangement, still relevant for certain trade agreements).
attributes.references: US Customs and Border Protection (CBP) Textile Category System

attributes.name: trade_agreement
attributes.description: Name of the trade agreement or preferential program under which the preferential duty rate applies (e.g., USMCA, GSP, CAFTA-DR, EU-FTA). Null if general duty rate applies.
attributes.references: US Customs and Border Protection (CBP) Trade Agreements

attributes.name: unit_of_quantity
attributes.description: The unit of measure required for statistical reporting and quota tracking for this HS code (e.g., dozens for shirts, pairs for footwear, kilograms for fabric).
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) Statistical Reporting Requirements

products.name: duty_calculation
products.description: Transactional record of landed duty paid (LDP) calculations performed for apparel purchase orders and shipments. Captures FOB value, freight cost, insurance, CIF value, applicable HS code, duty rate applied, GSP or FTA preference claimed, anti-dumping/countervailing duty amounts, MPF, HMF, total duty and tax, calculated LDP unit cost, and calculation timestamp. Feeds COGS and financial planning in Anaplan and SAP FI/CO for accurate margin management.
products.reference: LDP Calculation / Landed Cost — SAP S/4HANA MM / Customs Broker

attributes.name: duty_calculation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the duty calculation record. Primary key for the duty calculation transaction.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Duty costs are allocated to cost centers for budgeting and variance analysis. Cost center managers track landed cost components against budget to manage total product acquisition costs by department.

attributes.name: customs_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.customs_entry. Business justification: Duty calculations are performed for specific customs entries. N:1 relationship (multiple duty calculations can exist per customs entry for different line items or recalculations). Normalizes customs_e

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Landed cost components (duty, freight, insurance) post to specific GL accounts. Month-end close requires duty calculations to post to correct GL accounts for COGS and inventory valuation accuracy.

attributes.name: hs_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.hs_code. Business justification: Duty calculations use HS codes to determine duty rates. N:1 relationship to hs_code master table. Normalizes hs_code string and duty_rate_percentage which can be retrieved from hs_code.general_duty_ra

attributes.name: order_purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order for which duty is being calculated. Links to the procurement transaction in SAP MM.

attributes.name: primary_duty_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the system user or customs specialist who performed or approved the duty calculation.

attributes.name: production_factory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.factory. Business justification: Duty calculations require factory reference to determine country of origin for tariff classification, validate trade agreement eligibility (USMCA, GSP), and allocate landed costs back to production fa

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the inbound shipment associated with this duty calculation. Links to logistics shipment tracking in Manhattan Associates WMS.

attributes.name: sourcing_purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sourcing.sourcing_purchase_order. Business justification: Duty calculations are performed per sourcing PO to determine landed costs, allocate duty to specific SKU receipts, and reconcile with PO-level FOB values in apparel costing.

attributes.name: third_party_logistics_id
attributes.description: Reference to the 3PL partner managing the logistics and customs clearance for this shipment.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the licensed customs broker who prepared and submitted the customs entry and duty calculation.

attributes.name: anti_dumping_duty_amount
attributes.description: Additional duty imposed to offset unfair pricing practices when goods are sold below fair market value. Applied on top of standard duties.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the duty calculation was approved for submission. Part of audit trail for compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: base_duty_amount
attributes.description: Standard import duty calculated by applying the duty rate percentage to the CIF value, before any trade preferences or additional duties.

attributes.name: calculation_number
attributes.description: Business-readable unique identifier for the duty calculation, used for reference in customs documentation and financial reporting. Format: DC-XXXXXXXXXX.

attributes.name: calculation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the duty calculation. Tracks progression from initial calculation through customs approval and payment reconciliation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|calculated|submitted|approved|rejected|paid|reconciled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: calculation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the duty calculation was performed. Critical for audit trail and compliance reporting. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: cif_value
attributes.description: Total customs value including FOB value, freight, and insurance. The dutiable value upon which import duties and taxes are calculated.

attributes.name: countervailing_duty_amount
attributes.description: Additional duty imposed to offset foreign government subsidies that unfairly benefit exporters. Applied on top of standard duties.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code indicating where the goods were manufactured or produced. Determines eligibility for trade preferences and duty rates.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this duty calculation record was first created in the database. Part of audit trail. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for all monetary amounts in this calculation (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). All amounts are expressed in this currency.

attributes.name: destination_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code indicating the country where goods are being imported. Determines applicable customs regulations and duty rates.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Exchange rate applied to convert foreign currency amounts to the reporting currency. Used when FOB value is in a different currency than destination.

attributes.name: excise_tax_amount
attributes.description: Special excise taxes on specific product categories (e.g., luxury goods, alcohol, tobacco). Applied based on product classification.

attributes.name: fob_value
attributes.description: The value of goods at the point of shipment, excluding freight and insurance. Base value for duty calculation before transportation costs.

attributes.name: freight_cost
attributes.description: Transportation cost from origin to destination port. Added to FOB value to calculate CIF value for duty assessment.

attributes.name: fta_claimed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether preferential duty treatment under a Free Trade Agreement was claimed. FTAs provide reduced or zero duty rates for qualifying goods.

attributes.name: fta_name
attributes.description: Name of the specific Free Trade Agreement under which preferential treatment is claimed (e.g., USMCA, CAFTA-DR, Korea FTA).

attributes.name: fta_reduction_amount
attributes.description: Duty reduction amount granted under FTA preferential treatment. Reduces the base duty amount when FTA eligibility is confirmed.

attributes.name: gsp_claimed_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Generalized System of Preferences (GSP) Claimed Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether GSP preferential duty treatment was claimed for this shipment. GSP provides duty-free treatment for eligible products from developing countries.

attributes.name: gsp_reduction_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Generalized System of Preferences (GSP) Reduction Amount
attributes.description: Duty reduction amount granted under GSP preferential treatment. Reduces the base duty amount when GSP eligibility is confirmed.

attributes.name: hmf_amount
attributes.description: U.S. fee assessed on cargo shipped through U.S. ports to fund harbor maintenance. Calculated as a percentage of cargo value.

attributes.name: insurance_cost
attributes.description: Insurance premium for goods in transit. Added to FOB and freight to calculate CIF value for customs valuation.

attributes.name: ldp_total_amount
attributes.description: Total landed cost including CIF value, all duties, taxes, and fees. Represents the complete cost to bring goods into the destination country.

attributes.name: ldp_unit_cost
attributes.description: Per-unit landed cost calculated by dividing LDP total amount by quantity. Used for COGS calculation and margin analysis in SAP FI/CO.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this duty calculation record was last updated. Tracks data lineage and change history. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: mpf_amount
attributes.description: U.S. Customs fee for processing imported merchandise. Calculated as a percentage of shipment value with minimum and maximum caps.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing special circumstances, assumptions, or clarifications related to the duty calculation. Used for audit trail.

attributes.name: other_fees_amount
attributes.description: Miscellaneous customs fees, inspection charges, or regulatory fees not captured in standard duty and tax categories.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Actual date when duty and tax payment was made to customs authority. Used for reconciliation and cash flow tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which duty and tax payment must be made to customs authority to avoid penalties. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: Official payment confirmation or transaction reference number from customs authority or payment processor.

attributes.name: port_of_entry
attributes.description: Official customs port or border crossing where goods entered the destination country. Impacts processing times and local regulations.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of units in the shipment for which duty is calculated. Used to derive per-unit landed costs.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of reconciliation between calculated duty amounts and actual amounts paid or invoiced by customs. Tracks variance resolution.

attributes.name: submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the duty calculation was submitted to customs authorities. Critical for compliance and SLA tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: total_duty_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all duty components including base duty, anti-dumping, countervailing duties, less any GSP or FTA reductions. Excludes taxes and fees.

attributes.name: total_fees_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all customs processing fees including MPF, HMF, and other regulatory fees.

attributes.name: total_tax_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all tax components including VAT, excise taxes, and other applicable import taxes.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the quantity field. Common values: EA (each), DZ (dozen), CS (case), KG (kilogram), LB (pound), M (meter), YD (yard). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|DZ|CS|KG|LB|M|YD — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: Difference between calculated duty amount and actual amount assessed by customs. Positive indicates underpayment, negative indicates overpayment.

attributes.name: variance_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for any variance between calculated and actual duty amounts. Used for process improvement and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: vat_amount
attributes.description: Import VAT or sales tax assessed on the total landed value including duties. Applicable in jurisdictions with VAT systems.

products.name: carrier
products.description: Master record for all transportation carriers engaged by the apparel business — ocean shipping lines (Maersk, MSC, CMA CGM), air freight carriers, domestic LTL/FTL truckers, last-mile couriers (FedEx, UPS, DHL), and rail operators. Stores SCAC code, DOT number, carrier name, carrier type, service modes, contract reference, preferred/approved/probation status, insurance certificate, on-time performance score, and active status. SSOT for carrier identity referenced by freight bookings, shipments, routing guides, SLAs, and freight invoices.
products.reference: Carrier Master — Manhattan Associates WMS / SAP TM

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the transportation carrier. Primary key for the carrier master record.

attributes.name: api_integration_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier provides API integration for real-time tracking, rate quotes, and booking automation (True/False).

attributes.name: carrier_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the transportation carrier or logistics service provider (e.g., Maersk Line, FedEx Corporation, United Parcel Service).

attributes.name: carrier_status
attributes.description: Current operational and business relationship status of the carrier. Preferred carriers receive priority routing; approved carriers meet minimum standards; probation indicates performance issues under review; suspended carriers are temporarily blocked; inactive carriers are no longer used.

attributes.name: carrier_type
attributes.description: Primary classification of the carrier based on transportation mode: ocean shipping line, air freight carrier, ground less-than-truckload (LTL), ground full-truckload (FTL), rail operator, last-mile courier, third-party logistics provider (3PL), or freight forwarder. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ocean|air|ground_ltl|ground_ftl|rail|courier|3pl|freight_forwarder — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: contract_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the current carrier contract or service agreement became effective.

attributes.name: contract_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the current carrier contract or service agreement expires. Null for open-ended or evergreen agreements.

attributes.name: contract_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier of the master service agreement or transportation contract governing the business relationship with this carrier.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this carrier record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for invoicing and payment transactions with this carrier (e.g., USD, EUR, CNY).

attributes.name: damage_claim_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of shipments handled by this carrier that resulted in damage claims. Lower rates indicate better handling quality.

attributes.name: dot_number
attributes.description: US Department of Transportation identification number assigned to commercial motor carriers. Required for regulatory compliance and safety tracking.

attributes.name: edi_capability_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier supports EDI for automated booking, shipment status updates, and invoicing (True/False).

attributes.name: geographic_coverage
attributes.description: Description of the geographic regions, countries, or trade lanes served by this carrier (e.g., North America, Trans-Pacific, Europe-Asia, Last-Mile USA).

attributes.name: headquarters_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the carriers headquarters street address.

attributes.name: headquarters_city
attributes.description: City where the carriers headquarters is located.

attributes.name: headquarters_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the carriers headquarters location (e.g., USA, CHN, DEU).

attributes.name: headquarters_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the carriers headquarters address.

attributes.name: headquarters_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region where the carriers headquarters is located.

attributes.name: iata_code
attributes.description: Two or three-character airline designator code assigned by IATA for air freight carriers.

attributes.name: insurance_certificate_number
attributes.description: Certificate number of the carriers cargo insurance or liability insurance policy on file. Required for risk management and compliance.

attributes.name: insurance_coverage_amount
attributes.description: Maximum liability coverage amount provided by the carriers insurance policy, typically in USD. Used to assess risk exposure for high-value shipments.

attributes.name: insurance_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the carriers current insurance certificate. Monitored to ensure continuous coverage.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier is currently active and available for new shipment bookings (True) or inactive (False).

attributes.name: last_performance_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent formal performance review or scorecard evaluation of the carrier.

attributes.name: mc_number
attributes.description: Motor Carrier operating authority number issued by FMCSA for interstate commerce in the United States.

attributes.name: on_time_performance_score
attributes.description: Percentage score (0.00 to 100.00) representing the carriers on-time delivery performance based on historical shipment data. Used for carrier selection and routing optimization.

attributes.name: onboarding_date
attributes.description: Date when the carrier was first onboarded and approved for use in the logistics network.

attributes.name: otif_score
attributes.description: Percentage score (0.00 to 100.00) representing the carriers performance in delivering shipments both on time and in full (complete quantity, undamaged). Key performance indicator for carrier evaluation.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Standard payment terms negotiated with the carrier (e.g., Net 30, Net 45, Net 60, prepaid, upon delivery). Governs accounts payable processing.

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary business contact at the carrier for operational communication, booking confirmations, and issue resolution.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary business contact or account manager at the carrier organization.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary phone number of the carrier contact for urgent operational matters and escalations.

attributes.name: scac_code
attributes.description: Unique two-to-four-letter code used to identify transportation companies in North America. Required for EDI transactions and customs documentation.

attributes.name: service_mode
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of service modes offered by the carrier (e.g., express, standard, economy, next-day, two-day, international, domestic, white-glove).

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated or trade name of the carrier used in operational systems and documentation (e.g., Maersk, FedEx, UPS, DHL).

attributes.name: sla_target_days
attributes.description: Standard number of days committed by the carrier for delivery under the service level agreement. Used for shipment planning and performance measurement.

attributes.name: sustainability_certification
attributes.description: Environmental or sustainability certifications held by the carrier (e.g., SmartWay, ISO 14001, Carbon Neutral Certified). Supports corporate sustainability reporting.

attributes.name: tax_identifier
attributes.description: Tax identification number (TIN, EIN, VAT number) of the carrier entity. Used for invoicing, tax reporting, and compliance.
attributes.references: IFRS; GAAP; Internal Tax Compliance Policy

attributes.name: tracking_url_template
attributes.description: URL template for shipment tracking on the carriers website. Placeholder tokens (e.g., {tracking_number}) are replaced with actual shipment identifiers.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this carrier record was last modified or updated.

products.name: routing_guide
products.description: Defines the approved transportation routing rules and carrier assignments for apparel shipments by lane, origin-destination pair, shipment type, and season. Captures lane origin region, destination DC or store, preferred carrier, backup carrier, service level (standard, expedite, direct), mode of transport, maximum transit days, freight terms (FOB, prepaid, collect), effective date range, and compliance requirement flag. Used by sourcing and logistics teams to enforce carrier compliance and cost controls.
products.reference: Routing Guide — Manhattan Associates WMS / Carrier Compliance

attributes.name: routing_guide_id

attributes.name: destination_facility_distribution_center_id

attributes.name: lane_id

attributes.name: primary_routing_distribution_center_id

attributes.name: primary_routing_employee_id

attributes.name: tertiary_routing_last_mile_carrier_id

attributes.name: third_party_logistics_id

attributes.name: carrier_contract_number

attributes.name: compliance_required_flag

attributes.name: cost_currency_code

attributes.name: cost_per_unit

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: effective_end_date

attributes.name: freight_terms

attributes.name: gsp_eligible_flag

attributes.name: guide_code

attributes.name: guide_name

attributes.name: minimum_shipment_volume

attributes.name: shipment_type

attributes.name: sla_target_otif_percent

attributes.name: volume_uom

attributes.name: site_manager_employee_id

products.name: third_party_logistics
products.description: Master record for all third-party logistics (3PL) providers engaged to operate warehousing, fulfillment, transportation, or customs brokerage services for the apparel business. Stores 3PL partner identifier, company name, service type (warehousing, fulfillment, freight forwarding, customs brokerage, last-mile delivery), contract reference, geographic coverage regions, EDI capability flag, WMS integration type (API, EDI 940/945, flat file), SLA tier, composite performance rating, insurance coverage amount, onboarding status, and relationship effective dates. Distinct from the supplier domain which covers manufacturing vendors — this entity specifically governs logistics service providers. Note: PK uses legacy _3pl_partner_id naming convention pending infrastructure-level schema generation fix.
products.reference: 3PL Partner Master — Manhattan Associates WMS / SAP MM

products.name: sla_agreement
products.description: Defines the service level agreements governing logistics performance commitments between the apparel business and its 3PL partners, carriers, and distribution network nodes. Captures SLA type (transit time, OTIF, order accuracy, damage rate, customs clearance time), counterparty identity, applicable lane or facility scope, target metric value, measurement frequency, penalty structure, bonus structure, effective date range, and review cycle. Enables automated SLA breach detection and carrier scorecard generation.

products.name: return_shipment
products.description: Manages reverse logistics shipments for consumer returns, Return-to-Vendor (RTV), store-to-DC consolidation returns, and inter-facility transfers of returned apparel merchandise. Captures return authorization number, return type (consumer RMA, RTV, store recall, quality reject, warranty claim), origin location, destination DC or vendor, carrier, return reason code (fit, quality, wrong item, changed mind), item count, condition grade (A/B/C/D), restocking eligibility, and disposition outcome (restock, refurbish, outlet, donate, destroy). Critical for managing the 20-40% return rate typical in DTC apparel.

products.name: freight_invoice
products.description: Records freight invoices and credit memos received from carriers, freight forwarders, and 3PL providers for transportation and logistics services rendered. Captures invoice number, service provider identity, invoice date, billing period, shipment references covered, charge breakdown (base freight, fuel surcharge, accessorial charges, detention/demurrage, customs fees), currency, total invoiced amount, approved amount after audit, variance from contracted rate, dispute flag and reason, payment status, and GL account coding. Feeds AP processing in SAP FI/CO, freight spend analytics, and carrier rate compliance reporting.

products.name: carrier_service_agreement
products.description: This association product represents the contractual service agreement between a carrier and a factory for freight transportation services. It captures lane-specific routing arrangements, negotiated rates, service level commitments, and transit time expectations. Each record links one carrier to one factory with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific service relationship, enabling routing guide configuration and freight booking decisions.. Existence Justification: In apparel fashion logistics, factories ship finished goods via multiple carriers depending on destination, mode (ocean/air/truck), cost, and service level requirements. Carriers serve multiple factories across their network. The business actively manages carrier-factory service agreements that specify lane-specific negotiated rates, transit times, service levels, and priority rankings. These agreements are referenced by routing guides to make freight booking decisions.

domains.name: quality
domains.description: Ensures product quality through inspection protocols, defect tracking, SMS (Sample Management), PP sample approvals, lab testing, and compliance with OEKO-TEX, CPSC, and GOTS standards. Manages quality audits, non-conformance reports, RTV disposition, corrective actions, and quality gates across the T&A calendar from pre-production through final random inspection.

products.name: inspection
products.description: Master record for all quality inspection events across the product lifecycle — pre-production (PP), in-line, mid-production, and final random inspection (FRI/AQL). Header captures inspection type, stage in T&A calendar, factory, style/SKU scope, inspection date, AQL level, sampling plan reference, pass/fail outcome, defect summary counts, inspector identity, and disposition decision. Line-level findings (modeled as child records within this product) capture: defect type (linked to defect catalog), severity classification (critical/major/minor per AQL), quantity found, affected unit reference, location on garment, inspector notes, photographic evidence URL, and hold/CAPA trigger flags. Serves as the primary operational record for quality gate enforcement from raw material receipt through finished goods shipment, enabling defect frequency analysis and Pareto reporting by style, factory, and defect type.

attributes.description: The action decision made based on the inspection outcome. Accept: goods approved for shipment; Reject: goods refused and returned to vendor (RTV); Rework: defects to be corrected; Sort: 100% inspection to remove defective units; RTY: Return to Yard for further evaluation; Hold: quarantine pending further review.

attributes.name: hold_flag

attributes.name: inspection_number

attributes.name: inspection_status

attributes.name: inspection_type
attributes.description: Classification of the inspection event based on the stage in the production lifecycle. Pre-production (PP) inspections validate samples before bulk production; inline inspections occur during manufacturing; mid-production inspections assess progress; final random inspection (FRI) validates finished goods using AQL sampling; receiving inspections validate incoming materials; lab test inspections validate compliance with technical specifications.
attributes.references: ISO 2859-1 Sampling Procedures for Inspection by Attributes

attributes.name: inspector_name

attributes.name: inspector_notes

attributes.name: lab_test_required

attributes.name: major_defects_found
attributes.description: The count of major defects identified during the inspection. Major defects significantly impair product functionality or appearance and are likely to result in customer rejection.
attributes.references: ISO 2859-1 Sampling Procedures for Inspection by Attributes

attributes.name: minor_defects_found
attributes.description: The count of minor defects identified during the inspection. Minor defects are small imperfections that do not significantly affect product functionality or appearance.

attributes.name: pass_fail_outcome
attributes.description: The final inspection result indicating whether the lot met the AQL acceptance criteria. Pass indicates acceptance; Fail indicates rejection; Conditional Pass indicates acceptance with minor corrective actions required; Pending indicates awaiting final determination.

attributes.name: photo_evidence_url

attributes.name: product_category

attributes.name: report_url
attributes.description: The URL or file path to the detailed inspection report document, typically stored in a document management system or cloud storage.

attributes.name: sample_size
attributes.description: The number of units randomly selected and inspected from the lot, as determined by the sampling plan.
attributes.references: ISO 2859-1 Sampling Procedures for Inspection by Attributes

attributes.name: sampling_plan
attributes.description: The statistical sampling plan reference used for the inspection, defining sample size and acceptance criteria based on lot size and AQL level.

attributes.name: stage
attributes.description: The specific production stage or milestone in the Time and Action (T&A) calendar where the inspection was performed. Aligns with quality gates in the manufacturing workflow.

attributes.name: start_time

attributes.name: total_defects_found
attributes.description: The total count of all defects (critical + major + minor) identified during the inspection.

attributes.name: units_inspected
attributes.description: The actual number of units physically inspected during the inspection event. May differ from sample size if inspection was incomplete.

products.name: defect
products.description: Reference taxonomy of all defect types used to classify findings during inspections, lab tests, and production audits. Each entry defines a defect code, name, category (critical/major/minor per AQL classification), affected product area (seam, fabric, trim, print, fit, label, packaging), detailed description, photographic reference, and severity weighting. Acts as the controlled vocabulary ensuring consistent defect recording and enabling cross-factory, cross-season Pareto analysis across all quality workflows.

attributes.name: defect_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the quality defect record. Primary key for the quality defect taxonomy.

attributes.name: acceptance_criteria
attributes.description: The quantitative or qualitative threshold that distinguishes acceptable variation from a defect. Defines pass/fail boundaries for inspections and lab tests, ensuring consistent application across factories and seasons.

attributes.name: active_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this defect type is currently active in the quality taxonomy. Inactive defects are retained for historical analysis but not used in current inspection workflows.

attributes.name: affected_area
attributes.description: The specific component or area of the garment or product where the defect occurs. Enables root-cause analysis by production stage and supplier capability assessment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: seam|fabric|trim|print|embroidery|fit|label|packaging|hardware|zipper|button — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ASTM D5489 Standard Guide for Care Symbols

attributes.name: applicable_product_category
attributes.description: The product categories or divisions where this defect type is relevant. May include apparel, footwear, accessories, or specific subcategories (e.g., outerwear, activewear, luxury). Enables category-specific quality reporting.

attributes.name: aql_classification
attributes.description: AQL (Acceptable Quality Limit) classification tier per ISO 2859-1 and ANSI/ASQC Z1.4 standards. Determines sampling plan, acceptance number, and rejection criteria during pre-production (PP), inline, and final random inspections.
attributes.references: ISO 2859-1 AQL Sampling Procedures, ANSI/ASQC Z1.4

attributes.name: compliance_standard
attributes.description: The regulatory or industry standard that this defect type may violate if present. References OEKO-TEX Standard 100 for textile safety, CPSC (Consumer Product Safety Commission) requirements, GOTS (Global Organic Textile Standard), FTC labeling rules, or other applicable frameworks.
attributes.references: OEKO-TEX Standard 100, CPSC 16 CFR Part 1610, GOTS Version 6.0, FTC 16 CFR Part 303

attributes.name: corrective_action_guidance
attributes.description: Recommended corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) to address this defect type. Provides factory partners and internal quality teams with standardized remediation steps aligned with ISO 9001 and continuous improvement frameworks.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management Systems, CAPA Procedures

attributes.name: cost_impact_category
attributes.description: Estimated financial impact category of this defect type, considering rework costs, RTV (Return to Vendor) expenses, customer returns, and brand reputation risk. Informs quality investment prioritization.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this defect record was first created in the quality management system. Supports audit trails and data lineage per ISO 9001 and GDPR requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management Systems, GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: customer_visibility
attributes.description: Indicates whether the defect is visible to the end customer during normal use. Visible defects have higher severity weighting and stricter acceptance criteria. Hidden defects may still affect durability or compliance.

attributes.name: defect_category
attributes.description: AQL (Acceptable Quality Limit) classification of the defect severity. Critical defects render product unsafe or unusable; major defects significantly impair function or appearance; minor defects are noticeable but do not affect primary use. Drives sampling plans and acceptance criteria per ISO 2859-1.
attributes.references: ISO 2859-1 AQL Sampling Procedures, ANSI/ASQC Z1.4

attributes.name: defect_code
attributes.description: Standardized alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the defect type across all quality workflows. Used as the operational reference in inspection systems, SMS (Sample Management System), and audit reports.

attributes.name: defect_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the defect, including visual characteristics, measurement criteria, and conditions under which it is considered a defect. Serves as the authoritative definition for training inspectors and resolving disputes.

attributes.name: defect_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the defect type. Provides clear identification for quality inspectors, factory auditors, and merchandising teams.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this defect definition was retired or superseded. Null for currently active defects. Enables historical trend analysis and ensures data lineage for compliance audits.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this defect definition became effective in quality workflows. Supports historical analysis and ensures consistent application of quality standards across seasons and T&A (Time and Action) calendars.

attributes.name: frequency_rank
attributes.description: Historical ranking of this defect type by occurrence frequency across all inspections and audits. Lower numbers indicate more common defects. Used for Pareto analysis and prioritization of quality improvement initiatives.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management Systems, Pareto Analysis

attributes.name: inspection_stage
attributes.description: The quality gate or inspection checkpoint where this defect type is typically identified. Aligns with T&A (Time and Action) calendar milestones and quality protocols across the production lifecycle.

attributes.name: lab_test_method
attributes.description: The specific laboratory test method or standard used to detect or measure this defect. References AATCC (American Association of Textile Chemists and Colorists), ASTM, or ISO test procedures.
attributes.references: AATCC Test Methods, ASTM International Standards, ISO Standards

attributes.name: lab_test_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether detection or confirmation of this defect requires laboratory testing (e.g., colorfastness, flammability, chemical composition) rather than visual inspection alone.
attributes.references: AATCC Test Methods, ASTM International Standards

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this defect record was last updated. Tracks changes to definitions, criteria, or classifications, ensuring all stakeholders work from the current version.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management Systems, GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: measurement_method
attributes.description: The standardized procedure or tool used to detect and measure the defect. May reference visual inspection, dimensional measurement, lab testing (colorfastness, tensile strength), or specialized equipment (RFID readers, spectrophotometers).
attributes.references: ASTM International Standards, AATCC Test Methods

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system that last modified this defect record. Supports accountability, audit trails, and change management per ISO 9001 quality management principles.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special instructions, or clarifications related to this defect type. May include regional variations, seasonal considerations, or links to related quality documentation.

attributes.name: photo_reference_url
attributes.description: URL link to photographic or visual reference material illustrating the defect. Used in training materials, SMS (Sample Management System) workflows, and factory communication to ensure consistent identification.

attributes.name: rework_feasibility
attributes.description: Indicates whether products with this defect can be repaired or reworked to meet quality standards, or must be rejected and returned to vendor (RTV). Conditional rework depends on defect severity and cost-benefit analysis.

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the typical root cause for this defect type. Supports corrective action planning, supplier capability assessment, and continuous improvement initiatives.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management Systems, Six Sigma DMAIC

attributes.name: severity_weight
attributes.description: Numeric weighting factor representing the relative impact of this defect on product quality and customer satisfaction. Used in quality scoring algorithms, Pareto analysis, and supplier scorecards. Higher values indicate greater severity.

attributes.name: supplier_notification_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether occurrence of this defect triggers mandatory notification to the supplier or factory partner. Critical and major defects typically require immediate supplier engagement and corrective action.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for this defect definition. Incremented when acceptance criteria, descriptions, or classifications are updated. Ensures traceability and alignment across global quality teams and factory partners.

products.name: non_conformance
products.description: Formal non-conformance report (NCR) raised when a product, material, or process fails to meet defined quality standards. Captures NCR number, originating inspection or audit reference, affected style/SKU/PO, non-conformance category, root cause classification, severity, responsible party (factory, supplier, internal), disposition decision (rework, RTV, scrap, accept-as-is), corrective action required flag, and NCR status lifecycle (open, under review, closed). Central record for quality failure management and RTV disposition workflows.

attributes.name: audit_id

attributes.name: primary_non_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the quality inspector, auditor, or user who created this non-conformance report.

attributes.name: related_ncr_non_conformance_id
attributes.description: Reference to a previous or related non-conformance report, used to track recurring issues and corrective action effectiveness.

attributes.name: sales_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.sales_order. Business justification: NCRs raised against shipped customer orders capture post-delivery quality failures. Drives customer complaint resolution, warranty claims, and quality cost tracking for delivered goods in apparel reta

attributes.name: sketch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to design.design_sketch. Business justification: Non-conformances often cite design sketch deviations as root cause. Critical for root cause analysis when production doesn't match design intent, determining whether issue stems from design specificat

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific SKU affected by this non-conformance. Provides size/color/variant-level traceability.

attributes.name: sourcing_purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sourcing.sourcing_purchase_order.
