attributes.name: style_id
attributes.description: Reference to the affected product style. Links to the product master in PLM systems.

attributes.name: supplier_esg_assessment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.supplier_esg_assessment. Business justification: NCRs trigger ESG assessment reviews. Repeated quality failures impact supplier ESG ratings, sourcing approval status, and vendor consolidation decisions in responsible sourcing programs.

attributes.name: tertiary_non_closed_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the quality manager or authorized user who approved closure of this non-conformance report.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier or factory responsible for the non-conforming product or material.

attributes.name: vendor_quote_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sourcing.vendor_quote. Business justification: NCRs may reference quoted specifications for compliance verification when actual product deviates from vendor quote commitments. Supports vendor accountability and quote accuracy audits.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.work_order. Business justification: NCRs are raised against specific work orders when quality failures occur. Required for production hold decisions, rework authorization, cost-of-quality allocation to work orders, and tracking quality

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date when the non-conformance report was formally closed after disposition execution and verification. Null for open NCRs.

attributes.name: closure_notes
attributes.description: Final comments and verification notes recorded at NCR closure, including confirmation of disposition execution and effectiveness of corrective actions.

attributes.name: compliance_standard_violated
attributes.description: Specific regulatory or certification standard that was violated by this non-conformance (e.g., OEKO-TEX Standard 100, CPSC safety requirements, GOTS organic standards). Critical for compliance reporting and audit trails. attributes.references: OEKO-TEX Standard 100, CPSC Product Safety Standards, GOTS Global Organic Textile Standard

attributes.name: containment_action
attributes.description: Immediate actions taken to prevent non-conforming product from reaching customers or downstream processes. Includes quarantine, hold, or recall activities.

attributes.name: corrective_action_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether formal corrective action plan (CAP) is required to address systemic issues. True for major/critical defects or recurring non-conformances.

attributes.name: quantity_affected

attributes.name: quantity_unit

attributes.name: recurrence_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this non-conformance is a repeat occurrence of a previously identified issue. True signals ineffective corrective actions and escalates priority.

products.name: quality_sample
products.description: Master record for all physical samples managed through the SMS (Sample Management System) across product development and pre-production, including evaluation outcomes and approval decisions. Captures sample type (proto, salesman, fit, PP, TOP, shipment), style/colorway/size, season, request/expected/actual receipt dates, origin factory, sample status, and comments. Includes evaluation records: evaluator identity, evaluation date, type (fit session, aesthetic review, PP approval, TOP approval), pass/fail/conditional decision, comments by category (construction, fit, fabric hand, color, trim, labeling), required amendments, and approval authority sign-off. Serves as the SSOT for sample tracking and approval from design through pre-production sign-off, driving the PP approval gate in the T&A calendar.

products.name: lab_test
products.description: Record of a laboratory test submission, its individual parameter-level results, and overall outcome for a fabric, trim, or finished garment. Captures test request date, lab name, test standard (OEKO-TEX 100, GOTS, CPSC, ASTM, ISO), test type (colorfastness, tensile strength, flammability, chemical safety, dimensional stability, pH, fiber content), sample reference, overall pass/fail/conditional result, test report number, certificate expiry date, and remediation required flag. Includes granular line-level results per test parameter: parameter name, test method, required specification (min/max), actual measured value, unit of measure, parameter-level pass/fail, and lab technician notes. Supports compliance with FTC labeling, CPSC safety, and OEKO-TEX certification requirements with full parameter traceability.

products.name: aql_plan
products.description: Reference configuration defining Acceptable Quality Level (AQL) sampling plans per ANSI/ASQ Z1.4 (ISO 2859-1) applied to inspections by product category, supplier tier, or risk level. Stores AQL level (0.65–6.5), inspection level (I/II/III, S-1 through S-4), lot size ranges, sample size code letters, and accept/reject number pairs for critical/major/minor defect classes. Supports tightened/normal/reduced switching rules based on inspection history. Drives automated sample size calculation and pass/fail determination in all inspection workflows.

attributes.name: accept_number_critical
attributes.description: Maximum number of critical defects allowed in the sample for the lot to be accepted. Typically 0 for critical defects.
attributes.references: ANSI/ASQ Z1.4 (ISO 2859-1) Tables II-A, II-B, II-C

attributes.name: accept_number_major
attributes.description: Maximum number of major defects allowed in the sample for the lot to be accepted.

attributes.name: accept_number_minor

attributes.references: ANSI/ASQ Z1.4 (ISO 2859-1) Tables II-A, II-B, II-C

attributes.description: Product category or categories to which this AQL plan applies (e.g., apparel, footwear, accessories, outerwear, activewear). Null indicates the plan is category-agnostic.

attributes.name: applicable_supplier_tier
attributes.description: Supplier tier classification to which this AQL plan applies. Tier 1 suppliers may have more stringent or relaxed plans based on performance history.

attributes.name: aql_critical
attributes.description: AQL percentage for critical defects (defects that render the product unsafe or non-compliant with mandatory regulations). Typical values range from 0.0 to 0.65 percent. Critical defects are those that could cause injury or violate safety standards such as CPSC, OEKO-TEX, or GOTS.
attributes.references: ANSI/ASQ Z1.4 (ISO 2859-1), CPSC, OEKO-TEX Standard 100, GOTS

products.name: gate
products.description: Configuration record defining mandatory quality checkpoints within the Time & Action (T&A) calendar that must be satisfied before production or shipment can proceed. products.name: inspection_finding
products.description: This association product represents the individual defect findings recorded during a quality inspection event. Each record captures one specific defect type identified during one inspection, with attributes that exist only in the context of this finding: the count of occurrences, severity classification, location on the garment, photographic evidence, and inspector notes. This is the operational record created by quality inspectors as they document findings during pre-production, in-line, and final random inspections.. Existence Justification: In apparel quality management, inspectors examine production lots and identify multiple defect types during a single inspection event (e.g., one inspection may find stitching defects, label placement issues, and fabric flaws). Conversely, each defect type from the quality taxonomy appears across many different inspections over time and across factories. The business actively manages these findings as operational records, with inspectors documenting count, location, severity, and photographic evidence for each defect type found during each inspection.

Captures engagement type (gifting, paid post, takeover, event appearance, affiliate), contracted deliverables, content format (reel, story, post, blog, video), agreed fee, payment terms, posting schedule, actual post dates, platform-reported reach, impressions, engagement count, link clicks, promo code usage, and attributed revenue. Links to influencer master and campaign.

attributes.name: influencer_engagement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each influencer collaboration or activation event.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marketing campaign this engagement is part of.

attributes.name: circular_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.circular_program. Business justification: Influencer partnerships frequently promote circular economy programs (resale platforms, take-back initiatives, repair services) as part of brand sustainability storytelling. Tracking which influencers

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.collection. Business justification: Influencer partnerships promote collections; contract deliverables (posts per collection), product seeding, content approval, and performance measurement all require collection context for campaign al

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Influencer engagements have agreed fees (agreed_fee_amount) and payment obligations that must be charged to cost centers for influencer marketing budget tracking, accrual posting, and expense manageme

attributes.name: influencer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the influencer master record participating in this engagement.

attributes.name: obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_obligation. Business justification: Influencer partnerships must comply with FTC endorsement guidelines requiring material connection disclosures. Each engagement must track applicable compliance obligations (e.g., #ad disclosure, gifte

attributes.name: promo_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.promo_code. Business justification: influencer_engagement currently stores promo_code as STRING. When an influencer engagement includes a promotional code, it should reference the promo_code entity directly. This allows tracking which p

attributes.name: quality_sample_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.quality_sample. Business justification: Influencers receive seeding samples for content creation. Engagement records track which approved samples were sent for inventory control and compliance—ensuring only approved products are publicly sh

attributes.name: actual_post_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the influencer published the content.

attributes.name: affiliate_link
attributes.description: Unique affiliate tracking link provided to the influencer for attribution and commission tracking.

attributes.name: agreed_fee_amount
attributes.description: Total fee amount agreed upon for the influencer engagement.

attributes.name: attributed_order_count
attributes.description: Number of orders attributed to this influencer engagement through promo code usage and affiliate link tracking.

attributes.name: attributed_revenue_amount
attributes.description: Total revenue attributed to this influencer engagement through promo code usage and affiliate link tracking.

attributes.name: brand_sentiment_score
attributes.description: Sentiment analysis score of comments and reactions to the influencer content, ranging from -1 (negative) to +1 (positive).

attributes.name: comment_count
attributes.description: Number of comments received on the influencer content.

attributes.name: content_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the brand approved the influencer content for publication.

attributes.name: content_approval_status
attributes.description: Status of brand approval for the influencer content before publication (pending, approved, rejected, revision requested).

attributes.name: content_format
attributes.description: Format of content to be created by the influencer (reel, story, post, blog, video, carousel, live stream). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: reel|story|post|blog|video|carousel|live_stream — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: content_url
attributes.description: Direct URL link to the published influencer content.

attributes.name: contract_date
attributes.description: Date when the influencer engagement contract was signed or agreed upon.

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the influencer engagement contract period.

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the influencer engagement contract period.

attributes.name: cost_per_engagement
attributes.description: Calculated cost per engagement (agreed fee divided by engagement count).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the influencer engagement record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the agreed fee amount.

attributes.name: deliverable_count
attributes.description: Number of content pieces contracted for this engagement.

attributes.name: deliverable_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the contracted deliverables, including content requirements, messaging guidelines, and brand specifications.

attributes.name: engagement_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the influencer engagement, used for tracking and reporting.

attributes.name: engagement_count
attributes.description: Total number of user interactions with the content (likes, comments, shares, saves), as reported by the platform.

attributes.name: engagement_rate_percent
attributes.description: Calculated engagement rate as a percentage (engagement count divided by reach count times 100).

attributes.name: engagement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the influencer engagement (draft, contracted, in progress, completed, cancelled, disputed).

attributes.name: engagement_type
attributes.description: Type of influencer collaboration activity (gifting, paid post, takeover, event appearance, affiliate, ambassador, unboxing). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: gifting|paid_post|takeover|event_appearance|affiliate|ambassador|unboxing — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: exclusivity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the influencer is contractually restricted from promoting competing brands during the engagement period.

attributes.name: impression_count
attributes.description: Total number of times the influencer content was displayed, as reported by the platform.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the influencer engagement record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: like_count
attributes.description: Number of likes received on the influencer content.

attributes.name: link_click_count
attributes.description: Number of clicks on links included in the influencer content.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current payment status for this engagement (pending, partial, paid, overdue).

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Payment terms and conditions for the influencer engagement, including milestones and payment schedule.

attributes.name: platform
attributes.description: Social media platform where the content will be published (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, Twitter, Pinterest, Blog). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: instagram|tiktok|youtube|facebook|twitter|pinterest|blog — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: promo_code_usage_count
attributes.description: Number of times the promotional code was used by customers.

attributes.name: reach_count
attributes.description: Total number of unique users who saw the influencer content, as reported by the platform.

attributes.name: return_on_investment_percent
attributes.description: Calculated return on investment as a percentage ((attributed revenue minus agreed fee) divided by agreed fee times 100).

attributes.name: save_count
attributes.description: Number of times the influencer content was saved by users.

attributes.name: scheduled_post_date
attributes.description: Planned date for the influencer to publish the content.

attributes.name: share_count
attributes.description: Number of times the influencer content was shared by users.

attributes.name: usage_rights
attributes.description: Description of the brands rights to reuse the influencer content across owned channels, paid media, and other marketing materials.

products.name: audience_segment
products.description: Master record defining marketing audience segments used for campaign targeting, personalization, and suppression across channels. Captures segment name, definition logic (rules or ML-derived), segment type (behavioral, demographic, psychographic, lookalike, RFM-based, lifecycle stage), channel applicability, estimated and actual reach, source system (Adobe Experience Platform CDP), refresh frequency, activation status, and associated brand or product category. Enables precision targeting for DTC, wholesale, and retail campaigns.

attributes.name: audience_segment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the audience segment. Primary key.

attributes.name: customer_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.segment. Business justification: Marketing audience segments are derived from or mapped to customer segments for cross-domain consistency. Enables segment alignment between marketing activation and customer analytics, ensures targeti

attributes.name: activation_destinations
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of downstream systems or platforms where this segment has been activated for campaign execution (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Google Ads, Facebook Ads, email service provider).

attributes.name: activation_status
attributes.description: Current state of segment activation to downstream marketing channels: not activated (segment exists but not pushed), activated (successfully synced to destinations), activation pending (in progress), or activation failed (error during sync).

attributes.name: actual_reach
attributes.description: Current count of unique customers or profiles who actively qualify for this segment based on the latest evaluation run.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - Segment Evaluation Metrics

attributes.name: aov_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the AOV target amount.

attributes.name: audience_segment_description
attributes.description: Detailed business description of the segment purpose, target audience characteristics, and intended use cases for campaign planning and execution.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - Segment Documentation Standards

attributes.name: average_order_value_target
attributes.description: Target Average Order Value expected from customers in this segment, used for campaign ROI planning and performance benchmarking.

attributes.name: brand_association
attributes.description: Brand or sub-brand this segment is associated with for targeted brand campaigns and product launches.

attributes.name: business_objective
attributes.description: Strategic marketing goal this segment supports: customer acquisition, retention, cross-sell, upsell, win-back, loyalty engagement, seasonal campaign, new product launch.

attributes.name: cac_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the CAC target amount.

attributes.name: cac_target
attributes.description: Target Customer Acquisition Cost for campaigns using this segment, representing the maximum acceptable cost to acquire a new customer from this audience.

attributes.name: channel_applicability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of marketing channels where this segment can be activated: email, SMS, push notification, display advertising, social media, direct mail, in-store, web personalization.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - Channel Activation Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this segment record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: definition_logic
attributes.description: Business rules or machine learning model logic defining segment membership criteria. May include attribute filters, event conditions, propensity scores, or SQL-like expressions.

attributes.name: definition_type
attributes.description: Method used to define segment membership: rule-based (attribute/event filters), ML-derived (propensity/clustering models), hybrid (rules + ML), or manual upload (static list).
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - Segment Definition Standards

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this segment expires and is no longer available for new campaign activations. Null for evergreen segments.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - Segment Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this segment becomes active and available for campaign targeting and activation.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - Segment Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: estimated_reach
attributes.description: Projected number of unique customers or profiles expected to qualify for this segment based on historical data or model predictions.

attributes.name: expected_conversion_rate_percent
attributes.description: Anticipated percentage of segment members expected to convert (purchase, sign-up, engagement) based on historical performance or predictive models.

attributes.name: last_refresh_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the segment membership was last evaluated and updated.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - Segment Evaluation Audit

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this segment record was most recently modified, including changes to definition logic, status, or metadata.

attributes.name: next_refresh_timestamp
attributes.description: Scheduled date and time for the next segment membership evaluation run.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - Segment Evaluation Schedule

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional operational notes, performance observations, or special handling instructions for campaign managers using this segment.

attributes.name: owner_email
attributes.description: Email address of the marketing team member or business owner responsible for managing and maintaining this segment.

attributes.name: priority_tier
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to this segment for resource allocation and campaign sequencing: high (VIP/high-value customers), medium (core audience), low (exploratory/test segments).

attributes.name: product_category_association
attributes.description: Primary product category or collection this segment is aligned with for merchandising and promotional targeting (e.g., athletic footwear, luxury accessories, lifestyle apparel).

attributes.name: refresh_frequency
attributes.description: Cadence at which segment membership is re-evaluated and updated: real-time (streaming), hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, or on-demand (manual trigger).
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - Segment Evaluation Schedule

attributes.name: segment_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code used as a business identifier for the segment in campaign systems and reporting.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - Segment Identifier Standards

attributes.name: segment_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the audience segment used for campaign targeting and personalization.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - Segment Naming Standards

attributes.name: segment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the segment: draft (under development), active (available for activation), paused (temporarily disabled), archived (historical reference only), or expired (past effective date).
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - Segment Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: segment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the segment based on the underlying segmentation methodology: behavioral (actions/interactions), demographic (age/gender/location), psychographic (interests/values), lookalike (modeled similarity), RFM-based (recency/frequency/monetary), or lifecycle stage (acquisition/retention/churn).

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the system or platform where the segment was created and is maintained, typically Adobe Experience Platform Customer Data Platform (CDP).
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - System of Record

attributes.name: suppression_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this segment is used for suppression (excluding customers from campaigns) rather than inclusion targeting. True if suppression segment, False if targeting segment.

products.name: email_campaign

Captures campaign definition (name, type, subject line, sender, target segment, send schedule, template, personalization, A/B variants, ESP ID, GDPR/CCPA opt-in basis) and recipient-level send events (delivery status, open/click timestamps, bounce type, unsubscribe/spam flags, device type, email client, geolocation). SSOT for email channel performance measurement, deliverability monitoring, and engagement attribution. Sourced from Adobe Experience Platform and ESP event streams.

attributes.name: email_campaign_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the email campaign. Primary key.

attributes.name: audience_segment_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the customer segment targeted by this campaign. Links to customer segmentation in Adobe Experience Platform.

attributes.name: circular_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.circular_program. Business justification: Email campaigns drive customer participation in circular programs by promoting trade-in incentives, resale marketplace launches, and recycling initiatives. Linking campaigns to programs enables measur

attributes.name: collection_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.collection. Business justification: Email campaigns promote collections ("New Arrivals", "Spring Collection Launch"). Core email marketing operation for seasonal merchandising, collection storytelling, and email-to-sales attribution in

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Email campaigns have budgets (campaign_budget_amount) that must be allocated to cost centers for marketing expense tracking, budget variance analysis, and financial reporting of digital marketing spen

attributes.name: customer_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.segment. Business justification: Email campaigns target customer segments directly (beyond audience_segment). Enables segment-based email performance analysis, segment-specific engagement tracking, and customer segment email preferen

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the marketing user or system account that created this campaign.

attributes.name: esp_campaign_id
attributes.description: External identifier assigned by the Email Service Provider system for tracking and reconciliation.

attributes.name: obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_obligation. Business justification: Email campaigns must formally link to compliance obligations for GDPR consent requirements, CAN-SPAM Act compliance, and CCPA opt-out rights. While gdpr_compliant_flag exists, formal obligation tracki

attributes.name: template_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the email template used for this campaign. References template library in ESP or Adobe Experience Platform.

attributes.name: ab_test_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this campaign includes A/B testing of subject lines, content, or send times.

attributes.name: ab_test_variant_count
attributes.description: Number of variants being tested in the A/B test (e.g., 2 for A/B, 3 for A/B/C).

attributes.name: ab_test_winning_variant
attributes.description: Identifier of the winning variant selected based on test results (e.g., A, B, C). Null if test is incomplete.

attributes.name: actual_send_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the email campaign send was initiated by the Email Service Provider (ESP).

attributes.name: budget_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the campaign budget (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: campaign_budget_amount
attributes.description: Total budget allocated for this email campaign including creative, ESP costs, and promotional discounts.

attributes.name: campaign_goal
attributes.description: Primary business objective of the campaign (e.g., drive sales, increase engagement, promote new collection, recover abandoned carts).

attributes.name: ccpa_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this campaign meets CCPA requirements for consumer data rights and opt-out mechanisms.

attributes.name: completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when all emails in the campaign were fully processed and sent by the ESP.

attributes.name: consent_basis
attributes.description: Legal basis for sending this email under GDPR and CCPA regulations. Critical for compliance and audit trails.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the email campaign record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: esp_name
attributes.description: Name of the Email Service Provider platform used to send this campaign (e.g., Adobe Campaign, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Mailchimp).

attributes.name: gdpr_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this campaign meets GDPR requirements for consent, data processing, and right to unsubscribe.

attributes.name: hard_bounce_count
attributes.description: Number of emails that permanently failed delivery due to invalid email addresses or blocked domains.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the email campaign record was last modified.

attributes.name: personalization_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether dynamic personalization (name, product recommendations, location-based content) is enabled for this campaign.

attributes.name: personalization_fields
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of personalization tokens used in the email (e.g., first_name, last_purchase_date, recommended_products).

attributes.name: preheader_text
attributes.description: Preview text displayed after the subject line in email clients. Used to provide additional context and improve open rates.

attributes.name: reply_to_email_address
attributes.description: Email address where recipient replies will be directed. May differ from sender address.

attributes.name: scheduled_send_timestamp
attributes.description: Planned date and time when the email campaign is scheduled to be sent to recipients.

attributes.name: sender_email_address
attributes.description: Email address used as the from address for the campaign (e.g., marketing@apparelfashion.com).

attributes.name: sender_name
attributes.description: Display name shown as the sender of the email (e.g., Apparel Fashion, Customer Service Team).

attributes.name: soft_bounce_count
attributes.description: Number of emails that temporarily failed delivery due to full mailboxes or server issues.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which this campaign data originated (e.g., Adobe Experience Platform, Salesforce Marketing Cloud).

attributes.name: spam_complaint_count
attributes.description: Number of recipients who marked this email as spam or junk. Critical metric for sender reputation.

attributes.name: subject_line
attributes.description: The subject line text displayed in recipient inboxes. Critical for open rate optimization.

attributes.name: target_audience_size
attributes.description: Total number of recipients in the target segment at the time of campaign creation.

attributes.name: total_bounce_count
attributes.description: Total number of emails that bounced (hard bounces plus soft bounces).

attributes.name: total_click_count
attributes.description: Total number of clicks on links within the email (includes multiple clicks by same recipient).

attributes.name: total_delivered_count
attributes.description: Total number of emails successfully delivered to recipient inboxes (sent minus bounces).

attributes.name: total_open_count
attributes.description: Total number of times emails in this campaign were opened by recipients (includes multiple opens by same recipient).

attributes.name: total_sent_count
attributes.description: Total number of emails successfully sent by the ESP for this campaign.

attributes.name: unique_click_count
attributes.description: Number of unique recipients who clicked at least one link in the email.

attributes.name: unique_open_count
attributes.description: Number of unique recipients who opened the email at least once.

attributes.name: unsubscribe_count
attributes.description: Number of recipients who unsubscribed from the email list after receiving this campaign.

products.name: email_send_event
products.description: Transactional record of each individual email send event capturing recipient-level delivery and engagement data. Tracks send timestamp, delivery status, open timestamp, click timestamp, clicked URL, unsubscribe flag, bounce type (hard/soft), spam complaint flag, device type, email client, and geolocation. Sourced from Adobe Experience Platform and ESP event streams. Enables deliverability monitoring and engagement attribution.

attributes.name: email_send_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each individual email send event. Primary key for the email send event record.

attributes.name: audience_segment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the email list or segment to which the recipient belongs at the time of send.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marketing campaign that triggered this email send event.

attributes.name: email_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.email_campaign. Business justification: email_send_event currently has campaign_id linking to the master campaign table, but it should ALSO link to email_campaign (the specific email program instance). Each send event belongs to a specific

attributes.name: email_template_id
attributes.description: Reference to the email template used for this send event.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer profile who is the recipient of this email.

attributes.name: ab_test_variant
attributes.description: The variant identifier for A/B or multivariate testing. Indicates which version of the email (subject line, content, CTA) was sent to this recipient.

attributes.name: bounce_reason
attributes.description: Detailed reason code or message explaining why the email bounced. Sourced from SMTP error response. Null if no bounce occurred.

attributes.name: bounce_type
attributes.description: Classification of bounce event. Hard bounce indicates permanent delivery failure (invalid address), soft bounce indicates temporary issue (mailbox full). Null if no bounce occurred.
attributes.references: RFC 3463 - Enhanced Mail System Status Codes

attributes.name: clicked_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the recipient clicked any link within the email. True if at least one click event was tracked, False otherwise.

attributes.name: clicked_url
attributes.description: The first URL clicked by the recipient within the email. Used for primary engagement attribution. Null if no clicks occurred.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this email send event record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage.

attributes.name: delivered_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the email was successfully delivered to the recipient mail server. Null if delivery failed.

attributes.name: delivery_status
attributes.description: Current delivery status of the email indicating whether it successfully reached the recipient inbox or encountered an issue.

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: The type of device used by the recipient to open or interact with the email. Derived from user agent string.

attributes.name: email_client
attributes.description: The email client application used by the recipient to view the email (e.g., Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail). Derived from user agent string.

attributes.name: esp_message_reference
attributes.description: Unique message identifier assigned by the Email Service Provider. Used for tracking and troubleshooting delivery issues.

attributes.name: first_click_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time of the first recorded click event for any link in this email. Null if no clicks occurred.

attributes.name: first_open_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time of the first recorded open event for this email. Null if the email was never opened.

attributes.name: from_address
attributes.description: The sender email address displayed in the From field of the email. Used for sender reputation tracking.

attributes.name: from_name
attributes.description: The sender name displayed in the From field of the email (e.g., brand name or representative name).

attributes.name: geo_city
attributes.description: The city where the recipient opened the email. Derived from IP address geolocation.

attributes.name: geo_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code representing the geographic location of the recipient at the time of email interaction. Derived from IP address geolocation.

attributes.name: geo_region
attributes.description: The state, province, or region where the recipient opened the email. Derived from IP address geolocation.

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: The IP address from which the recipient opened or clicked the email. Used for geolocation and fraud detection. May be considered PII under GDPR.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this email send event record was last modified. Tracks updates to engagement metrics (opens, clicks) as they occur.

attributes.name: opened_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the recipient opened the email. True if at least one open event was tracked, False otherwise.

attributes.name: operating_system
attributes.description: The operating system of the device used to open the email (e.g., iOS, Android, Windows, macOS). Derived from user agent string.

attributes.name: personalization_applied_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether dynamic personalization (name, product recommendations, location-based content) was applied to this email send.

attributes.name: recipient_email_address
attributes.description: The email address to which this message was sent. Personally identifiable information subject to GDPR and CCPA.

attributes.name: send_priority
attributes.description: The priority level assigned to this email send event. High priority emails are processed first by the ESP.

attributes.name: send_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the email was sent from the Email Service Provider (ESP). Primary business event timestamp for this transaction.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the source system or Email Service Provider that generated this send event record (e.g., Adobe Experience Platform, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze).

attributes.name: spam_complaint_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the recipient marked this email as spam or junk. True if spam complaint was filed, False otherwise. Critical for sender reputation monitoring.

attributes.name: spam_complaint_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the spam complaint was registered. Null if no complaint was filed.

attributes.name: subject_line
attributes.description: The subject line text of the email sent to the recipient. Used for A/B testing and engagement analysis.

attributes.name: total_click_count
attributes.description: Total number of link clicks recorded for this email across all links. Includes multiple clicks by the same recipient.

attributes.name: total_open_count
attributes.description: Total number of times this email was opened by the recipient. Includes multiple opens by the same recipient.

attributes.name: unsubscribe_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the recipient clicked the unsubscribe link. Null if no unsubscribe action occurred.

attributes.name: unsubscribed_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the recipient unsubscribed from the email list as a result of this send event. True if unsubscribe action was taken, False otherwise.

products.name: campaign_flight
products.description: This association product represents the execution of a marketing campaign on a specific digital storefront. It captures the market-specific deployment of campaigns including budget allocation, flight timing, creative adaptation, and performance tracking. Each record links one campaign to one storefront with attributes that exist only in the context of this market-specific execution.. Existence Justification: In apparel fashion multi-market operations, marketing campaigns are executed across multiple regional storefronts (e.g., US site, UK site, EU site) with market-specific budget allocations, localized creative, and region-specific flight timing. Simultaneously, each storefront runs multiple concurrent campaigns (seasonal launches, brand awareness, promotional campaigns). The business actively manages these campaign flights as operational entities with distinct budgets, performance tracking, and creative variants per storefront-campaign combination.

products.name: campaign_initiative_promotion

It captures how specific sustainability initiatives are featured, messaged, and attributed within marketing campaigns. Each record links one campaign to one sustainability initiative with campaign-specific messaging themes, contribution allocation percentages, and attributed impact metrics that exist only in the context of this promotional relationship.. Marketing teams actively manage which initiatives are featured in which campaigns, allocate messaging budget percentages, create campaign-specific creative themes, and measure attributed impact metrics for each campaign-initiative pairing.

products.name: influencer_seeding
products.description: This association product represents the product seeding event between influencer and work_order. It captures the allocation of manufactured goods from specific work orders to influencers for content creation, brand awareness, and product promotion. Each record links one influencer to one work_order with seeding-specific attributes including quantities shipped, deadlines for content delivery, return requirements, and usage rights granted for the seeded products.. Existence Justification: Influencer product seeding is a real operational marketing process in apparel fashion where brands allocate manufactured goods from work orders to multiple influencers for content creation and brand awareness. A single work order (e.g., 5000 units of a new sneaker style) can be seeded to dozens of influencers across different tiers and markets as part of a launch campaign. Conversely, a single influencer receives seeded products from multiple work orders over time (seasonal collections, new launches, ongoing ambassador programs). The seeding event itself carries operational data including quantities allocated, shipment tracking, content deadlines, return requirements, and usage rights that belong to neither the influencer profile nor the work order.

Each record links one influencer to one sustainability_initiative with attributes that exist only in the context of this partnership relationship, including ambassador role, contract terms, content deliverables, and campaign focus areas.. The business actively manages these partnerships as formal contracts with specific deliverables, timelines, and compensation tied to each influencer-initiative combination.

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: personalization_tokens

attributes.name: reply_to_email

attributes.name: status

attributes.name: target_audience_segment

attributes.name: template_code

attributes.name: template_name

attributes.name: template_type

attributes.name: thumbnail_image_url

attributes.name: unsubscribe_link_included

domains.name: supplier
domains.description: SSOT for all vendor and supplier master data including manufacturer profiles, CMT factories, OEM/ODM partners, fabric mills, trim suppliers, and 3PL providers. Manages factory certifications, compliance audits (WRAP, FLA, GOTS, OEKO-TEX), capacity profiles, payment terms, LC terms, and supplier risk scorecards.
domains.references: WRAP, FLA, ISO 9001, SAP S/4HANA MM

products.name: vendor
products.description: Master record for all supplier and vendor entities in the apparel-fashion supply chain, including CMT factories, OEM/ODM partners, fabric mills, trim suppliers, 3PL providers, and raw material vendors. Captures legal entity name, registration number, country of origin, vendor type (CMT/OEM/ODM/Mill/Trim/3PL), tier classification (Tier 1/2/3), business status, primary contact, headquarters address, currency, payment terms, incoterms, FOB port, lead time, MOQ thresholds, EDI capability flag, VMI eligibility, onboarding stage, onboarding checklist completion percentage, onboarding manager, target go-live date, onboarding completion date, go-live date, and final approval date. SSOT for all vendor identity, commercial terms, and lifecycle status (including onboarding workflow state) across sourcing, production, and supply chain domains.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor entity. Primary key for the vendor master record.

attributes.name: bank_account_number
attributes.description: Vendor's bank account number used for electronic payment transfers and settlements.

attributes.name: bank_name
attributes.description: Name of the financial institution where the vendor maintains their primary business banking account.

attributes.name: business_registration_number
attributes.description: Official government-issued business registration or tax identification number for the vendor entity.

attributes.name: business_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the vendor relationship indicating whether the vendor is actively engaged, suspended, or terminated.

attributes.name: compliance_certifications
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of compliance certifications held by the vendor, such as WRAP, FLA, GOTS, OEKO-TEX, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, BCI, or other industry-recognized standards.
attributes.references: Global Compliance Standards (WRAP, FLA, GOTS, OEKO-TEX, ISO)

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code representing the primary country where the vendor is legally registered and operates.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the vendor record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code representing the primary currency used for transactions and payments with this vendor.

attributes.name: edi_capable_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the vendor has the technical capability to exchange business documents electronically using EDI standards.

attributes.name: final_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor received final executive or procurement approval to be added to the approved vendor list.

attributes.name: fob_port
attributes.description: Name of the port or location where goods are loaded for shipment and where ownership and risk transfer from vendor to buyer under FOB terms.

attributes.name: go_live_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the vendor became operational and began fulfilling orders or providing services to the business.

attributes.name: headquarters_address
attributes.description: Full physical address of the vendor's primary headquarters or registered office location.

attributes.name: incoterms
attributes.description: Standard trade terms defining the responsibilities, costs, and risks associated with the transportation and delivery of goods between buyer and seller. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent compliance, quality, or social responsibility audit conducted at the vendor's facilities.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the vendor record was most recently updated or modified.

attributes.name: lc_terms_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Letter of Credit (LC) Terms Required Flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the vendor requires payment to be secured through a letter of credit for international transactions.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard number of days required from purchase order placement to delivery of goods or completion of services by the vendor.

attributes.name: legal_entity_name
attributes.description: The full legal registered name of the vendor as it appears on official business registration documents and contracts.

attributes.name: moq_units
attributes.description: Minimum number of units that must be ordered from the vendor in a single purchase order to meet their production or business requirements.

attributes.name: moq_value
attributes.description: Minimum monetary value required for a purchase order to be accepted by the vendor, expressed in the vendor's currency.

attributes.name: next_audit_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next compliance or quality audit to be conducted at the vendor's facilities.

attributes.name: onboarding_completion_date
attributes.description: Actual date when all onboarding activities and checklist items were completed and the vendor was approved for activation.

attributes.name: onboarding_completion_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of onboarding checklist items completed, calculated as completed tasks divided by total required tasks, expressed as a decimal (0.00 to 100.00).

attributes.name: onboarding_manager
attributes.description: Name of the internal employee or team responsible for managing the vendor onboarding process and ensuring completion of all required steps.

attributes.name: onboarding_stage
attributes.description: Current stage in the vendor onboarding workflow process, tracking progress from initial documentation through final approval and system setup. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Not Started|Documentation|Compliance Review|Factory Audit|Contract Negotiation|System Setup|Approved|Completed — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Negotiated payment terms defining the timeline and conditions for payment, such as Net 30, Net 60, or advance payment requirements.
attributes.references: International Chamber of Commerce Payment Terms

attributes.name: preferred_vendor_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the vendor has been designated as a preferred or strategic supplier with priority consideration for new business.

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary business contact for vendor communications and correspondence.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary business contact person at the vendor organization for operational communications.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for reaching the vendor's main business contact.

attributes.name: production_capacity_units_per_month
attributes.business_glossary_term: Production Capacity in Units Per Month
attributes.description: Maximum number of units the vendor can produce or supply per month based on their current production capacity and resources.

attributes.name: quality_rating_score
attributes.description: Vendor quality performance score based on defect rates, compliance with specifications, and quality audit results, typically on a scale of 0.00 to 5.00.

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: Composite risk assessment score evaluating the vendor across financial stability, geopolitical risk, compliance history, and operational reliability, typically on a scale of 0.00 to 10.00.

attributes.name: swift_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT) Code
attributes.description: International bank identifier code used for cross-border wire transfers and international payments to the vendor.

attributes.name: target_go_live_date
attributes.description: Planned date when the vendor is expected to be fully operational and ready to begin fulfilling orders or providing services.

attributes.name: tax_id_number
attributes.description: Government-issued tax identification number used for tax reporting and compliance purposes in the vendor's country of operation.

attributes.name: tier_classification
attributes.description: Supply chain tier level indicating the vendor's position in the supply chain hierarchy. Tier 1 represents direct suppliers, Tier 2 represents suppliers to Tier 1, and so on.

attributes.name: vendor_code
attributes.description: Internal business identifier or short code used to reference the vendor in operational systems, purchase orders, and transactions.

attributes.name: vendor_type
attributes.description: Classification of the vendor based on the type of goods or services provided. CMT (Cut Make Trim) for contract manufacturers, OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer), ODM (Original Design Manufacturer), Fabric Mill for textile suppliers, Trim Supplier for accessories, 3PL (Third-Party Logistics) for logistics providers. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CMT|OEM|ODM|Fabric Mill|Trim Supplier|3PL|Raw Material|Packaging|Logistics|Other — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: vmi_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the vendor is eligible and approved to participate in vendor-managed inventory programs where they manage stock levels at buyer locations.

products.name: supplier_factory
products.description: Detailed operational profile of a manufacturing facility associated with a vendor, capturing factory name, physical address, country, region, factory type (Cut-Make-Trim, Full Package, Knitting, Weaving, Dyeing, Finishing, Embroidery), production capacity (units/month), number of production lines, workforce headcount, floor area (sqm), machinery types, product categories manufactured, gender specialization (menswear/womenswear/kidswear), minimum order quantity (MOQ), lead time (days), shift structure, and operational status. Distinct from the vendor legal entity — one vendor may operate multiple factories.
products.reference: Infor PLM Factory Profile / Centric PLM Supplier Factory

attributes.name: supplier_factory_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the manufacturing facility. Primary key for the supplier factory entity.

attributes.name: manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Factories require operational managers for day-to-day oversight, performance accountability, compliance coordination, and escalation. Critical for factory scorecards, audit coordination, and capacity

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent vendor or supplier legal entity that owns or operates this factory. One supplier may operate multiple factories.

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the factory facility including building number and street name.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address information such as suite, floor, or industrial zone designation.

attributes.name: audit_score
attributes.description: Most recent audit score or rating (typically 0-100 scale) reflecting compliance with labor standards, workplace safety, environmental practices, and quality systems. Used for supplier risk assessment and scorecard reporting.

attributes.name: certifications
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of current valid certifications held by the factory (e.g., WRAP, FLA, GOTS, OEKO-TEX Standard 100, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, BCI, BSCI). Required for compliance verification and ethical sourcing.
attributes.references: WRAP, FLA, GOTS, OEKO-TEX, ISO Standards

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the factory is located.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code identifying the country where the factory is located. Critical for trade compliance, duty calculation, and country-of-origin labeling per FTC requirements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this factory record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for transactions with this factory. Used for pricing, purchase orders, and financial settlement.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email contact for factory operations, production coordination, and quality communications.

attributes.name: established_date
attributes.description: Date when the factory was originally established or began operations. Indicates factory maturity and operational experience.

attributes.name: factory_code
attributes.description: Internal alphanumeric code assigned to uniquely identify the factory within the enterprise sourcing system. Used in purchase orders and production planning.

attributes.name: factory_name
attributes.description: Official business name of the manufacturing facility as registered with local authorities.

attributes.name: factory_type
attributes.description: Classification of the manufacturing facility based on its primary production capability. Cut-Make-Trim (CMT) factories perform assembly only; Full Package factories handle design through production; specialized factories focus on fabric production or finishing processes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Cut-Make-Trim|Full Package|Knitting|Weaving|Dyeing|Finishing|Embroidery — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: floor_area_sqm
attributes.description: Total manufacturing floor space in square meters. Used to assess factory scale, capacity utilization, and compliance with workplace safety standards.

attributes.name: gender_specialization
attributes.description: Primary gender category focus of the factory production capability. Some factories specialize in specific gender categories due to sizing, fit, and construction expertise.

attributes.name: incoterms
attributes.description: Standard Incoterms code defining the division of costs, risks, and responsibilities between buyer and seller for shipments from this factory. FOB (Free on Board) is most common in apparel sourcing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FOB|CIF|DDP|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent compliance or quality audit conducted at the factory. Used to track audit frequency and identify factories due for re-audit per WRAP and FLA requirements.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this factory record was last updated. Supports change tracking and data governance.

attributes.name: last_order_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent purchase order placed with this factory. Used to identify inactive suppliers and manage supplier lifecycle.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard production lead time from purchase order confirmation to ex-factory shipment readiness, measured in calendar days. Used for Time and Action (TNA) calendar planning and On Time In Full (OTIF) performance tracking.
attributes.references: Infor PLM Time and Action Calendar

attributes.name: machinery_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of key machinery and equipment types available at the factory (e.g., single-needle machines, overlock machines, flatlock machines, buttonhole machines, pressing equipment, cutting tables). Determines production capabilities and product suitability.

attributes.name: moq_units
attributes.description: Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) required by the factory per style or purchase order, measured in units. Critical for order planning and vendor negotiation.

attributes.name: next_audit_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next compliance or certification audit. Factories must maintain current audit status to remain active in the approved supplier network.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, special instructions, quality observations, or compliance remarks related to the factory.

attributes.name: number_of_production_lines
attributes.description: Total count of active production lines or assembly lines operating within the factory. Indicates scale and parallel production capability.

attributes.name: onboarding_date
attributes.description: Date when the factory was approved and onboarded into the enterprise supplier network. Marks the start of the business relationship.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the factory in the supplier network. Active factories are approved for production; Suspended factories are temporarily blocked due to compliance or quality issues; Under Audit factories are undergoing certification review.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Standard payment terms negotiated with the factory (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, 30% deposit + 70% on shipment, Letter of Credit at sight). Impacts cash flow planning and supplier relationship management.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact telephone number for the factory including country and area codes.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the factory location.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary factory contact person responsible for production coordination and communication with the buying organization.

attributes.name: primary_contact_title
attributes.description: Job title or role of the primary factory contact (e.g., Factory Manager, Production Director, Merchandising Manager).

attributes.name: product_categories_manufactured
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of product categories the factory is equipped to manufacture (e.g., T-shirts, Dresses, Outerwear, Denim, Activewear, Footwear, Accessories). Used for supplier selection and product allocation.

attributes.name: production_capacity_units_per_month
attributes.description: Maximum monthly production capacity of the factory measured in units (garments, pieces, or pairs). Used for capacity planning, order allocation, and Open-to-Buy (OTB) calculations.

attributes.name: region
attributes.description: Broader geographic region classification for sourcing strategy and logistics planning (e.g., South Asia, Southeast Asia, East Asia, Europe, Americas).

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Overall supplier risk classification based on audit results, compliance history, financial stability, geopolitical factors, and operational performance. High or Critical risk factories require enhanced monitoring and corrective action plans.

attributes.name: shift_structure
attributes.description: Daily shift operation model of the factory. Indicates production hours and capacity flexibility. Triple shift operations provide maximum throughput but require strong labor compliance oversight.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region where the factory operates.

attributes.name: workforce_headcount
attributes.description: Total number of employees working at the factory including production workers, supervisors, quality control staff, and administrative personnel. Required for labor compliance audits.

products.name: vendor_contact
products.description: Individual contact persons associated with a vendor or factory, capturing full name, job title, department, email, phone, WhatsApp/WeChat handle, preferred communication channel, language, role type (Account Manager, QC Liaison, Compliance Officer, Logistics Coordinator, Finance Contact), primary contact flag, and active status. Supports multi-contact management per vendor for sourcing, production, compliance, and logistics workflows.

attributes.name: vendor_contact_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor contact person. Primary key.

attributes.name: internal_relationship_owner_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Internal Relationship Owner Employee Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Each vendor contact has an internal relationship owner (buyer, sourcing manager, QA lead) responsible for coordination, communication, and issue resolution. Essential for vendor management workflows,

attributes.name: supplier_factory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.supplier_factory. Business justification: Vendor contacts can be factory-specific (factory manager, production planner, QC supervisor) or vendor-level (corporate procurement, finance). Currently vendor_contact only has vendor_id. Adding facto

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vendor or supplier organization this contact is associated with. Links to the vendor master record.

attributes.name: authorization_level
attributes.description: Level of decision-making authority the contact has within the vendor organization (e.g., Operational, Managerial, Executive). Used to determine appropriate escalation paths and approval workflows.

attributes.name: certification_credentials
attributes.description: Professional certifications or credentials held by the contact relevant to their role (e.g., WRAP Auditor, GOTS Certified, Six Sigma Black Belt, ISO 9001 Lead Auditor). Supports compliance verification and quality assurance.

attributes.name: contact_first_name
attributes.description: First name or given name of the vendor contact person.

attributes.name: contact_full_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the vendor contact person, including first name, middle name, and last name.

attributes.name: contact_last_name
attributes.description: Last name or family name of the vendor contact person.

attributes.name: contact_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the vendor contact record. Indicates whether the contact is actively engaged, temporarily unavailable, or no longer with the vendor organization.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vendor contact record was first created in the system. Used for audit trails and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: Department or functional area within the vendor organization where the contact works (e.g., Sales, Quality Assurance, Compliance, Logistics, Finance, Production).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this contact person's role ended or they ceased to be the designated contact. Null if the contact is currently active. Used for contact history tracking and audit trails.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this contact person began their role with the vendor or became the designated contact for this business relationship. Used for contact history tracking and audit trails.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary business email address of the vendor contact person. Used for official communications, purchase orders, and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_number
attributes.description: Emergency contact phone number for urgent situations requiring immediate vendor response, such as production issues, quality failures, or compliance incidents.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4, CCPA Section 1798.140, ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this contact is currently active and should be used for communications. True if active, False if inactive or no longer with the vendor organization.

attributes.name: is_primary_contact
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this contact is the primary point of contact for the vendor. True if primary, False otherwise. Only one primary contact should exist per vendor per role type.

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: Official job title or position of the contact within the vendor organization (e.g., Account Manager, Quality Control Manager, Compliance Officer, Production Coordinator).

attributes.name: language_preference
attributes.description: Primary language(s) spoken by the contact for business communications. Supports multilingual vendor management and reduces miscommunication risk. Use ISO 639-1 two-letter codes (e.g., EN, ZH, ES, FR, IT, PT, DE, JA, KO, VI, BN, HI).

attributes.name: last_contact_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent communication or interaction with this vendor contact. Used for relationship management and engagement tracking.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vendor contact record was last updated or modified. Used for audit trails, change tracking, and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: mobile_number
attributes.description: Mobile phone number of the vendor contact person for urgent communications and field coordination.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4, CCPA Section 1798.140, ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or context about the vendor contact. May include communication preferences, special instructions, relationship history, or other relevant information.

attributes.name: office_location
attributes.description: Physical office location or site where the contact is based within the vendor organization (e.g., factory name, office branch, city). Used for site visit planning and logistics coordination.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary business phone number of the vendor contact person, including country code and extension if applicable.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4, CCPA Section 1798.140, ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: preferred_communication_channel
attributes.description: The contact's preferred method of communication for routine business interactions. Used to optimize communication effectiveness and response times.

attributes.name: reporting_manager_name
attributes.description: Name of the contact's direct manager or supervisor within the vendor organization. Used for escalation paths and organizational context.

attributes.name: role_type
attributes.description: Standardized role classification indicating the primary function of the contact in the vendor relationship. Used for routing communications and workflow assignments.
attributes.value_regex: Account Manager|QC Liaison|Compliance Officer|Logistics Coordinator|Finance Contact|Production Manager

attributes.name: specialization_area
attributes.description: Specific area of expertise or specialization of the contact within their role (e.g., Fabric Sourcing, Garment Construction, Chemical Compliance, Export Documentation, Quality Testing). Used for routing specialized inquiries.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: Time zone of the vendor contact's primary work location. Used for scheduling meetings and coordinating communications across global supply chains. Use IANA time zone database format (e.g., Asia/Shanghai, America/New_York, Europe/London).

attributes.name: wechat_handle
attributes.description: WeChat contact identifier or username used for instant messaging communication with the vendor contact, commonly used for China-based suppliers.

attributes.name: whatsapp_handle
attributes.description: WhatsApp contact identifier (typically phone number) used for instant messaging communication with the vendor contact, commonly used in international sourcing operations.

attributes.name: years_of_experience
attributes.description: Number of years of professional experience the contact has in their field or role. Used for assessing vendor capability and relationship strength.

products.name: vendor_bank_account
products.description: Banking and payment settlement details for vendors, including bank name, bank country, account holder name, IBAN/account number, SWIFT/BIC code, routing number, currency, payment method (Wire/ACH/LC/TT), Letter of Credit (LC) terms, LC issuing bank, LC expiry date, preferred payment terms (Net 30/60/90, FOB, LDP), and account verification status. Critical for AP processing, LC issuance, and cross-border payment compliance. Owned by the supplier domain as part of vendor master.

attributes.name: vendor_bank_account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor bank account record. Primary key.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor or supplier that owns this bank account. Links to the vendor master record.

attributes.name: account_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the bank account. Determines the settlement currency for payments and impacts foreign exchange requirements.

attributes.name: account_holder_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the account holder as registered with the bank. Must match vendor legal name for payment processing and compliance verification.

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: Bank account number for the vendor. Format varies by country and banking system. Used for domestic and international payment processing.
attributes.references: PCI DSS - Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the vendor bank account. Active accounts are eligible for payment processing; inactive/suspended/closed accounts are blocked from new payments.

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Type of bank account (checking, savings, current, business, escrow). Determines payment processing rules and settlement timing.

attributes.name: bank_address
attributes.description: Full address of the bank branch or headquarters. Required for international payment routing and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: bank_branch_code
attributes.description: Branch identifier or sort code used for domestic payment routing. Format varies by country (e.g., UK sort code, Indian IFSC code).

attributes.name: bank_branch_name
attributes.description: Name of the specific bank branch where the account is held. Used for domestic payment routing and vendor communication.

attributes.name: bank_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code of the bank's domicile. Critical for cross-border payment routing, foreign exchange, and compliance with international sanctions and trade regulations.

attributes.name: bank_name
attributes.description: Full name of the financial institution holding the account. Used for payment routing and vendor master data management.

attributes.name: beneficiary_address
attributes.description: Full address of the account beneficiary. Required for international wire transfers and compliance with anti-money laundering (AML) regulations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this bank account record was first created in the system. Used for audit trails and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this bank account is no longer valid for payment processing. Null indicates an open-ended account. Used for account lifecycle management and historical tracking.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this bank account becomes effective for payment processing. Supports time-based account activation and vendor onboarding workflows.

attributes.name: external_reference_code
attributes.description: External identifier for this bank account in the source system or vendor portal. Used for cross-system reconciliation and data integration.

attributes.name: iban
attributes.description: International Bank Account Number for cross-border payments within SEPA and other regions. Standardized format for international payment routing.

attributes.name: intermediary_bank_name
attributes.description: Name of the intermediary or correspondent bank used for routing international payments when direct settlement is not available. Common in cross-border transactions.

attributes.name: intermediary_bank_swift_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Intermediary Bank Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT) Code
attributes.description: SWIFT/BIC code of the intermediary bank. Required for routing payments through correspondent banking networks in international transactions.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this bank account record was last updated. Used for change tracking, audit trails, and data synchronization.

attributes.name: last_payment_amount
attributes.description: Amount of the most recent payment processed to this bank account in the account currency. Used for payment pattern analysis and fraud detection.

attributes.name: last_payment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent payment processed to this bank account. Used for account activity monitoring and dormant account identification.

attributes.name: corrective_action_due_date

attributes.name: corrective_action_required_flag
