Pending indicates corrective actions have been identified but not yet started. In progress indicates corrective actions are being implemented. Completed indicates corrective actions have been implemented and are awaiting verification. Verified indicates corrective actions have been verified by the certifying body. Overdue indicates corrective actions have not been completed by the due date.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: minor_findings_count

attributes.name: next_audit_date

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: renewal_initiated_date

attributes.name: renewal_status

Renewal in progress indicates renewal audit or documentation review is underway. Renewal completed indicates certification has been successfully renewed. attributes.name: risk_rating

attributes.name: scope_of_certification

products.name: supplier_audit_finding

attributes.name: supplier_audit_finding_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the supplier audit finding record. Primary key for the supplier audit finding entity.

attributes.name: compliance_audit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent compliance or quality audit during which this finding was identified.

attributes.name: actual_closure_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the corrective action was completed, verified, and the finding was formally closed. Null if the finding remains open.

attributes.name: auditor_notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, observations, or context provided by the auditor regarding the finding, including mitigating factors, supplier cooperation, or special circumstances.

attributes.name: business_impact
attributes.description: Description of the potential or actual business impact of the finding, including production delays, quality issues, regulatory penalties, reputational risk, or supply chain disruption.

attributes.name: closure_status
attributes.description: Current status of the finding in the corrective action lifecycle. Open: newly identified, action not started. In Progress: corrective action underway. Pending Verification: action completed, awaiting verification. Closed: verified and accepted. Overdue: past target closure date without completion.

attributes.name: corrective_action_required
attributes.description: Detailed description of the corrective action plan (CAP) required to remediate the finding, including specific steps, process changes, training requirements, or infrastructure improvements needed.

attributes.name: cost_to_remediate
attributes.description: Estimated or actual cost incurred by the supplier to implement the corrective action and remediate the finding, including infrastructure upgrades, training, process changes, or equipment purchases.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this supplier audit finding record was first created in the system, following the format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the cost to remediate amount, such as USD, EUR, CNY, or INR.

attributes.name: escalation_date

attributes.name: escalation_flag

attributes.name: evidence_document_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to supporting evidence documentation for the finding, including photographs, audit reports, corrective action plans, or verification records stored in the document management system.

attributes.name: finding_category

attributes.name: finding_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the non-conformance finding, including specific observations, conditions found, and evidence collected during the audit.

attributes.name: finding_identified_date
attributes.description: Date when the non-conformance finding was first identified during the audit inspection or assessment.

attributes.name: finding_reference_number
attributes.description: Business-readable unique reference number assigned to this non-conformance finding for tracking and communication purposes.

attributes.name: finding_subcategory
attributes.description: Detailed subcategory or specific compliance area within the primary finding category, providing granular classification for analysis and reporting.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this supplier audit finding record was last updated or modified, following the format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for tracking changes to corrective action status, closure dates, or verification results.

attributes.name: previous_finding_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the previous finding if this is identified as a repeat finding, enabling linkage and trend analysis of recurring non-conformances.

attributes.name: regulatory_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the specific regulatory requirement, standard clause, or compliance framework that was violated or not met, such as WRAP Principle 3, FLA Code Section 2.1, or OEKO-TEX Standard 100 Annex 6.

attributes.name: repeat_finding_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) identifying whether this finding is a repeat occurrence of a previously identified and closed non-conformance at the same supplier, indicating systemic compliance issues or ineffective corrective actions.

attributes.name: responsible_party_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual or role at the supplier factory responsible for implementing the corrective action and ensuring closure of the finding.

attributes.name: responsible_party_title
attributes.description: Job title or position of the responsible party at the supplier factory, such as Factory Manager, Compliance Officer, or Health & Safety Coordinator.

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: Quantitative risk score assigned to the finding based on severity, likelihood of recurrence, and potential business impact, used for prioritization and supplier risk assessment.

attributes.name: root_cause_analysis
attributes.description: Analysis of the underlying root cause of the non-conformance, identifying systemic issues, process gaps, or resource constraints that led to the finding.

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Classification of the finding's severity based on risk and impact. Critical: immediate threat to worker safety or legal compliance, requires immediate action. attributes.name: target_closure_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the corrective action must be completed and the finding closed, based on severity level and agreed-upon remediation timeline.

attributes.name: verification_date

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify completion and effectiveness of the corrective action, such as document review, on-site re-inspection, remote verification via photos/videos, or third-party audit.

attributes.name: verified_by

products.name: delivery_schedule
products.description: Time and Action (T&A) calendar defining the critical path from design handoff to ex-factory shipment for a production order or style at a specific factory. Contains calendar header (season, style reference, factory, T&A template version, overall status) and embedded milestone records (milestone name, type such as Sample/Approval/Production/Shipment, planned date, actual date, days variance, responsible party, completion status, escalation flag, comments). Standard milestones include design approval, tech pack issue, fabric booking, PP sample submission/approval, bulk fabric in-house, cut date, sew completion, finishing, final inspection, and ex-factory date. SSOT for factory-execution T&A tracking within the supplier domain. Sourcing domain owns strategic T&A planning; this product owns operational milestone execution at the factory level.

products.name: factory_sourcing_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the operational allocation between supplier factories and sourcing agreements in the apparel manufacturing network. It captures factory-specific terms within multi-factory vendor relationships, including capacity commitments, pricing variations, volume allocations, and exclusivity arrangements that exist only when a specific factory is designated to fulfill a sourcing agreement. Each record links one supplier factory to one sourcing agreement with attributes reflecting the negotiated terms for that factory-agreement pairing.. Existence Justification: In apparel sourcing operations, vendors commonly operate multiple manufacturing facilities with different capabilities, and strategic sourcing agreements are executed across multiple factories to diversify risk, leverage specialized capabilities, and meet volume commitments. A single sourcing agreement covering 100,000 units may allocate 40,000 to Factory A (knitting specialist), 35,000 to Factory B (dyeing/finishing), and 25,000 to Factory C (CMT operations). Conversely, a high-performing factory participates in multiple concurrent sourcing agreements across different seasons, product categories, and buyer divisions. The business actively manages these factory-agreement allocations with factory-specific pricing, capacity reservations, exclusivity terms, and volume commitments.

products.name: vendor_defect_occurrence
products.description: This association product represents the operational tracking of quality defects observed at specific vendors in the apparel-fashion supply chain. It captures vendor-specific defect patterns, frequency, cost impact, and corrective action effectiveness for supplier scorecarding and quality improvement programs. Each record links one quality defect type to one vendor with attributes that exist only in the context of this vendor-defect relationship, enabling Pareto analysis, supplier quality rating, and targeted CAPA initiatives.. Existence Justification: In apparel-fashion supply chain operations, quality defects are tracked at the vendor level to enable supplier scorecarding, quality improvement programs, and sourcing decisions. A single defect type (e.g., 'seam puckering') occurs across multiple vendors with different frequencies and root causes, and each vendor exhibits multiple defect types across their production. The business actively manages vendor-specific defect patterns through CAPA workflows, cost tracking, and recurrence analysis—this is not a derived analytical correlation but an operational quality management process.

products.name: vendor_quality_compliance

It captures vendor-specific compliance status, audit schedules, certification requirements, and quality performance tracking for each quality standard that applies to each vendor. Each record links one quality standard to one vendor with attributes that exist only in the context of this compliance relationship, enabling tracking of multi-standard compliance per vendor and multi-vendor applicability per standard.. products.name: vendor_relationship
products.description: This association product represents the operational assignment between internal employees and external vendors in the apparel-fashion supply chain. It captures which employees are authorized to interact with which vendors, in what capacity, and for what time period. Each record links one vendor to one employee with role-specific attributes that exist only in the context of this working relationship. This is distinct from vendor_contact (which tracks external vendor personnel) and represents internal employee-to-vendor assignments for sourcing, quality, compliance, and technical collaboration.. Existence Justification: In apparel-fashion sourcing operations, vendors are managed by multiple internal employees in different functional capacities simultaneously (a buyer negotiates commercial terms, a quality manager oversees QA, a compliance auditor conducts social audits, a technical designer collaborates on product development). Each employee manages a portfolio of multiple vendors, often specialized by product category or material type. The business actively manages these assignments with role definitions, authorization levels, and time-bound effective periods.

products.description: This association product represents the compliance testing and monitoring relationship between vendors and restricted substances in the apparel-fashion supply chain. It captures vendor-specific testing protocols, test results, and compliance status for chemical management and product safety clearance. Each record links one vendor to one restricted substance with attributes that exist only in the context of this compliance relationship, enabling tracking of which vendors have been tested for which substances, when, and with what results.. Existence Justification: In apparel-fashion supply chain operations, vendors must comply with multiple restricted substance regulations (REACH, Prop 65, CPSIA), and each restricted substance applies to multiple vendors. The business actively manages vendor-specific testing protocols, test schedules, test results, and compliance status for each vendor-substance combination as part of chemical management and product safety clearance processes. This is an operational compliance monitoring relationship, not an analytical correlation.

attributes.name: cost_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the unit cost (e.g., USD, EUR, CNY).

attributes.name: cost_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the unit cost (e.g., per yard, per meter, per kilogram, per piece).

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the country where the material is manufactured. Required for customs and trade compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Country Codes, Federal Trade Commission (FTC) Country of Origin Labeling

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the material sourcing record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: development_season
attributes.description: Season or collection for which this material was developed (e.g., 'SS24', 'FW24', 'Holiday 2024'). Links material to merchandising calendar.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System Assortment Planning

attributes.name: development_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the material in the product development and sourcing workflow.

attributes.name: fiber_content
attributes.description: Composition of the material by fiber type and percentage (e.g., '100% Organic Cotton', '65% Polyester 35% Cotton', 'Metal: Brass'). Required for FTC textile labeling compliance.
attributes.references: Federal Trade Commission (FTC) Textile Fiber Products Identification Act

attributes.name: fob_cost
attributes.description: Free on Board cost including material cost and delivery to port of shipment. Used for total landed cost calculation.

attributes.name: gots_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Global Organic Textile Standard (GOTS) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the material meets Global Organic Textile Standard (GOTS) requirements for organic fiber content and sustainable processing.

attributes.name: hs_code
attributes.description: Harmonized System code for customs classification and international trade. Required for import/export documentation and duty calculation.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the material sourcing record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard lead time in days from purchase order placement to material delivery. Used in Time and Action (TNA) calendar planning.
attributes.references: Infor PLM Sourcing, Time and Action Calendar

attributes.name: moq_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum order quantity required by the mill or supplier for this material. Critical for procurement planning and costing.

attributes.name: moq_unit
attributes.business_glossary_term: Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) Unit of Measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the MOQ (e.g., yards, meters, kilograms, pieces).

attributes.name: oeko_tex_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the material has OEKO-TEX Standard 100 certification for textile safety and absence of harmful substances.

attributes.name: pp_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the material received Pre-Production approval. Key milestone in the Time and Action (TNA) calendar.

attributes.name: pp_approval_status
attributes.description: Pre-Production approval status for the material. Indicates whether the material has passed quality and specification review for production use.

attributes.name: sample_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether a physical sample of this material is available in the Sample Management System (SMS) for design review and approval.

attributes.name: sample_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number for the physical sample in the Sample Management System (SMS) if available.

attributes.name: sustainability_score
attributes.description: Composite sustainability score for the material based on environmental impact, certifications, and sourcing practices. Scale 0-100.

attributes.name: test_report_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether lab test reports (e.g., colorfastness, shrinkage, tensile strength) are available for this material.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management, Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC)

attributes.name: test_report_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or document identifier for the lab test report if available.

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: Cost per unit of the material in the base currency. Used for Bill of Materials (BOM) costing and Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master, Infor PLM Sourcing

attributes.name: weight_gsm
attributes.description: Weight of the fabric material measured in grams per square meter. Key specification for fabric performance and costing.
attributes.references: ISO 3801 Textiles - Woven fabrics - Determination of mass per unit length and mass per unit area

attributes.name: width_inches
attributes.description: Usable width of the fabric material measured in inches. Critical for yield calculation and cutting efficiency.
attributes.references: ISO 3932 Textiles - Woven fabrics - Determination of width

products.name: fabric_development
products.description: Fabric development record tracking the lifecycle of a new fabric from concept through mill approval. Captures fabric name, construction, fiber blend, colorway, finish, target hand-feel, lab dip status, strike-off approval, bulk yardage commitment, and development season. Manages the iterative mill development process including submission rounds, test results, and final bulk approval.

attributes.name: fabric_development_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fabric development record. Primary key for tracking a fabric through its entire development lifecycle from concept to bulk approval.

attributes.name: collection_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product collection for which this fabric is being developed. Links fabric development to specific merchandising collections.

attributes.name: concept_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to design.concept. Business justification: Fabric development projects originate from design concepts requiring custom fabric creation. Enables concept-to-fabric development traceability, concept-level fabric innovation tracking, and design co

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Fabric development costs must be allocated to cost centers for R&D expense tracking, product development budgeting, and innovation cost management - standard practice in apparel product development fi

attributes.name: developer_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Fabric development is led by textile developers who manage lab dips, strike-offs, and bulk approvals. Tracks ownership for fabric innovation, quality issues, and development timelines. Normalizes deno

attributes.name: environmental_impact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.environmental_impact. Business justification: New fabric developments require environmental impact assessments (LCA) for sustainability evaluation and material selection decisions. Enables comparison of development alternatives based on environme

attributes.name: material_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.material. Business justification: Fabric development results in approved materials added to material library. Critical for BOM integration and material master data. Sourcing teams link approved fabrics to material master for reuse.

attributes.name: product_safety_test_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.product_safety_test. Business justification: New fabric developments require safety testing (azo dyes, formaldehyde, phthalates, lead) before bulk approval. Fabric approval gate requires passing test results. Development teams track test status

attributes.name: production_factory_id
attributes.description: Reference to the textile mill or fabric supplier responsible for developing and producing this fabric. Links to supplier master data.

attributes.name: rfq_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sourcing.rfq. Business justification: Fabric development can be initiated via RFQs sent to mills. This FK links fabric development to the RFQ that initiated it, providing traceability from solicitation to fabric approval. No bidirectional

attributes.name: sourcing_material_sourcing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sourcing.material_sourcing. Business justification: Fabric development records track the lifecycle of new fabrics, which should reference the material sourcing master record. This FK links fabric development to the material master, enabling consolidate

attributes.name: style_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.style. Business justification: Fabric development is initiated for specific styles. Needed for style-fabric linkage, development tracking, and fabric approval workflow. Design and sourcing teams link fabric development to target st

attributes.name: sustainable_material_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.sustainable_material. Business justification: Fabric development projects target sustainable material specifications for new collections. Links R&D efforts to sustainability material library. Essential for tracking sustainable innovation pipeline

attributes.name: bulk_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the fabric received final bulk approval. Enables procurement to issue Purchase Orders (PO) for production yardage.

attributes.name: bulk_approval_status
attributes.description: Final approval status for bulk production of the fabric. Indicates whether the fabric is cleared for large-scale manufacturing and Purchase Order (PO) placement.

attributes.name: bulk_yardage_commitment
attributes.description: Total yardage or meterage of fabric committed for bulk production. Used for capacity planning and Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) negotiations with the mill.

attributes.name: colorway
attributes.description: Color or color combination being developed for this fabric. May include Pantone references, color names, or internal color codes.

attributes.name: cost_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the fabric cost (e.g., USD, EUR, CNY). Required for multi-currency procurement and landed cost calculations.

attributes.name: cost_per_unit
attributes.description: Negotiated cost per unit (yard or meter) of fabric from the mill. Used for Bill of Materials (BOM) costing and Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) calculations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fabric development record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: development_season
attributes.description: The target season for which this fabric is being developed. Format: SS (Spring/Summer), FW (Fall/Winter), SP (Spring), FA (Fall) followed by two-digit year (e.g., SS24, FW25).

attributes.name: development_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fabric development process. Tracks progression from initial concept through mill submissions, lab dip approval, strike-off approval, and final bulk approval. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: concept|submitted|lab_dip_pending|lab_dip_approved|strike_off_pending|strike_off_approved|bulk_approved|rejected|on_hold — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: fabric_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code assigned to the fabric for system identification and cross-referencing across Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems.

attributes.name: fabric_construction
attributes.description: Technical description of the fabric structure including weave type, knit pattern, or construction method (e.g., plain weave, twill, jersey knit, rib knit, interlock).

attributes.name: fabric_name
attributes.description: Business name or marketing name assigned to the fabric being developed. Used for identification in collection planning and merchandising.

attributes.name: fabric_weight
attributes.description: Weight of the fabric measured in grams per square meter (GSM) or ounces per square yard. Critical specification for product costing and performance characteristics.

attributes.name: fabric_width
attributes.description: Width of the fabric measured in inches or centimeters. Standard widths impact cutting efficiency and Bill of Materials (BOM) calculations.

attributes.name: fiber_blend
attributes.description: Composition of fibers used in the fabric with percentages (e.g., 60% Cotton 40% Polyester, 100% Organic Cotton). Must comply with Federal Trade Commission (FTC) fiber content labeling requirements.
attributes.references: FTC Textile Fiber Products Identification Act

attributes.name: finish_treatment
attributes.description: Chemical or mechanical finishing processes applied to the fabric (e.g., enzyme wash, stone wash, water repellent, anti-microbial, wrinkle-free). Impacts hand-feel and performance.

attributes.name: lab_dip_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the lab dip color sample was approved by the design or product development team. Critical milestone in the TNA calendar.

attributes.name: lab_dip_status
attributes.description: Approval status of the lab dip color sample. Lab dip is the initial small-scale color sample submitted by the mill for color approval before bulk production.

attributes.name: lab_dip_submission_date
attributes.description: Date when the lab dip color sample was submitted by the mill for review. Used to track Time and Action (TNA) calendar milestones.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Number of days required from Purchase Order (PO) placement to fabric delivery. Critical for Time and Action (TNA) calendar planning and On Time In Full (OTIF) performance.

attributes.name: mill_reference_number
attributes.description: The mills internal reference or article number for this fabric. Used for communication and ordering with the supplier.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fabric development record was last modified. Audit trail for tracking changes throughout the development lifecycle.

attributes.name: moq_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) required by the mill for this fabric. Critical for procurement planning and cost negotiations.

attributes.name: moq_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) - may be linear measure (yards/meters) or weight (kg) depending on mill requirements.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special instructions, or observations during the fabric development process. Captures iterative feedback and mill communications.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation if the fabric was rejected at any stage (lab dip, strike-off, or bulk). Captures quality issues, color mismatch, hand-feel deviation, or test failures.

attributes.name: strike_off_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the strike-off fabric sample was approved. Approval triggers progression to bulk yardage commitment and Pre-Production (PP) sample phase.

attributes.name: strike_off_status
attributes.description: Approval status of the strike-off sample. Strike-off is a larger fabric sample (typically 1-2 yards) that demonstrates the final fabric construction, color, and finish.

attributes.name: strike_off_submission_date
attributes.description: Date when the strike-off fabric sample was submitted by the mill for review. Key TNA milestone before bulk production commitment.

attributes.name: submission_round
attributes.description: Sequential number indicating which iteration of fabric submission this represents. Tracks the number of times the mill has resubmitted samples for approval.

attributes.name: sustainability_certification
attributes.description: Environmental or ethical certifications held by the fabric (e.g., GOTS, BCI, OEKO-TEX, Bluesign, GRS). Supports sustainability reporting and compliance.
attributes.references: Global Organic Textile Standard (GOTS), Better Cotton Initiative (BCI), OEKO-TEX Standard 100

attributes.name: target_hand_feel
attributes.description: Desired tactile characteristics and drape of the fabric as specified by the design team (e.g., soft, crisp, fluid, structured, brushed).

attributes.name: test_results_summary
attributes.description: Summary of physical and chemical test results performed on the fabric (e.g., colorfastness, shrinkage, pilling resistance, tensile strength). Links to detailed lab test reports.
attributes.references: AATCC Test Methods, ASTM Textile Standards

attributes.name: weight_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for fabric weight. GSM (grams per square meter) is metric standard; oz per square yard is imperial standard.

attributes.name: width_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for fabric width (inches or centimeters).

attributes.name: yardage_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for bulk yardage commitment (yards or meters).

products.name: lab_dip
products.description: Lab dip approval record tracking the color development and approval process for a fabric or material. Captures colorway reference, Pantone/color standard, dye lot, mill submission date, evaluation result (approved, rejected, resubmit), delta-E measurement, submission round number, and final approval date. Critical for color accuracy compliance before bulk fabric production commitment.

attributes.name: lab_dip_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the lab dip approval record. Primary key for tracking color development and approval process for fabric or material.

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Lab dips are approved by color managers or product developers who verify Pantone accuracy and color fastness. Tracks approval authority for color standards, critical for quality control and vendor acc

attributes.name: chemical_compliance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.chemical_compliance. Business justification: Lab dips must be tested for chemical compliance (ZDHC MRSL, restricted substances) before bulk production approval. Quality gate for color development. Links color approval process to chemical testing

attributes.name: colorway_development_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to design.colorway_development. Business justification: Lab dips are color approval samples for specific colorway development projects. Direct 1:1 business relationship. Enables colorway-to-lab-dip traceability, color approval workflow management, and colo

attributes.name: colorway_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.colorway. Business justification: Lab dips are submitted for specific colorways to achieve color standards. Fundamental to color approval process and bulk production authorization. Colorists link lab dips to colorway master for approv

attributes.name: fabric_development_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific fabric or material for which the color is being matched.

attributes.name: material_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.material. Business justification: Lab dips test specific materials for color accuracy and fastness. Needed for material-color approval tracking and dye recipe validation. Sourcing teams link lab dips to material master for quality con

attributes.name: print_colorway_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to design.print_colorway. Business justification: Lab dips validate print colorway color accuracy for printed fabrics. Natural design-to-sourcing validation process. Enables print colorway approval tracking, print color conformance validation, and pr

attributes.name: production_factory_id
attributes.description: Reference to the textile mill or dye house that submitted this lab dip for approval.

attributes.name: sourcing_material_sourcing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sourcing.material_sourcing. Business justification: Lab dips are color approval records for materials. This FK links lab dip approvals to the material sourcing master record, enabling consolidated material color management. No bidirectional conflict ex

attributes.name: style_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product style for which this lab dip color is being developed.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary supplier managing the fabric sourcing and color development process.

attributes.name: actual_lab_a
attributes.description: Measured green-red axis value of the submitted lab dip in CIELAB color space.

attributes.name: actual_lab_b
attributes.description: Measured blue-yellow axis value of the submitted lab dip in CIELAB color space.

attributes.name: actual_lab_l
attributes.description: Measured lightness value of the submitted lab dip in CIELAB color space.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the lab dip received final approval for bulk production. Null if not yet approved. Critical milestone for TNA calendar and PO (Purchase Order) release.
attributes.references: Infor PLM Time and Action Calendar

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the lab dip in the color development workflow. Determines whether bulk fabric production can proceed.

attributes.name: collection_name
attributes.description: Name of the product collection or line to which this color belongs. Used for merchandising and assortment planning.

attributes.name: color_fastness_rating
attributes.description: Rating (1-5 scale) indicating the color fastness performance of the dyed fabric. Higher values indicate better resistance to fading. Based on ISO 105 testing standards.

attributes.name: color_standard_type
attributes.description: Type of color standard used for matching specification (Pantone, LAB values, RGB, CMYK, or physical swatch).

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, observations, or special instructions related to the lab dip evaluation and approval process.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this lab dip record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and process tracking.

attributes.name: delta_e_value
attributes.description: Calculated color difference (Delta E) between target and actual color. Lower values indicate closer match. Typically acceptable range is Delta E < 1.0 for critical color matching.

attributes.name: digital_image_url
attributes.description: URL link to digital photograph or scan of the lab dip sample. Enables remote review and digital archiving.

attributes.name: dye_lot_number
attributes.description: Batch identifier for the dye lot used in this lab dip submission. Critical for traceability and consistency in bulk production.

attributes.name: dye_recipe_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific dye formulation and recipe used for this color. Links to dye house technical specifications.

attributes.name: evaluation_date
attributes.description: Date when the lab dip was evaluated by the design or quality team.

attributes.name: is_strike_off_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a larger strike-off sample (printed or dyed fabric yardage) is required after lab dip approval before bulk production commitment.

attributes.name: lab_dip_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the lab dip submission. Externally-known reference number used across PLM systems and vendor communications.

attributes.name: light_fastness_grade
attributes.description: Grade (1-8 scale) measuring resistance to color change from light exposure. Grade 8 is excellent, grade 1 is poor.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this lab dip record was last modified. Tracks the most recent update to any field in the record.

attributes.name: pantone_reference
attributes.description: Pantone color standard reference code used as the target color specification for matching.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the lab dip was rejected or requires resubmission. Includes specific color matching issues or quality defects.

attributes.name: sample_physical_location
attributes.description: Physical storage location of the lab dip sample swatch (e.g., design studio, quality lab, archive). Used for sample retrieval and reference.

attributes.name: season_code
attributes.description: Code representing the fashion season for which this color is being developed (e.g., SS24 for Spring/Summer 2024, FW24 for Fall/Winter 2024).

attributes.name: spectrophotometer_reading_file
attributes.description: File path or reference to the spectrophotometer measurement data file. Contains detailed color measurement data for technical analysis.

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date when the mill submitted this lab dip sample for evaluation. Critical for Time and Action (TNA) calendar tracking.
attributes.references: Infor PLM Time and Action Calendar

attributes.name: submission_round
attributes.description: Sequential number indicating which submission attempt this represents (1 for first submission, 2 for resubmit, etc.). Tracks iteration count in color approval process.

attributes.name: target_bulk_production_date
attributes.description: Planned date for bulk fabric production to begin. Drives urgency of lab dip approval process within TNA calendar.
attributes.references: Infor PLM Time and Action Calendar

attributes.name: target_lab_a
attributes.description: Target green-red axis value in CIELAB color space. Negative values indicate green, positive indicate red.

attributes.name: target_lab_b
attributes.description: Target blue-yellow axis value in CIELAB color space. Negative values indicate blue, positive indicate yellow.

attributes.name: target_lab_l
attributes.description: Target lightness value in CIELAB color space (0-100 scale). Used for precise color measurement and matching.

attributes.name: wash_fastness_grade
attributes.description: Grade (1-5 scale) measuring resistance to color change from washing. Grade 5 is excellent, grade 1 is poor.

products.name: lead_time_profile
products.description: Master record defining standard lead time parameters for a supplier-product category combination including total lead time, component lead times, and buffer days

attributes.name: lead_time_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the lead time profile record.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sourcing.sourcing_agreement. Business justification: Lead time profiles can be defined and governed by sourcing agreements. This FK links lead time profiles to the agreements that define them, enabling agreement-based lead time management. No bidirectio

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Lead time profiles require cost center assignment for supply chain cost modeling, lead time cost analysis, and procurement planning expense allocation - supports apparel sourcing financial optimizatio

attributes.name: destination_distribution_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.distribution_center. Business justification: Lead time profiles specify target in-DC dates for specific destination facilities; critical for vendor onboarding, PO placement timing, and ensuring sourcing commitments align with DC capacity and ret

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the sourcing manager or planner who approved this lead time profile for operational use.

attributes.name: primary_carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.carrier. Business justification: Lead time profiles include carrier-specific transit times for different lanes and service levels; essential for accurate TNA planning, routing guide alignment, and vendor lead time commitments in appa

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier for which this lead time profile is defined.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when this lead time profile was formally approved and activated for planning purposes.

attributes.name: buffer_days
attributes.description: Additional safety buffer days added to the total lead time to account for variability, delays, and risk mitigation.

attributes.name: capacity_constraint_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier has capacity constraints for this product category that may affect lead time variability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this lead time profile record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: critical_path_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lead time profile is on the critical path for Time and Action (TNA) calendar planning.

attributes.name: customs_clearance_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Number of days required for customs clearance, duty payment, and import documentation processing.

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code representing the destination country for shipment.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this lead time profile becomes active and applicable for planning and sourcing decisions.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date until which this lead time profile remains valid; nullable for open-ended profiles.

attributes.name: fob_port_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the port of loading where goods are handed over to the carrier under FOB terms.

attributes.name: incoterm
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) defining the delivery terms and responsibility transfer point between supplier and buyer.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when this lead time profile was last reviewed and validated against actual performance data.

attributes.name: material_sourcing_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Number of days required to source and procure raw materials, fabrics, and trims from mills and vendors.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this lead time profile record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: moq_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum order quantity required by the supplier for this product category, negotiated during sourcing.

attributes.name: moq_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the minimum order quantity (e.g., units, pieces, dozens, cartons).

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next review and update of this lead time profile to ensure accuracy.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special instructions, or contextual information about this lead time profile.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Negotiated payment terms with the supplier (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, Letter of Credit) that may influence lead time planning.

attributes.name: plm_system_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this lead time profile to the corresponding record in Centric PLM or Infor PLM system.

attributes.name: pp_approval_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Number of days required for pre-production sample approval workflow including fit, construction, and material compliance evaluation.

attributes.name: product_category_code
attributes.description: Code representing the product category (e.g., tops, bottoms, footwear, accessories) for which this lead time profile applies.

attributes.name: production_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Number of days required for bulk production including cutting, making, and trimming (CMT) operations.

attributes.name: profile_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name for the lead time profile to facilitate identification and reporting.

attributes.name: profile_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the lead time profile indicating whether it is actively used in planning.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Number of days allocated for quality inspection and compliance testing before shipment.

attributes.name: quality_standard
attributes.description: Quality standard or certification requirement applicable to this lead time profile (e.g., ISO 9001, AQL 2.5).

attributes.name: sample_development_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Number of days required for sample development, submission, and evaluation through the Sample Management System (SMS).

attributes.name: season_code
attributes.description: Code representing the fashion season or collection period for which this lead time profile is applicable (e.g., SS24, FW24).

attributes.name: shipping_transit_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Number of days required for freight transportation from Free on Board (FOB) port to destination warehouse or distribution center.

attributes.name: sustainability_certification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether sustainability certifications (OEKO-TEX, GOTS, BCI) are required for this supplier-category combination, which may impact lead time.

attributes.name: total_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Total end-to-end lead time in days from order placement to delivery at destination, including all component lead times and buffers.

attributes.name: superseded_lead_time_profile_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on lead_time_profile (superseded_lead_time_profile_id)

RTV root cause tracking for regulatory violations

attributes.name: production_factory_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the factory or manufacturing facility that produced the returned goods.

attributes.name: return_shipment_id

attributes.name: sourcing_purchase_order_id

attributes.name: vendor_id

attributes.description: Standard time allocated for completing this operation per unit, measured in minutes. Used for capacity planning, costing, and efficiency measurement in apparel manufacturing.

attributes.description: Time required to clean up, reset, or prepare the work center for the next operation after completing this operation, measured in minutes.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for quantities in this operation (EA=Each, PC=Piece, DZ=Dozen, PR=Pair, SET=Set, KG=Kilogram, M=Meter, YD=Yard). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|PC|DZ|PR|SET|KG|M|YD — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: yield_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of good output relative to input for this operation, calculated as (confirmed_quantity / planned_quantity) * 100. Key metric for production efficiency.

products.name: order_confirmation
products.description: Goods confirmation event recording actual output quantities, scrap, rework, and labor hours against a work order operation. Captures confirmation date, confirmed yield quantity, scrap quantity, rework quantity, actual machine time, actual labor time, shift, operator ID, and confirmation type (partial, final). Represents the SAP PP goods confirmation transaction (CO11N/CO15).

attributes.name: order_confirmation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the production order confirmation record. Primary key for the goods confirmation transaction.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center to which labor and overhead costs from this confirmation are allocated. Used for management accounting.

attributes.name: material_id
attributes.description: Reference to the finished good or semi-finished material being produced in this operation. Links to the product master data.

attributes.name: primary_order_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production operator or worker who performed and confirmed this operation. Used for labor tracking and performance management.

attributes.name: production_factory_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing facility or plant where this production confirmation occurred. Used for multi-site production tracking.

attributes.name: reversed_confirmation_order_confirmation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original confirmation record that this reversal transaction is cancelling. Creates audit trail for corrections.

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing work center or production line where this operation was executed. Represents the physical production resource.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production work order against which this confirmation is recorded. Links to the manufacturing order being executed.

attributes.name: work_order_operation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific operation within the work order routing that this confirmation applies to. Represents a discrete manufacturing step.

attributes.name: activity_type_code
attributes.description: Classification of the production activity performed during this operation. Used for activity-based costing and capacity planning.

attributes.name: actual_labor_hours
attributes.description: The total number of labor hours consumed to complete this operation. Used for labor cost calculation and capacity planning.

attributes.name: actual_machine_hours
attributes.description: The total number of machine or equipment hours utilized during this operation. Used for equipment utilization analysis and maintenance scheduling.

attributes.name: backflush_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether component materials were automatically consumed via backflushing when this confirmation was posted. Used for automated material consumption.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: The production batch or lot number assigned to the output from this confirmation. Used for traceability and quality control.

attributes.name: confirmation_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the production activity was completed and confirmed. Represents the actual manufacturing event date.

attributes.name: confirmation_number
attributes.description: Business-facing confirmation document number generated by the production system. Used for tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: confirmation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the confirmation record indicating whether it is in draft, submitted for approval, posted to inventory, cancelled, or reversed.

attributes.name: confirmation_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the confirmation transaction was recorded in the system. Used for audit trail and real-time production tracking.

attributes.name: confirmation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the confirmation transaction indicating whether this is a partial completion, final completion, milestone achievement, rework confirmation, or scrap reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this confirmation record was first created in the database. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: final_confirmation_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the final confirmation for the operation, signaling that no further output is expected and the operation can be closed.

attributes.name: goods_movement_posted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the confirmed quantities have been posted to inventory through a goods receipt transaction. Links confirmation to inventory update.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_number
attributes.description: The material document number generated when confirmed output was posted to inventory. Used for inventory reconciliation and traceability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this confirmation record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting date on which the confirmation was posted to inventory and financial ledgers. May differ from confirmation date for period-end adjustments.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this confirmation triggers a mandatory quality inspection before the output can be moved to finished goods inventory.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_status
attributes.description: Current status of the quality inspection associated with this confirmation. Determines whether output can be released to inventory.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this confirmation has been reversed or cancelled. Used to track corrections and adjustments to previously posted confirmations.

attributes.name: rework_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of units that require rework or reprocessing to meet quality standards. Represents non-conforming output that can be salvaged.

attributes.name: scrap_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of material or units that were scrapped or rejected during this production operation due to defects or quality failures.

attributes.name: setup_time_hours
attributes.description: The time spent preparing equipment, tooling, and materials before production could begin. Separate from actual production time.

attributes.name: shift_code
attributes.description: The production shift during which this confirmation was recorded. Used for shift-based performance analysis and labor scheduling.

attributes.name: teardown_time_hours
attributes.description: The time spent cleaning, resetting, or breaking down equipment after the production operation was completed.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The standard unit in which quantities are measured and reported for this confirmation. Common values include EA (each), PC (piece), KG (kilogram), M (meter).

attributes.name: variance_notes
attributes.description: Free-text explanation providing additional context about production variances, quality issues, or operational challenges encountered during this confirmation.

attributes.name: variance_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for any variance between planned and actual quantities or times. Used for root cause analysis of production inefficiencies.

attributes.name: yield_quantity
attributes.description: The actual quantity of good output produced and confirmed for this operation. Represents conforming units that passed quality inspection.

products.name: production_factory
products.description: Master record for each manufacturing facility (CMT factory, OEM, ODM) engaged in production. Captures factory code, factory name, legal entity name, country, city, address, factory type (CMT/OEM/ODM/internal), production capabilities (woven, knit, denim, footwear, accessories), certified capacity (units/week), compliance certifications (WRAP, BSCI, FLA, OEKO-TEX, SA8000), audit status, lead time profile, minimum order quantity, and active flag. SSOT for factory identity within the production domain; supplier domain owns the broader vendor relationship and commercial terms.

attributes.name: production_factory_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the manufacturing facility. Primary key for the factory entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Factories operate as cost centers for overhead allocation, factory performance analysis, and manufacturing cost tracking—fundamental to apparel manufacturing accounting and factory profitability analy

attributes.name: manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Factories require operational managers for production oversight, capacity planning, compliance audits, and vendor relationship management. Links factory operations to internal employee accountability

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Factories map to profit centers for regional/brand P&L segmentation in multi-brand apparel operations, enabling factory-level margin analysis and strategic sourcing decisions.

attributes.name: active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the factory is currently active and available for new production orders. Inactive factories are retained for historical reference but excluded from sourcing and planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master Data

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the factory facility. Used for shipping, audits, and official correspondence.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address information such as building name, floor, or suite number.

attributes.name: audit_score
attributes.description: Numerical score from the most recent audit, typically on a 0-100 scale. Used for factory performance benchmarking and risk assessment.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Association (FLA), WRAP Certification Standards

attributes.name: certified_capacity_units_per_week
attributes.description: Maximum production capacity in units per week as certified by the factory and validated through capacity audits. Used for production planning and allocation decisions.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the factory is located. Used for logistics planning and regional risk assessment.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code where the factory is located. Used for duty calculation, trade compliance, and origin marking requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Country Codes, Harmonized System (HS) Code Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this factory record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code used for pricing and invoicing with this factory (e.g., USD, EUR, CNY, BDT, VND).

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for factory communications, Purchase Order (PO) transmission, and Time and Action (TNA) updates.

attributes.name: employee_count
attributes.description: Total number of employees working at the factory. Used for capacity assessment, social compliance monitoring, and risk evaluation.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Association (FLA), ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety

attributes.name: facility_size_sqm
attributes.description: Total floor area of the factory in square meters. Used for capacity planning and facility assessment.

attributes.name: factory_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the factory, used across systems and documentation. Typically alphanumeric code assigned during factory onboarding.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Master Data Standards

attributes.name: factory_name
attributes.description: Common business name of the manufacturing facility as used in operational communications and planning.

attributes.name: factory_type
attributes.description: Classification of the manufacturing relationship model. CMT (Cut Make Trim) = factory provides labor only; OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) = factory manufactures to buyer specs; ODM (Original Design Manufacturer) = factory provides design and manufacturing; INTERNAL = company-owned facility; HYBRID = mixed model; SUBCONTRACTOR = secondary tier supplier.

attributes.name: incoterm
attributes.description: Standard International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) used for shipments from this factory. Defines responsibility for shipping costs, insurance, and risk transfer. FOB (Free on Board) is most common in apparel. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FOB|FCA|CIF|DDP|DAP|CPT|CIP — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent compliance or quality audit conducted at the factory. Used to track audit recency and schedule follow-up audits.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Association (FLA), WRAP Certification Standards

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard production lead time in days from Purchase Order (PO) confirmation to ex-factory shipment readiness. Used in Time and Action (TNA) calendar planning.

attributes.name: legal_entity_name
attributes.description: Official registered legal name of the factory entity as it appears on contracts, licenses, and regulatory filings.

attributes.name: moq_units
attributes.description: Minimum Order Quantity in units that the factory requires per style or per order to accept production. Critical for buy plan feasibility and allocation planning.

attributes.name: next_audit_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next compliance or quality audit. Used for audit planning and vendor compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Association (FLA), WRAP Certification Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional factory information, special handling instructions, strategic notes, or historical context not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master Data

attributes.name: onboarding_date
attributes.description: Date when the factory was approved and onboarded into the company's vendor network. Used for relationship tenure analysis and vendor lifecycle tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master Data

attributes.name: otif_performance_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: On Time In Full (OTIF) Performance Percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of orders delivered On Time In Full over the trailing 12 months. Key performance indicator for factory reliability and used in allocation decisions.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Standard payment terms negotiated with the factory (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, Letter of Credit (LC), 30% deposit + 70% on shipment). Used for cash flow planning and Purchase Order (PO) processing.
attributes.references: International Chamber of Commerce (ICC) Payment Terms

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the factory. Used for operational coordination and emergency communication.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the factory location. Used for logistics and regional analysis.

attributes.name: preferred_vendor_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this factory has preferred vendor status based on performance, quality, compliance, and strategic relationship. Preferred vendors receive priority allocation and longer-term commitments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master Data

attributes.name: production_capabilities
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of product categories and manufacturing techniques the factory is equipped to produce (e.g., woven, knit, denim, footwear, accessories, leather goods, outerwear, activewear, swimwear, intimate apparel).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Work Center Capabilities

attributes.name: quality_rating
attributes.description: Letter grade quality rating based on defect rates, inspection results, and customer returns. A = excellent (defect rate <1%), B = good (1-2%), C = acceptable (2-4%), D = needs improvement (4-6%), F = unacceptable (>6%).
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems, Acceptable Quality Limit (AQL) Standards

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Overall risk classification for the factory based on compliance history, audit findings, geographic risk, and operational stability. Used for sourcing decisions and monitoring frequency.
attributes.references: ISO 31000 Risk Management, Supply Chain Risk Standards

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region where the factory is located. Used for regional compliance and logistics routing.

attributes.name: sustainability_score
attributes.description: Composite sustainability score (0-100) based on environmental practices, energy efficiency, waste management, water usage, and chemical compliance. Used for ESG reporting and sustainable sourcing initiatives.
attributes.references: Global Organic Textile Standard (GOTS), OEKO-TEX, ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when the business relationship with the factory was terminated or the factory was deactivated. Null for active factories.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master Data

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the factory location (e.g., Asia/Shanghai, Asia/Dhaka, Europe/Istanbul). Used for scheduling meetings, coordinating shipments, and Time and Action (TNA) planning.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this factory record was last modified. Used for change tracking and data freshness monitoring.

products.name: factory_capacity
products.description: Weekly or monthly capacity plan and reservation record for a factory, capturing available machine hours, labor hours, allocated capacity (units), reserved capacity by season/booking, efficiency rate, utilization percentage, and booking status by production line or department. Supports OTB capacity planning, T&A scheduling, forward capacity booking, and load balancing across manufacturing partners.

attributes.name: factory_capacity_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the factory capacity planning record.

attributes.name: budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.budget. Business justification: Capacity planning ties to factory overhead budgets for resource allocation decisions, enabling capacity cost planning and factory investment budget tracking in apparel manufacturing operations.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_category. Business justification: Capacity planning by product category (knits vs wovens, footwear vs apparel) reflects different machine/skill requirements. Enables category-level capacity allocation and booking. Removes denormalized

attributes.name: production_factory_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the manufacturing facility or CMT (Cut Make Trim) partner to which this capacity plan applies.

attributes.name: season_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the merchandise season for which capacity is reserved or allocated.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System Season Master

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.work_center. Business justification: Factory capacity is often planned and tracked at the work center or production line level. The table currently has production_line_id (STRING) but no formal FK to work_center. Adding work_center_id en

attributes.name: allocated_capacity_units
attributes.description: Production capacity units already allocated to confirmed purchase orders (PO) or work orders during the planning period.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the production planner or manager who approved this capacity plan.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this capacity plan was approved for execution.

attributes.name: available_capacity_units
attributes.description: Remaining production capacity units available for new bookings, calculated as total capacity minus allocated and reserved capacity.

attributes.name: available_labor_hours
attributes.description: Total labor hours available for production during the planning period, based on workforce headcount and shift schedules.

attributes.name: available_machine_hours
attributes.description: Total machine hours available for production during the planning period, accounting for scheduled maintenance and downtime.

attributes.name: booking_cutoff_date
attributes.description: Last date by which new production orders can be booked for this capacity period.

attributes.name: booking_status
attributes.description: Current booking status of the capacity period, indicating whether additional orders can be accepted.

attributes.name: capacity_allocation_priority
attributes.description: Priority level for capacity allocation, used to manage competing demands from multiple customers or product lines.

attributes.name: capacity_buffer_percent
attributes.description: Safety buffer percentage applied to capacity planning to account for variability, quality issues, or unexpected delays.

attributes.name: capacity_status
attributes.description: Operational status of the factory or production line during the planning period.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Work Center Status

attributes.name: capacity_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure used to express production capacity (e.g., pieces, garments, dozens, pairs).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this capacity planning record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Manufacturing department or process stage to which this capacity allocation applies (e.g., cutting, sewing, finishing). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cutting|sewing|finishing|packing|embroidery|printing|dyeing|quality_control — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: efficiency_rate_percent
attributes.description: Factory or production line efficiency rate as a percentage, representing actual output versus theoretical maximum capacity.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this capacity plan is currently active and in use for production scheduling.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard production lead time in days from order confirmation to shipment for orders booked in this capacity period.

attributes.name: machine_count
attributes.description: Total number of production machines or equipment units available during the planning period.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum order quantity (MOQ) in units that the factory requires for accepting new production bookings during this period.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding capacity constraints, special conditions, or planning assumptions for this period.

attributes.name: overtime_hours_available
attributes.description: Additional overtime hours available for production if needed to meet demand during the planning period.

attributes.name: planned_downtime_hours
attributes.description: Total hours of planned downtime for maintenance, changeovers, or scheduled breaks during the planning period.

attributes.name: planning_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the capacity planning period (weekly or monthly bucket).

attributes.name: planning_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the capacity planning period (weekly or monthly bucket).

attributes.name: planning_period_type
attributes.description: Granularity of the capacity planning period (daily, weekly, or monthly).

attributes.name: reserved_capacity_units
attributes.description: Production capacity units reserved for specific seasons, collections, or customers but not yet confirmed by purchase order.

attributes.name: shift_count
attributes.description: Number of production shifts per day during the planning period (e.g., 1, 2, or 3 shifts).

attributes.name: standard_minute_value
attributes.description: Average standard minute value (SMV) per unit for the product mix planned during this capacity period, used for capacity calculation.

attributes.name: total_capacity_units
attributes.description: Total production capacity expressed in units (pieces, garments, or SKUs) that can be manufactured during the planning period.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this capacity planning record was last modified.

attributes.name: utilization_rate_percent
attributes.description: Capacity utilization rate as a percentage, calculated as allocated capacity divided by total available capacity.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of the capacity plan, incremented with each revision to support change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: workforce_headcount
attributes.description: Total number of production workers assigned to the factory or production line during the planning period.

attributes.name: working_days
attributes.description: Number of working days available during the planning period, excluding holidays and factory closures.

products.name: schedule

Captures schedule version, schedule status (draft, confirmed, locked), season, delivery window, critical path flags, and schedule change reason. Supports T&A calendar management, on-time delivery tracking (OTIF), and weekly production planning meetings with factory partners.

attributes.name: schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the production schedule record. Primary key for the master production schedule (MPS) entity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP - Production Order Management

attributes.name: delivery_window_id
attributes.description: Reference to the target delivery window or time bucket for finished goods. Aligns production schedule with retail distribution calendar and store delivery requirements.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production planner responsible for this schedule. Identifies the person accountable for schedule creation and maintenance.

attributes.name: factory_capacity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.factory_capacity. Business justification: Production schedules allocate capacity from factory capacity plans. The MPS (Master Production Schedule) record should reference the specific capacity plan/slot it is consuming. This enables capacity

attributes.name: production_factory_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing facility where production is scheduled. Identifies the factory partner or internal plant assigned to execute this production run.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP - Plant Master Data

attributes.name: production_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific production line or work center within the factory allocated for this schedule. Represents the capacity slot assignment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP - Work Center Master

attributes.name: season_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fashion season or collection period this production schedule supports. Links schedule to merchandising calendar for seasonal product delivery.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Season Planning

attributes.name: sketch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to design.design_sketch. Business justification: Production schedules reference design sketches for visual production planning boards, design-driven scheduling, and design complexity-based capacity allocation. Enables design-aware production plannin

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the work order being scheduled. Links this schedule record to the production work order that defines what is being manufactured.

attributes.name: actual_cut_date
attributes.description: Actual date when fabric cutting operations began. Used for On-Time In-Full (OTIF) performance tracking and schedule variance analysis.

attributes.name: actual_ex_factory_date
attributes.description: Actual date when finished goods left the factory. Critical for OTIF performance measurement and supply chain delivery tracking.

attributes.name: actual_finishing_date

attributes.name: actual_sew_end_date

attributes.name: actual_sew_start_date
attributes.description: Actual date when sewing operations commenced. Used for production milestone tracking and factory performance measurement.

attributes.name: change_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for the most recent schedule change or revision. Captures rationale for date shifts, quantity adjustments, or factory reassignments to support root cause analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this production schedule record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and schedule age analysis.

attributes.name: critical_path_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this schedule is on the critical path for seasonal delivery. True for schedules with no slack time that directly impact retail delivery deadlines.

attributes.name: factory_capacity_utilization_pct

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who most recently updated this production schedule record. Used for accountability and change management.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this production schedule record was most recently updated. Used for change tracking and data freshness monitoring.

attributes.name: lead_time_days

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: otif_target_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this schedule met the On-Time In-Full (OTIF) delivery target. True if actual ex-factory date matched planned date and full quantity was delivered.

attributes.name: planned_cut_date

attributes.name: planned_ex_factory_date

attributes.name: planned_finishing_date

attributes.name: planned_sew_end_date

attributes.name: planned_sew_start_date

attributes.name: planning_group

attributes.name: priority_level
