attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Payments are posted to a legal entity (company code). Normalizing STRING company_code to FK company_code_id → company_code.company_code_id. Remove redundant company_code STRING column.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Payments can be allocated to cost centers for cost tracking. Normalizing STRING cost_center to FK cost_center_id → cost_center.cost_center_id. Remove redundant cost_center STRING column.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Payments to employees (expense reimbursements, advances, commissions) must link to employee for payment tracking and reconciliation. Apparel sales teams receive commission payments requiring employee→

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Payments post to GL accounts for financial reporting. Normalizing STRING gl_account_code to FK gl_account_id → gl_account.gl_account_id. Remove redundant gl_account_code STRING column.

attributes.name: letter_of_credit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.letter_of_credit. Business justification: Payments can be linked to letters of credit for trade finance. Normalizing STRING lc_number to FK letter_of_credit_id → letter_of_credit.letter_of_credit_id. Remove redundant lc_number and lc_issuing_

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The gross payment amount in the transaction currency before any adjustments, fees, or exchange rate conversions.

attributes.name: bank_charges
attributes.description: Fees charged by the bank for processing the payment transaction, including wire transfer fees, LC handling fees, or foreign exchange fees.

attributes.name: bank_statement_date
attributes.description: The date on which this payment appeared on the bank statement, used for bank reconciliation and cash positioning.

attributes.name: beneficiary_bank_name
attributes.description: The name of the beneficiary's bank institution receiving or sending the payment.

attributes.name: beneficiary_bank_swift_code
attributes.description: The SWIFT/BIC code of the beneficiary's bank, used for international wire transfers and cross-border payments.

attributes.name: beneficiary_name
attributes.description: The name of the payment recipient (vendor, supplier, or customer). For outgoing payments, this is the payee; for incoming receipts, this is the payer.

attributes.name: block_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the payment is blocked for processing due to approval requirements, compliance holds, or dispute resolution. True if blocked, False if released.

attributes.name: block_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why the payment is blocked, such as pending approval, invoice dispute, compliance review, or missing documentation.

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: The business area or division within the company responsible for the payment, enabling profitability analysis by channel, product line, or region.

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP FI clearing document that links this payment to the original invoice or receivable, enabling Accounts Payable (AP) or Accounts Receivable (AR) clearing.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this payment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trails and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the payment transaction (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, CNY). Represents the currency in which the payment was executed.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Early payment discount amount taken by the payer or granted to the payee, reducing the net payment amount. Common in vendor payment terms (e.g., 2/10 net 30).

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique document number assigned to this payment in SAP S/4HANA FI. Used for audit trails and reconciliation.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate applied at payment date to convert payment currency to local currency. Critical for multi-currency payment processing and landed cost (LDP) accounting.

attributes.name: intercompany_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this payment is an intercompany transaction between legal entities within the same corporate group. True for intercompany, False for external.

attributes.name: local_amount
attributes.description: The payment amount converted to the company's local reporting currency for consolidation and statutory reporting per IFRS/GAAP requirements.

attributes.name: local_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the company's local reporting currency used in financial consolidation and statutory reporting.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this payment record was last modified or updated. Critical for change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: net_payment_amount
attributes.description: The final net amount transferred after applying discounts and deducting bank charges. Represents the actual cash movement.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The business date when the payment transaction was executed or processed. Distinct from value date and posting date.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The instrument or mechanism used to execute the payment: wire transfer, ACH (Automated Clearing House), SEPA (Single Euro Payments Area), check, Letter of Credit (LC), electronic funds transfer, or cash. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: wire_transfer|ach|sepa|check|lc|electronic_funds_transfer|cash — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: payment_run_number
attributes.description: Identifier for the automated payment run batch in SAP S/4HANA FI that grouped multiple payments for processing. Used for batch reconciliation and audit trails.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payment: pending approval, cleared through bank, reconciled with bank statement, failed processing, cancelled, or in transit.

attributes.name: payment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payment transaction: outgoing vendor payments, incoming customer receipts, intercompany netting settlements, Letter of Credit (LC) settlements, bank transfers, or refunds.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting period date when the payment was posted to the General Ledger (GL) in SAP S/4HANA FI. Used for period-end close (EOM) and financial consolidation.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: The priority level assigned to the payment for processing sequence in payment runs: urgent, high, normal, or low.

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: The date when this payment was successfully reconciled with the bank statement, completing the cash management cycle.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of bank statement reconciliation: matched to bank statement, unmatched, partially matched, or under review by treasury team.

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number or remittance advice identifier provided by the payer or payee for payment tracking and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The tax amount (VAT, GST, withholding tax) associated with the payment transaction, if applicable. Used for tax reporting and compliance.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: The tax code applied to the payment transaction in SAP S/4HANA FI, determining tax calculation rules and reporting requirements.

attributes.name: terms
attributes.description: The agreed payment terms between buyer and seller (e.g., Net 30, 2/10 Net 30, FOB, DDP). Influences discount eligibility and cash flow timing.

attributes.name: value_date
attributes.description: The effective date when funds are available or debited for interest calculation and cash positioning purposes. Critical for treasury management and cash flow analysis.

products.name: budget
products.description: Financial budget plan in SAP S/4HANA CO and Anaplan capturing budget header (version, fiscal year, type, owner, approval status) and granular period-level line allocations (monthly/quarterly amounts by GL account, cost center, profit center, channel). Supports budget types including OPEX, CAPEX, COGS, and OTB (Open-to-Buy). Each line stores planned, revised, committed, and actual amounts with variance calculations at the period level. Enables merchandise financial planning, OTB management, budget vs. actual tracking, and EBITDA target-setting for apparel fashion operations.
products.reference: Anaplan Financial Budget / SAP CO Budget

attributes.name: budget_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the budget record. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Budgets are allocated to cost centers for cost planning. Normalizing STRING cost_center_code to FK cost_center_id → cost_center.cost_center_id. Remove redundant cost_center_code STRING column.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Budgets are planned by GL account for financial planning. Normalizing STRING gl_account_code to FK gl_account_id → gl_account.gl_account_id. Remove redundant gl_account_code STRING column.

attributes.name: initiative_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.sustainability_initiative. Business justification: Links initiative funding to financial planning. Enables ESG capex tracking, sustainability ROI analysis, and budget variance reporting for decarbonization projects—standard for integrated financial/su

attributes.name: obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_obligation. Business justification: Annual compliance budgets are planned by obligation type (CPSIA testing, REACH compliance, factory audits) in apparel. Links budget allocation to specific regulatory requirements for compliance spend

attributes.name: owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Budget ownership must link to employee for accountability, approval workflows, and budget variance responsibility. Apparel companies require budget_owner FK for budget approval routing and performance

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Budgets are allocated to profit centers for profitability planning. Normalizing STRING profit_center_code to FK profit_center_id → profit_center.profit_center_id. Remove redundant profit_center_code S

attributes.name: actual_amount
attributes.description: The actual amount spent or incurred against this budget to date. Updated from financial actuals in the general ledger.

attributes.name: allocated_amount
attributes.description: The amount of budget that has been allocated or distributed to specific cost centers, projects, or line items.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this budget was formally approved by the authorized approver or budget committee.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual who approved this budget (e.g., CFO, Finance Director, Budget Committee Chair).

attributes.name: budget_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the budget plan (e.g., FY2024 OPEX Budget, Spring Collection COGS Budget).

attributes.name: budget_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the budget plan in the approval and execution workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DRAFT|SUBMITTED|APPROVED|REJECTED|ACTIVE|CLOSED|REVISED — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: budget_type
attributes.description: Classification of budget type: OPEX (Operating Expenses), CAPEX (Capital Expenditures), COGS (Cost of Goods Sold), OTB (Open-to-Buy), REVENUE, or EBITDA (Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization).

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The sales or distribution channel for which this budget applies. DTC stands for Direct-to-Consumer.

attributes.name: committed_amount
attributes.description: The amount of budget that has been committed through purchase orders or contractual obligations but not yet spent.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this budget record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this budget (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The effective end date of the budget period (e.g., 2024-12-31 for FY2024 annual budget).

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year for which this budget applies (e.g., 2024).

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this budget is currently active and in use for financial tracking and reporting. True for active, False for inactive or superseded budgets.

attributes.name: is_baseline
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this is the baseline (original approved) budget version. True for baseline, False for revised versions.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this budget record was last modified. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the budget, including assumptions, constraints, or special considerations.

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: The granularity of budget period allocation: MONTHLY (12 periods), QUARTERLY (4 periods), or ANNUAL (1 period).

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Geographic region code for budget allocation (e.g., USA, EUR, APAC). Uses ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes or regional abbreviations.

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Sequential revision number tracking changes to the budget. Starts at 0 for original budget, increments with each revision.

attributes.name: revision_reason
attributes.description: Business justification or reason for budget revision (e.g., Market Conditions Change, Strategic Initiative, Cost Overrun, Revenue Shortfall).

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The system of record from which this budget data originated (e.g., SAP S/4HANA CO for controlling budgets, Anaplan for merchandise financial planning).

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier of this budget record in the source system (e.g., SAP budget document number, Anaplan budget ID).

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The effective start date of the budget period (e.g., 2024-01-01 for FY2024 annual budget).

attributes.name: total_budget_amount
attributes.description: The total planned budget amount for the entire fiscal period, in the specified currency. Sum of all period-level allocations.

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: The variance between budgeted and actual amounts (calculated as total_budget_amount minus actual_amount). Positive indicates under-budget, negative indicates over-budget.

attributes.name: variance_percentage
attributes.description: The variance expressed as a percentage of the total budget amount. Calculated as (variance_amount / total_budget_amount) * 100.

attributes.name: brand_code
attributes.description: The brand code associated with the intercompany transaction, particularly relevant for royalty and license fee transactions. Used for brand-level financial analysis.

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: The sales or distribution channel associated with the intercompany transaction. Wholesale for B2B distribution; retail for owned stores; ecommerce for digital; franchise for licensed operations; outlet for clearance channels.

attributes.name: consolidation_unit_code
attributes.description: The consolidation unit or reporting entity code used in the financial consolidation system. Identifies the level at which this transaction is eliminated in the consolidation hierarchy.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who created the intercompany transaction record in the system. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the intercompany transaction record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: elimination_date
attributes.description: The date when the intercompany transaction was eliminated during the financial consolidation process. Null if elimination is still pending.

attributes.name: elimination_status
attributes.description: The current status of the intercompany transaction in the consolidation elimination process. Pending indicates awaiting elimination; eliminated means fully removed from consolidated statements; partially eliminated for complex multi-step transactions; exception for transactions requiring manual review.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate used to convert the transaction amount from transaction currency to group currency. Typically the rate effective on the transaction date.
attributes.references: IAS 21 The Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year when the intercompany transaction is recorded, typically 1-12 for monthly periods or 1-13 including adjustments.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the intercompany transaction is recorded, used for financial reporting and consolidation purposes.

attributes.name: geographic_region_code
attributes.description: The geographic region code associated with the intercompany transaction, used for regional segment reporting and transfer pricing documentation by jurisdiction.

attributes.name: group_currency_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the intercompany transaction translated into the group reporting currency using the applicable exchange rate. Used for consolidated financial reporting.

attributes.name: group_currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code of the corporate group reporting currency. All intercompany transactions are translated to this currency for consolidation purposes.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who last modified the intercompany transaction record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the intercompany transaction record was last modified or updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: netting_position
attributes.description: Indicates the settlement position of the intercompany transaction from the group perspective. Payable means the sending entity owes the receiving entity; receivable means the opposite; settled indicates payment completed; offset means netted against other transactions.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments providing additional context about the intercompany transaction, including special circumstances, adjustments, or audit findings.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date when the intercompany transaction was posted to the general ledger in the financial system. May differ from transaction date due to period-end processing or adjustments.

attributes.name: product_category_code
attributes.description: The product category or merchandise hierarchy code associated with the intercompany transaction, particularly relevant for goods transfers. Used for category-level profitability analysis.

attributes.name: receiving_company_code
attributes.description: The company code of the legal entity that is the receiver or consumer in the intercompany transaction. Represents the entity being charged or receiving goods/services. Typically a 4-character alphanumeric code per SAP standard.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Company Code Structure

attributes.name: receiving_profit_center_code
attributes.description: The profit center code within the receiving company that is charged for the intercompany transaction. Used for internal profitability analysis and segment reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Profit Center Accounting

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: The date when the intercompany transaction was reconciled and confirmed between the sending and receiving entities. Null if reconciliation is pending or disputed.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: The current reconciliation status between the sending and receiving entities. Matched indicates both sides agree; unmatched for discrepancies; disputed for contested amounts; resolved for cleared disputes.

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: The reference number of the source document that triggered the intercompany transaction, such as a purchase order, invoice, or service agreement number. Used for audit trail and reconciliation.

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: The date when the intercompany transaction was settled through cash payment, netting, or other settlement mechanism between the legal entities. Null if settlement is pending.

attributes.name: settlement_method
attributes.description: The mechanism used to settle the intercompany transaction. Cash payment for direct fund transfer; netting for multilateral settlement; offset against other balances; loan conversion for capitalization; waiver for forgiveness.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: The tax jurisdiction code applicable to the intercompany transaction, used for transfer pricing compliance and tax reporting. Critical for OECD BEPS documentation.

attributes.name: transaction_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the intercompany transaction in the transaction currency. Represents the gross amount charged or transferred before any adjustments.

attributes.name: transaction_currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the intercompany transaction was originally denominated and executed between the two legal entities.

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: The business date when the intercompany transaction occurred or was recognized. This is the accounting effective date used for financial period assignment and consolidation.

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique transaction number for the intercompany transaction, typically following format IC followed by 10 digits. Used for external reference and audit trails.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the intercompany transaction indicating the nature of the business activity between legal entities. Goods transfer represents finished goods or materials moved between entities; service charge for shared services; royalty and license fees for intellectual property usage; management fees for corporate overhead; loan and interest for financing arrangements; dividend for profit distribution; allocation for cost sharing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: goods_transfer|service_charge|royalty|license_fee|management_fee|loan|interest|dividend|allocation — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: transfer_price_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Any adjustment amount applied to the intercompany transaction to align with transfer pricing policy and arms-length principles. Positive values indicate upward adjustments; negative values indicate downward adjustments.

attributes.name: transfer_pricing_method
attributes.description: The OECD-compliant transfer pricing methodology applied to determine the arms-length price for this intercompany transaction. Comparable uncontrolled price uses market benchmarks; resale price based on resale margin; cost plus adds markup to cost; transactional net margin compares net margins; profit split allocates combined profits.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount
attributes.description: The amount of withholding tax applied to the intercompany transaction, particularly relevant for cross-border royalty, interest, and service fee payments. Recorded in transaction currency.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_rate
attributes.description: The withholding tax rate percentage applied to the intercompany transaction based on applicable tax treaties and local regulations. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 5.00 for 5%).

products.name: tax_item
products.description: Captures tax line items associated with financial transactions in SAP S/4HANA FI, including VAT, sales tax, import duty, withholding tax, and GST. Stores tax code, tax type, taxable base amount, tax amount, tax jurisdiction, reporting period, tax return reference, and filing status. Supports indirect tax compliance, statutory tax reporting, and customs duty reconciliation for apparel fashion global operations.

attributes.name: cost_center_id

attributes.name: gl_account_id

attributes.name: original_tax_item_id

attributes.name: profile_id

attributes.name: profit_center_id

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_filing. Business justification: Regulatory filing fees and compliance service taxes generate tax items in apparel operations. Enables tax accounting for compliance expenditures and supports VAT/GST recovery on certification and test

attributes.name: transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent financial transaction (invoice, payment, purchase order) to which this tax item applies.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor or supplier associated with this tax item, relevant for withholding tax and input tax scenarios.

attributes.name: wholesale_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.wholesale_account. attributes.name: business_area_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the business area or segment (e.g., retail, wholesale, e-commerce) to which this tax item is allocated for internal reporting.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code where the tax obligation arises (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU).

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or username of the person or system process that created this tax item record.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tax item record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the tax amounts (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: customs_entry_number
attributes.description: The customs declaration or entry number associated with import duty tax items, used for customs clearance tracking.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date on the source document (invoice date, receipt date) that triggered this tax obligation.

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: The externally-known financial document number (invoice number, receipt number, or accounting document number) associated with this tax item.

attributes.name: filing_status
attributes.description: Current status of this tax item in the filing and payment lifecycle: pending (not yet filed), filed (submitted to authorities), paid (payment completed), reconciled (confirmed by authorities), or disputed (under review or appeal).

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period number within the fiscal year (1-12 for monthly, 1-4 for quarterly) when this tax item is recorded.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which this tax item is recorded for financial and statutory reporting purposes.

attributes.name: hs_code
attributes.description: The Harmonized System code used for customs classification of goods, relevant for import duty and customs tax calculations.

attributes.name: landed_cost_component
attributes.description: Identifies which component of landed cost this tax item represents: duty (import tax), freight (shipping tax), insurance (insurance premium tax), or handling (processing fees).

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or username of the person or system process that last modified this tax item record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tax item record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: line_item_number
attributes.description: Sequential line item number within the parent financial document, used for ordering and referencing individual tax entries.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Line Item Management

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, explanations, or special instructions related to this tax item.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The date when the tax amount was paid to the tax authority, if applicable.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date when this tax item was posted to the general ledger for accounting purposes.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this tax item is a reversal or correction of a previously posted tax entry.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The calculated tax amount for this line item, derived from taxable base amount multiplied by tax rate.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: The tax code identifier that determines the tax type, rate, and calculation method applied to this transaction line (e.g., V1 for standard VAT, I0 for import duty).

attributes.name: tax_determination_date
attributes.description: The date used to determine the applicable tax rate and rules, typically the transaction date or delivery date.

attributes.name: tax_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is input tax (tax paid on purchases, recoverable) or output tax (tax collected on sales, payable to authorities).

attributes.name: tax_exemption_certificate_number
attributes.description: The certificate or authorization number supporting the tax exemption claim, required for audit and compliance verification.

attributes.name: tax_exemption_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for tax exemption or reduced rate, if applicable (e.g., export exemption, diplomatic exemption, zero-rated goods).

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the tax authority or jurisdiction where this tax is applicable (e.g., country code, state code, or customs territory).

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_name
attributes.description: Full name of the tax jurisdiction or authority (e.g., United States - California, European Union, HM Revenue & Customs UK).

attributes.name: tax_rate_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage rate applied to calculate the tax amount (e.g., 20.00 for 20% VAT, 5.50 for 5.5% import duty).

attributes.name: tax_reporting_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period or reporting period to which this tax item belongs (e.g., 2024-Q1, 2024-03, 2024-FY).

attributes.name: tax_return_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier of the tax return filing in which this tax item is included for statutory reporting to tax authorities.

attributes.name: tax_type
attributes.description: The category of tax applied: VAT (Value Added Tax), sales tax, import duty, excise duty, withholding tax, or GST (Goods and Services Tax).

attributes.name: taxable_base_amount
attributes.description: The base amount on which the tax is calculated, before tax is applied. Represents the net value subject to taxation.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this tax item represents withholding tax deducted at source from vendor payments.

products.name: fixed_asset
products.description: Master record and complete lifecycle history for fixed assets in SAP S/4HANA FI-AA, including retail store fixtures, manufacturing equipment, warehouse racking, IT infrastructure, and leasehold improvements. Captures asset master attributes (asset class, acquisition date, cost, useful life, depreciation method, net book value, location, company code) and all lifecycle transactions (acquisitions, transfers, retirements, write-downs, depreciation postings with transaction type, posting date, amount, depreciation area, and document reference). Provides the complete audit trail for fixed asset movements. Supports CAPEX tracking, depreciation runs, IFRS 16 lease accounting, and IAS 16 compliance reporting for apparel fashion.
products.reference: SAP FI-AA Fixed Asset Master / IFRS IAS 16

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fixed asset record. Primary key for the fixed asset master data in SAP S/4HANA FI-AA.

attributes.name: audit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.audit. Business justification: Factory equipment and facilities are verified during safety and social compliance audits in apparel manufacturing. Links asset records to audit findings for capital expenditure planning and compliance

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Fixed assets belong to a legal entity (company code). Normalizing STRING company_code to FK company_code_id → company_code.company_code_id. Remove redundant company_code STRING column.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.cost_center

attributes.name: responsible_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier for the person responsible for the fixed asset. Used for asset custody tracking and accountability.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: FK to supplier.vendor

attributes.name: warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.warehouse_location. Business justification: Fixed assets (racking systems, conveyors, RFID gates, sortation equipment) are assigned to specific warehouse locations for depreciation allocation, asset tracking, and maintenance scheduling. Standar

attributes.name: accumulated_depreciation
attributes.description: Total depreciation posted to date since acquisition. Used to calculate net book value and track asset consumption over time.

attributes.name: acquisition_cost
attributes.description: Original acquisition cost of the fixed asset including purchase price, installation costs, and any directly attributable costs to bring the asset to working condition. Basis for depreciation calculation.

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: Date when the fixed asset was acquired or placed in service. Start date for depreciation calculation and useful life tracking.

attributes.name: asset_class_code
attributes.description: Classification code defining the type of fixed asset (e.g., store fixtures, manufacturing equipment, warehouse racking, IT infrastructure, leasehold improvements). Determines depreciation method, useful life, and GL account assignment in SAP FI-AA.

attributes.name: asset_description
attributes.description: Detailed business description of the fixed asset including make, model, specifications, and purpose. Used for asset identification and audit trail.

attributes.name: asset_group_code
attributes.description: Grouping code for aggregating similar assets for reporting and analysis. Supports portfolio management and CAPEX planning by asset category.

attributes.name: asset_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the fixed asset. The externally-known unique asset number used across SAP S/4HANA FI-AA for asset tracking, depreciation runs, and financial reporting.

attributes.name: asset_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fixed asset. Determines whether depreciation is active and whether the asset is included in financial reporting.

attributes.name: asset_subnumber
attributes.description: SAP asset subnumber for tracking components or sub-assets within a main asset. Enables detailed tracking of complex assets with multiple depreciable components.

attributes.name: asset_tag_number
attributes.description: Physical asset tag or barcode number affixed to the asset for identification during physical inventory counts and asset verification audits.

attributes.name: business_area_code
attributes.description: Business area code for segment reporting and profitability analysis. Enables CAPEX tracking and asset analysis by channel, product line, or region.

attributes.name: capitalization_date
attributes.description: Date when the asset was capitalized and added to the fixed asset register. May differ from acquisition date for assets under construction.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User ID of the person who created the fixed asset record. Supports audit trail and data governance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the fixed asset record was first created in SAP S/4HANA FI-AA. Provides audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for acquisition cost and net book value. Used for multi-currency consolidation and IFRS reporting.

attributes.name: depreciation_area
attributes.description: SAP depreciation area code (e.g., 01 for book depreciation, 15 for tax depreciation). Enables parallel valuation for IFRS, GAAP, and local statutory reporting requirements.

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: Depreciation calculation method applied to the fixed asset. Determines how acquisition cost is systematically allocated over useful life per IAS 16.

attributes.name: impairment_amount
attributes.description: Total impairment loss recognized on the fixed asset per IAS 36. Reduces net book value when recoverable amount falls below carrying amount.

attributes.name: insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Insurance policy number covering the fixed asset. Supports risk management and insurance claim processing.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID of the person who last modified the fixed asset record. Supports audit trail and accountability for data changes.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the fixed asset record was last modified. Tracks data currency and supports change audit trail.

attributes.name: last_physical_inventory_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent physical inventory verification for the fixed asset. Supports audit compliance and asset existence verification.

attributes.name: lease_contract_number
attributes.description: Contract number for leased assets. Links fixed asset to lease liability and supports IFRS 16 compliance reporting for right-of-use assets.

attributes.name: lease_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the asset is held under a lease agreement. Used for IFRS 16 lease accounting and right-of-use asset tracking.

attributes.name: maintenance_schedule_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the preventive maintenance schedule for the fixed asset. Links to maintenance planning and asset reliability programs.

attributes.name: net_book_value
attributes.description: Current net book value of the fixed asset calculated as acquisition cost minus accumulated depreciation. Represents the carrying amount on the balance sheet per IAS 16.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments about the fixed asset. Captures additional context, special handling instructions, or historical information.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Purchase order number used to acquire the fixed asset. Links asset acquisition to procurement process and provides audit trail for CAPEX tracking.

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: Date when the fixed asset was retired, disposed, or scrapped. Marks the end of the asset lifecycle and depreciation posting.

attributes.name: retirement_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for asset retirement. Supports audit trail and asset lifecycle analysis for CAPEX planning and replacement strategies.

attributes.name: salvage_value
attributes.description: Estimated residual value of the fixed asset at the end of its useful life. Subtracted from acquisition cost to determine depreciable amount per IAS 16.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer serial number or unique identifier for the physical asset. Used for warranty tracking, maintenance scheduling, and physical inventory verification.

attributes.name: tax_depreciation_method
attributes.description: Depreciation method used for tax reporting purposes. May differ from book depreciation method to comply with local tax regulations.

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: Expected useful life of the fixed asset in years. Used for depreciation calculation and asset lifecycle planning. May include fractional years for precision.

attributes.name: warranty_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the manufacturer warranty expires. Used for maintenance planning and cost forecasting.

attributes.name: entry_timestamp

attributes.name: exchange_rate

attributes.name: fiscal_period

attributes.name: group_currency_amount

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the asset transaction record was last modified. Tracks changes for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: local_currency_amount

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Date when the asset transaction was posted to the general ledger. This is the accounting date that determines the fiscal period for financial reporting.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment, SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Date

attributes.name: quantity

attributes.name: reason_code

attributes.name: reference_document_number

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
