attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: Document number of the original transaction that this reversal transaction is canceling. Populated only when reversal_indicator is True.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the source system from which the asset transaction originated (e.g., SAP S/4HANA, legacy ERP, interface system). Supports data lineage and multi-system integration.

attributes.name: transaction_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the asset transaction in the transaction currency. Represents acquisition cost, depreciation expense, write-down amount, or retirement proceeds depending on transaction type.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment, SAP S/4HANA FI-AA Transaction Amount

attributes.name: transaction_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the asset transaction in the financial system workflow.

attributes.name: transaction_text
attributes.description: Free-text description or memo providing additional context about the asset transaction. Used for audit trail and user notes.

attributes.name: transaction_type_code
attributes.description: Code representing the type of asset transaction: ACQ (Acquisition), TRF (Transfer), RET (Retirement), DEP (Depreciation), WDN (Write-Down), REV (Revaluation), COR (Correction), ADJ (Adjustment). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ACQ|TRF|RET|DEP|WDN|REV|COR|ADJ — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the asset quantity (e.g., EA for each, M2 for square meters, KG for kilograms).

attributes.name: vendor_code
attributes.description: Vendor or supplier code for asset acquisitions. Links to accounts payable and procurement records.

products.name: cost_allocation
products.description: Records internal cost allocation and assessment cycles executed in SAP S/4HANA CO, distributing shared costs (overhead, logistics, marketing) across cost centers, profit centers, and product lines. Captures allocation cycle, sender cost center, receiver cost center or profit center, allocation method (percentage, quantity, equivalence), allocated amount, and fiscal period. Enables accurate product-level and channel-level profitability analysis and EBITDA reporting.

attributes.name: cost_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cost allocation record. Primary key for the cost allocation entity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO - Cost Allocation Object

attributes.name: allocation_cycle_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the allocation cycle or run executed in SAP S/4HANA CO. Groups multiple allocation records processed together in a single execution.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Cost allocations are posted to a legal entity (company code). Normalizing STRING company_code to FK company_code_id → company_code.company_code_id. Remove redundant company_code STRING column.

attributes.name: original_allocation_cost_allocation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original cost allocation record if this is a reversal or correction. Links reversal documents to their original transactions.

attributes.name: receiver_cost_center_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.cost_center

attributes.name: receiver_profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Cost allocations can be allocated to profit centers for profitability analysis. Normalizing STRING receiver_profit_center_code to FK receiver_profit_center_id → profit_center.profit_center_id. Remove

attributes.name: sender_cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Cost allocations track sender cost center for internal cost distribution. Normalizing STRING sender_cost_center_code to FK sender_cost_center_id → cost_center.cost_center_id (first FK to cost_center w

attributes.name: allocated_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount allocated from sender to receiver in the transaction currency. Represents the portion of shared cost assigned to the receiver.

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: Method used to distribute costs from sender to receiver. Percentage allocates by fixed ratio, quantity by volume or count, equivalence by weighted factors, direct by explicit assignment, activity-based by activity driver consumption, driver-based by cost driver metrics.

attributes.name: allocation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments explaining the allocation rationale, special circumstances, or business justification. Used for audit and review purposes.

attributes.name: allocation_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of sender cost allocated to this receiver when using percentage-based allocation method. Value between 0 and 100.

attributes.name: allocation_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity or volume used as the basis for allocation when using quantity-based or driver-based methods. Unit depends on allocation driver.

attributes.name: allocation_run_date
attributes.description: Date when the allocation cycle was executed. May differ from posting date if allocation is run retrospectively or in batch.

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the cost allocation record. Posted indicates successfully posted to CO/FI, reversed indicates reversal document created, pending indicates awaiting approval, error indicates posting failure, cancelled indicates allocation was voided.

attributes.name: allocation_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the allocation quantity (e.g., hours, square meters, headcount, transactions). Defines the driver metric.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO - Unit of Measure

attributes.name: brand_code
attributes.description: Brand code to which the allocated cost is assigned. Supports brand-level profitability and GMROI analysis.

attributes.name: channel_code
attributes.description: Sales or distribution channel code (e.g., retail, wholesale, e-commerce, DTC) to which the allocated cost is assigned. Enables channel-level profitability analysis.

attributes.name: controlling_area_code
attributes.description: Controlling area in which the cost allocation is executed. Represents the organizational unit for cost accounting and internal reporting.

attributes.name: cost_element_code
attributes.description: Cost element (account assignment) under which the allocated cost is posted. Represents the nature of the cost being distributed (e.g., overhead, logistics, marketing).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO - Cost Element Master

attributes.name: cost_element_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the cost element being allocated. Provides business-readable context for the type of cost.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO - Cost Element Master

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User ID of the person or system account that created the cost allocation record. Part of audit trail.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the cost allocation record was created in the system. Part of audit trail for compliance and data lineage.

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: Controlling document number generated in SAP S/4HANA CO when the allocation is posted. Provides audit trail and traceability.

attributes.name: equivalence_number
attributes.description: Weighting factor used in equivalence-based allocation. Represents the relative consumption or benefit received by the receiver.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO - Equivalence Number Allocation

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year when the allocation is posted. Typically 1-12 for monthly periods, supports EOM close processes.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which the cost allocation is posted. Used for period-based financial reporting and EBITDA analysis.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID of the person or system account that last modified the cost allocation record. Part of audit trail.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the cost allocation record was last modified. Part of audit trail for compliance and change tracking.

attributes.name: local_currency_amount
attributes.description: Allocated amount converted to the company code local currency for statutory reporting and consolidation.

attributes.name: local_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the company code local currency.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Date when the cost allocation was posted to the general ledger and controlling documents. Used for period assignment and audit trail.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO - Document Posting Date

attributes.name: product_line_code
attributes.description: Product line or category code to which the allocated cost is assigned. Enables product-level profitability and COGS analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO - Product Line Profitability

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: External or cross-reference document number for traceability. May reference source documents, approval workflows, or related transactions.

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Geographic region code to which the allocated cost is assigned. Enables regional profitability and landed cost analysis.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this allocation record is a reversal of a previous allocation. True if this is a reversal document.

attributes.name: segment_code
attributes.description: Business segment code for segment reporting under IFRS 8. Enables profitability analysis by reportable segment.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifier of the source system from which the cost allocation record originated. Typically SAP S/4HANA CO module identifier.

attributes.name: transaction_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the allocated amount is denominated. Typically the controlling area currency.

products.name: margin_record
products.description: Authoritative profitability analysis record in SAP S/4HANA CO-PA capturing the complete cost-to-margin chain from landed cost inputs through COGS recognition to realized margin outputs. At the SKU/transaction level by channel, region, and season, stores: full landed duty paid (LDP) cost breakdown (FOB, ocean/air freight, insurance, customs duty, HS code tariff rate, GSP preference, port handling, inland freight), COGS recognition event (standard cost, actual cost, cost variance, quantity sold, sales order reference), and margin outputs (net revenue, gross margin, contribution margin, AUR, ASP, IMU, MMU, STR contribution, GMROI, markdown amount, discount amount). The single source of truth for product-level profitability from sourcing origin through gross margin analysis in apparel fashion.
products.reference: SAP CO-PA Profitability Segment / Margin Analysis

attributes.name: margin_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the margin record. Primary key for the authoritative profitability analysis record capturing the complete cost-to-margin chain from landed cost through COGS to realized margin at SKU/transaction level.

attributes.name: environmental_impact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.environmental_impact. Business justification: Links product profitability to lifecycle environmental footprint. Enables true-cost accounting (financial + environmental), sustainable product portfolio optimization, and eco-margin analysis—emerging

attributes.name: actual_cost_amount
attributes.description: Actual cost per unit based on real landed cost inputs. Used to calculate cost variance against standard cost.

attributes.name: air_freight_cost
attributes.description: Air shipping cost component of landed cost. Used when expedited shipping is required, impacting margin significantly.

attributes.name: asp_amount
attributes.description: Average selling price per unit at gross revenue level before markdowns. Used to track pricing strategy effectiveness.

attributes.name: aur_amount
attributes.description: Average selling price per unit after markdowns and discounts. Key metric for pricing effectiveness and markdown impact analysis.

attributes.name: brand_code
attributes.description: Brand identifier for multi-brand portfolio margin analysis. Enables brand-level profitability comparison and GMROI benchmarking.

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: Sales channel through which the transaction occurred. Critical dimension for channel-level profitability analysis and GMROI calculation.

attributes.name: cogs_amount
attributes.description: Total cost of goods sold recognized for this transaction. The cost basis subtracted from net revenue to calculate gross margin.

attributes.name: contribution_margin_amount
attributes.description: Gross margin minus variable selling expenses. Used for break-even analysis and channel profitability assessment.

attributes.name: cost_variance_amount
attributes.description: Difference between actual cost and standard cost. Positive variance indicates cost overrun impacting margin negatively.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this margin record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this margin record. Essential for multi-currency consolidation.

attributes.name: customs_duty_amount
attributes.description: Import duty paid at customs based on HS code classification and tariff rate. Critical component of landed cost impacting gross margin.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Promotional discount or customer-specific discount applied to the transaction. Reduces net revenue and impacts gross margin.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year for this margin record. Used for EOM close and period-level profitability analysis.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which this margin record is recognized for financial reporting purposes.

attributes.name: fob_cost_amount
attributes.description: Factory gate cost before freight, insurance, and duties. First component of the landed duty paid cost breakdown. Sourced from purchase order or standard costing.

attributes.name: gmroi_ratio
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gross Margin Return on Investment (GMROI) Ratio
attributes.description: Gross margin dollars returned for every dollar of inventory investment. Critical metric for inventory productivity and buying decisions.

attributes.name: gross_margin_amount
attributes.description: Net revenue minus COGS. The primary profitability metric for product-level margin analysis.

attributes.name: gross_margin_percentage
attributes.description: Gross margin as a percentage of net revenue. Key performance indicator for profitability analysis by SKU, channel, and region.

attributes.name: gross_revenue_amount
attributes.description: Total revenue before discounts and markdowns. The starting point for margin calculation.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 - Revenue from Contracts with Customers

attributes.name: gsp_preference_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Generalized System of Preferences (GSP) Preference Indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether GSP tariff preference was applied to reduce or eliminate customs duty. Impacts landed cost and margin calculation.

attributes.name: hs_code
attributes.description: International product classification code used to determine customs duty rates. Essential for accurate landed cost calculation and tariff management.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization - Harmonized System Convention

attributes.name: imu_percentage
attributes.description: Initial markup percentage from cost to original retail price. Measures the starting margin before markdowns.

attributes.name: inland_freight_cost
attributes.description: Domestic transportation cost from port to distribution center or store. Final component of the full LDP cost breakdown.

attributes.name: insurance_cost
attributes.description: Cargo insurance cost component of landed cost. Part of the full LDP cost breakdown.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this margin record was last updated. Tracks changes to cost components or margin calculations due to adjustments or corrections.

attributes.name: markdown_amount
attributes.description: Price reduction from original retail price. Critical for calculating maintained markup and understanding margin erosion.

attributes.name: mmu_percentage
attributes.description: Maintained markup percentage after markdowns and discounts. The realized margin percentage that accounts for all price reductions.

attributes.name: net_revenue_amount
attributes.description: Revenue after markdowns and discounts. The revenue figure used to calculate gross margin and contribution margin.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 - Revenue from Contracts with Customers

attributes.name: ocean_freight_cost
attributes.description: Ocean shipping cost component of landed cost. Part of the full LDP cost breakdown for margin calculation.

attributes.name: port_handling_cost
attributes.description: Port and terminal handling charges component of landed cost. Includes unloading, storage, and customs clearance fees.

attributes.name: product_category_code
attributes.description: Product category classification for category-level margin analysis. Links to merchandise hierarchy for aggregated profitability reporting.

attributes.name: quantity_sold
attributes.description: Number of units sold in this transaction. Used to calculate unit-level margin metrics and contribution to sell-through rate.

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Geographic region code where the sale occurred. Enables regional profitability analysis and landed cost variance tracking by destination market.

attributes.name: sales_order_number
attributes.description: Reference to the sales order document that triggered the COGS recognition event. Links to the originating transaction in SAP SD.

attributes.name: season_code
attributes.description: Fashion season identifier (e.g., SS2024, FW2024) for the product. Essential for seasonal margin analysis, markdown tracking, and sell-through rate contribution.

attributes.name: sku_code
attributes.description: Unique product identifier at the SKU level for which margin is calculated. Links to the specific product variant (style-color-size combination) in the product master.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Originating system that provided the margin record data. Typically SAP S/4HANA CO-PA or Oracle Retail for profitability analysis.

attributes.name: standard_cost_amount
attributes.description: Predetermined standard cost per unit used for inventory valuation and initial COGS recognition. Basis for cost variance analysis.

attributes.name: str_contribution
attributes.description: Contribution of this transaction to the overall sell-through rate for the SKU/season. Used to assess inventory turn and markdown risk.

attributes.name: tariff_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Customs duty rate percentage applied to this product based on HS code and country of origin. Used to calculate customs duty amount.

attributes.name: total_ldp_cost
attributes.description: Complete landed cost including FOB, freight, insurance, duties, and inland transportation. The total cost basis for COGS and margin calculation.

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: The business date when the revenue and COGS were recognized for this margin record. Represents the point-of-sale or shipment date depending on revenue recognition policy.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 - Revenue from Contracts with Customers

products.name: period_close
products.description: Tracks the EOM (End of Month) and period-end financial close process for each company code and fiscal period in SAP S/4HANA FI/CO. Captures close checklist step, responsible owner, planned close date, actual completion date, status (open, in-progress, complete, blocked), blocking reason, and sign-off approver. Manages the structured close calendar including depreciation runs, accruals, intercompany reconciliation, and statutory reporting milestones.
products.reference: SAP FI Period Close / EOM Close Process

attributes.name: period_close_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the period close record. Primary key.

attributes.name: close_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Period close ownership must link to employee for close process accountability, task assignment, and audit trail. Apparel companies require close_owner FK for SOX compliance and close process managemen

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Period close is performed per legal entity (company code). Normalizing STRING company_code to FK company_code_id → company_code.company_code_id. Remove redundant company_code STRING column.

attributes.name: ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ledger. Business justification: Period close is performed per ledger for parallel accounting. Normalizing STRING ledger_group to FK ledger_id → ledger.ledger_id. Remove redundant ledger_group STRING column.

attributes.name: accrual_posting_status
attributes.description: Status of accrual postings for expenses and revenues that need to be recognized in the current period per IFRS/GAAP accrual accounting principles.

attributes.name: actual_close_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the period close process was completed and signed off. Null if close is not yet complete.

attributes.name: blocked_steps
attributes.description: The number of checklist steps that are currently blocked and cannot proceed due to issues or dependencies.

attributes.name: blocking_reason
attributes.description: A description of the reason why the period close is blocked or delayed, such as missing data, unreconciled accounts, or pending approvals. Null if close is not blocked.

attributes.name: checklist_template_code
attributes.description: The code or identifier of the close checklist template used for this period close, defining the standard steps and milestones (e.g., depreciation run, accruals, intercompany reconciliation, statutory reporting).

attributes.name: close_completion_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the period close process was marked as complete and all checklist steps were finished.

attributes.name: close_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the period close process was initiated and status changed from open to in_progress.

attributes.name: close_status
attributes.description: Current status of the period close process. Open indicates not started, in_progress indicates close activities underway, complete indicates all steps finished and signed off, blocked indicates close cannot proceed due to issues, reopened indicates a previously closed period has been reopened for adjustments.

attributes.name: close_type
attributes.description: The purpose or scope of the close: operational for internal management reporting, statutory for regulatory and external reporting per IFRS/GAAP, management for internal KPI and EBITDA analysis, consolidation for group-level financial consolidation.

attributes.name: cogs_recognition_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) Recognition Status
attributes.description: Status of COGS recognition and inventory valuation adjustments for the period, ensuring proper matching of costs to revenues.

attributes.name: completed_steps
attributes.description: The number of checklist steps that have been completed and signed off as of the current state.

attributes.name: controlling_area_code
attributes.description: The controlling area code in SAP S/4HANA FI/CO that governs cost accounting and profitability analysis for this period close.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this period close record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the reporting currency for this period close (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: depreciation_run_status
attributes.description: Status of the depreciation calculation and posting run for fixed assets as part of the period close process.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period number within the fiscal year (e.g., 1-12 for monthly periods, 1-4 for quarterly periods). Represents the accounting period being closed.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year for which the period close is being performed, typically a four-digit year (e.g., 2024).

attributes.name: intercompany_reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of intercompany account reconciliation and elimination entries required for group consolidation.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the user who last modified this period close record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this period close record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional comments, observations, or special instructions related to this period close process.

attributes.name: period_lock_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the fiscal period has been locked in SAP S/4HANA FI/CO to prevent further postings. True if locked, False if open for postings.

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: The type of accounting period being closed: monthly for regular month-end close, quarterly for quarter-end, annual for year-end, or special for ad-hoc adjustments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Fiscal Year Variant

attributes.name: planned_close_date
attributes.description: The target date by which the period close process is scheduled to be completed, as defined in the close calendar.

attributes.name: reopen_approved_by
attributes.description: The name of the senior finance executive who approved the reopening of a previously closed period. Null if period has not been reopened.

attributes.name: reopen_reason
attributes.description: The business justification or reason for reopening a previously closed period, such as error correction, audit adjustment, or late invoice receipt. Null if period has not been reopened.

attributes.name: reopen_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the period was reopened for additional postings or adjustments. Null if period has not been reopened.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_status
attributes.description: Status of revenue recognition adjustments and deferrals to ensure compliance with IFRS 15 or GAAP ASC 606 revenue recognition standards.

attributes.name: sign_off_approver_email
attributes.description: The email address of the sign-off approver who provided final approval for the period close.

attributes.name: sign_off_approver_name
attributes.description: The full name of the senior finance executive (e.g., CFO, Controller) who provided final sign-off approval for the period close.

attributes.name: sign_off_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the sign-off approver formally approved and signed off on the period close, marking it as officially complete.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the source ERP system from which this period close record originated, typically SAP S/4HANA FI/CO.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier or key of this period close record in the source ERP system.

attributes.name: statutory_reporting_status
attributes.description: Status of statutory financial statement preparation and regulatory reporting submissions required for this period.

attributes.name: total_checklist_steps
attributes.description: The total number of checklist steps or tasks defined for this period close process.

attributes.name: variance_explanation
attributes.description: Explanation or commentary on significant variances identified during the close process, such as budget vs actual variances, prior period comparisons, or unusual transactions.

products.name: bank_account
products.description: Master record for bank accounts maintained in SAP S/4HANA FI (house banks and account IDs) used for payment processing, cash pooling, and treasury management. Captures bank key, account number, IBAN, SWIFT/BIC, currency, GL reconciliation account, account type (operating, payroll, LC), daily balance, and bank relationship details. Essential for cash flow management, payment run configuration, and Letter of Credit settlement in apparel fashion global operations.

attributes.name: bank_account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the bank account record. Primary key for the bank account master data entity.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Internal account identifier within the house bank structure. Used in combination with house_bank_id to uniquely identify the account in SAP.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Bank accounts belong to a legal entity (company code). Normalizing STRING company_code to FK company_code_id → company_code.company_code_id. Remove redundant company_code STRING column.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Bank accounts are linked to GL accounts for reconciliation and financial reporting. Normalizing STRING gl_account_code to FK gl_account_id → gl_account.gl_account_id. Remove redundant gl_account_code

attributes.name: account_closing_date
attributes.description: Date when the bank account was officially closed. Null for active accounts.

attributes.name: account_holder_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the account holder as registered with the bank. Typically matches the company legal entity name.

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: The actual bank account number as assigned by the financial institution. Format varies by country and banking system.

attributes.name: account_opening_date
attributes.description: Date when the bank account was officially opened and activated with the financial institution.

attributes.name: account_purpose_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the business purpose and usage of this bank account. Provides context for treasury management and audit purposes.

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the bank account. Active accounts are in use, inactive are temporarily suspended, closed are permanently terminated, blocked are restricted by bank or company, dormant have no recent activity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Master Data Management

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the bank account based on its business purpose. Operating accounts handle day-to-day transactions, payroll accounts for employee payments, Letter of Credit (LC) accounts for trade finance, cash pooling for treasury optimization, escrow for held funds, and transit for in-process payments.

attributes.name: available_balance_amount
attributes.description: Available balance after accounting for holds, pending transactions, and reserved funds. Represents actual spendable cash.

attributes.name: bank_address_line_1
attributes.description: First line of the bank branch physical address. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: bank_address_line_2
attributes.description: Second line of the bank branch physical address (suite, floor, building). Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: bank_branch_name
attributes.description: Name of the specific bank branch where the account is maintained.

attributes.name: bank_city
attributes.description: City where the bank branch is located. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: bank_key
attributes.description: Country-specific bank identifier code (e.g., routing number in USA, sort code in UK, bank code in other countries). Used for domestic payment processing.

attributes.name: bank_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the financial institution where the account is held.

attributes.name: bank_phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the bank branch. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: bank_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the bank branch location. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: bank_state_province
attributes.description: State or province where the bank branch is located. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: cash_pooling_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this account participates in a cash pooling arrangement for treasury optimization across multiple entities or accounts.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code where the bank account is domiciled. Important for regulatory reporting and tax compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this bank account master record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code representing the primary currency denomination of the bank account.

attributes.name: current_balance_amount
attributes.description: Current available balance in the bank account as of the last reconciliation or statement date. Used for cash flow management and liquidity analysis.

attributes.name: house_bank_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the house bank in SAP S/4HANA FI. Represents the company's banking partner where the account is maintained.

attributes.name: iban
attributes.description: International Bank Account Number used for cross-border payments and international transactions. Standardized format for global banking.

attributes.name: interest_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Annual interest rate percentage applied to the account balance. May be positive for interest-bearing accounts or negative for certain treasury accounts.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this bank account master record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: last_reconciliation_date
attributes.description: Date when the last bank reconciliation was completed for this account. Critical for End of Month (EOM) close and financial reporting accuracy.

attributes.name: last_statement_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent bank statement received and processed for this account. Used for reconciliation tracking.

attributes.name: lc_facility_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this account is designated for Letter of Credit (LC) issuance and settlement. Critical for apparel fashion global sourcing and Free on Board (FOB) payment terms.
attributes.references: UCP 600 Uniform Customs and Practice for Documentary Credits

attributes.name: lc_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum Letter of Credit facility limit available on this account. Used for managing trade finance capacity for international supplier payments.
attributes.references: UCP 600 Uniform Customs and Practice for Documentary Credits

attributes.name: minimum_balance_amount
attributes.description: Minimum balance requirement set by the bank or company policy to avoid fees or maintain account status.

attributes.name: overdraft_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum overdraft or credit facility limit extended by the bank for this account. Zero if no overdraft facility exists.

products.name: cost_center_initiative_participation
products.description: This association product represents the participation relationship between cost centers and sustainability initiatives in Apparel Fashion operations. It captures the cross-functional involvement of organizational cost centers (stores, warehouses, DCs, offices) in discrete sustainability improvement programs (renewable energy, waterless dyeing, repair services, packaging elimination). Each record links one cost center to one sustainability initiative with attributes that track the participation role (lead vs. participant), cost allocation responsibility, timeline boundaries, and implementation phase. This enables portfolio management of sustainability programs across the organizational cost structure and supports ESG reporting by cost center hierarchy.. Existence Justification: In Apparel Fashion sustainability operations, cost centers (stores, warehouses, DCs, offices, production facilities) participate in multiple sustainability initiatives simultaneously (LED retrofit, renewable energy procurement, waterless dyeing, packaging elimination), and each initiative involves multiple cost centers across the organizational hierarchy. The business actively manages these participation relationships as part of ESG program portfolio management, tracking which locations are involved in which programs, their roles (lead vs. participant), cost allocation responsibility, implementation timelines, and measured impact by location.

attributes.name: cost_center_initiative_participation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cost center initiative participation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cost Center Initiative Participation - Cost Center Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the cost center participating in the sustainability initiative. References the organizational cost object (store, warehouse, DC, office, production facility) involved in the program.

attributes.name: initiative_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cost Center Initiative Participation - Sustainability Initiative Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the sustainability initiative in which the cost center is participating. References the discrete sustainability improvement program or project.

attributes.name: sustainability_initiative_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to sustainability.sustainability_initiative. The sustainability program in which the cost center participates.

attributes.name: actual_carbon_reduction_mt_co2e
attributes.description: Measured annual greenhouse gas emissions reduction in metric tons of CO2 equivalent achieved by this cost center through participation in the initiative. Enables rollup of initiative impact by cost center hierarchy and location.

attributes.name: actual_energy_savings_mwh
attributes.description: Measured annual energy consumption reduction in megawatt hours achieved by this cost center through participation in the initiative. Supports energy efficiency reporting by facility type and geography.

attributes.name: actual_water_savings_m3
attributes.description: Measured annual water consumption reduction in cubic meters achieved by this cost center through participation in the initiative. Supports water stewardship reporting by facility and region.

attributes.name: allocated_investment_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the initiative's total investment amount allocated to this cost center, calculated as initiative investment_amount × cost_allocation_percentage. Used for cost center budget impact analysis and ESG investment tracking by organizational unit.

attributes.name: cost_allocation_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the initiative's total investment amount allocated to or borne by this cost center, expressed as a decimal percentage (0.00 to 100.00). Used for distributing initiative costs across participating organizational units and for cost center budget tracking. This attribute was explicitly identified in the detection reasoning as relationship data (cost share).

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date when this cost center completed or exited participation in the sustainability initiative. Null if participation is ongoing. This attribute was explicitly identified in the detection reasoning as relationship data (timeline).

attributes.name: initiative_phase
attributes.description: The current phase of initiative implementation at this specific cost center. PLANNING: initiative approved but not yet started at this location. IMPLEMENTATION: active rollout in progress. MEASUREMENT: implementation complete, measuring impact. COMPLETED: initiative fully implemented and measured at this location. SUSPENDED: participation paused or cancelled. This attribute was explicitly identified in the detection reasoning as relationship data (phase).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing implementation details, challenges, lessons learned, or other context specific to this cost center's participation in the initiative.

attributes.name: participation_role
attributes.description: The role of the cost center in the sustainability initiative. LEAD: primary responsible party driving implementation at this location. PARTICIPANT: active participant implementing the program. PILOT: test site for initiative before broader rollout. OBSERVER: monitoring or learning from the initiative without active implementation. This attribute was explicitly identified in the detection reasoning as relationship data.

attributes.name: participation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this cost center's participation in the initiative. ACTIVE: currently participating. COMPLETED: participation finished successfully. SUSPENDED: temporarily paused. CANCELLED: participation terminated before completion.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date when this cost center began participating in the sustainability initiative. May differ from the initiative's overall start date if cost centers join in phases. This attribute was explicitly identified in the detection reasoning as relationship data (timeline).

products.name: staffing_model

products.name: benefit_enrollment
products.description: SSOT for the complete employee benefits lifecycle. Plan catalog section defines available benefit plans including plan name, type (medical, dental, vision, retirement, life, disability, supplemental), carrier, plan year, coverage tiers, employer/employee contribution rates, eligibility rules, vesting schedules, and open enrollment windows. Enrollment section captures individual employee elections including selected plan, coverage tier, enrollment/effective dates, annual premium, contribution amounts, dependent/beneficiary coverage, life event triggers, and enrollment status (active, waived, terminated, COBRA). Supports open enrollment management, ACA compliance reporting (1095-C generation), COBRA administration, qualifying life event processing, and employee discount program tracking for retail associates.

attributes.name: benefit_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the benefit enrollment record. Primary key for the benefit enrollment entity.

attributes.name: benefit_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the benefit plan selected by the employee. Links to the benefit plan catalog.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Benefit enrollments must link to legal entity for benefit cost allocation, entity-level benefit accounting, and statutory reporting (ACA 1095-C by entity). Apparel companies require benefit→company_co

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the employee enrolling in benefits. Links to the employee master record in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: aca_affordability_safe_harbor
attributes.description: Safe harbor method used to determine ACA affordability for this enrollment. Employers can use federal poverty line, rate of pay, or W-2 wages to demonstrate that coverage offered meets affordability requirements and avoid employer shared responsibility penalties.

attributes.name: aca_minimum_value_met_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the benefit plan meets the ACA minimum value standard of covering at least 60% of the total allowed cost of benefits. Required for ACA compliance and Form 1095-C reporting.

attributes.name: annual_premium_amount
attributes.description: Total annual cost of the benefit plan for the selected coverage tier. Represents the combined employer and employee contribution before any cost-sharing splits.

attributes.name: beneficiary_count
attributes.description: Number of beneficiaries designated for life insurance and retirement plan death benefits. Applicable for life insurance, AD&D, and 401k plan enrollments.

attributes.name: carrier_confirmation_received_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the benefit carrier has confirmed receipt and processing of the enrollment. Confirmation typically includes member ID assignment and coverage effective date validation.
attributes.references: EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance Standard

attributes.name: carrier_member_number
attributes.description: Unique member identifier assigned by the benefit carrier for this enrollment. Used for claims processing, provider verification, and member services. Differs from employee ID and is carrier-specific.

attributes.name: carrier_notification_sent_date
attributes.description: Date on which enrollment data was transmitted to the benefit carrier. Used to track carrier processing timelines and resolve coverage activation issues.
attributes.references: EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance Standard

attributes.name: carrier_notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the enrollment information was transmitted to the benefit carrier for coverage activation. Typically sent via EDI 834 transaction for medical, dental, and vision plans.
attributes.references: EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance Standard

attributes.name: cobra_election_date
attributes.description: Date on which the former employee or qualified beneficiary elected to continue coverage under COBRA. Must occur within 60 days of the later of the qualifying event date or the date the COBRA notice was provided.

attributes.name: cobra_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which COBRA continuation coverage ends. Typically 18 months after the qualifying event for termination or reduction in hours, 36 months for divorce or dependent loss of eligibility.

attributes.name: cobra_qualifying_event
attributes.description: Type of qualifying event that triggered COBRA continuation coverage eligibility. Termination of employment and reduction in hours are most common for employees; divorce and dependent aging out apply to dependents.

attributes.name: coverage_tier
attributes.description: Level of coverage elected by the employee, determining who is covered under the benefit plan. Employee only covers the individual, employee plus spouse covers two adults, employee plus children covers employee and dependents under 26, and employee plus family covers all eligible dependents.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this benefit enrollment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: dependent_count
attributes.description: Number of eligible dependents covered under this enrollment. Includes spouse, domestic partner, and children under age 26 as defined by ACA dependent coverage provisions.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which benefit coverage ends. Null for active enrollments. Populated upon termination of employment, plan change, or waiver. For COBRA, typically 18 months after qualifying event.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which benefit coverage begins. For new hires, typically the first day of the month following hire date or 30 days after hire. For open enrollment, typically January 1st of the plan year.

attributes.name: employee_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Annual amount deducted from employee pay for benefit premium. Typically deducted pre-tax for qualified plans under Section 125. Used for payroll processing and W-2 reporting.

attributes.name: employee_discount_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is eligible for the Apparel Fashion employee discount program as part of their benefits package. Typically available to retail associates and corporate staff for purchasing company merchandise at reduced prices.

attributes.name: employee_discount_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage discount on company merchandise available to the employee. Varies by employee type and tenure. Retail associates typically receive 20-30% discount, corporate staff may receive higher tiers.

attributes.name: employer_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Annual amount contributed by Apparel Fashion toward the employee benefit premium. Used for ACA affordability calculations and ERISA reporting.

attributes.name: enrollment_confirmation_sent_date
attributes.description: Date on which the enrollment confirmation was sent to the employee via email or postal mail. Used for audit trail and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: enrollment_confirmation_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an enrollment confirmation notification was sent to the employee. Confirmation includes enrollment number, coverage details, premium amounts, and effective dates.
attributes.references: ERISA Section 104, Plan Document Disclosure Requirements

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the employee submitted their benefit election. This is the transaction date for the enrollment event and may differ from the coverage effective date.

attributes.name: enrollment_number
attributes.description: Business-facing enrollment confirmation number provided to the employee upon successful enrollment. Used for reference in benefits inquiries and claims.

attributes.name: enrollment_source
attributes.description: Channel or system through which the benefit enrollment was submitted. Employee self-service indicates online enrollment through Workday portal, HR representative indicates manual entry by HR staff, automated renewal applies to passive enrollments carried forward from prior year.

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the benefit enrollment. Active indicates coverage is in force, waived means employee declined coverage, terminated indicates coverage has ended, pending is awaiting approval or effective date, suspended is temporarily inactive, and COBRA active indicates continuation coverage post-employment.

attributes.name: enrollment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the enrollment event that triggered this benefit election. New hire enrollments occur within 30 days of hire date, open enrollment is the annual election period, qualifying life events include marriage/birth/divorce, and COBRA applies to continuation coverage after employment termination.
attributes.references: ERISA Section 601, HIPAA Special Enrollment Rights

attributes.name: form_1095c_furnished_date
attributes.description: Date on which Form 1095-C was provided to the employee. Must be furnished by January 31st following the calendar year of coverage per IRS requirements.

attributes.name: form_1095c_generated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether IRS Form 1095-C has been generated for this enrollment record. Form 1095-C is required for ACA reporting to document that coverage was offered to the employee and dependents.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this benefit enrollment record was last updated. Captures any changes to enrollment status, coverage tier, premium amounts, or other enrollment attributes.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional information about the enrollment such as special circumstances, exceptions, or processing notes. Used by benefits administrators for case management and audit documentation.

attributes.name: payroll_deduction_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which employee benefit contributions are deducted from payroll. Aligns with the company payroll schedule for retail associates, corporate staff, and distribution center teams.

attributes.name: per_pay_period_deduction_amount
attributes.description: Employee contribution amount deducted each pay period. Calculated by dividing annual employee contribution by number of pay periods per year based on payroll deduction frequency.

attributes.name: plan_year
attributes.description: Calendar year for which this benefit enrollment is effective. Typically aligns with open enrollment periods and ACA reporting requirements.

attributes.name: qualifying_life_event_date
attributes.description: Date on which the qualifying life event occurred. Used to determine the 30-day election window and coverage effective date for mid-year changes.

attributes.name: qualifying_life_event_type
attributes.description: Type of qualifying life event that triggered a mid-year enrollment change outside of open enrollment. QLE allows employees to modify benefit elections within 30 days of the event as permitted by HIPAA special enrollment rights. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: marriage|divorce|birth|adoption|death|loss_of_coverage|employment_change — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: vesting_date
attributes.description: Date on which the employee becomes fully vested in employer contributions. Typically after 3-5 years of service depending on the plan vesting schedule (cliff or graded).

attributes.name: vesting_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of employer contributions that the employee is entitled to retain upon termination. Applicable to retirement plans such as 401k with employer match. Increases based on years of service per the plan vesting schedule.

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Reason provided by employee for declining benefit coverage. Required for ACA reporting to demonstrate that coverage was offered but declined. Spouse coverage and other employer coverage are most common reasons. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: spouse_coverage|other_employer_coverage|medicare|medicaid|tricare|cost|not_needed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: waiver_signed_date
attributes.description: Date on which the employee signed the benefit waiver form. Required documentation for ACA compliance to prove that coverage was offered and voluntarily declined.

products.name: talent_requisition
products.description: SSOT for the full talent acquisition lifecycle from requisition approval through candidate hire. Requisition header captures requisition number, job profile, target location, hiring manager, recruiter, requisition status (draft, approved, open, filled, cancelled), target start date, approved headcount, sourcing channel strategy, and time-to-fill KPI. Candidate application records capture applicant identity, contact details, application date, source channel (job board, referral, campus, walk-in, internal transfer), pipeline stage (applied, screened, phone screen, interviewed, offered, hired, rejected, withdrawn), interview scores, offer details (compensation, start date, contingencies), background check status, and disposition reason. Supports funnel analysis, seasonal hiring ramp planning (holiday, back-to-school), recruiter productivity reporting, diversity pipeline tracking, and high-volume retail associate hiring workflows.

attributes.name: time_to_fill_days

products.name: performance_review

products.name: obligation
products.description: Master record defining each distinct regulatory, ethical, or sustainability compliance obligation applicable to Apparel Fashion, serving as both the obligation registry and the unified compliance calendar. Captures obligation type (labeling, safety, ESG, trade, labor, chemical), governing body, applicable jurisdiction, regulatory citation, effective date, review frequency, and business process owner. Manages the full compliance scheduling lifecycle as the single operational calendar: filing deadlines, certification renewal dates, audit scheduling windows, planned vs. actual completion dates, reminder triggers, escalation paths, SLA breach thresholds, responsible team assignments, and calendar entry status (upcoming, overdue, completed, waived). Acts as the single authoritative source for what the company must comply with, when each activity is due, and who owns it — replacing any need for a separate calendar entity. Foundation for all proactive compliance tracking, deadline management, and regulatory calendar operations across FTC labeling, CPSC safety, ESG reporting, trade compliance, and ethical sourcing programs.

products.name: ftc_label

Manages the full lifecycle of label creation, legal review, approval, and revision across all product categories including children's sleepwear (flammability labeling) and down/feather products.

attributes.name: ftc_label_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the FTC-compliant textile and apparel label record. Primary key for the label master data.

attributes.name: colorway_development_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to design.colorway_development. Business justification: Fiber content and care instructions vary by colorway due to different dye processes and fabric treatments. Links FTC label to specific colorway for accurate regulatory labeling and care instruction co

attributes.name: compliance_certification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_certification. Business justification: FTC labels reference certifications for organic, OEKO-TEX, and other claims. This FK links the label to the certification it references, enabling verification that label claims are backed by valid cer

attributes.name: ecolabel_id

attributes.name: labeling_requirement_id

This FK links the label design to the requirement it satisfies, enabling verification that labels comply with jurisdiction-specific rules.

attributes.name: print_design_id

attributes.name: superseded_by_label_ftc_label_id
attributes.description: Reference to the newer label that replaces this label. Used to track label revision history and ensure proper version control. Null for current active labels.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the label received final approval for production and use. Marks transition from legal_review to approved status.

attributes.name: care_instructions
attributes.description: Complete care instructions for the product including washing, bleaching, drying, ironing, and dry cleaning guidance as required by the Care Labeling Rule. Must include at least one safe cleaning method.
attributes.references: 16 CFR Part 423 - Care Labeling of Textile Wearing Apparel

attributes.name: care_symbol_code
attributes.description: Standardized care symbol codes following ASTM D5489 international care labeling system. Represents washing, bleaching, drying, ironing, and professional care symbols in sequence.
attributes.references: ASTM D5489 - Standard Guide for Care Symbols for Care Instructions on Textile Products

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code indicating where the product was manufactured, processed, or assembled as required by FTC country of origin marking requirements and customs regulations.
attributes.references: 19 CFR Part 134 - Country of Origin Marking, ISO 3166-1 alpha-3

attributes.name: country_of_origin_statement
attributes.description: Full country of origin disclosure statement as it appears on the label. Example: 'Made in USA', 'Imported', 'Made in China', 'Assembled in Mexico from imported materials'.
attributes.references: 16 CFR Part 303.33 - Country of Origin Disclosure

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the label record was first created in the system. Part of audit trail for compliance tracking.

attributes.name: down_content_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage by weight of down fill content. Required disclosure for products containing down fill. Null if product contains no down.
attributes.references: 16 CFR Part 303 - Down and Feather Fill Disclosure

attributes.name: down_feather_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product contains down or feather fill and requires down/feather content disclosure per FTC guidelines.
attributes.references: 16 CFR Part 303 - Down and Feather Fill Disclosure

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the label becomes effective and approved for use on products. Labels cannot be used on products before this date.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the label is no longer valid for use on new products. Null for labels with indefinite validity. Superseded labels receive an expiration date.

attributes.name: fiber_content_description
attributes.description: Complete fiber content disclosure listing all constituent fibers by generic name and percentage by weight in descending order, as required by the Textile Fiber Products Identification Act. Example: '60% Cotton, 40% Polyester'.
attributes.references: 15 USC 70 - Textile Fiber Products Identification Act, 16 CFR Part 303

attributes.name: flammability_standard_code
attributes.description: Applicable flammability standard code for the product. 16CFR1610 for general wearing apparel, 16CFR1615/1616 for childrens sleepwear. Required for products subject to CPSC flammability regulations.
attributes.references: 16 CFR Part 1610 - Flammability of Clothing Textiles, 16 CFR Part 1615 - Childrens Sleepwear

attributes.name: flammability_test_result

attributes.references: 16 CFR Part 1610, 16 CFR Part 1615 - Flammability Testing Requirements

attributes.name: fur_animal_name

attributes.references: 16 CFR Part 301 - Fur Products Labeling Act Rules

attributes.name: fur_product_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product contains fur and is subject to the Fur Products Labeling Act requirements.

attributes.name: label_language
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 639-2 language code indicating the primary language of the label text. Multiple languages may require separate label records.

attributes.name: label_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the label used for tracking and reference across product lifecycle management and compliance systems.

attributes.name: label_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the label in the approval workflow. Tracks progression from draft through legal review to active use and eventual retirement.

attributes.name: label_type
attributes.description: Physical format and construction method of the label (woven fabric label, printed label, heat transfer, hang tag, sewn-in label, or adhesive label).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the label record was last modified. Updated whenever any field in the record changes. Part of audit trail for compliance tracking.

attributes.name: legal_review_date
attributes.description: Date when legal review of the label was completed and compliance with FTC regulations was verified.

attributes.name: legal_reviewer_name
attributes.description: Name of the legal or compliance professional who reviewed and approved the label for regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: manufacturer_identifier_type
attributes.description: Type of manufacturer or importer identification used on the label: RN (Registered Identification Number), WPL (Wool Products Labeling number), or full company name.

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the manufacturer, importer, or other business responsible for the product. Used when RN/WPL number is not provided on the label.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the label. May include supplier instructions, production notes, or compliance clarifications.

attributes.name: oeko_tex_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product is certified under OEKO-TEX Standard 100 for textile safety and absence of harmful substances.

attributes.name: organic_certification_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product carries organic certification (GOTS, USDA Organic, or other recognized organic standard) and requires organic content disclosure.
attributes.references: Global Organic Textile Standard (GOTS), USDA Organic Standards

attributes.name: primary_fiber_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage by weight of the primary fiber constituent. Must be accurate within tolerances specified by FTC regulations (typically +/- 3% for fibers over 15%, +/- 2% for fibers under 15%).

attributes.name: primary_fiber_type
attributes.description: The predominant fiber type by weight percentage. Used for reporting and categorization purposes.
attributes.references: 16 CFR Part 303 - Textile Fiber Products Identification Act Rules

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: High-level product category that determines applicable FTC labeling requirements. Childrens sleepwear and down/feather products have additional flammability and content disclosure requirements.
attributes.references: 16 CFR Part 1615 - Childrens Sleepwear Flammability Standards, 16 CFR Part 1633

attributes.name: recycled_content_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product contains recycled fiber content and requires recycled content disclosure per FTC Green Guides.

attributes.name: recycled_content_percentage

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Sequential revision number for the label. Increments with each approved change to fiber content, care instructions, or other regulated content.

attributes.name: revision_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for creating a new revision of the label. Examples: fiber content change, country of origin change, regulatory requirement update, care instruction correction.

attributes.name: rn_number
attributes.description: FTC-issued Registered Identification Number that identifies the manufacturer, importer, or other business responsible for the product. Format: RN followed by 5-6 digits.

attributes.name: wool_content_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage by weight of wool fiber content. Required disclosure for products subject to Wool Products Labeling Act. Null if product contains no wool.
attributes.references: 16 CFR Part 300 - Wool Products Labeling Act Rules

attributes.name: wool_product_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product contains wool fiber and is subject to the Wool Products Labeling Act requirements. True if product contains any wool content.

attributes.name: wpl_number
attributes.description: Legacy FTC-issued Wool Products Labeling number (discontinued in 1998 but still valid for existing registrations). Format: WPL followed by 4-5 digits.

Supports customs classification, duty optimization, sanctions compliance, and preferential trade program utilization across all sourcing and distribution markets.

attributes.name: trade_compliance_record_id

attributes.description: Indicates whether the product qualifies for duty-free or reduced-duty treatment under the Generalized System of Preferences program.

attributes.name: hs_code_description
attributes.description: Official description of the HS code classification from the Harmonized System nomenclature.

attributes.name: import_duty_rate

attributes.name: landed_duty_paid_amount

products.name: regulatory_change
products.description: Regulatory change management record tracking new, amended, or repealed regulations that impact Apparel Fashion's operations. Captures the regulation name, issuing authority, jurisdiction, change type (new/amendment/repeal), effective date, impact assessment, affected business processes, and required internal response actions. Drives the regulatory change management workflow ensuring timely adaptation of labeling, safety, trade, and ESG compliance programs.

attributes.name: regulatory_change_id

This FK links the change record to the obligation it creates or affects, enabling tracking of obligation evolution over ti

attributes.description: Type of regulatory change: new regulation introduced, amendment to existing regulation, repeal of regulation, clarification issued, extension of deadline, or temporary suspension.

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: product_safety|labeling|trade_compliance|labor_standards|environmental_esg|data_privacy|financial_reporting|ethical_sourcing|quality_standards|consumer_protection — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: compliance_progress_status

attributes.name: impact_assessment

attributes.name: internal_response_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this regulatory change requires formal internal response actions, policy updates, or operational changes (True) or is informational only (False).

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory body, government agency, or standards organization that issued or amended the regulation (e.g., FTC, CPSC, ISO, OEKO-TEX, GOTS).

attributes.name: jurisdiction
attributes.description: Geographic or legal jurisdiction where the regulation applies (e.g., USA, EU, California, Global). Use 3-letter ISO country codes or recognized jurisdiction names.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, observations, or internal commentary related to this regulatory change.

attributes.name: notification_date

attributes.name: notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether internal stakeholders have been formally notified of this regulatory change (True) or not (False).

attributes.name: publication_date

attributes.name: regulation_code

attributes.name: regulation_name

products.name: substance_regulation
products.description: This association product represents the regulatory restriction relationship between compliance obligations and restricted substances. It captures the specific regulatory requirements, thresholds, and conditions that apply when a particular compliance obligation restricts a particular substance. Each record links one compliance obligation to one restricted substance with jurisdiction-specific thresholds, effective dates, exemption conditions, and reporting requirements that exist only in the context of this regulatory relationship.. Existence Justification: This is a genuine operational M:N relationship representing substance regulation management in apparel compliance. Compliance teams actively manage a matrix where each compliance obligation (REACH, Prop 65, CPSIA, etc.) restricts multiple substances, and each substance is restricted by multiple regulations with different thresholds, exemptions, and effective dates. The business queries this as 'which substances are restricted under REACH?' and 'which regulations restrict lead?'

products.name: test_substance_measurement
products.description: This association product represents the measurement result for a specific restricted substance within a product safety test. It captures the laboratory measurement of each substance tested, the threshold comparison, and the pass/fail determination for that substance. Each record links one product_safety_test to one restricted_substance with measurement values, thresholds, and results that exist only in the context of this specific test-substance combination.. Existence Justification: In apparel product safety testing, laboratories test each product sample against multiple restricted substances (lead, cadmium, phthalates, formaldehyde, etc.) and report individual measurement results for each substance. A single safety test generates multiple substance measurements, and each restricted substance is tested across many different products/tests over time. The business actively manages these test-substance measurements as the core output of laboratory testing.

attributes.description: Name of the consulting firm, certification body, or internal department that performed the assessment. Used for credibility evaluation and third-party verification tracking.
