products.name: supplier_esg_assessment
products.description: Transactional record of ESG and sustainability assessments conducted on Apparel Fashion's Tier 1, Tier 2, and Tier 3 suppliers and factories. Captures assessment date, assessment type (self-assessment, third-party audit, Higg FEM, SMETA), supplier tier, environmental score, social score, governance score, overall rating, key findings, and remediation requirements. Distinct from quality audits — focuses on ESG performance rather than product quality.
products.reference: Higg Facility Environmental Module (FEM) / SMETA / amfori BSCI

attributes.name: supplier_esg_assessment_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supplier ESG (Environmental, Social, Governance) Assessment ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the supplier ESG assessment record.

attributes.name: esg_report_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.esg_report. Business justification: Supplier ESG assessment results are aggregated and disclosed in corporate ESG reports. Need linkage for reporting supplier sustainability performance and risk management. N:1 relationship. No bidirect

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.facility. Business justification: ESG assessments are conducted at specific facilities. facility_name and facility_location are text fields that should be normalized to facility FK for data consistency and to enable linking assessment

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier or factory being assessed for ESG performance.

attributes.name: areas_for_improvement
attributes.description: Description of areas where the supplier needs to improve ESG performance to meet standards or best practices.

attributes.name: assessment_cost
attributes.description: Total cost incurred for conducting the ESG assessment, including auditor fees, travel, and administrative expenses.

attributes.name: assessment_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the assessment cost.

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: Date when the ESG assessment was conducted or completed.

attributes.name: assessment_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the ESG assessment, used for external tracking and reporting.

attributes.name: assessment_report_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the detailed assessment report document stored in the document management system.

attributes.name: assessment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the ESG assessment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: scheduled|in_progress|completed|under_review|approved|failed|remediation_required — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: assessment_type
attributes.description: Type of ESG assessment conducted. Higg FEM (Facility Environmental Module) is a standardized supply chain tool. SMETA (Sedex Members Ethical Trade Audit) is a widely used social audit format. BSCI (Business Social Compliance Initiative) is a European supply chain management system. WRAP (Worldwide Responsible Accredited Production) is an independent certification program. SA8000 is a social accountability standard. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: self_assessment|third_party_audit|higg_fem|smeta|bsci|wrap|sa8000|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Sustainable Apparel Coalition (Higg Index), Sedex (SMETA), amfori BSCI, WRAP, Social Accountability International (SA8000)

attributes.name: assessor_accreditation
attributes.description: Professional accreditation or certification held by the assessor (e.g., APSCA, SAAS, ISO lead auditor).
attributes.references: Association of Professional Social Compliance Auditors (APSCA), Social Accountability Accreditation Services (SAAS)

attributes.name: assessor_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual or organization that conducted the ESG assessment.

attributes.name: assessor_organization
attributes.description: Name of the third-party auditing firm or certification body that performed the assessment.

attributes.name: certification_achieved
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier achieved formal certification as a result of this assessment (e.g., WRAP certified, SA8000 certified).

attributes.name: certification_name
attributes.description: Name of the ESG certification or standard achieved by the supplier through this assessment.

attributes.name: corrective_action_plan_approved
attributes.description: Indicates whether the submitted corrective action plan has been reviewed and approved by Apparel Fashion.

attributes.name: corrective_action_plan_submitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier has submitted a formal corrective action plan in response to assessment findings.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this assessment record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: critical_findings_count
attributes.description: Number of critical non-conformances or zero-tolerance violations identified during the assessment that require immediate corrective action.

attributes.name: environmental_score
attributes.description: Numerical score representing the supplier's environmental performance across metrics such as energy use, water consumption, waste management, emissions, and chemical management. Scale and methodology depend on assessment type.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 (Environmental Management), Higg FEM, GOTS (Global Organic Textile Standard)

attributes.name: facility_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the facility location.

attributes.name: follow_up_assessment_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the follow-up assessment to verify corrective action completion.

attributes.name: follow_up_assessment_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a follow-up assessment is required to verify implementation of corrective actions.

attributes.name: governance_score
attributes.description: Numerical score representing the supplier's governance and ethical business practices including anti-corruption, transparency, management systems, and compliance with laws and regulations. Scale and methodology depend on assessment type.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 (Quality Management), ISO 45001 (Occupational Health and Safety), UN Global Compact

attributes.name: key_findings_summary
attributes.description: Textual summary of the most significant findings, violations, and observations from the ESG assessment.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this assessment record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: major_findings_count
attributes.description: Number of major non-conformances identified during the assessment that require corrective action within a defined timeframe.

attributes.name: minor_findings_count
attributes.description: Number of minor non-conformances or opportunities for improvement identified during the assessment.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or context related to the ESG assessment.

attributes.name: overall_rating
attributes.description: Categorical rating summarizing the supplier's overall ESG performance. Zero tolerance indicates critical violations requiring immediate action or termination of business relationship.

attributes.name: overall_score
attributes.description: Composite numerical score representing the supplier's overall ESG performance, typically calculated as a weighted average of environmental, social, and governance scores.

attributes.name: remediation_deadline
attributes.description: Target date by which the supplier must complete all required corrective actions and remediation measures.

attributes.name: remediation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier is required to implement corrective actions or remediation measures based on assessment findings.

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: Risk classification based on the assessment results, indicating the level of ESG-related business risk posed by continuing to work with this supplier.

attributes.name: scheduled_date
attributes.description: Date when the ESG assessment was originally scheduled to occur.

attributes.name: social_score
attributes.description: Numerical score representing the supplier's social and labor performance across metrics such as working conditions, wages, working hours, health and safety, freedom of association, and non-discrimination. Scale and methodology depend on assessment type.
attributes.references: ILO (International Labour Organization) Core Conventions, Fair Labor Association (FLA) Standards, WRAP Principles, SA8000

attributes.name: strengths_identified
attributes.description: Description of positive practices, strengths, and areas of excellence identified during the assessment.

attributes.name: supplier_tier
attributes.description: Supply chain tier classification of the assessed supplier. Tier 1 are direct suppliers (cut-make-trim factories), Tier 2 are fabric mills and material processors, Tier 3 are raw material suppliers (fiber, yarn), Tier 4 are commodity suppliers.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which the assessment results are considered valid and effective.

attributes.name: valid_until_date
attributes.description: Date until which the assessment results remain valid, after which reassessment is required.

attributes.name: prior_supplier_esg_assessment_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on supplier_esg_assessment (prior_supplier_esg_assessment_id)

products.name: traceability_record
products.description: Transactional record capturing supply chain traceability events for Apparel Fashion products, tracking the journey of materials and finished goods from raw fiber origin through spinning, weaving/knitting, dyeing, CMT, and final product. Captures traceability tier (Tier 1–4), facility, material batch, transaction certificate reference, chain-of-custody method (identity preserved, segregated, mass balance, book and claim), and verification status. Enables fiber-to-finished-product traceability for transparency commitments.
products.reference: Textile Exchange Chain of Custody / GOTS Transaction Certificate

attributes.name: traceability_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the traceability record capturing a supply chain event in the product journey from raw material to finished good.
attributes.references: ISO 22005 Traceability in the feed and food chain

attributes.name: lot_batch_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific material batch or lot being traced, enabling batch-level traceability.
attributes.references: ISO 22005 Traceability in the feed and food chain

attributes.name: print_design_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to design.print_design. Business justification: Print designs are traced through supply chain for organic/certified textile compliance. Real process: GOTS/OCS traceability requires print design documentation with transaction certificates.

attributes.name: production_factory_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing facility, supplier site, or processing location where this traceability event occurred.

attributes.name: rfid_tag_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the RFID tag attached to the material or product batch, enabling automated tracking and traceability.
attributes.references: GS1 EPC (Electronic Product Code) RFID Standards

attributes.name: sketch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to design.design_sketch. Business justification: Traceability systems link materials back to original design intent for sustainability reporting and certification audits. Real process: blockchain/QR codes reference design specifications for chain-of

attributes.name: style_id
attributes.description: Reference to the finished product or material being traced through the supply chain.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier or vendor responsible for this stage of the supply chain.

attributes.name: audit_trail_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the audit report or inspection record associated with this traceability event, linking to compliance and quality assurance documentation.
attributes.references: ISO 19011 Guidelines for auditing management systems

attributes.name: blockchain_hash
attributes.description: The cryptographic hash or transaction identifier if this traceability record is anchored on a blockchain platform for immutable supply chain transparency.
attributes.references: ISO/TC 307 Blockchain and distributed ledger technologies

attributes.name: carbon_footprint_kg_co2e
attributes.business_glossary_term: Carbon Footprint in Kilograms Carbon Dioxide Equivalent (kg CO2e)
attributes.description: The calculated carbon footprint for this stage of the supply chain, measured in kilograms of carbon dioxide equivalent (kg CO2e), supporting environmental impact reporting.
attributes.references: GHG Protocol Product Life Cycle Accounting and Reporting Standard

attributes.name: certification_standard
attributes.description: The sustainability or quality certification standard applicable to this traceability event. GOTS (Global Organic Textile Standard), OCS (Organic Content Standard), GRS (Global Recycled Standard), RCS (Recycled Claim Standard), BCI (Better Cotton Initiative), FSC (Forest Stewardship Council), OEKO-TEX (textile safety). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: GOTS|OCS|GRS|RCS|BCI|FSC|OEKO-TEX — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: chain_of_custody_method
attributes.description: The method used to track and verify the material through the supply chain. Identity Preserved maintains physical separation of certified material throughout. Segregated keeps certified material separate but may mix sources. Mass Balance allows mixing with tracking of certified content percentage. Book and Claim uses administrative credits without physical traceability.
attributes.references: Global Organic Textile Standard (GOTS) Chain of Custody

attributes.name: chemical_usage_kg
attributes.description: The total weight of chemicals used in this processing stage (e.g., dyes, finishes, treatments), measured in kilograms, supporting chemical management and ZDHC compliance.
attributes.references: Zero Discharge of Hazardous Chemicals (ZDHC) Manufacturing Restricted Substances List (MRSL)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this traceability record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: energy_consumption_kwh
attributes.description: The energy consumed during this manufacturing or processing stage, measured in kilowatt hours (kWh), supporting energy efficiency and renewable energy reporting.

attributes.name: fair_trade_certified
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this supply chain stage is Fair Trade certified, ensuring fair labor practices and community development.

attributes.name: geographic_coordinates
attributes.description: The latitude and longitude coordinates of the facility or farm where this traceability event occurred, enabling precise geographic traceability.
attributes.references: ISO 6709 Standard representation of geographic point location

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this traceability record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: material_composition
attributes.description: The fiber composition or blend of the material at this traceability stage, including percentages of each fiber type (e.g., 100% Organic Cotton, 60% Recycled Polyester 40% Cotton).
attributes.references: Federal Trade Commission (FTC) Textile Fiber Products Identification Act

attributes.name: material_type
attributes.description: The type or category of material being traced at this stage (e.g., organic cotton fiber, recycled polyester yarn, dyed fabric, finished garment).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, observations, or contextual information about this traceability event that may be relevant for transparency or compliance purposes.

attributes.name: organic_content_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of organic material content in the product or material at this traceability stage, supporting organic certification claims.

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO country code representing the country of origin for the material or product at this traceability stage.

attributes.name: process_stage
attributes.description: The specific manufacturing or processing stage captured in this traceability record (e.g., Spinning, Weaving, Knitting, Dyeing, Printing, Cutting, Sewing, Finishing, Packaging).

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: The purchase order number associated with this supply chain transaction, linking traceability to procurement records.
attributes.references: SAP MM Materials Management Purchase Order

attributes.name: qr_code_data
attributes.description: The encoded data string from the QR code associated with this traceability record, enabling consumer-facing transparency and product authentication.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 18004 QR Code bar code symbology specification

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of material or product units involved in this traceability event.

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: The current status of this traceability record. Active indicates the record is current and valid. Archived indicates the record is historical but retained for audit purposes. Disputed indicates the record accuracy is under review. Corrected indicates the record has been amended after initial creation.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems - Document Control

attributes.name: recycled_content_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of recycled material content in the product or material at this traceability stage, supporting recycled content claims and circular economy goals.

attributes.name: shipping_document_number
attributes.description: The shipping document, bill of lading, or delivery note number associated with the physical movement of material in this traceability event.

attributes.name: traceability_tier
attributes.description: The supply chain tier level of this traceability event. Tier 1 represents final assembly or Cut-Make-Trim (CMT), Tier 2 represents fabric mills or dyeing facilities, Tier 3 represents spinning or weaving facilities, Tier 4 represents raw fiber origin.

attributes.name: transaction_certificate_reference
attributes.description: The unique reference number of the transaction certificate (TC) issued by the certification body for this supply chain transaction, enabling verification of certified material transfer.
attributes.references: Global Organic Textile Standard (GOTS) Transaction Certificate

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: The date when this supply chain transaction or traceability event occurred.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the quantity field. KG (kilograms), LB (pounds), M (meters), YD (yards), PCS (pieces), ROLL (rolls), BALE (bales). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: KG|LB|M|YD|PCS|ROLL|BALE — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: The date when this traceability record was verified by a certification body or auditor.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: The verification status of this traceability record. Verified indicates the chain of custody has been validated by a certification body or third-party auditor. Pending indicates verification is in progress. Failed indicates verification issues were identified. Not Required indicates this stage does not require third-party verification.
attributes.references: ISO 17065 Conformity assessment - Requirements for bodies certifying products

attributes.name: verifier_organization
attributes.description: The name of the certification body, auditor, or third-party organization that verified this traceability record.

attributes.name: waste_generated_kg
attributes.description: The weight of waste material generated during this manufacturing stage, measured in kilograms, supporting circular economy and waste reduction initiatives.

attributes.name: water_consumption_liters
attributes.description: The volume of water consumed during this manufacturing or processing stage, measured in liters, supporting water stewardship reporting.
attributes.references: Sustainable Apparel Coalition Higg Facility Environmental Module (FEM)

attributes.name: prior_traceability_record_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on traceability_record (prior_traceability_record_id)

products.name: packaging_sustainability
products.description: Master record defining the sustainability profile of each packaging type used by Apparel Fashion across retail, e-commerce, and wholesale channels. Captures packaging type (polybag, hang tag, shopping bag, mailer, carton), material composition, recycled content percentage, recyclability rating, FSC certification status, plastic weight per unit, and compliance with extended producer responsibility (EPR) regulations. Supports plastic reduction and sustainable packaging commitments.
products.reference: FSC / How2Recycle / EU Single-Use Plastics Directive

attributes.name: packaging_sustainability_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the packaging sustainability record.

attributes.name: replacement_packaging_packaging_sustainability_id
attributes.description: Reference to the more sustainable packaging type that will replace this one during phase-out. Null if no replacement identified.

attributes.name: annual_volume_units
attributes.description: Estimated annual usage volume of this packaging type across all channels. Used to calculate total environmental impact and cost.

attributes.name: baseline_year
attributes.description: Reference year for measuring packaging reduction progress and sustainability improvements (e.g., 2020). Used in conjunction with reduction targets.

attributes.name: biodegradability_certification
attributes.description: Third-party certification for biodegradable or compostable packaging: ok_compost_home (home composting), ok_compost_industrial (industrial composting), astm_d6400 (US standard), en_13432 (EU standard), not_certified.

attributes.name: carbon_footprint_kg_co2e
attributes.description: Estimated carbon footprint of the packaging unit expressed in kilograms of carbon dioxide equivalent (CO2e), covering raw material extraction, manufacturing, and end-of-life. Supports Scope 3 emissions reporting.

attributes.name: channel_applicability
attributes.description: Sales channel(s) where this packaging type is used: retail (brick-and-mortar stores), e_commerce (online orders), wholesale (B2B distribution), all_channels (universal use).

attributes.name: cost_per_unit_usd
attributes.description: Standard cost per packaging unit in US dollars. Used for cost-benefit analysis of sustainable packaging alternatives.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this packaging sustainability record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this packaging type was discontinued or phased out. Null if still active.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this packaging type was first introduced into production and distribution. Supports historical tracking and sustainability progress measurement.

attributes.name: energy_consumption_mj
attributes.description: Total energy consumption in megajoules (MJ) required to produce one unit of packaging, covering raw material extraction, manufacturing, and transportation to distribution center.

attributes.name: epr_compliance_status
attributes.description: Compliance status with Extended Producer Responsibility regulations requiring producers to manage end-of-life packaging: compliant (meets all EPR requirements), non_compliant (violations identified), exempt (not subject to EPR), pending_review (under assessment).
attributes.references: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Directive 94/62/EC, California SB 54

attributes.name: epr_registration_number
attributes.description: Official registration number with EPR compliance schemes (e.g., PRN in UK, Green Dot in EU). Null if not registered or exempt.
attributes.references: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Directive 94/62/EC

attributes.name: fsc_certificate_number
attributes.description: Official FSC chain-of-custody certificate number for paper-based packaging (e.g., FSC-C123456). Null if not FSC-certified.

attributes.name: fsc_certification_status
attributes.description: FSC certification level for paper/cardboard packaging: fsc_100 (100% FSC-certified forests), fsc_mix (mix of FSC and controlled sources), fsc_recycled (100% recycled fiber), not_certified, pending (certification in progress).

attributes.name: hazardous_substance_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the packaging contains hazardous substances restricted under REACH, RoHS, or similar regulations (e.g., heavy metals, phthalates, PFAS). True if hazardous substances present, False if compliant.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this packaging sustainability record was last updated, reflecting changes to certifications, compliance status, or environmental metrics.

attributes.name: lifecycle_stage
attributes.description: Current lifecycle stage of the packaging type: active (in production and use), phasing_out (being replaced by more sustainable alternative), discontinued (no longer used), under_development (pilot or testing phase).

attributes.name: material_composition
attributes.description: Detailed description of the materials used in the packaging (e.g., 100% recycled polyethylene, FSC-certified kraft paper, biodegradable cornstarch film, virgin polypropylene). May include multiple materials separated by semicolons.
attributes.references: ISO 1043 - Plastics symbols and abbreviated terms

attributes.name: microplastic_shedding_risk
attributes.description: Assessment of the risk that the packaging will shed microplastics during use or degradation: high (significant shedding expected), medium (moderate risk), low (minimal risk), none (no plastic content or non-shedding material).

attributes.name: packaging_category
attributes.description: Classification of packaging by usage context: primary (direct product contact), secondary (retail display), tertiary (shipping/distribution), point_of_sale (in-store), e_commerce (online fulfillment), wholesale (B2B distribution).

attributes.name: packaging_reduction_target_percentage
attributes.description: Target percentage reduction in packaging weight or volume compared to baseline year, aligned with corporate sustainability commitments (e.g., 25.00 for 25% reduction target).

attributes.name: packaging_type_code
attributes.description: Unique code identifying the packaging type (e.g., PBAG001 for polybag, HTAG002 for hang tag, SBAG003 for shopping bag, MAIL004 for mailer, CRTN005 for carton).

attributes.name: packaging_type_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the packaging type (e.g., Polybag, Hang Tag, Shopping Bag, Mailer, Carton, Box, Tissue Paper, Ribbon).

attributes.name: phase_out_target_date
attributes.description: Target date for discontinuing this packaging type as part of sustainability roadmap. Null if no phase-out planned.

attributes.name: plastic_weight_grams
attributes.description: Total weight of plastic content per packaging unit in grams. Critical for tracking plastic reduction targets and Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) reporting.

attributes.name: post_consumer_recycled_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of post-consumer recycled content specifically (material recovered from consumer waste streams), as distinct from post-industrial recycled content. Critical for ESG reporting and sustainability claims.

attributes.name: primary_material_type
attributes.description: The dominant material category of the packaging: plastic, paper, cardboard, textile, metal, glass, bioplastic (plant-based), or composite (mixed materials). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: plastic|paper|cardboard|textile|metal|glass|bioplastic|composite — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 1043 - Plastics symbols and abbreviated terms

attributes.name: reach_compliance_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration, Evaluation, Authorisation and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliance Status
attributes.description: Compliance status with EU REACH regulation restricting hazardous substances in packaging materials: compliant (meets all REACH requirements), non_compliant (violations identified), under_review (assessment in progress), not_applicable (outside EU scope).

attributes.name: recyclability_rating
attributes.description: Assessment of how easily the packaging can be recycled in standard municipal recycling systems: fully_recyclable (accepted everywhere), widely_recyclable (accepted in most programs), limited_recyclability (specialty facilities only), not_recyclable, compostable (industrial composting), biodegradable (natural decomposition).
attributes.references: ISO 18604 - Packaging and the environment - Material recycling

attributes.name: recycled_content_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of post-consumer or post-industrial recycled material in the packaging, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 75.00 for 75% recycled content). Supports circular economy and plastic reduction commitments.

attributes.name: renewable_content_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of packaging material derived from renewable resources (e.g., plant-based bioplastics, sustainably harvested paper). Distinct from recycled content.

attributes.name: reusability_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the packaging is designed for multiple uses (e.g., reusable shopping bags, returnable shipping containers). True if reusable, False if single-use.

attributes.name: reuse_cycle_count
attributes.description: Expected number of reuse cycles for reusable packaging before end-of-life. Null for single-use packaging.

attributes.name: supplier_sustainability_score
attributes.description: Sustainability performance score of the packaging supplier, typically on a 0-100 scale. Based on environmental audits, certifications, and ESG assessments.

attributes.name: sustainable_certification_list
attributes.description: Semicolon-separated list of sustainability certifications held by the packaging (e.g., Cradle to Cradle; OEKO-TEX; Global Recycled Standard; Blue Angel; Nordic Swan). Supports ESG reporting and marketing claims.

attributes.name: total_weight_grams
attributes.description: Total weight of the packaging unit in grams, including all materials. Used for carbon footprint calculations and logistics optimization.

attributes.name: virgin_plastic_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the packaging contains virgin (non-recycled) plastic. True if virgin plastic is present, False if plastic-free or 100% recycled plastic. Critical for plastic reduction commitments.

attributes.name: water_usage_liters
attributes.description: Estimated water consumption in liters required to produce one unit of packaging, from raw material extraction through manufacturing. Supports water stewardship reporting.

attributes.name: superseded_packaging_sustainability_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on packaging_sustainability (superseded_packaging_sustainability_id)

products.name: target
products.description: Master record defining Apparel Fashion's sustainability commitments and targets beyond carbon, including water reduction, waste diversion, sustainable material mix percentage, circular economy diversion rate, chemical elimination (ZDHC), and social targets (living wage coverage, women in leadership). Captures target category, baseline value, target value, target year, progress-to-date, and public commitment status. Distinct from carbon_target which is specific to GHG emissions.
products.reference: UN SDGs / Fashion Pact / ZDHC Roadmap to Zero

attributes.name: target_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the sustainability target record. Primary key for the sustainability target entity.

attributes.name: esg_report_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.esg_report. Business justification: Non-carbon sustainability targets (water, waste, biodiversity, etc.) are disclosed in ESG reports. Same disclosure pattern as carbon_target. Enables linking targets to the report period for transparen

attributes.name: baseline_value
attributes.description: The starting or reference value from which progress toward the target is measured. Represents the initial state before improvement initiatives.

attributes.name: baseline_year
attributes.description: The calendar year in which the baseline value was established or measured.

attributes.name: commitment_framework
attributes.description: The external sustainability framework, initiative, or standard to which this target is aligned (e.g., 'Science Based Targets', 'UN SDG 6', 'ZDHC Roadmap to Zero', 'Fair Labor Association').
attributes.references: GRI 102-12 External Initiatives, UN Sustainable Development Goals

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this sustainability target record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: current_value
attributes.description: The most recent measured or reported value representing progress toward the target. Updated periodically as performance data becomes available.

attributes.name: current_value_as_of_date
attributes.description: The date on which the current value was last measured or reported, indicating the freshness of progress data.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this sustainability target was retired, achieved, or cancelled. Null for active targets.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this sustainability target became active and tracking began.

attributes.name: executive_sponsor
attributes.description: Name or title of the executive leader sponsoring and accountable for this sustainability target at the leadership level.

attributes.name: is_public_commitment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this target has been publicly disclosed or committed to external stakeholders, investors, or regulatory bodies.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this sustainability target record was most recently modified or updated.

attributes.name: measurement_methodology
attributes.description: Description of the calculation method, data sources, and standards used to measure progress toward the target.

attributes.name: mitigation_plan
attributes.description: Description of actions, initiatives, or interventions planned or underway to address risks and ensure target achievement.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional context, assumptions, exclusions, or commentary relevant to the interpretation of this sustainability target.

attributes.name: progress_percentage
attributes.description: Calculated percentage of progress from baseline to target, representing how far the organization has advanced toward the goal.

attributes.name: public_commitment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the target was publicly announced or committed to external parties. Null if not publicly committed.

attributes.name: related_sdg_goals
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) to which this target contributes (e.g., 'SDG 6', 'SDG 12', 'SDG 5').

attributes.name: reporting_frequency
attributes.description: The cadence at which progress toward this target is measured and reported internally or externally.

attributes.name: responsible_department
attributes.description: The business unit, department, or function accountable for achieving this sustainability target.

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: Assessment of the risk that the target will not be achieved by the target year, based on current progress and external factors.

attributes.name: scope_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the organizational scope and boundaries covered by this target (e.g., 'Global operations', 'Tier 1 suppliers', 'Direct manufacturing facilities', 'All product categories').

attributes.name: target_category
attributes.description: Classification of the sustainability target by environmental or social domain. Distinct from carbon targets which are tracked separately. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: water_reduction|waste_diversion|sustainable_material_mix|circular_economy|chemical_elimination|social_equity|energy_efficiency|biodiversity|packaging|supply_chain_transparency — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GRI 300 Environmental Series, GRI 400 Social Series

attributes.name: target_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier or code for the sustainability target used for external reporting and tracking (e.g., 'WATER-2030', 'CIRC-DIV-2025').

attributes.name: target_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or title of the sustainability target (e.g., 'Water Reduction 2030', 'Circular Economy Diversion Rate', 'Women in Leadership 50%').

attributes.name: target_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the sustainability target indicating progress and active state. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|active|on_track|at_risk|achieved|retired|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: target_value
attributes.description: The goal or desired value to be achieved by the target year. Represents the committed improvement level.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which baseline, target, and current values are expressed (e.g., 'liters', 'percentage', 'metric tons', 'number of employees', 'percentage of total materials').

attributes.name: verification_body
attributes.description: Name of the third-party organization or auditor that verified the target and its progress data. Null if not externally verified.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent third-party verification or audit of this target was completed. Null if not verified.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Indicates the level of external assurance or verification applied to the target and its reported progress.

attributes.name: year
attributes.description: The calendar year by which the target value is committed to be achieved.

attributes.name: superseded_target_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on target (superseded_target_id)

products.name: chemical_compliance
products.description: Master and transactional record managing Restricted Substance List (RSL) and Manufacturing Restricted Substance List (MRSL) compliance for chemicals used in Apparel Fashion's supply chain. Captures chemical name, CAS number, restriction type (RSL/MRSL), applicable regulation (REACH, CPSC, OEKO-TEX STANDARD 100, ZDHC MRSL), maximum allowable limit, test result value, pass/fail status, and remediation action. Distinct from compliance.chemical_compliance which is owned by the compliance domain — this record is the sustainability domain's operational tracking of ZDHC and chemical stewardship programs.

attributes.name: chemical_compliance_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the chemical compliance record. Primary key for tracking Restricted Substance List (RSL) and Manufacturing Restricted Substance List (MRSL) compliance across the supply chain.

attributes.name: colorway_development_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to design.colorway_development. Business justification: Colorway dyes and finishes must pass chemical compliance testing (RSL, MRSL). Real process: lab dip approval includes chemical testing; compliance records link to colorway development for audit trails

attributes.name: material_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific material or component tested for chemical compliance. Links to the material master data in the Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) system.

attributes.name: print_design_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to design.print_design. Business justification: Print designs must comply with chemical restrictions (ZDHC MRSL, Oeko-Tex). Real process: print approval requires RSL testing of dyes/pigments; compliance records link to print designs.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier or manufacturer responsible for the material or component being tested. Critical for supply chain accountability and remediation tracking.

attributes.name: applicable_regulation
attributes.description: Primary regulatory framework or standard governing this chemical restriction. May include REACH, CPSC, OEKO-TEX STANDARD 100, ZDHC MRSL, California Proposition 65, or other jurisdiction-specific regulations.
attributes.references: REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006, CPSC 16 CFR, OEKO-TEX Standard 100, ZDHC MRSL

attributes.name: cas_number
attributes.description: Unique numerical identifier assigned by the Chemical Abstracts Service to every chemical substance. Standard reference for global chemical identification.

attributes.name: certificate_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the compliance certificate expires and retesting is required. Critical for maintaining continuous compliance status.

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Compliance certificate number issued upon successful testing. Examples include OEKO-TEX certificate numbers, ZDHC InCheck report numbers, or other certification identifiers.

attributes.name: chemical_name
attributes.description: Common or trade name of the chemical substance being tracked for compliance. Used for identification and communication across supply chain partners.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Overall pass/fail determination based on comparison of test result value against threshold limit. Pass indicates compliance; Fail indicates violation requiring remediation; Pending indicates testing in progress; Conditional indicates compliance with restrictions.
attributes.references: ZDHC Chemical Management System, OEKO-TEX Certification Process

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this chemical compliance record was first created in the system. Follows format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Source system or platform from which this compliance data originated. Examples include PLM system, ZDHC Gateway, laboratory portal, or manual entry.

attributes.name: detection_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the chemical substance was detected in the test sample. Distinct from compliance status; a substance may be detected but still compliant if below threshold.

attributes.name: facility_country
attributes.description: ISO 3-letter country code of the production facility location. Used for jurisdiction-specific compliance requirements and supply chain transparency.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this compliance record is currently active and valid. False indicates the record has been superseded or archived.

attributes.name: laboratory_accreditation
attributes.description: Accreditation body and certificate number validating the testing laboratory's competence. Examples include ISO 17025, CNAS, UKAS, A2LA.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier or system name that last modified this compliance record. Used for accountability and audit purposes.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this chemical compliance record was last updated. Follows format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Critical for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special circumstances, or clarifications related to the compliance record. May include supplier communications, testing anomalies, or regulatory interpretations.

attributes.name: oeko_tex_class
attributes.description: OEKO-TEX Standard 100 product class determining applicable limit values. Class I (baby products) has strictest limits; Class IV (decoration materials) has most lenient.

attributes.name: production_facility
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the manufacturing facility where the material or product was produced. Important for MRSL compliance tracking at facility level.
attributes.references: ZDHC Gateway - Chemical Module, Internal Facility Registry

attributes.name: regulation_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Geographic region or country where the regulation applies. Uses ISO 3-letter country codes or regional identifiers (e.g., USA, EUR, CHN, Global).

attributes.name: remediation_action
attributes.description: Description of the corrective action plan to address non-compliance. May include supplier engagement, material substitution, process changes, or product recall.
attributes.references: ZDHC Chemical Management System, Internal Corrective Action Procedures

attributes.name: remediation_completed_date
attributes.description: Actual date when remediation action was completed and verified. Used to track remediation cycle time and supplier performance.

attributes.name: remediation_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which remediation action must be completed. Based on risk assessment and regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: remediation_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether corrective action is required due to non-compliance. True when compliance_status is Fail or Conditional.

attributes.name: remediation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the remediation action plan. Tracks progress from identification through verification of corrective measures.

attributes.name: responsible_party
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual or team responsible for managing this compliance record and driving remediation if required.

attributes.name: restriction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the restriction category. RSL (Restricted Substance List) applies to finished products; MRSL (Manufacturing Restricted Substance List) applies to manufacturing processes and facilities.

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: Risk classification based on the severity of non-compliance, potential health/environmental impact, and regulatory consequences. Drives prioritization of remediation efforts.
attributes.references: Internal Risk Assessment Framework, ZDHC Chemical Management System

attributes.name: sample_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the sample tested, including color, material composition, processing stage, or other identifying characteristics relevant to the test.

attributes.name: sample_type
attributes.description: Classification of the sample tested. Distinguishes between raw materials, components, finished products, or environmental samples (wastewater, air emissions) for MRSL compliance.

attributes.name: test_date
attributes.description: Date when the laboratory test was conducted to measure chemical substance concentration. Critical for tracking compliance timeline and certificate validity.

attributes.name: test_method
attributes.description: Standardized laboratory test method or protocol used to detect and quantify the chemical substance. Examples include ISO, ASTM, AATCC, or proprietary test methods.
attributes.references: ISO 17025, AATCC Test Methods, ASTM International Standards

attributes.name: test_report_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned by the testing laboratory to the test report. Used for traceability and audit purposes.

attributes.name: test_result_value
attributes.description: Actual measured concentration or quantity of the chemical substance detected in laboratory testing. Expressed in the same unit as threshold_unit for direct comparison.

attributes.name: testing_laboratory
attributes.description: Name of the accredited third-party laboratory that performed the chemical compliance testing. Should be ISO 17025 accredited for credibility.

attributes.name: threshold_limit
attributes.description: Maximum allowable concentration or quantity of the chemical substance permitted by the applicable regulation. Expressed in the unit specified in threshold_unit.
attributes.references: ZDHC MRSL Version 3.1, OEKO-TEX Standard 100 Limit Values

attributes.name: threshold_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measurement for the threshold limit. Common units include parts per million (ppm), milligrams per kilogram (mg/kg), percentage (percent), milligrams per liter (mg/L), or micrograms per gram (ug/g).
attributes.references: International System of Units (SI), ZDHC Testing Guidelines

attributes.name: zdhc_mrsl_version
attributes.business_glossary_term: Zero Discharge of Hazardous Chemicals (ZDHC) Manufacturing Restricted Substance List (MRSL) Version
attributes.description: Version number of the ZDHC MRSL standard used for compliance assessment. ZDHC MRSL is updated periodically with new restrictions and revised limits.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User identifier or system name that created this compliance record. Used for accountability and audit purposes.

attributes.name: superseded_chemical_compliance_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on chemical_compliance (superseded_chemical_compliance_id)

products.name: renewable_energy_certificate
products.description: Master and transactional record for Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs), Guarantees of Origin (GOs), and Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) procured by Apparel Fashion to support RE100 and Scope 2 market-based accounting. Captures certificate type (REC, GO, I-REC), energy source (solar, wind, hydro), generation facility, vintage year, quantity (MWh), registry, retirement status, and associated facility or market. Enables market-based Scope 2 emissions accounting.
products.reference: RE100 / I-REC Standard / GHG Protocol Scope 2 Guidance

attributes.name: renewable_energy_certificate_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the renewable energy certificate record.

attributes.name: initiative_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.initiative. Business justification: REC purchases are often part of renewable energy initiatives. Need to link RECs to the initiative that drove procurement for initiative impact tracking and budget allocation. N:1 relationship. No bidi

attributes.name: production_factory_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the Apparel Fashion facility (manufacturing plant, distribution center, office, store) for which this certificate is being applied to offset Scope 2 emissions. Null if applied at corporate level.

attributes.name: associated_market
attributes.description: Geographic market or grid region where the certificate is being applied for Scope 2 accounting, ensuring alignment between generation location and consumption location per GHG Protocol guidance.

attributes.name: beneficiary_organization
attributes.description: Name of the organization on whose behalf the certificate was retired, typically Apparel Fashion or a subsidiary entity.

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Externally-issued unique certificate number or serial number assigned by the issuing registry or authority.

attributes.name: certificate_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the certificate. Active = available for use, Retired = claimed for Scope 2 accounting, Expired = past validity period, Cancelled = invalidated, Transferred = moved to another account.

attributes.name: certificate_type
attributes.description: Type of renewable energy certificate instrument. REC = Renewable Energy Certificate (North America), GO = Guarantee of Origin (Europe), I-REC = International Renewable Energy Certificate, TIGR = The International Greenhouse Gas Registry, J-Credit = Japan Carbon Credit.

attributes.name: contract_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the Power Purchase Agreement (PPA), procurement contract, or purchase order under which this certificate was acquired.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this renewable energy certificate record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: energy_source
attributes.description: Primary renewable energy source used to generate the electricity represented by this certificate.

attributes.name: generation_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the generation period for the electricity represented by this certificate.

attributes.name: generation_facility_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code where the generation facility is located.

attributes.name: generation_facility_location
attributes.description: Geographic location of the generation facility, typically city and state or province.

attributes.name: generation_facility_name
attributes.description: Name of the renewable energy generation facility or power plant that produced the electricity.

attributes.name: generation_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the generation period for the electricity represented by this certificate.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this renewable energy certificate record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or context regarding this renewable energy certificate, including any special conditions or clarifications.

attributes.name: procurement_method
attributes.description: Method by which the renewable energy certificate was procured. Unbundled REC = certificate purchased separately from electricity, Bundled PPA = Power Purchase Agreement with bundled RECs, VPPA = Virtual Power Purchase Agreement, Green Tariff = utility green pricing program, Direct Investment = owned generation facility.

attributes.name: purchase_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the purchase price.

attributes.name: purchase_date
attributes.description: Date on which the certificate was purchased or acquired by Apparel Fashion.

attributes.name: purchase_price_per_mwh
attributes.description: Price paid per megawatt-hour for this certificate, used for cost tracking and financial reporting.

attributes.name: quantity_mwh
attributes.description: Quantity of renewable electricity represented by this certificate, measured in megawatt-hours. One certificate typically represents one MWh of renewable electricity generation.

attributes.name: re100_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certificate meets RE100 technical criteria for renewable electricity sourcing, including additionality, vintage matching, and geographic correlation requirements.

attributes.name: registry_account_number
attributes.description: Account number or identifier in the registry system under which this certificate is held or was retired.

attributes.name: registry_name
attributes.description: Name of the tracking system or registry that issued and tracks this certificate (e.g., M-RETS, PJM-GATS, APX TIGR, I-REC Standard).

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the certificate was retired in the registry system to claim the renewable energy attribute for Scope 2 market-based accounting. Null if not yet retired.

attributes.name: retirement_reason
attributes.description: Business reason or purpose for retiring the certificate, typically referencing the reporting period or facility for which the renewable claim is being made.

attributes.name: scope_2_reporting_period
attributes.description: Fiscal year or reporting period for which this certificate is being applied to Scope 2 market-based emissions accounting (e.g., FY2024, 2024-Q1).

attributes.name: supplier_name
attributes.description: Name of the broker, utility, or renewable energy provider from whom the certificate was purchased.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which third-party verification of this certificate was completed. Null if not yet verified.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Status of third-party verification or assurance of this certificate for ESG reporting purposes.

attributes.name: verifier_organization
attributes.description: Name of the third-party organization that verified this certificate for ESG reporting (e.g., DNV, SGS, Bureau Veritas).

attributes.name: vintage_year
attributes.description: Calendar year in which the renewable electricity was generated. Critical for matching certificate vintage to consumption period per GHG Protocol.

attributes.name: bundled_from_renewable_energy_certificate_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Bundled From Renewable Energy Certificate Id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on renewable_energy_certificate (bundled_from_renewable_energy_certificate_id)

products.name: social_impact_program
products.description: Master record for Apparel Fashion's social impact and community investment programs including worker welfare initiatives, living wage programs, women's empowerment programs (HERproject), community development grants, and artisan partnership programs. Captures program name, program type, target beneficiary group, geographic scope, partner NGO, investment amount, beneficiary count, and impact metrics. Supports the Social pillar of ESG reporting.
products.reference: BSR HERproject / ILO Better Work / UN SDG 8

attributes.name: social_impact_program_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the social impact program record. Primary key.

attributes.name: esg_report_id
attributes.description: Reference to the ESG report in which this program is disclosed.

attributes.name: audit_provider
attributes.description: Name of the third-party organization that conducted the external audit or verification of program impact.

attributes.name: beneficiary_count
attributes.description: Total number of individuals directly benefiting from the program during the reporting period.
attributes.references: GRI 413: Local Communities, UN SDG Reporting

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the primary country where the program operates. For multi-country programs, this represents the lead country.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this program record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: direct_beneficiary_count
attributes.description: Number of individuals receiving direct program services or interventions.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Planned or actual date when the program concluded or is scheduled to conclude. Null for ongoing programs.

attributes.name: external_audit_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the program has undergone or is subject to external third-party audit or verification.

attributes.name: external_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this program is included in external ESG reports, sustainability disclosures, or public communications.

attributes.name: female_beneficiary_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of program beneficiaries who are female, supporting gender equity tracking.
attributes.references: UN SDG 5: Gender Equality, GRI 405: Diversity and Equal Opportunity

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year for which the investment and impact metrics are reported.

attributes.name: fla_aligned_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the program is aligned with Fair Labor Association workplace standards and principles.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Geographic reach and scale of the social impact program.

attributes.name: herproject_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this program is part of the HERproject womens empowerment initiative in the supply chain.

attributes.name: impact_metric_type
attributes.description: Primary quantitative metric used to measure program impact and effectiveness.
attributes.references: GRI 413: Local Communities, UN SDG Indicators

attributes.name: impact_metric_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measurement for the impact metric value (e.g., USD, hours, individuals, percentage).

attributes.name: impact_metric_value
attributes.description: Quantitative value of the primary impact metric achieved during the reporting period.

attributes.name: indirect_beneficiary_count
attributes.description: Estimated number of individuals indirectly benefiting from the program (e.g., family members, community members).

attributes.name: investment_amount
attributes.description: Total financial investment committed or allocated to the program in the reporting currency.

attributes.name: investment_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the investment amount.

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent external audit or verification of the program.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this program record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent program performance review or impact assessment.

attributes.name: living_wage_benchmark_met_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the program has achieved living wage benchmarks for participating workers as defined by Fair Wage Network or Global Living Wage Coalition standards.
attributes.references: Fair Wage Network, Global Living Wage Coalition

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next program performance review or impact assessment.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or contextual information about the program not captured in other fields.

attributes.name: partner_ngo_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary non-governmental organization or non-profit partner collaborating on program delivery.
attributes.references: GRI 413: Local Communities, FLA Partnership Standards

attributes.name: partner_ngo_type
attributes.description: Classification of the partner organization type.

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the social impact program used for external reporting and reference.

attributes.name: program_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the programs objectives, activities, and intended social impact outcomes.

attributes.name: program_manager_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual responsible for day-to-day program management and execution.

attributes.name: program_name
attributes.description: Full name of the social impact or community investment program.

attributes.name: program_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the social impact program.

attributes.name: program_type
attributes.description: Classification of the social impact program by its primary focus area.
attributes.references: GRI 413: Local Communities, FLA Social Compliance

attributes.name: region
attributes.description: Geographic region or province within the country where the program is implemented.

attributes.name: responsible_executive
attributes.description: Name or title of the executive or senior leader accountable for program oversight and results.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date when the social impact program officially commenced operations.

attributes.name: success_story_summary
attributes.description: Brief summary of key success stories, testimonials, or qualitative impact evidence from the program.

attributes.name: target_beneficiary_group
attributes.description: Description of the primary beneficiary population or demographic group targeted by this program (e.g., garment workers, women in supply chain, local artisans, factory communities).

attributes.name: un_sdg_alignment
attributes.business_glossary_term: United Nations (UN) Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) Alignment
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of UN SDG numbers that this program contributes to (e.g., 1, 5, 8, 10 for poverty, gender equality, decent work, reduced inequalities).

attributes.name: wrap_certified_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Worldwide Responsible Accredited Production (WRAP) Certified Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether participating facilities in the program hold WRAP certification for social compliance.

attributes.name: predecessor_social_impact_program_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on social_impact_program (predecessor_social_impact_program_id)

products.name: esg_disclosure_metric
products.description: Transactional record capturing individual quantitative and qualitative ESG metric values reported in each ESG disclosure period. Captures metric name, GRI/SASB/TCFD indicator code, reporting period, value, unit of measure, boundary (company-owned, supply chain), data quality flag, restatement indicator, and assurance level. Serves as the granular data backbone for ESG report compilation and external rating agency submissions (MSCI, Sustainalytics, CDP).

attributes.name: esg_disclosure_metric_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environmental Social Governance (ESG) Disclosure Metric Identifier (ID)
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each ESG disclosure metric record. Primary key for the ESG disclosure metric transactional data.

attributes.name: esg_report_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent ESG report to which this metric belongs. Links the metric to the specific reporting period and framework.

attributes.name: target_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.sustainability_target. Business justification: ESG disclosure metrics track progress toward sustainability targets (water reduction, waste diversion, renewable energy %, etc.). The esg_disclosure_metric table currently has embedded target_value an

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this metric was approved for disclosure. Marks the completion of internal review and authorization for publication.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The current approval status of the metric value in the disclosure workflow. Tracks the metric through internal review and approval processes before publication.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the person who approved this metric for disclosure. Provides audit trail for governance and accountability.

attributes.name: assurance_level
attributes.description: The level of external assurance or verification applied to this specific metric. Indicates the degree of third-party validation (limited assurance, reasonable assurance, no assurance, or internal audit only).

attributes.name: assurance_provider
attributes.description: The name of the third-party organization that provided assurance or verification for this metric (e.g., Deloitte, EY, Bureau Veritas). Null if no external assurance was obtained.

attributes.name: baseline_value
attributes.description: The baseline or reference value against which progress is measured. Used for target-based metrics to track improvement over time.

attributes.name: baseline_year
attributes.description: The year from which the baseline value was established. Provides temporal context for progress tracking and target achievement assessment.

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: The specific business unit, division, or brand to which this metric applies. Enables segment-level ESG performance tracking and accountability.

attributes.name: calculation_methodology
attributes.description: Description of the method, formula, or standard used to calculate or derive the metric value. Ensures transparency and reproducibility of ESG metrics.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this metric record was first created in the system. Provides audit trail for data lineage and record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: data_quality_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of the reliability and completeness of the metric data. Flags whether the value is verified actual data, an estimate, modeled projection, or has quality concerns.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: The origin system or method from which the metric data was collected (e.g., SAP ERP, Utility Bills, Third-Party Survey, Manual Calculation, IoT Sensors). Important for data lineage and quality assessment.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this metric belongs. Enables year-over-year trend analysis and alignment with financial reporting cycles.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: The geographic coverage of the metric (e.g., Global, USA, CHN, IND, specific region or facility). Enables location-based analysis and regional compliance reporting.

attributes.name: indicator_type
attributes.description: The nature of the metric value: quantitative (numeric measurement), qualitative (descriptive assessment), binary (yes/no), or narrative (text explanation).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this metric record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change to the record for audit and data quality purposes.

attributes.name: materiality_assessment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this metric was identified as material through the organization's materiality assessment process. True if the metric is considered material to stakeholders and business impact.

attributes.name: metric_category
attributes.description: High-level ESG pillar classification of the metric. Categorizes the metric into one of the four primary ESG dimensions.

attributes.name: metric_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for the ESG metric. Typically follows the reporting framework standard code (e.g., GRI 305-1, SASB CG-AA-130a.1, TCFD Metrics a).
attributes.references: Global Reporting Initiative (GRI), Sustainability Accounting Standards Board (SASB), Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures (TCFD)

attributes.name: metric_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the ESG metric being reported (e.g., Scope 1 GHG Emissions, Water Consumption, Employee Turnover Rate, Board Diversity Percentage).

attributes.name: metric_subcategory
attributes.description: Detailed subcategory within the ESG pillar (e.g., Emissions, Water, Waste, Labor Practices, Diversity, Ethics, Supply Chain). Provides granular classification for analytics and benchmarking.

attributes.name: metric_value_numeric
attributes.description: The quantitative value of the ESG metric for the reporting period. Used for numeric metrics such as emissions tonnage, water volume, energy consumption, employee count, incident rates.

attributes.name: metric_value_text
attributes.description: The qualitative or narrative value of the ESG metric. Used for descriptive metrics, policy statements, or explanatory disclosures that cannot be captured numerically.
attributes.references: Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures (TCFD)

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional context, explanations, assumptions, or caveats related to this metric. Provides supplementary information that aids interpretation and understanding of the metric value.

attributes.name: previous_reported_value
attributes.description: The originally reported value before restatement. Maintained for audit trail and transparency when metrics are restated.

attributes.name: public_disclosure_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this metric is publicly disclosed in external reports, websites, or regulatory filings. True if the metric is available to external stakeholders.

attributes.name: rating_agency_submission_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this metric is submitted to external ESG rating agencies (e.g., MSCI, Sustainalytics, CDP). True if the metric is part of rating agency disclosures.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether reporting of this metric is mandated by regulatory or legal requirements. True if the metric is required by law or regulation (e.g., EU CSRD, SEC climate disclosure).
attributes.references: Federal Trade Commission (FTC), Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC), General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR)

attributes.name: reporting_framework
attributes.description: The ESG reporting framework or standard under which this metric is disclosed. Indicates the governing body or standard that defines the metric.
