products.name: scope3_category
products.description: Reference master defining the 15 Scope 3 GHG emission categories applicable to Apparel Fashion per the GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain Standard. Captures category number, category name (purchased goods and services, capital goods, fuel and energy, upstream transportation, waste, business travel, employee commuting, upstream leased assets, downstream transportation, processing of sold products, use of sold products, end-of-life treatment, downstream leased assets, franchises, investments), calculation methodology, and data collection approach. Used to classify and aggregate carbon_emission records.
products.reference: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard

attributes.name: scope3_category_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the Scope 3 greenhouse gas emission category as defined by the GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain Standard.
attributes.references: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard

attributes.name: applicability_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this Scope 3 category is applicable and material to Apparel Fashion's business operations and value chain. True indicates the category is relevant and should be tracked; False indicates the category does not apply to the company's activities.
attributes.references: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard - Materiality Assessment

attributes.name: baseline_emissions_mt_co2e
attributes.business_glossary_term: Baseline Emissions Metric Tons Carbon Dioxide Equivalent (MT CO2e)
attributes.description: The total greenhouse gas emissions for this category in the baseline year, expressed in metric tons of carbon dioxide equivalent. Serves as the reference point for measuring progress toward reduction targets.
attributes.references: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard

attributes.name: baseline_year
attributes.description: The reference year against which emission reductions for this category are measured and tracked. Typically aligned with corporate carbon reduction targets and Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) commitments.
attributes.references: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard - Target Setting

attributes.name: calculation_methodology
attributes.description: The primary calculation approach used to quantify emissions for this category. Spend-based uses financial data and emission factors; activity-based uses physical quantities; average-data uses industry averages; supplier-specific uses actual supplier data; hybrid combines multiple methods.
attributes.references: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard - Calculation Guidance

attributes.name: calculation_methodology_description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the specific calculation approach, data sources, emission factors, and assumptions used to quantify emissions for this Scope 3 category at Apparel Fashion. Includes references to databases such as DEFRA, EPA, or industry-specific factors.
attributes.references: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard - Calculation Guidance

attributes.name: category_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code used internally to reference this Scope 3 category in reporting systems and carbon emission records. Typically formatted as S3C01, S3C02, etc.

attributes.name: category_name
attributes.description: The official name of the Scope 3 emission category as defined by the GHG Protocol. Examples include Purchased Goods and Services, Capital Goods, Fuel and Energy Related Activities, Upstream Transportation and Distribution, Waste Generated in Operations, Business Travel, Employee Commuting, Upstream Leased Assets, Downstream Transportation and Distribution, Processing of Sold Products, Use of Sold Products, End-of-Life Treatment of Sold Products, Downstream Leased Assets, Franchises, and Investments.
attributes.references: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard

attributes.name: category_number
attributes.description: The official numeric identifier (1-15) assigned to this Scope 3 category by the GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain Standard. Categories are numbered sequentially from 1 (Purchased Goods and Services) through 15 (Investments).
attributes.references: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard

attributes.name: category_status
attributes.description: Current status of this category in Apparel Fashion's Scope 3 reporting program. Active categories are currently tracked and reported; inactive categories are not applicable to the business; under review categories are being evaluated for materiality.

attributes.name: category_type
attributes.description: Classification indicating whether this category represents upstream or downstream value chain emissions. Upstream categories (1-8) occur before the reporting company's operations; downstream categories (9-15) occur after.
attributes.references: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard

attributes.name: cdp_disclosure_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether emissions for this category are disclosed in Apparel Fashion's annual CDP Climate Change questionnaire response. True indicates the category is included in CDP reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this Scope 3 category record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: data_collection_approach
attributes.description: Description of how activity data is collected for this category, including source systems (ERP, PLM, WMS, procurement systems), data collection frequency, responsible parties, and data quality controls. Specific to Apparel Fashion's operational systems and supply chain structure.

attributes.name: data_coverage_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of total activity within this category for which actual data is collected and used in emission calculations, as opposed to estimated or extrapolated data. Higher coverage indicates more accurate and reliable emission quantification.
attributes.references: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard - Data Quality

attributes.name: data_owner_email
attributes.description: The email address of the data owner responsible for this Scope 3 category. Used for coordination, data quality escalation, and audit inquiries.

attributes.name: data_owner_name
attributes.description: The name of the individual or role accountable for the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of emission data for this category. Serves as the primary contact for data quality issues and methodology questions.

attributes.name: data_quality_tier
attributes.description: Classification of the typical data quality level achieved for this category based on the GHG Protocol data quality hierarchy. Tier 1 represents supplier-specific primary data; Tier 2 represents secondary data; Tier 3 represents industry averages; Tier 4 represents proxy or estimated data.
attributes.references: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard - Data Quality

attributes.name: disclosure_requirement
attributes.description: Classification of the disclosure expectation for this category based on regulatory requirements, investor expectations, and sustainability reporting frameworks. Mandatory categories must be reported; recommended categories are expected by stakeholders; optional categories may be disclosed for transparency.
attributes.references: CDP Climate Change Questionnaire, GRI 305, TCFD

attributes.name: emission_factor_database
attributes.description: The authoritative database or source used to obtain emission factors for calculating this category's carbon footprint. Common sources include DEFRA, EPA, Ecoinvent, GaBi, Higg MSI, or industry-specific databases.
attributes.references: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard - Emission Factors

attributes.name: emission_factor_version
attributes.description: The version or publication year of the emission factor database currently in use for this category. Emission factors are updated periodically, and version tracking ensures consistency and auditability of calculations.

attributes.name: gri_standard_reference
attributes.description: The specific GRI standard and disclosure number to which this Scope 3 category maps for sustainability reporting purposes. Typically references GRI 305: Emissions standard.

attributes.name: industry_specific_guidance
attributes.description: Reference to apparel and fashion industry-specific calculation guidance, tools, or standards applicable to this category. May include references to Higg Index, Sustainable Apparel Coalition methodologies, or textile-specific emission factor databases.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this Scope 3 category record was most recently updated. Tracks changes to methodology, boundaries, targets, or other category attributes over time.

attributes.name: last_verification_date
attributes.description: The date when emissions data for this category was most recently verified or assured by a third-party auditor. Used to track assurance currency and plan future verification cycles.

attributes.name: materiality_assessment_date

attributes.name: materiality_rationale
attributes.description: Business justification explaining why this category was determined to be material or immaterial to Apparel Fashion's Scope 3 emissions inventory. Includes considerations such as estimated emission magnitude, stakeholder expectations, and strategic relevance.
attributes.references: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard - Materiality Assessment

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional context, assumptions, limitations, or special considerations relevant to this Scope 3 category. May include information about data gaps, methodology changes, or category-specific challenges in the apparel supply chain.

attributes.name: primary_data_source_system

attributes.name: reduction_target_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage reduction in emissions targeted for this category by the target year, relative to the baseline year. Aligned with Apparel Fashion's overall Scope 3 reduction commitments and SBTi validation requirements.

attributes.name: reporting_boundary
attributes.description: Definition of the organizational and operational boundaries for this category, specifying which entities, facilities, geographies, and activities are included in or excluded from the emission calculations for this category.

attributes.name: reporting_frequency

attributes.name: sasb_metric_reference

attributes.name: sbti_alignment_flag

attributes.name: verification_requirement

products.name: initiative_carbon_contribution
products.description: This association product represents the contribution relationship between sustainability initiatives and carbon reduction targets. It captures the quantified carbon impact that each initiative delivers toward specific corporate carbon targets, enabling portfolio-level carbon accounting, SBTi reporting, CDP disclosure, and progress tracking against science-based targets. Each record links one sustainability initiative to one carbon target with projected and actual carbon reduction metrics, contribution percentages, verification status, and timeline alignment.. Existence Justification: In apparel fashion sustainability operations, initiatives frequently contribute to multiple carbon targets simultaneously (e.g., a renewable energy initiative contributes to both Scope 1+2 absolute target and intensity-based target), and carbon targets are achieved through portfolios of multiple initiatives. Sustainability teams actively manage these initiative-to-target alignments for SBTi reporting, CDP disclosure, and board-level carbon accounting, tracking projected vs. actual contributions, verification status, and allocation percentages for each initiative-target pair.

attributes.description: Unique identifier for this initiative-to-carbon-target contribution record. Primary key.

attributes.business_glossary_term: Initiative Carbon Contribution - Carbon Target Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the carbon reduction target that this initiative is aligned with and contributing toward.

attributes.business_glossary_term: Initiative Carbon Contribution - Sustainability Initiative Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the sustainability initiative that is contributing carbon reduction toward the target.

attributes.name: actual_carbon_reduction_mt_co2e
attributes.description: Measured annual greenhouse gas emissions reduction in metric tons of CO2 equivalent that this specific initiative has actually delivered toward this specific carbon target, based on verified measurement and reporting.

attributes.name: alignment_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this initiative's contribution to this carbon target ended or is planned to end. Null if the alignment is ongoing. Supports historical tracking of initiative-target relationships.

attributes.name: alignment_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this initiative was formally aligned to contribute toward this carbon target. Enables tracking of when initiatives were added to target portfolios.

attributes.name: allocation_methodology
attributes.description: Description of the methodology used to allocate this initiative's carbon reduction to this specific target (e.g., 'direct attribution - initiative exclusively serves this target', 'proportional allocation based on scope coverage', 'financial allocation based on investment split').

attributes.name: contribution_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of this initiative's total carbon reduction impact that is allocated to this specific carbon target. Enables initiatives to contribute proportionally to multiple targets (e.g., 60% to Scope 1+2 target, 40% to Scope 3 target).

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this contribution record was created in the system.

attributes.name: last_updated_by
attributes.description: User or system that last updated this contribution record.

attributes.name: last_updated_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this contribution record was last updated.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes on this initiative-target contribution relationship, including assumptions, exclusions, measurement challenges, or special circumstances affecting the carbon accounting.

attributes.name: projected_carbon_reduction_mt_co2e
attributes.description: Estimated annual greenhouse gas emissions reduction in metric tons of CO2 equivalent that this specific initiative is projected to contribute toward this specific carbon target. This is the initiative's allocated contribution to the target, which may differ from the initiative's total projected impact if the initiative contributes to multiple targets.

attributes.name: reporting_year
attributes.description: The calendar or fiscal year for which this contribution is being reported. Enables year-over-year tracking of initiative contributions to targets.

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Legal ownership structure of the facility indicating the business relationship model.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact telephone number for the facility.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the facility address.

attributes.name: production_capacity_units_per_month
attributes.description: Maximum monthly production capacity of the facility measured in units, applicable to manufacturing facilities.

attributes.name: renewable_energy_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of total energy consumption sourced from renewable energy sources, ranging from 0 to 100.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region of the facility location.

attributes.name: tier_level
attributes.description: Position of the facility within the apparel supply chain hierarchy, where Tier 1 is final assembly and higher tiers are upstream suppliers.

attributes.name: total_area_sqm
attributes.description: Total physical area of the facility measured in square meters, used for capacity planning and environmental impact calculations.

attributes.name: waste_diversion_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of total waste diverted from landfills through recycling, composting, or circular economy programs, ranging from 0 to 100.

attributes.name: wastewater_treatment_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility meets local and international wastewater treatment standards.

attributes.name: parent_facility_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on facility (parent_facility_id)

domains.name: design
domains.description: Manages the creative design process including concept development, mood boards, trend research, CAD/3D design, colorway development, print and pattern libraries, and design collaboration workflows

products.name: concept
products.description: Master record for a creative design concept — the earliest ideation artifact in the apparel design process. Captures concept name, season, theme, design direction, inspiration sources, target customer archetype, mood/aesthetic keywords, assigned designer, concept status (ideation, review, approved, rejected), and links to the collection or trend research that inspired it. Serves as the creative brief anchor for all downstream design work.

attributes.name: concept_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the design concept. Primary key for the concept entity.

attributes.name: assigned_designer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the lead designer or design team member responsible for developing this concept. Links to the workforce or employee master data.

attributes.name: circular_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.circular_program. Business justification: Design-for-circularity concepts are created specifically for take-back, resale, or rental programs. Real process: circular design briefs specify disassembly, mono-material, or durability requirements

attributes.name: collection_id
attributes.description: Reference to the collection or line that this concept belongs to. Links the concept to its parent collection for merchandising and planning purposes.

attributes.name: concept_created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user or designer who originally created this concept record. Links to workforce master data for accountability and collaboration tracking.

attributes.name: concept_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual (e.g., Creative Director, Design Manager) who approved this concept for progression to the next stage. Links to workforce master data.

attributes.name: concept_modified_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who last modified this concept record. Supports audit trail and collaboration workflow visibility.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Design concepts are budgeted and expense-tracked against design department cost centers for budget variance reporting and design labor allocation in apparel operations.

attributes.name: ecolabel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.ecolabel. Business justification: Concepts target specific ecolabel certifications (GOTS, Oeko-Tex, Bluesign) as design requirements. Real process: concept briefs specify certification targets to guide material and construction choice

attributes.name: packaging_sustainability_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.packaging_sustainability. Business justification: Concept briefs define packaging sustainability requirements for holistic product sustainability. Real process: designers specify FSC-certified, recycled, or plastic-free packaging at concept stage to

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Collections are planned by brand/channel profit centers for P&L accountability and margin planning. Real process: collection-level profitability forecasting and actual performance tracking.

attributes.name: sustainable_material_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.sustainable_material. Business justification: Concept briefs specify sustainable material requirements for sustainability-focused collections. Designers select certified materials during concept development to meet ESG targets. Real process: conc

attributes.name: target_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.sustainability_target. Business justification: Concepts are designed to meet specific sustainability targets (50% recycled content, carbon reduction). Real process: concept KPIs are aligned to corporate sustainability targets; PLM tracks concept-t

attributes.name: trend_report_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trend research or trend forecast that inspired or informed this concept. Links to trend analysis and market intelligence data.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this concept was formally approved to move forward in the design and development process. Key milestone for TNA (Time and Action) tracking.

attributes.name: collaboration_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing collaboration notes, feedback from design reviews, and cross-functional input from merchandising, product development, and marketing teams.

attributes.name: color_palette_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the intended color palette for this concept (e.g., earthy neutrals with pops of terracotta, monochromatic blues, vibrant neons). Guides colorway development.

attributes.name: concept_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code assigned to the concept for tracking and reference across systems. Used as the business identifier in design documentation and collaboration tools.

attributes.name: concept_name
attributes.description: The creative name or title assigned to this design concept. Serves as the primary human-readable identifier for the concept throughout the design workflow.

attributes.name: concept_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the design concept. Tracks progression from initial ideation through approval or rejection. Critical for workflow management and design pipeline visibility.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this concept record was first created in the system. Audit trail for concept inception and design pipeline tracking.

attributes.name: design_direction
attributes.description: Detailed description of the design direction, including silhouette, fabrication approach, color philosophy, and intended aesthetic outcome. Serves as the creative brief for downstream design work.
attributes.references: PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) Design Brief Standard

attributes.name: estimated_unit_count
attributes.description: Estimated number of individual product units (SKUs) expected to be developed from this concept. Used for capacity planning and resource allocation in the design pipeline.

attributes.name: fabric_direction
attributes.description: High-level guidance on fabric types, textures, and material characteristics desired for this concept (e.g., sustainable cottons, technical performance fabrics, luxe knits). Guides material sourcing.

attributes.name: gender_target
attributes.description: The target gender segment for this concept. Used for collection planning and merchandising assortment decisions.

attributes.name: inspiration_sources
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or narrative description of the inspiration sources for this concept (e.g., art movements, cultural references, nature, architecture, historical periods). Documents the creative genesis.
attributes.references: Centric PLM Mood Board and Inspiration Library

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this concept record was last modified. Tracks iterative refinement and collaboration activity on the concept.

attributes.name: mood_board_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the digital mood board or visual inspiration board associated with this concept. Provides visual reference for the design team.

attributes.name: mood_keywords
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of aesthetic and emotional keywords that capture the mood and feeling of the concept (e.g., bold, minimalist, playful, sophisticated, edgy). Used for mood board creation and design alignment.

attributes.name: price_tier
attributes.description: The intended price tier or market positioning for products developed from this concept. Guides material selection, construction methods, and target MSRP (Manufacturers Suggested Retail Price) range.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to this concept. Determines resource allocation, design team focus, and sequencing in the development pipeline.

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: High-level product category this concept is intended for. Aligns the concept with merchandising hierarchy and product taxonomy.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System Product Hierarchy

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Explanation or rationale for why this concept was rejected or put on hold. Captures learnings for future design cycles and portfolio optimization.
attributes.references: PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) Design Review Process

attributes.name: season
attributes.description: The fashion season this concept is designed for (e.g., SS24 for Spring/Summer 2024, FW24 for Fall/Winter 2024). Critical for collection planning and merchandising timelines.

attributes.name: silhouette_direction
attributes.description: Description of the intended silhouette and fit direction for this concept (e.g., oversized and relaxed, tailored and structured, body-conscious). Informs pattern development and fit strategy.

attributes.name: sustainability_focus
attributes.description: Indicates whether this concept has a specific sustainability or eco-conscious design focus. Aligns with corporate sustainability goals and certifications (GOTS, BCI, OEKO-TEX).
attributes.references: Global Organic Textile Standard (GOTS), Better Cotton Initiative (BCI)

attributes.name: target_customer_archetype
attributes.description: Description of the target customer persona or archetype this concept is designed for (e.g., Active Millennial, Luxury Minimalist, Gen-Z Streetwear Enthusiast). Aligns design with customer segmentation strategy.

attributes.name: target_launch_date
attributes.description: The planned market launch date for products developed from this concept. Drives the TNA (Time and Action) calendar and critical path milestones.

attributes.name: theme
attributes.description: The overarching creative theme or narrative that defines this concept (e.g., Urban Explorer, Coastal Minimalism, Heritage Revival). Guides the aesthetic direction and storytelling.

attributes.name: evolved_from_concept_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on concept (evolved_from_concept_id)

products.name: mood_board
products.description: Master record for a digital or physical mood board created during the concept development phase. Captures mood board title, associated concept and season, creative theme, color story, texture references, silhouette direction, cultural or lifestyle references, creation date, designer owner, approval status, and the platform or tool used (e.g., Milanote, InVision, physical board). Mood boards are the primary visual communication artifact between design and merchandising.

attributes.name: mood_board_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the mood board. Primary key for the mood board entity.

attributes.name: collection_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific product collection that this mood board is associated with.

attributes.name: concept_id
attributes.description: Reference to the design concept that this mood board supports. Links the mood board to the broader creative concept development phase.

attributes.name: designer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the lead designer or creative owner responsible for creating and maintaining this mood board.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user or stakeholder who approved the mood board.

attributes.name: season_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fashion season or collection period for which this mood board was created (e.g., Spring/Summer 2024, Fall/Winter 2024).

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Specific approval status indicating whether the mood board has been formally approved by design leadership or merchandising stakeholders.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date when the mood board was formally approved by design leadership or merchandising.

attributes.name: board_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier or code assigned to the mood board for tracking and reference purposes across design and merchandising teams.

attributes.name: brand_alignment
attributes.description: Assessment of how well the mood board aligns with the brand's established aesthetic, values, and positioning.

attributes.name: collaboration_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing feedback, comments, or collaboration discussions from design team members, merchandisers, or stakeholders.

attributes.name: color_story
attributes.description: Narrative description of the color palette and color relationships featured in the mood board, including primary, secondary, and accent colors.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the mood board record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: creative_theme
attributes.description: The overarching creative theme or narrative that the mood board communicates (e.g., 'Sustainable Luxury', 'Street Culture Fusion', 'Heritage Revival').

attributes.name: cultural_references
attributes.description: Description of cultural, historical, or lifestyle references that inform the mood board's aesthetic and narrative.

attributes.name: digital_file_path
attributes.description: File system path or cloud storage location where the digital mood board assets are stored.

attributes.name: format_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the mood board is digital, physical (printed/mounted), or a hybrid of both formats.

attributes.name: gender_category
attributes.description: Target gender category or market segment for the design direction represented in the mood board.

attributes.name: geographic_market_focus
attributes.description: Target geographic markets or regions that the mood board's aesthetic is designed to appeal to (e.g., 'North America', 'Europe', 'Asia Pacific', 'Global').

attributes.name: inspiration_source
attributes.description: Description of the primary sources of inspiration for the mood board, such as art movements, cultural references, nature, architecture, or lifestyle trends.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the mood board is currently active and in use for design development, or has been archived.

attributes.name: is_confidential
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the mood board contains confidential or proprietary design information that should have restricted access.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Date when the mood board was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the mood board record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: merchandising_feedback
attributes.description: Specific feedback provided by merchandising teams regarding commercial viability, market alignment, or assortment planning considerations.

attributes.name: mood_board_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the mood board in the design approval workflow.

attributes.name: mood_board_type
attributes.description: Classification of the mood board by its purpose or scope within the design process.

attributes.name: platform_tool
attributes.description: The software platform or tool used to create and manage the mood board (e.g., 'Milanote', 'InVision', 'Miro', 'Adobe Creative Cloud', 'Centric PLM', 'Physical Board').

attributes.name: presentation_date
attributes.description: Date when the mood board was presented to stakeholders, merchandising teams, or executive leadership.

attributes.name: primary_color_palette
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or description of the primary colors featured in the mood board (e.g., 'Sage Green, Terracotta, Cream, Charcoal').

attributes.name: product_category_focus
attributes.description: Primary product categories that the mood board is intended to inspire (e.g., 'Outerwear', 'Footwear', 'Accessories', 'Activewear').

attributes.name: silhouette_direction
attributes.description: Description of the intended silhouette and fit direction communicated by the mood board (e.g., 'Oversized and Relaxed', 'Tailored and Structured', 'Fluid and Draped').

attributes.name: sustainability_focus
attributes.description: Indicates the level of sustainability emphasis in the mood board's material, color, and design direction.
attributes.references: Global Organic Textile Standard (GOTS), Better Cotton Initiative (BCI)

attributes.name: target_customer_persona
attributes.description: Description of the target customer or consumer persona that the mood board is designed to appeal to, including lifestyle, values, and aesthetic preferences.

attributes.name: target_price_point
attributes.description: Intended price tier or market segment that the mood board's aesthetic and material direction is targeting.

attributes.name: texture_references
attributes.description: Description of key textures, materials, and surface treatments referenced in the mood board (e.g., 'Raw Linen, Brushed Metal, Distressed Leather, Organic Cotton').

attributes.name: thumbnail_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to a thumbnail image representing the mood board for quick visual reference in design management systems.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The descriptive title or name given to the mood board, capturing the creative theme or inspiration (e.g., 'Urban Nomad', 'Coastal Minimalism', 'Neo-Futurism').

attributes.name: trend_alignment_score
attributes.description: Quantitative score (0.00 to 5.00) indicating how well the mood board aligns with current market trends and consumer preferences, as assessed by trend research teams.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for the mood board, tracking iterations and revisions (e.g., 'v1.0', 'v2.1').

attributes.name: creation_date
attributes.description: Date when the mood board was initially created or started by the designer.

attributes.name: evolved_from_mood_board_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on mood_board (evolved_from_mood_board_id)

products.name: mood_board_asset
products.description: Individual asset record within a mood board, representing a single image, swatch, fabric reference, editorial clip, or inspirational element pinned to the board. Captures asset type (image, video, fabric swatch, color chip, editorial), asset source URL or file path, caption, position on board, upload date, and the designer who added it. Enables granular tracking of creative references and supports digital asset management integration.

attributes.name: mood_board_asset_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the mood board asset record. Primary key for the mood board asset entity.

attributes.name: collection_id
attributes.description: FK to product.collection

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user or design lead who approved the asset for inclusion in the mood board or collection. Supports governance and accountability in the creative process.

attributes.name: mood_board_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent mood board to which this asset belongs. Links the asset to its containing mood board for collection management.

attributes.name: uploaded_by_designer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the designer or user who added the asset to the mood board. Supports collaboration tracking and attribution of creative contributions.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval state of the asset within the design review workflow. Indicates whether the asset has been approved for use, rejected, is pending review, or has not yet been submitted for approval.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the asset was approved. Captures the moment of formal acceptance for audit trail and workflow tracking.

attributes.name: asset_caption
attributes.description: Descriptive text or annotation provided by the designer to explain the inspiration, context, or relevance of the asset to the design concept. Supports creative storytelling and team collaboration.

attributes.name: asset_file_format
attributes.description: File extension or media format of the asset. Indicates the technical format for rendering and compatibility purposes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: jpg|jpeg|png|gif|bmp|tiff|svg|mp4|mov|avi|pdf|psd|ai — 13 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: asset_file_name
attributes.description: Original file name of the uploaded or linked asset. Preserves the source file identifier for traceability and reference.

attributes.name: asset_file_path
attributes.description: Internal storage location or file system path where the asset is stored within the Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) or Digital Asset Management (DAM) system. Enables retrieval and version control.

attributes.name: asset_file_size_bytes
attributes.description: Size of the asset file measured in bytes. Used for storage management and performance optimization.

attributes.name: asset_height
attributes.description: Height of the asset as displayed on the mood board, measured in pixels or percentage. Controls the visual scale and prominence of the asset within the composition.

attributes.name: asset_sequence_number
attributes.description: Ordinal position of the asset within the mood board layout. Determines the display order and visual arrangement of assets on the board.

attributes.name: asset_source_url
attributes.description: Web address or external link from which the asset was sourced. Captures the original location for reference and attribution purposes.

attributes.name: asset_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the mood board asset. Indicates whether the asset is actively displayed, archived for reference, removed from the board, or awaiting design review.

attributes.name: asset_tags
attributes.description: Comma-separated or pipe-separated list of keywords or labels applied to the asset for search, filtering, and categorization. Examples include trend names, color families, themes, or seasonal references.

attributes.name: asset_type
attributes.description: Classification of the mood board asset by media type. Distinguishes between images, videos, physical material references, color samples, editorial content, design sketches, textures, and patterns. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: image|video|fabric_swatch|color_chip|editorial|sketch|texture|pattern — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: asset_width
attributes.description: Width of the asset as displayed on the mood board, measured in pixels or percentage. Controls the visual scale and prominence of the asset within the composition.

attributes.name: color_palette_hex_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of hexadecimal color codes extracted or associated with the asset. Supports colorway development and trend analysis by capturing dominant or inspirational colors.

attributes.name: copyright_attribution
attributes.description: Copyright holder or source attribution for the asset. Ensures compliance with intellectual property rights and provides proper credit for external content.
attributes.references: Berne Convention for the Protection of Literary and Artistic Works

attributes.name: fabric_reference_code
attributes.description: Internal or supplier fabric code if the asset represents a fabric swatch or material sample. Links the mood board asset to the material library for sourcing and Bill of Materials (BOM) integration.

attributes.name: inspiration_source
attributes.description: Description of the original source or context from which the asset was drawn. Examples include runway shows, street style, art exhibitions, nature, architecture, or cultural references.

attributes.name: is_featured
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the asset is marked as a featured or hero element on the mood board. Featured assets may receive prominence in presentations or design reviews.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the asset record was last updated. Tracks changes to position, caption, tags, or other metadata for version control and collaboration visibility.

attributes.name: linked_product_sku
attributes.description: Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) of a product that was directly inspired by or developed from this mood board asset. Establishes traceability from creative concept to final product.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, design rationale, or collaborative feedback related to the asset. Supports team communication and documentation of creative decisions.

attributes.name: position_x_coordinate
attributes.description: Horizontal position of the asset on the mood board canvas, measured in pixels or percentage from the left edge. Enables precise layout control and visual composition.

attributes.name: position_y_coordinate
attributes.description: Vertical position of the asset on the mood board canvas, measured in pixels or percentage from the top edge. Enables precise layout control and visual composition.

attributes.name: season_code
attributes.description: Seasonal identifier for which the mood board asset is relevant. Examples include Spring/Summer 2025 (SS25), Fall/Winter 2025 (FW25). Aligns the asset with collection planning cycles.

attributes.name: trend_theme
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the fashion trend or design theme that the asset represents or supports. Examples include seasonal trends, cultural movements, or aesthetic directions.

attributes.name: upload_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the asset was added to the mood board. Captures the moment of creation for audit trail and chronological tracking of design evolution.

attributes.name: usage_rights
attributes.description: Licensing or usage rights associated with the asset. Defines whether the asset can be used internally only, is licensed for commercial use, is in the public domain, or has restricted usage terms.

attributes.name: grouped_with_mood_board_asset_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Grouped With Mood Board Asset Id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on mood_board_asset (grouped_with_mood_board_asset_id)

products.name: trend_report
products.description: Master record for a seasonal or thematic trend research report compiled by the design team or sourced from trend forecasting agencies (WGSN, Trendalytics, Edited). Captures report title, season, trend category (macro trend, micro trend, color trend, silhouette trend, material trend), source agency, publication date, key trend themes, relevance score, and adoption recommendation (lead, follow, avoid). Drives concept development and collection direction.

attributes.name: trend_report_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the trend research report. Primary key.

attributes.name: adoption_recommendation
attributes.description: Strategic recommendation for how the brand should respond to the trend: lead (be first to market, drive the trend), follow (adopt after market validation), monitor (watch for further signals), or avoid (not aligned with brand positioning).

attributes.name: color_palette
attributes.description: Key colors or color families highlighted in the trend report, typically represented as color names, Pantone codes, or hex values. Used to inform colorway development.

attributes.name: consumer_segment
attributes.description: The target consumer demographic or psychographic segment for which the trend is most relevant (e.g., Gen Z, Millennials, Luxury Consumers, Athleisure Enthusiasts).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the trend report record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cultural_influence
attributes.description: Cultural movements, subcultures, art movements, or societal shifts that are driving or influencing the trend (e.g., Y2K revival, streetwear, cottagecore, digital culture).

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date after which the trend report is considered outdated or no longer relevant for active collection planning. Typically aligned with the end of the season or trend cycle.

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: The primary geographic market or region for which the trend report is most relevant (e.g., North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Global). Trends may have regional variations.

attributes.name: key_trend_themes
attributes.description: A summary of the primary trend themes, concepts, or narratives identified in the report. May include keywords, thematic descriptors, or trend names (e.g., 'Neo-Nostalgia', 'Sustainable Minimalism', 'Digital Craft').

attributes.name: material_focus
attributes.description: Key materials, fabrics, or textile innovations featured in the trend report (e.g., recycled polyester, organic cotton, technical knits, vegan leather).

attributes.name: print_pattern_theme
attributes.description: Key print, pattern, or graphic themes featured in the trend report (e.g., florals, geometric, abstract, animal print, stripes).

attributes.name: publication_date
attributes.description: The date on which the trend report was officially published or released by the source agency or design team.

attributes.name: relevance_score
attributes.description: A quantitative score (0.00 to 100.00) assigned by the design team or merchandising leadership indicating the relevance and applicability of this trend report to the brand's target market, aesthetic positioning, and strategic direction. Higher scores indicate stronger alignment.

attributes.name: report_author
attributes.description: Name of the individual or team within the design organization who compiled, authored, or is responsible for the trend report (if internally generated).

attributes.name: report_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier or reference code assigned to the trend report for cataloging and retrieval purposes.

attributes.name: report_document_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the full trend report document, presentation deck, or digital asset stored in the PLM system or document management system.

attributes.name: report_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the trend report within the organization's design workflow: draft (initial compilation), under review (being evaluated by design leadership), approved (validated for use in collection planning), archived (historical reference), or obsolete (no longer relevant).

attributes.name: report_title
attributes.description: The full title or name of the trend research report as published by the design team or trend forecasting agency.

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: The date on which the trend report was reviewed and approved by design or merchandising leadership.

attributes.name: reviewed_by
attributes.description: Name or role of the design leadership, creative director, or merchandising executive who reviewed and approved the trend report for use in collection planning.

attributes.name: season
attributes.description: The fashion season or collection period to which this trend report applies (e.g., Spring/Summer 2025, Fall/Winter 2024).

attributes.name: season_year
attributes.description: The calendar year associated with the trend report season.

attributes.name: silhouette_direction
attributes.description: Dominant silhouette or fit trends identified in the report (e.g., oversized, tailored, fluid, structured, cropped, elongated).

attributes.name: source_agency
attributes.description: The name of the trend forecasting agency or organization that published the report (e.g., WGSN, Trendalytics, Edited, Pantone, Fashion Snoops) or 'Internal' if compiled by the in-house design team.

attributes.name: sustainability_focus
attributes.description: Indicates whether the trend report has a specific focus on sustainability, circular fashion, or environmentally responsible design practices.
attributes.references: Global Organic Textile Standard (GOTS), Better Cotton Initiative (BCI)

attributes.name: tags
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of keywords, tags, or metadata labels applied to the trend report for search, filtering, and categorization within the PLM system (e.g., 'sustainable', 'bold color', 'minimalist', 'tech-inspired').

attributes.name: target_product_category
attributes.description: The product category or categories (e.g., womenswear, menswear, footwear, accessories) for which this trend report is most applicable. May be a comma-separated list if the trend spans multiple categories.

attributes.name: trend_category
attributes.description: The classification of the trend report by type: macro trend (broad cultural/lifestyle shifts), micro trend (specific design details), color trend (palette forecasts), silhouette trend (shape and fit directions), material trend (fabric and textile innovations), or print trend (pattern and graphic themes).
attributes.value_regex: macro trend|micro trend|color trend|silhouette trend|material trend|print trend

attributes.name: trend_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the trend report content, including insights, consumer behavior drivers, aesthetic directions, and supporting rationale.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the trend report record was last modified or updated in the system.

attributes.name: usage_count
attributes.description: The number of times this trend report has been referenced or linked to design concepts, mood boards, or collection plans within the PLM system. Indicates report influence and adoption.

attributes.name: prior_season_trend_report_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on trend_report (prior_season_trend_report_id)

products.name: trend_item
products.description: Individual trend signal or data point extracted from a trend report or observed in the market. Captures trend item name, trend category (color, silhouette, fabric, print, embellishment, styling), trend stage (emerging, peak, declining), geographic relevance, consumer segment relevance, competitive brand adoption, runway citation, and the designer or analyst who logged it. Enables granular trend tracking and cross-season trend analysis.

attributes.name: trend_item_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the trend item record. Primary key.

attributes.name: trend_report_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent trend report from which this trend item was extracted or observed.

attributes.name: adoption_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (0.00 to 100.00) representing the estimated market adoption or prevalence of this trend item based on analyst assessment.

attributes.name: collection_adoption_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this trend item has been adopted or incorporated into an internal collection or product line (True/False).
