attributes.name: print_design_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the print design record. Primary key for the print design entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Print design development costs including artwork, licensing, and strike-offs are tracked to design cost centers for design budget management and royalty expense allocation.

attributes.name: designer_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the designer or design team member who created this print design. Links to workforce management system for attribution and portfolio tracking.

attributes.name: primary_print_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who granted final approval for this print design. Typically a design director, merchandising manager, or creative director.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date when the print design received final approval. Used for Time and Action (TNA) calendar tracking and production timeline management.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The formal approval decision status for this print design. Determines whether the design can proceed to production sampling and manufacturing.

attributes.name: collection_name
attributes.description: The name of the product collection or line that this print design belongs to. Links the design to merchandising and marketing strategies.

attributes.name: color_count
attributes.description: The total number of distinct colors used in the print design. Impacts printing cost, complexity, and production method selection.

attributes.name: color_profile
attributes.description: The color space or profile used in the print design file. Ensures accurate color reproduction across different media and printing technologies.

attributes.name: colorway_count
attributes.description: The total number of color variations developed for this print design. Each colorway represents a distinct color palette application of the same base design.

attributes.name: copyright_year
attributes.description: The year in which copyright protection was established for this print design. Used for intellectual property protection and legal compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this print design record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and design portfolio tracking.

attributes.name: design_medium
attributes.description: The creative medium or technique used to create the original print artwork. Impacts file format requirements and reproduction quality.

attributes.name: design_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for designers and stakeholders to capture creative rationale, technical specifications, production considerations, or feedback related to the print design.

attributes.name: design_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the print design in the approval workflow. Governs visibility and usage permissions across the organization.

attributes.name: design_theme
attributes.description: The creative theme or inspiration concept behind the print design. Examples include floral, geometric, abstract, animal, nautical, ethnic, or seasonal themes.

attributes.name: fabric_compatibility
attributes.description: Description of fabric types and compositions that are suitable for this print design. May include restrictions based on print technique or design characteristics.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this print design is currently active and available for use in new product development. Inactive designs are retained for historical reference.

attributes.name: is_licensed_artwork
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this print design uses licensed artwork from an external artist or intellectual property holder versus original in-house creation.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this print design record was most recently updated. Tracks design iteration and version control.

attributes.name: license_agreement_number
attributes.description: The contract or agreement reference number governing the use of licensed artwork. Used for royalty tracking and compliance verification.

attributes.name: license_holder_name
attributes.description: The name of the individual artist, agency, or organization that holds the intellectual property rights for licensed artwork. Null for original designs.

attributes.name: master_file_format
attributes.description: The file format of the master print design file. Determines compatibility with design software, printing systems, and production workflows. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AI|PSD|PDF|TIFF|PNG|SVG|EPS — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: master_file_path
attributes.description: The file system or cloud storage path to the master high-resolution print design file. Used for production, printing, and archival purposes.

attributes.name: master_file_size_mb
attributes.description: The file size of the master print design file measured in megabytes. Used for storage planning and file transfer optimization.

attributes.name: primary_color_hex
attributes.description: The dominant color in the print design represented as a hexadecimal color code. Used for color matching, merchandising, and digital asset management.

attributes.name: print_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code assigned to the print design for system identification and cross-referencing in Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems.

attributes.name: print_name
attributes.description: The creative name or title assigned to this print design by the design team. Used for identification and reference in collections and tech packs.

attributes.name: print_resolution_dpi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Print Resolution in Dots Per Inch (DPI)
attributes.description: The resolution of the print design file measured in dots per inch. Higher DPI ensures better print quality and detail reproduction.

attributes.name: print_technique
attributes.description: The recommended or required printing technique for applying this design to fabric. Impacts production cost, lead time, and fabric compatibility.

attributes.name: print_type
attributes.description: Classification of the print design based on application method and placement on the garment. Determines manufacturing process and costing.

attributes.name: repeat_height_cm
attributes.description: The vertical height of one complete pattern repeat measured in centimeters. Used in fabric yield calculations and production planning.

attributes.name: repeat_type
attributes.description: The pattern repeat structure used in the print design. Defines how the design tiles across fabric yardage and impacts fabric utilization and cutting efficiency.

attributes.name: repeat_width_cm
attributes.description: The horizontal width of one complete pattern repeat measured in centimeters. Critical for fabric ordering and marker making efficiency.

attributes.name: royalty_rate_percent
attributes.description: The percentage of revenue or fixed fee per unit owed to the license holder for use of the artwork. Critical for Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) calculation.

attributes.name: season_code
attributes.description: The fashion season and year for which this print design was created. Format: SS=Spring/Summer, FW=Fall/Winter, SP=Spring, FA=Fall, HO=Holiday followed by two-digit year.

attributes.name: secondary_color_hex
attributes.description: The secondary prominent color in the print design represented as a hexadecimal color code. Supports color story development and assortment planning.

attributes.name: sustainability_certification
attributes.description: Any sustainability or environmental certification applicable to the print design, particularly related to dyes, chemicals, or production methods used.
attributes.references: Global Organic Textile Standard (GOTS) / OEKO-TEX Standard 100

attributes.name: trend_alignment
attributes.description: The macro fashion trend or consumer insight that this print design addresses. Links design decisions to market research and trend forecasting.

attributes.name: usage_rights
attributes.description: The scope of rights granted for use of this print design. Defines geographic, product category, or time-based restrictions on design application.

attributes.name: original_print_design_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on print_design (original_print_design_id)

products.name: print_colorway
products.description: Transactional record capturing a specific color variant of a print design. A single print design may be executed in multiple colorways for different styles or markets. Captures print design reference, colorway name, color codes per print layer (Pantone, CMYK, RGB), strike-off status (requested, approved, rejected), season, and associated style references. Enables the print library to track all approved color executions of each print asset.

attributes.name: print_colorway_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the print colorway record. Primary key.

attributes.name: designer_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the designer who created or specified this colorway variant.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who approved this colorway for production or use.

attributes.name: print_design_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent print design that this colorway is based on. Links to the master print design asset.

attributes.name: supplier_factory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.supplier_factory. Business justification: Print colorways are developed with specific factories for strike-off approvals - print quality varies by factory equipment, so colorways are approved against factory-specific strike-off samples before

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the mill, printer, or supplier responsible for producing this colorway.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the colorway was officially approved for production or inclusion in the collection.

attributes.name: azo_free
attributes.description: Indicates whether the colorway is produced using azo-free dyes, which are safer and more environmentally friendly.
attributes.references: EU REACH Regulation - Azo Dyes Restriction

attributes.name: cmyk_color_formula
attributes.description: Cyan, Magenta, Yellow, Black color formula for digital printing and reproduction. Format: C:xx M:xx Y:xx K:xx.

attributes.name: collection_name
attributes.description: Name of the collection or product line this colorway is associated with.

attributes.name: color_fastness_rating
attributes.description: Color fastness test rating (1-5 scale) indicating resistance to fading from washing, light exposure, and rubbing. Higher numbers indicate better fastness.

attributes.name: color_palette_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the overall color palette and color story for this colorway, including mood and aesthetic intent.

attributes.name: colorway_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for the colorway variant. Used in tech packs, production orders, and material specifications.

attributes.name: colorway_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name for the colorway variant, often reflecting the dominant color theme or inspiration (e.g., Ocean Blue, Sunset Coral, Forest Green).

attributes.name: colorway_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the colorway in the design and production workflow.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this colorway record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the unit cost (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: digital_file_format
attributes.description: File format of the digital artwork (e.g., AI for Adobe Illustrator, EPS, PDF, PSD for Photoshop). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AI|EPS|PDF|PSD|TIFF|PNG|JPG — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: digital_file_path
attributes.description: File system path or cloud storage location of the digital artwork file for this colorway.

attributes.name: gender_target
attributes.description: Target gender demographic for this colorway variant.

attributes.name: hex_color_code
attributes.description: Hexadecimal color code for web and digital applications. Format: #RRGGBB.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this colorway record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Number of days required from order placement to delivery of the printed fabric in this colorway.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum order quantity required by the supplier to produce this colorway, typically measured in yards or meters.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to this colorway variant.

attributes.name: oeko_tex_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the colorway uses dyes and chemicals that meet OEKO-TEX Standard 100 certification for textile safety.

attributes.name: primary_pantone_code
attributes.description: Primary Pantone color reference for the dominant color in this colorway. Used for color matching and production specifications.

attributes.name: print_layer_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct color layers or screens required to produce this colorway. Impacts production complexity and cost.

attributes.name: print_technique
attributes.description: Printing method or technique specified for producing this colorway (e.g., screen print, digital print, sublimation). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: screen_print|digital_print|sublimation|rotary_print|block_print|discharge_print|pigment_print — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: Product category or division this colorway is intended for (e.g., Activewear, Outerwear, Swimwear, Accessories).
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Assortment Planning

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Explanation or reason provided if the colorway was rejected during the approval process.

attributes.name: rgb_color_code
attributes.description: Red, Green, Blue color code for digital display and e-commerce imagery. Format: rgb(r, g, b).

attributes.name: season_code
attributes.description: Season identifier for which this colorway is intended (e.g., SS24 for Spring/Summer 2024, FW24 for Fall/Winter 2024).

attributes.name: secondary_pantone_code
attributes.description: Secondary Pantone color reference for accent or supporting colors in the colorway.

attributes.name: strike_off_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the strike-off sample was approved for bulk production.

attributes.name: strike_off_status
attributes.description: Status of the physical strike-off sample approval process. Strike-offs are physical print samples submitted by mills or printers for color and quality approval before bulk production. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: not_requested|requested|in_progress|submitted|approved|rejected|revision_required — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: strike_off_submission_date
attributes.description: Date when the physical strike-off sample was submitted for approval.

attributes.name: style_reference_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of style codes or SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) references that use this colorway. Links the colorway to specific garments or products.

attributes.name: substrate_type
attributes.description: Type of fabric or material substrate this colorway is designed for (e.g., cotton jersey, polyester knit, silk).

attributes.name: sustainability_certification
attributes.description: Sustainability or environmental certification applicable to this colorway (e.g., GOTS, Bluesign, Cradle to Cradle).

attributes.name: target_market
attributes.description: Geographic market or region this colorway is designed for, reflecting regional color preferences and trends.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Assortment Planning

attributes.name: tertiary_pantone_code
attributes.description: Tertiary Pantone color reference for additional accent colors in multi-color prints.

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: Cost per unit (yard or meter) to produce this colorway, including dyes, printing, and finishing.

attributes.name: derived_from_print_colorway_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on print_colorway (derived_from_print_colorway_id)

products.name: pattern_block
products.description: Master record for a base pattern block (sloper) used as the foundational template for garment construction. Captures block name, garment category, fit type (slim, regular, relaxed, oversized), gender, size range, body measurement basis, pattern version, grading rules reference, creation date, and pattern maker owner. Pattern blocks are reusable IP assets that underpin the technical construction of multiple styles across seasons.

attributes.name: pattern_block_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the pattern block record. Primary key.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the design team or division that owns and maintains this pattern block. Links to organizational hierarchy.

attributes.name: primary_pattern_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the pattern maker or technical designer who created or owns this pattern block. Links to workforce/employee master data.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the pattern block was formally approved for use in production design. Nullable for blocks still in draft status.

attributes.name: block_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric business identifier for the pattern block used across PLM and design systems. This is the externally-known code for referencing the block in technical documentation and production systems.

attributes.name: block_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the pattern block, including key construction features, design intent, and usage guidelines (e.g., 'Basic bodice block with princess seams, designed for woven fabrics with 2-inch ease at bust').

attributes.name: block_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the pattern block (e.g., 'Basic Bodice Block', 'Slim Fit Trouser Block', 'Oversized Hoodie Block'). This is the primary identity label for the pattern block.

attributes.name: block_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the pattern block (e.g., draft, approved, active, archived, deprecated). Indicates whether the block is in development, ready for use, or retired.

attributes.name: body_measurement_basis
attributes.description: Reference body measurement standard or fit model specification used as the foundation for this pattern block (e.g., 'ASTM D5585', 'ISO 8559-1', 'Company Fit Model Size 8', 'US Standard Sizing Chart').

attributes.name: ease_allowance_inches
attributes.description: Standard ease allowance built into the pattern block, measured in inches. Represents the difference between body measurement and garment measurement at key points (e.g., 2.00 inches at bust, 1.50 inches at waist).

attributes.name: fabric_type_recommendation
attributes.description: Recommended fabric types or fabric characteristics for which this pattern block is optimized (e.g., 'Woven fabrics with minimal stretch', 'Knit fabrics with 20-30% stretch', 'Structured outerwear fabrics').

attributes.name: fit_type
attributes.description: Intended fit profile of the pattern block (e.g., slim, regular, relaxed, oversized, athletic, tailored). Defines the silhouette and ease allowance built into the block.

attributes.name: garment_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the garment type this pattern block is designed for (e.g., tops, bottoms, dresses, outerwear, activewear, accessories).

attributes.name: garment_subcategory
attributes.description: Detailed subcategory within the garment category (e.g., 'T-Shirt', 'Blouse', 'Jeans', 'Chinos', 'Maxi Dress', 'Parka', 'Leggings', 'Sports Bra').

attributes.name: gender_target
attributes.description: Target gender demographic for the pattern block (e.g., mens, womens, unisex, kids_boys, kids_girls). Determines body measurement standards and proportions.

attributes.name: grading_rules_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the grading rule set or grading specification document that defines how this pattern block scales across sizes (e.g., 'GR-2024-WOMENS-TOPS', 'Standard 2-inch Grade', 'Athletic Fit Grade Rule v3').

attributes.name: is_proprietary
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this pattern block is proprietary intellectual property developed in-house (True) or based on industry-standard blocks (False).

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Date when the pattern block was last updated or revised. Tracks the most recent change to the block specifications.

attributes.name: measurement_chart_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the detailed measurement chart (spec sheet) that documents all key measurements for this pattern block across the size range.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-form notes, comments, or special instructions related to the pattern block. Captures ad-hoc information not covered by structured fields.

attributes.name: pattern_file_format
attributes.description: Digital file format of the pattern block (e.g., DXF, AAMA, ASTM, PLT, PDF, proprietary CAD format). Indicates the CAD system compatibility.

attributes.name: pattern_file_path
attributes.description: File system path or PLM repository location where the digital pattern block file is stored (e.g., CAD file, DXF, AAMA format). Confidential IP asset location.

attributes.name: pattern_version
attributes.description: Version number of the pattern block (e.g., 'v1.0', 'v2.3'). Incremented when the block is revised or updated. Enables version control and traceability of pattern evolution.

attributes.name: seam_allowance_inches
attributes.description: Standard seam allowance included in the pattern block, measured in inches (e.g., 0.50 inches, 0.375 inches). Defines the margin added beyond the stitching line for seam construction.

attributes.name: size_range_end
attributes.description: Ending size in the size range this pattern block covers (e.g., 'XXL', '18', '42', '12'). Represents the largest size for which this block is graded.

attributes.name: size_range_start
attributes.description: Starting size in the size range this pattern block covers (e.g., 'XS', '2', '28', '4T'). Represents the smallest size for which this block is graded.

attributes.name: sustainability_notes
attributes.description: Notes on sustainability considerations built into the pattern block design (e.g., 'Optimized for zero-waste cutting', 'Designed for fabric efficiency', 'Modular construction for repair').

attributes.name: technical_sketch_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the technical sketch or flat drawing that illustrates the pattern block design. Used for visual reference in PLM and design collaboration.

attributes.name: usage_count
attributes.description: Number of styles or products that have been derived from this pattern block. Tracks the reuse and value of this IP asset across collections.

attributes.name: creation_date
attributes.description: Date when the pattern block was originally created in the PLM system. Represents the initial capture of this reusable IP asset.

attributes.name: base_pattern_block_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on pattern_block (base_pattern_block_id)

products.name: review
products.description: Transactional record of a formal design review session where sketches, CAD files, or samples are evaluated by the design director, merchandising, and commercial teams. Captures review date, review type (concept review, line review, final adoption review), participants, styles reviewed, decisions per style (adopted, revised, dropped), revision instructions, and next action owner. Design reviews are the critical gate events in the seasonal design calendar.

attributes.name: review_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the design review session. Primary key.

attributes.name: collection_id
attributes.description: Reference to the collection being reviewed in this session.

attributes.name: concept_id
attributes.description: Reference to the design concept under review, if applicable.

attributes.name: review_approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the executive or design director who provided final approval for the review outcomes.

attributes.name: review_created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who created the design review record.

attributes.name: review_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the design director or lead reviewer who chaired the session.

attributes.name: review_last_modified_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who last modified the design review record.

attributes.name: review_next_action_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or designer responsible for executing the next actions following the review.

attributes.name: agenda
attributes.description: Detailed agenda or objectives for the design review session, outlining topics and focus areas.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Overall approval status of the design review session outcome (pending, approved, conditionally approved, rejected).

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the design review outcomes were formally approved.

attributes.name: brand_alignment_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (0.00 to 5.00) representing how well the reviewed designs align with brand identity and strategic direction.

attributes.name: commercial_feedback
attributes.description: Feedback from the commercial team on sales potential, customer demand, and distribution strategy.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the design review record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: end_time
attributes.description: Timestamp when the design review session concluded.

attributes.name: follow_up_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the follow-up design review session, if applicable.

attributes.name: follow_up_review_scheduled
attributes.description: Indicates whether a follow-up review session has been scheduled to re-evaluate revised styles.

attributes.name: is_confidential
attributes.description: Indicates whether the design review session and its outcomes are confidential and subject to restricted access.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the design review record was last updated.

attributes.name: location
attributes.description: Physical or virtual location where the design review session was held (e.g., 'Design Studio NYC', 'Virtual - Zoom', 'Milan Showroom').

attributes.name: meeting_minutes_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the detailed meeting minutes document for the design review session.

attributes.name: merchandising_feedback
attributes.description: Feedback provided by the merchandising team regarding commercial viability, pricing, and market fit.

attributes.name: next_action_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the next actions or revisions must be completed.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: General notes and observations captured during the design review session.

attributes.name: participant_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of participant names or IDs who attended the design review session (design team, merchandising, commercial teams).

attributes.name: presentation_file_path
attributes.description: File path or URL to the presentation materials used during the design review session.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the design review outcomes were rejected or not approved, if applicable.

attributes.name: review_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the design review session, used for external reference and tracking.

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: The date on which the design review session took place. This is the principal business event timestamp for the review.

attributes.name: review_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the design review session (e.g., 'Spring 2025 Concept Review', 'Fall Line Adoption Review').

attributes.name: review_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the design review session (scheduled, in progress, completed, cancelled, postponed).

attributes.name: review_type
attributes.description: Type of design review session indicating the stage in the design calendar (concept review, line review, final adoption review, pre-production review, sample review, technical review).

attributes.name: revision_instructions
attributes.description: Consolidated revision instructions and feedback provided to designers for styles requiring changes.

attributes.name: season_code
attributes.description: Season identifier for the collection under review (e.g., SS25 for Spring/Summer 2025, FW24 for Fall/Winter 2024).

attributes.name: start_time
attributes.description: Timestamp when the design review session started.

attributes.name: styles_adopted_count
attributes.description: Number of styles approved for adoption and progression to the next stage.

attributes.name: styles_dropped_count
attributes.description: Number of styles rejected and removed from the collection pipeline.

attributes.name: styles_reviewed_count
attributes.description: Total number of styles or designs evaluated during this review session.

attributes.name: styles_revised_count
attributes.description: Number of styles requiring revisions before re-submission.

attributes.name: sustainability_assessment
attributes.description: Assessment of the sustainability aspects of the designs reviewed, including material sourcing, environmental impact, and compliance with sustainability standards (GOTS, BCI, OEKO-TEX).
attributes.references: Global Organic Textile Standard (GOTS), Better Cotton Initiative (BCI), OEKO-TEX Standard 100

attributes.name: technical_feedback
attributes.description: Technical feedback on feasibility, construction, materials, and production considerations.

attributes.name: trend_alignment_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (0.00 to 5.00) representing how well the reviewed designs align with current and forecasted market trends.

attributes.name: follow_up_review_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on review (follow_up_review_id)

products.name: review_item
products.description: Individual style-level decision record within a design review session. Captures the design review reference, style or sketch being reviewed, reviewer decision (adopt, revise, drop, hold), revision comments, priority ranking within the line, commercial feedback from merchandising, and the designer responsible for any revisions. Enables granular tracking of which styles were adopted, revised, or dropped at each review gate.

attributes.name: review_item_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the design review item record. Primary key for tracking individual style-level decisions within design review sessions.

attributes.name: assigned_designer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the designer responsible for executing any required revisions or advancing this style to the next development phase.

attributes.name: primary_review_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the lead reviewer or decision-maker who provided the final decision for this item. Typically a design director or merchandising leader.

attributes.name: review_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent design review session in which this style was evaluated. Links this item to the broader review gate event.

attributes.name: sketch_id
attributes.description: Reference to the design sketch being reviewed if the item is still in conceptual phase and not yet a finalized style. Nullable for finalized styles.

attributes.name: style_id
attributes.description: Reference to the style or design being reviewed. May link to a finalized style master record or a design sketch depending on review stage.

attributes.name: tertiary_review_last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who most recently modified this design review item record. Supports change tracking and audit requirements.

attributes.name: brand_alignment_score
attributes.description: Numeric assessment of how well this style aligns with brand identity, aesthetic standards, and strategic positioning. Scale typically 1-10.

attributes.name: color_story
attributes.description: Narrative description of the color palette and colorway strategy for this style. Captures the creative vision and seasonal color direction.

attributes.name: commercial_feedback
attributes.description: Input from merchandising and commercial teams regarding market viability, pricing potential, target customer fit, and sales forecasts for this style.

attributes.name: competitive_benchmark
attributes.description: Reference to competitor products or market comparables used to evaluate this styles positioning, pricing, and differentiation strategy.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this design review item record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: decision_rationale
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the reviewer decision was made. Captures strategic, commercial, or creative reasoning behind adopt, revise, drop, or hold outcomes.

attributes.name: decision_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the reviewer decision was finalized for this item. Critical for tracking review gate progression and Time and Action (TNA) calendar adherence.

attributes.name: estimated_cogs
attributes.description: Projected Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) for this style including materials, labor, and manufacturing overhead. Critical for margin analysis and pricing decisions.

attributes.name: estimated_retail_price
attributes.description: Projected Manufacturers Suggested Retail Price (MSRP) for this style. Used to evaluate price tier positioning and competitive landscape fit.

attributes.name: estimated_unit_volume
attributes.description: Projected production quantity or sales volume for this style. Used to assess commercial scale and manufacturing feasibility.

attributes.name: estimated_wholesale_price
attributes.description: Projected wholesale price point for this style based on cost estimates and target margin. Used for commercial viability assessment during review.

attributes.name: fabric_type
attributes.description: Primary fabric or material composition for this style. Critical for cost estimation, sustainability assessment, and technical feasibility evaluation.

attributes.name: gender_target
attributes.description: Intended gender demographic for this style. Used for collection segmentation and merchandising planning.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this design review item record is currently active and valid. Supports soft-delete patterns and historical record management.

attributes.name: item_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential ordering of this item within the design review session. Used to maintain presentation order and facilitate discussion flow.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this design review item record was most recently updated. Supports change tracking and audit requirements.

attributes.name: price_tier

attributes.description: FK to supplier.vendor

attributes.name: embellishment_vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the external supplier or vendor providing the embellishment if origin_type is supplier. Used for procurement and vendor management.

attributes.name: supplier_factory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.supplier_factory. Business justification: Embellishments may be factory-specific (e.g., 'Factory A's beading capability') - technical feasibility assessment where designers specify which factory can execute specialized embellishment technique

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the embellishment design was approved for production use, following the format yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the embellishment design within the Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) workflow, indicating readiness for production use.

attributes.name: care_instructions
attributes.description: Special care or handling instructions for garments with this embellishment, used for labeling compliance and customer communication per Federal Trade Commission (FTC) requirements.

attributes.name: color_specification
attributes.description: Detailed color specification for the embellishment, including Pantone codes, thread colors, or ink formulations. May include multiple colors for multi-color designs.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the embellishment design record was first created in the system, following the format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the unit cost, enabling multi-currency cost tracking for global sourcing.

attributes.name: digital_file_path
attributes.description: File system path or cloud storage location for the digital design file of the embellishment (e.g., embroidery DST file, vector artwork, print-ready PDF).

attributes.name: embellishment_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the embellishment design, used across Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems for cross-referencing and sourcing.

attributes.name: embellishment_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the embellishment design, used for identification in design briefs, tech packs, and production orders.

attributes.name: embellishment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the embellishment technique or method applied to the garment or accessory. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: embroidery|applique|beading|screen_print|heat_transfer|woven_label|sequin|rhinestone|patch|foil_print|digital_print — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: AATCC Technical Manual - Textile Decoration Standards

attributes.name: file_format
attributes.description: Digital file format of the embellishment design file, such as DST for embroidery, AI/EPS for vector graphics, or PDF for print-ready artwork. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DST|PES|AI|EPS|PDF|PNG|SVG|JPG — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: height_cm
attributes.description: Height dimension of the embellishment design in centimeters, used for sizing specifications in tech packs and Bill of Materials (BOM).

attributes.name: ip_ownership
attributes.description: Defines the intellectual property rights ownership for the embellishment design, critical for legal compliance and licensing agreements.
attributes.references: WIPO - World Intellectual Property Organization Standards

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether the embellishment design is currently active and available for use in new product development, or has been retired or archived.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the embellishment design record was last updated or modified, following the format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Number of days required to produce or procure the embellishment from order placement to delivery, critical for Time and Action (TNA) calendar planning.

attributes.name: license_agreement_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the licensing agreement if the embellishment design is licensed from a third party, used for legal and financial tracking.
attributes.references: WIPO - World Intellectual Property Organization Standards

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) required by the supplier or production facility for this embellishment, used for procurement planning and inventory management.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the embellishment design, production considerations, or usage guidelines.

attributes.name: origin_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the embellishment design was created in-house by the design team, sourced from an external supplier, licensed from a third party, or custom-developed for a specific collection.

attributes.name: placement_position
attributes.description: Designated location on the garment or accessory where the embellishment is applied, critical for tech pack specifications and production instructions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: chest_left|chest_right|chest_center|back_upper|back_lower|sleeve_left|sleeve_right|hem|collar|pocket|cuff|hood|side_panel|full_front|full_back — 15 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ASTM D5489 - Standard Guide for Care Symbols

attributes.name: reusable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the embellishment design is a reusable asset that can be applied across multiple styles and collections, or is specific to a single product.

attributes.name: season_code
attributes.description: Season identifier for which the embellishment design was created, following industry convention (e.g., SS24 for Spring/Summer 2024, FW24 for Fall/Winter 2024).

attributes.name: stitch_count
attributes.description: Total number of stitches in an embroidered embellishment design, used for production time estimation and Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) calculation.

attributes.name: sustainability_certification
attributes.description: Sustainability or environmental certifications applicable to the embellishment materials or production process, such as OEKO-TEX, GOTS, or recycled content certifications.
attributes.references: OEKO-TEX Standard 100, Global Organic Textile Standard (GOTS)

attributes.name: tags
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of descriptive tags or keywords for the embellishment design, used for search, filtering, and categorization in Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems.

attributes.name: technique
attributes.description: Detailed description of the specific production technique or process used to create the embellishment, including stitch type for embroidery, application method for appliqués, or printing technology for screen prints.

attributes.name: thread_count
attributes.description: Number of thread colors or individual threads used in embroidery or stitched embellishments, relevant for costing and production planning.

attributes.name: thumbnail_url
attributes.description: Uniform Resource Locator (URL) or path to a thumbnail image of the embellishment design, used for visual reference in Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems and merchandising tools.

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: Cost per unit to produce or procure the embellishment, used for Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) calculation and pricing strategy. Expressed in the company's base currency.
attributes.references: IFRS 2 - Share-based Payment / GAAP Cost Accounting Standards

attributes.name: usage_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct Stock Keeping Units (SKUs) or styles that currently use this embellishment design, used for asset utilization analysis.

attributes.name: width_cm
attributes.description: Width dimension of the embellishment design in centimeters, used for sizing specifications in tech packs and Bill of Materials (BOM).

attributes.name: derived_from_embellishment_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on embellishment (derived_from_embellishment_id)

products.name: color_palette
products.description: Master record for a seasonal or thematic color palette defined by the design team. Captures palette name, season, palette type (core palette, accent palette, neutral palette, trend palette), number of colors, Pantone/NCS/RAL codes for each color, color names, color story narrative, and approval status. Color palettes are the authoritative color direction documents that govern colorway development, print design, and material sourcing across a season.

attributes.name: color_palette_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the color palette record. Primary key.

attributes.name: assigned_designer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the lead designer responsible for creating and curating this color palette.

attributes.name: collection_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent collection that this color palette supports. Links palette to broader collection planning and merchandising strategy.

attributes.name: primary_color_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user (typically Creative Director or Merchandising Lead) who approved this color palette for production use.

attributes.name: tertiary_color_modified_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who last modified this color palette record.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the color palette received final approval. Used for tracking design-to-production timelines and governance compliance.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval state of the color palette in the design governance workflow: draft (in development), submitted (under review), approved (ready for production), rejected (not approved), archived (historical record).

attributes.name: collaboration_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing cross-functional feedback, design rationale, or collaboration comments from merchandising, marketing, and sourcing teams.

attributes.name: color_story_narrative
attributes.description: Descriptive narrative explaining the inspiration, mood, and strategic intent behind the color palette. Communicates the emotional and aesthetic direction to design, merchandising, and marketing teams.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the color palette record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and design timeline analysis.

attributes.name: design_team
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the design team or studio that developed this palette (e.g., 'Womens Apparel Design', 'Footwear Innovation Lab').

attributes.name: digital_file_path
attributes.description: File system path or cloud storage URI where the authoritative digital palette file is stored (e.g., Adobe Swatch Exchange .ase file, Pantone Color Manager file).

attributes.name: gender_target
attributes.description: Gender category this palette is designed for: mens, womens, unisex, kids, or all genders.

attributes.name: geographic_market_focus
attributes.description: Primary geographic markets or regions this palette is tailored for (e.g., 'North America', 'EMEA', 'APAC'). Reflects regional color preferences and cultural sensitivities.

attributes.name: hex_codes_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of all hexadecimal color codes in the palette. Used for digital design, e-commerce product imagery, and web applications.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this palette is currently active and available for use in new designs. False if archived or superseded.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the color palette record. Tracks design iteration and change activity.

attributes.name: ncs_codes_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of Natural Color System codes for colors in the palette. Used in European markets and for architectural/interior design applications.

attributes.name: number_of_colors
attributes.description: Total count of distinct colors included in this palette. Typically ranges from 5 to 30 colors depending on palette type and collection scope.
attributes.references: Color Theory and Merchandising Best Practices

attributes.name: palette_category
attributes.description: Product category scope for which this palette is intended: apparel, footwear, accessories, or all categories.

attributes.name: palette_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code assigned to the color palette for system identification and cross-referencing in PLM, ERP, and merchandising systems.

attributes.name: palette_name
attributes.description: Business name of the color palette (e.g., 'Spring Bloom 2024', 'Urban Edge Neutrals'). Human-readable identifier used by design and merchandising teams.

attributes.name: palette_type
attributes.description: Classification of the palette's strategic role within the collection: core (foundational colors), accent (highlight colors), neutral (base colors), trend (fashion-forward colors), seasonal (time-bound colors), capsule (limited edition).
attributes.references: Color Theory and Merchandising Best Practices

attributes.name: pantone_codes_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of all Pantone codes included in the palette. Authoritative reference for material sourcing and supplier communication.

attributes.name: primary_color_name
attributes.description: Business-friendly name of the primary or hero color in the palette (e.g., 'Sunset Coral', 'Midnight Navy'). Used in marketing and merchandising communications.

attributes.name: primary_hex_code
attributes.description: Hexadecimal color code for the primary color, used in digital design, e-commerce, and web applications (e.g., '#FF6347').

attributes.name: primary_pantone_code
attributes.description: Pantone Matching System (PMS) code for the primary color, ensuring consistent color reproduction across materials and suppliers (e.g., '18-1664 TPX').

attributes.name: primary_rgb_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Primary Red Green Blue (RGB) Color Code
attributes.description: RGB color code for the primary color, used in digital rendering and screen-based applications (e.g., 'rgb(255, 99, 71)').

attributes.name: ral_codes_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of RAL color standard codes for colors in the palette. Used for industrial and hardware applications (e.g., zippers, buttons, trims).

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why the palette was rejected, if applicable. Captures feedback for design iteration and learning.

attributes.name: season_code
attributes.description: Season identifier for which this palette is designed (e.g., SS24 for Spring/Summer 2024, FW24 for Fall/Winter 2024). Follows industry-standard season coding.

attributes.name: season_year
attributes.description: Calendar year associated with the season (e.g., 2024, 2025). Used for multi-year trend analysis and archival.

attributes.name: secondary_color_names
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of business-friendly names for secondary colors in the palette. Supports merchandising and marketing communication.

attributes.name: sustainability_focus
attributes.description: Indicates whether this palette prioritizes sustainable or eco-friendly dyeing processes and materials. True if sustainability is a core design principle.
attributes.references: Global Organic Textile Standard (GOTS), OEKO-TEX Standard 100

attributes.name: sustainability_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes describing sustainability considerations, such as low-impact dyes, natural pigments, or water-saving processes associated with this palette.
attributes.references: Global Organic Textile Standard (GOTS), Better Cotton Initiative (BCI)

attributes.name: target_customer_segment
attributes.description: Primary customer demographic or psychographic segment this palette is designed for (e.g., 'Gen Z Urban', 'Active Lifestyle', 'Luxury Consumer').

attributes.name: thumbnail_url
attributes.description: URL to a visual thumbnail or preview image of the color palette, used in PLM systems and design collaboration tools.

attributes.name: trend_alignment_tags
attributes.description: Comma-separated tags linking this palette to macro trends, cultural movements, or trend forecasting themes (e.g., 'sustainability', 'retro revival', 'digital nomad').

attributes.name: usage_count
attributes.description: Number of products, SKUs, or designs that reference this color palette. Indicates palette adoption and business impact.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of the palette, incremented with each revision. Supports design iteration tracking and change management.

attributes.name: derived_from_color_palette_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on color_palette (derived_from_color_palette_id)

products.name: handoff
products.description: Transactional record capturing the formal handoff of a completed design package from the design team to the product development or sourcing team. Captures handoff date, style or sketch reference, handoff package contents (tech pack, CAD files, print files, colorway specs, BOM draft), receiving team, handoff status (pending, submitted, acknowledged, rejected with feedback), and any outstanding design items. The design handoff is the critical gate event marking the end of the design phase.

attributes.name: handoff_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the design handoff transaction. Primary key for the design handoff record.

attributes.name: concept_id
attributes.description: Reference to the design concept that is being handed off. Links to the originating concept record.

attributes.name: handoff_approved_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who approved the design handoff. Typically a product development manager or technical design lead.

attributes.name: handoff_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific user or team lead who acknowledged receipt of the design handoff package.

attributes.name: handoff_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who last modified the design handoff record. Provides accountability for changes.

attributes.name: submitting_designer_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the designer who submitted the design handoff package. Responsible party from the design team.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.vendor. Business justification: Design handoffs specify target vendor for tech pack execution - production planning workflow where design team designates which vendor will manufacture the style, enabling vendor-specific technical sp

attributes.name: acknowledgment_date
attributes.description: Date when the receiving team acknowledged receipt of the design handoff package. Marks the start of the product development phase.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the design handoff was formally approved by the receiving team. Indicates readiness to proceed to sourcing and production.

attributes.name: bom_draft_included
attributes.business_glossary_term: Bill of Materials (BOM) Draft Included Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a draft Bill of Materials listing all components, fabrics, trims, and hardware is included in the handoff.

attributes.name: bom_draft_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the draft BOM included in the handoff (e.g., draft_v1, draft_v2). Tracks BOM iterations during design phase.

attributes.name: cad_file_format
attributes.description: File format of the CAD files included (e.g., AI for Adobe Illustrator, CLO for CLO3D, ZPRJ for Browzwear). Indicates the software compatibility. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AI|PDF|DXF|CLO|ZPRJ|OBJ|FBX|none — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: cad_files_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether CAD design files (e.g., Adobe Illustrator, CLO3D, Browzwear) are included in the handoff package.

attributes.name: collaboration_platform
attributes.description: Digital platform or tool used to facilitate the design handoff and collaboration between teams (e.g., Centric PLM, Infor PLM, Microsoft Teams).

attributes.name: collection_name
attributes.description: Name of the collection to which this design belongs. Groups related styles under a cohesive theme or brand story.

attributes.name: colorway_count
attributes.description: Number of colorway variations included in the design handoff. Each colorway represents a different color combination for the same style.

attributes.name: colorway_specs_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether detailed colorway specifications (Pantone codes, fabric swatches, trim colors) are included in the handoff.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the design handoff record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: feedback_notes
attributes.description: General feedback and comments from the receiving team regarding the design handoff. May include suggestions for improvement or clarification requests.

attributes.name: gender_target
attributes.description: Target gender segment for the design. Determines merchandising placement and marketing strategy.

attributes.name: handoff_date
attributes.description: The date when the design package was formally handed off from the design team to the receiving team. Critical gate event marking the end of the design phase.

attributes.name: handoff_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the design handoff, typically formatted as DH-NNNNNN. Used for tracking and reference in cross-functional communications.

attributes.name: handoff_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the design handoff. Tracks the progression from submission through acknowledgment and approval or rejection.

attributes.name: is_confidential
attributes.description: Indicates whether the design handoff contains confidential or proprietary information requiring restricted access. Used for high-profile collaborations or innovative designs.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the design handoff record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change to the record.

attributes.name: material_library_references
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of material codes or references from the PLM material library that are specified in the design. Links to approved fabric and trim options.

attributes.name: outstanding_design_items
attributes.description: List of any outstanding design items, open questions, or pending decisions that need to be resolved by the receiving team. Tracks incomplete elements at handoff.

attributes.name: package_url
attributes.business_glossary_term: Design Handoff Package Uniform Resource Locator (URL)
attributes.description: URL or file path to the complete design handoff package stored in the PLM system or shared drive. Provides access to all handoff materials.

attributes.name: price_tier
attributes.description: Price tier classification for the design (entry, core, premium, luxury). Aligns with brand positioning and target customer segment.

attributes.name: print_files_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether print and pattern artwork files are included in the handoff package. Essential for styles with custom prints or graphics.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority classification for the design handoff. Critical and high priority items receive expedited processing by the receiving team.

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: High-level product category for the design (e.g., tops, bottoms, dresses, outerwear). Used for merchandising and assortment planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: tops|bottoms|dresses|outerwear|activewear|footwear|accessories|swimwear — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: receiving_team
attributes.description: The functional team receiving the design handoff package. Typically product development, sourcing, or technical design team.

attributes.name: rejection_date
attributes.description: Date when the design handoff was rejected by the receiving team. Triggers rework by the design team.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the design handoff was rejected. Provides feedback to the design team for revisions.

attributes.name: season_code
attributes.description: Season identifier for the design handoff (e.g., SS24 for Spring/Summer 2024, FW24 for Fall/Winter 2024). Indicates the target selling season.

attributes.name: silhouette_description
attributes.description: Description of the design silhouette and fit (e.g., slim fit, relaxed, oversized, A-line). Key design characteristic communicated to product development.

attributes.name: style_code
attributes.description: The style or sketch reference code for the design being handed off. Unique identifier for the style within the collection.

attributes.name: sustainability_notes
attributes.description: Notes on sustainability considerations for the design, including use of organic materials, recycled content, or sustainable manufacturing processes. Supports compliance with GOTS, BCI, and OEKO-TEX standards.
attributes.references: Global Organic Textile Standard (GOTS), Better Cotton Initiative (BCI), OEKO-TEX Standard 100

attributes.name: target_launch_date
attributes.description: Target date for the style to be available for sale. Drives the Time and Action calendar for product development and production.

attributes.name: target_price_point
attributes.description: Target retail price point for the design as specified by the design team. Used by product development and sourcing to guide costing decisions.

attributes.name: tech_pack_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether a technical specification package (tech pack) is included in the handoff. Tech packs contain detailed construction, measurement, and material specifications.

attributes.name: tech_pack_version
attributes.description: Version number of the tech pack included in the handoff (e.g., v1.0, v2.3). Tracks iterations and revisions.

attributes.name: reissued_handoff_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on handoff (reissued_handoff_id)

products.name: revision
products.description: Transactional record of a design revision event triggered by a design review decision, fit session feedback, or commercial direction change. Captures the original sketch or CAD file reference, revision number, revision type (silhouette change, colorway change, construction change, print change, trim change), revision instructions, requestor, assigned designer, revision due date, and revision completion status. Maintains the full revision history of each design from concept through final approval.

attributes.name: revision_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the design revision record. Primary key.

attributes.name: assigned_designer_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the designer assigned to execute the revision. Tracks workload distribution and designer accountability.

attributes.name: collection_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product collection this design is part of. Enables analysis of revision patterns by collection.

attributes.name: fit_session_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fit session that generated feedback requiring this revision. Tracks revisions driven by fit and construction issues.

attributes.name: review_id
attributes.description: Reference to the design review session where this revision was discussed or decided. Links revision to formal review process.

attributes.name: reviewer_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the person responsible for reviewing and approving the completed revision. Typically a senior designer or design director.

attributes.name: revision_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the person or role who requested the design revision. May be a merchandiser, product manager, design director, or technical designer.

attributes.name: sketch_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent design being revised. Links to the original design concept or CAD file that is undergoing revision.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the revision was formally approved by the reviewer. Marks the completion of the revision lifecycle.

attributes.name: collaboration_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for team collaboration and communication during the revision process. Captures discussions, decisions, and context.

attributes.name: colorway_change_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of color palette or colorway modifications. Applicable when revision_type is colorway_change.

attributes.name: completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the designer completed the revision work and submitted for review. Marks the end of active design work.

attributes.name: construction_change_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of changes to garment construction, seaming, or assembly methods. Applicable when revision_type is construction_change.

attributes.name: cost_impact_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the estimated cost impact. Examples: USD, EUR, GBP.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this revision record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage.

attributes.name: cycle_time_hours
attributes.description: Total elapsed time in hours from revision request to approval. Key performance indicator for design process efficiency.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Target completion date for the revision. Used to manage design calendar and ensure revisions do not delay collection launch.

attributes.name: estimated_cost_impact
attributes.description: Estimated change in unit cost resulting from this revision. Positive values indicate cost increase, negative values indicate cost reduction.

attributes.name: instructions
attributes.description: Detailed description of the changes requested. Provides specific guidance to the designer on what modifications are needed and why.

attributes.name: is_final_revision
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this is the final approved revision before the design moves to technical design or sampling. True when design is locked for production.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this revision record was last updated. Audit trail for data lineage and change tracking.

attributes.name: original_cad_file_path
attributes.description: Full file system path or cloud storage location of the original CAD design file. Enables designers to access the baseline version for comparison.

attributes.name: print_pattern_change_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of changes to print designs or patterns. Applicable when revision_type is print_change.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Urgency level assigned to this revision. Critical revisions may be required to meet launch deadlines or address safety/compliance issues.

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: High-level product classification for the design being revised. Examples: tops, bottoms, outerwear, footwear, accessories.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Explanation provided when a revision is rejected. Captures feedback for the designer to address in a subsequent iteration.

attributes.name: request_date
attributes.description: Date when the revision was formally requested. Marks the start of the revision lifecycle.

attributes.name: requestor_role
attributes.description: Functional role of the person requesting the revision. Helps analyze which stakeholder groups drive the most design changes.

attributes.name: revised_cad_file_path
attributes.description: Full file system path or cloud storage location of the revised CAD design file. Captures the output of the revision work.

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Sequential revision number for this design, starting from 1. Increments with each revision cycle to maintain version history from concept through final approval.

attributes.name: revision_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the revision request. Tracks progression from initial request through completion or cancellation.

attributes.name: revision_type
attributes.description: Category of design change being requested. Classifies the nature of the revision to track which design elements are most frequently modified.

attributes.name: season_code
attributes.description: Season identifier for the collection this design belongs to. Examples: SS24 (Spring/Summer 2024), FW24 (Fall/Winter 2024).

attributes.name: silhouette_change_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of changes to the garment silhouette or shape. Applicable when revision_type is silhouette_change.

attributes.name: start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the designer began working on the revision. Enables cycle time analysis.

attributes.name: sustainability_impact
attributes.description: Assessment of whether the revision improves, maintains, or reduces the sustainability profile of the design. Tracks alignment with environmental goals.
attributes.references: Global Organic Textile Standard (GOTS), OEKO-TEX Standard 100

attributes.name: technical_feasibility_assessment
attributes.description: Evaluation of whether the requested revision can be manufactured with current capabilities and supplier base. Identifies potential production risks.

attributes.name: trigger
attributes.description: Business event or decision that initiated this revision request. Captures whether the change was driven by design review feedback, fit session results, commercial strategy shift, or other factors.

attributes.name: trim_change_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of changes to trims, buttons, zippers, labels, or other embellishments. Applicable when revision_type is trim_change.

attributes.name: prior_revision_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on revision (prior_revision_id)

products.name: fabric_swatch
products.description: Master record for a physical or digital fabric swatch evaluated during the design phase for potential use in a collection. Captures swatch name, fabric type (woven, knit, denim, jersey, technical), fiber composition, weight (GSM), finish, texture, color, supplier mill, swatch receipt date, designer evaluation notes, adoption decision (selected, shortlisted, rejected), and associated season or concept. Fabric swatches are the material exploration artifacts that precede formal material sourcing.

attributes.name: fabric_swatch_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fabric swatch record. Primary key for the fabric swatch entity.

attributes.name: assigned_designer_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the designer responsible for evaluating and making decisions about the fabric swatch.

attributes.name: concept_id

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `apparel_fashion_ecm`.`_metrics`.`compliance_audit`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Compliance audit performance metrics tracking audit completion, findings severity, compliance scores, and cost efficiency across factories, suppliers, and regulatory programs"
  source: "`apparel_fashion_ecm`.`compliance`.`audit`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "audit_type"
      expr: audit_type
      comment: "Type of compliance audit conducted (social, environmental, quality, safety)"
    - name: "audit_status"
      expr: audit_status
      comment: "Current status of the audit (scheduled, in-progress, completed, closed)"
    - name: "auditor_organization"
      expr: auditor_organization
      comment: "Organization conducting the audit"
    - name: "program"
      expr: program
      comment: "Compliance program or standard being audited against"
    - name: "region"
      expr: region
      comment: "Geographic region of the audited facility"
    - name: "country_code"
      expr: country_code
      comment: "Country where audit was conducted"
    - name: "risk_level"
      expr: risk_level
      comment: "Risk classification of the audit (low, medium, high, critical)"
    - name: "overall_rating"
      expr: overall_rating
      comment: "Overall audit rating or grade"
    - name: "certification_status"
      expr: certification_status
      comment: "Certification status resulting from audit"
    - name: "approved_for_production_flag"
      expr: approved_for_production_flag
      comment: "Whether facility is approved for production based on audit results"
    - name: "corrective_action_required_flag"
      expr: corrective_action_required_flag
      comment: "Whether corrective actions are required"
    - name: "follow_up_audit_required_flag"
      expr: follow_up_audit_required_flag
      comment: "Whether a follow-up audit is required"
    - name: "audit_year"
      expr: YEAR(audit_date)
      comment: "Year the audit was conducted"
    - name: "audit_quarter"
      expr: CONCAT('Q', QUARTER(audit_date))
      comment: "Quarter the audit was conducted"
    - name: "audit_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', audit_date)
      comment: "Month the audit was conducted"
  measures:
    - name: "total_audits"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of compliance audits conducted"
    - name: "total_audit_cost"
      expr: SUM(CAST(cost_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total cost of all audits in local currencies"
    - name: "avg_audit_cost"
      expr: AVG(CAST(cost_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average cost per audit"
    - name: "avg_compliance_percentage"
      expr: AVG(CAST(compliance_percentage AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average compliance percentage across all audits - key performance indicator for supplier quality"
    - name: "avg_overall_score"
      expr: AVG(CAST(overall_score AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average overall audit score - primary metric for audit performance"
    - name: "total_critical_findings"
      expr: SUM(CAST(critical_findings_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total count of critical findings across all audits - highest severity issues requiring immediate action"
    - name: "total_major_findings"
      expr: SUM(CAST(major_findings_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total count of major findings - significant compliance gaps"
    - name: "total_minor_findings"
      expr: SUM(CAST(minor_findings_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total count of minor findings - lower severity issues"
    - name: "audits_requiring_corrective_action"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN corrective_action_required_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of audits requiring corrective action plans"
    - name: "corrective_action_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN corrective_action_required_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of audits requiring corrective action - indicator of supplier compliance quality"
    - name: "audits_requiring_follow_up"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN follow_up_audit_required_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of audits requiring follow-up audits"
    - name: "follow_up_audit_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN follow_up_audit_required_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of audits requiring follow-up - measure of initial audit failure rate"
    - name: "production_approved_audits"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN approved_for_production_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of audits resulting in production approval"
    - name: "production_approval_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN approved_for_production_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of audits resulting in production approval - key supplier qualification metric"
    - name: "distinct_factories_audited"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT production_factory_id)
      comment: "Number of unique production facilities audited"
    - name: "distinct_suppliers_audited"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT vendor_id)
      comment: "Number of unique suppliers audited"
$$
metric_views.description: Compliance audit performance metrics tracking audit completion, findings severity, compliance scores, and cost efficiency across factories, suppliers, and regulatory programs

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `apparel_fashion_ecm`.`_metrics`.`compliance_audit_finding`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$

  source: "`apparel_fashion_ecm`.`compliance`.`compliance_audit_finding`"

    - name: "severity_level"

    - name: "finding_status"
